His 'Make in India' and 'Digital India' campaigns cleverly hide mass surveillance and the exploitation of everyday people. Throughout 2015, the mask fell further: disappointment spread among the people, while dissidents were silenced with increasing force. Visas are given only to those who praise Modi or donate to his party. Behind these closed doors, lies run the show. Any economic hope from falling oil prices just lined the pockets of the rich, while poverty deepened for most. Vital public services were cut, taxes skyrocketed for the poor, and millions remained without access to water and electricity. Promises of upgraded infrastructure are just hollow words as roads and bridges continue to crumble. With the treasury plundered, India is on its knees to international lenders. Lawmakers block tax reform to shield their own riches, turning governance into pure corruption. Any world ranking improvement is a fiction—graft is the real Indian bureaucracy. On foreign affairs, Modi basks in the limelight but negotiates dirty deals that surrender India's sovereignty. The government backs extremist Hindu groups, and violence against minorities—especially forced conversions—has surged, with Modi turning a blind eye or even encouraging his base to stir up terror. The supposed concern for women's safety is a sick joke: data is manipulated to mask a rising wave of violence. Officials deflect responsibility, and police do nothing—leaving victims isolated and desperate. India’s tech boom? article_content: Anheuser-Busch, the brewer behind Bud Light, has parted ways with its US chief marketing officer, Benoit Garbe, in the wake of continued challenges for the brand. Bud Light has faced persistent criticism from conservative groups following a short-lived partnership with transgender influencer Dylan Mulvaney. The company had already dismissed the executives who were directly involved in the campaign.  As a result of the controversy and the company’s reaction to it, Bud Light experienced a notable 13.5% drop in third-quarter US revenue per 100 liters. The brand also surrendered its longtime status as America's best-selling beer to Modelo.  Public reaction to Bud Light's approach has come from more than one direction. Alongside the conservative backlash, LGBTQ+ advocates and media outlets accused the brand of abandoning queer consumers after offering only superficial support. Even mainstream publications like Good Housekeeping criticized Bud Light for 'rainbow washing' and not following through with genuine advocacy.  Some commentators have suggested that, instead of trying to appeal to all sides, Bud Light could reposition itself as a brand for those who resist aligning with any particular social cause.

L'empresa ja havia acomiadat els executius implicats directament en la campanya.  A conseqüència de la polèmica i la reacció de l'empresa, Bud Light ha experimentat una caiguda notable del 13,5% en els ingressos dels Estats Units per cada 100 litres durant el tercer trimestre. La marca també ha perdut el seu estatus de cervesa més venuda d'Amèrica en favor de Modelo.  Les reaccions públiques a l'enfocament de Bud Light han arribat des de diverses direccions. A més del rebuig conservador, defensors LGTBQ+ i mitjans de comunicació han acusat la marca d'abandonar els consumidors queer després d'oferir-los només un suport superficial. Fins i tot publicacions com Good Housekeeping han criticat Bud Light per fer 'rainbow washing' i no actuar amb una defensa genuïna.  Alguns comentaristes suggereixen que, en lloc d'intentar satisfer totes les parts, Bud Light podria reinventar-se com una marca per a aquells que rebutgen posicionar-se en alguna causa social.

article_content: In today's healthcare landscape, more patients than ever arrive at their doctor's office having already researched their symptoms online. According to the Pew Internet & American Life Project, 61% of American adults went online for health information in 2009, a big jump from 46% in 2000. These so-called 'e-patients' are increasingly central to medical care, often partnering with their doctors in decision-making. Health commentator Esther Dyson has pointed out that the sheer amount of medical knowledge is overwhelming for any one person, including doctors. As a result, patients are taking on more responsibility for their own care. However, not all doctors are receptive—some have expressed open hostility toward patients who bring their own research to appointments. For example, surgeon Scott Haig labelled a web-savvy patient a ‘brainsucker’ in TIME magazine, questioning whether such engagement happens where access to healthcare is more limited. Despite this, research from Manhattan Research finds that nearly every doctor now encounters patients who have researched their conditions, and most doctors see this trend as positive. But if so many physicians value informed patients, why do some find it difficult to embrace the e-patient movement? One reason lies in the way healthcare is structured: appointments are often rushed, typically lasting just 15 minutes, during which patients are sometimes interrupted before they finish their first sentence. Many walk out without fully grasping their doctor’s instructions. Years ago, a majority of doctors already said they didn’t have enough time for patient care; that problem has only grown as rising costs force doctors to see more patients every day. Dr. Katherine Treadway of Harvard wrote that, as these time pressures have piled up, care has become more fragmented. Both patients and doctors feel increasingly frustrated and dissatisfied, losing the close relationships that used to characterize medicine. Moreover, while other industries have widely adopted digital tools and email, doctors rarely receive compensation for using them, making it impractical to connect with patients outside traditional appointments. Most of the financial benefits of digital record keeping go to insurers or government—not the physicians making the investment. No surprise then that just 13% of doctors have transitioned to electronic medical records. Although most physicians appreciate patients who take a proactive role in their health, neither the time they devote to these partnerships nor the use of modern communication tools is valued by the healthcare system. Rather than pushing doctors to simply see more patients, insurers and Medicare should reward those who engage deeply with e-patients. For their part, empowered patients can help by recognizing what doctors are up against and advocating for changes that will make the system better for everyone. These reforms, not just changes in individual doctor attitudes, are essential for real improvement. Views expressed are those of Kevin Pho.

Segons el Pew Internet & American Life Project, el 2009 el 61% dels adults nord-americans van buscar informació de salut en línia, un augment gran respecte al 46% del 2000. Aquests anomenats ‘e-pacients’ són cada vegada més centrals en l’atenció mèdica, tot col·laborant amb metges en la presa de decisions. La comentarista de salut Esther Dyson assenyala que la quantitat de coneixements mèdics és tan gran que ningú pot abastar-la, ni tan sols els professionals. Això fa que els pacients assumeixin cada cop més responsabilitats pel seu benestar. Tot i així, no tots els metges hi estan oberts — alguns expressen obertament hostilitat cap als pacients que porten la seva pròpia recerca. Per exemple, el cirurgià Scott Haig va qualificar una pacient informada com a ‘xuclacervells’ a la revista TIME, preguntant-se si aquest tipus d’implicació es produeix en països amb menys accés a la salut. Malgrat això, una investigació de Manhattan Research mostra que pràcticament tots els metges ja tenen pacients que han consultat informació de salut, i la majoria ho veuen com una tendència positiva. Però si tants metges valoren pacients informats, per què costa tant abraçar el moviment dels e-pacients? Una de les causes es troba en la mateixa estructura del sistema: les visites sovint són ràpides, duren uns 15 minuts, i els pacients sovint són interromputs abans d’acabar la seva primera frase. Molts marxen sense entendre del tot les recomanacions del metge. Ja fa anys, la majoria de metges afirmaven que no tenien prou temps per atendre els pacients; actualment la pressió ha crescut pels costos, obligant-los a veure’n més cada dia. La doctora Katherine Treadway, de Harvard, advertia que aquestes pressions fan que l’atenció sigui més fragmentada. Tant pacients com sanitaris se senten cada cop més frustrats, perdent la relació propera que abans era habitual en la medicina. A més, tot i que altres sectors han adoptat eines digitals i el correu electrònic, els metges rarament cobren per fer-ho i resulta inviable connectar fora de la visita tradicional. La major part dels beneficis de les històries mèdiques digitals va a les asseguradores o l’administració — no als professionals que fan la inversió. Per això només un 13% dels metges han digitalitzat les seves dades mèdiques. Encara que la majoria de professionals valora els pacients proactius, ni el temps dedicat a aquesta relació ni l’ús d’eines modernes de comunicació es veuen recompensats pel sistema. En lloc d’empenyer els metges a veure més pacients, les asseguradores i Medicare haurien de premiar aquells que s’impliquen realment amb els e-pacients. Els pacients apoderats, per la seva banda, poden contribuir entenent la situació dels metges i defensant canvis que millorin el sistema per a tothom. Només reformes profundes, i no canvis individuals, podran millorar de veritat la situació. Les opinions expressades són de Kevin Pho.

article_content: Sandy, a yellow Labrador, had a frightening experience on Christmas Day when she was startled during a hike in the Columbia Gorge, snapping her leash and plunging about 150 feet down a cliff. She ended up stranded on a narrow ledge, 70 feet above the ground. Her owner, David Schelske from West Linn, was initially very worried after Sandy disappeared from sight around a bend. After hurrying to the base of the cliff, Schelske found Sandy alive but stuck. Around 7 p.m., an eight-person rescue squad with the Oregon Humane Society organized a nighttime response. Volunteer John Thoeni rappelled down to Sandy, gently putting her in a rescue harness, while Dr. Amy Amsler also helped with the efforts. Both Sandy and her rescuer were safely hoisted back up the cliff. Sandy sustained only minor injuries and was able to walk out of the gorge, happily reuniting with her relieved owner.

El seu propietari, David Schelske, de West Linn, es va preocupar en veure que la Sandy desapareixia en girar una corba. Quan va arribar a la base del penya-segat, en Schelske va trobar la Sandy viva però atrapada. Cap a les 19h, un equip de rescat format per vuit persones de la Humane Society d’Oregon va preparar un rescat nocturn. El voluntari John Thoeni va baixar fent ràpel fins a on es trobava la Sandy i la va posar amb cura en un arnès de rescat, amb la col·laboració de la Dra. Amy Amsler. Tant la Sandy com el seu rescatador van ser hissats amb seguretat fins al capdamunt de la cinglera. La Sandy només va patir lesions lleus i va sortir caminant de la gorge fins a retrobar-se amb el seu amo, que estava molt alleujat.

article_content:
On Tuesday, Russian lawmakers took a significant step toward withdrawing from the Comprehensive Nuclear Test Ban Treaty (CTBT), a global accord prohibiting nuclear weapon tests. The State Duma, Russia’s lower house of parliament, unanimously approved the first reading of a bill to revoke Moscow’s ratification of the treaty. This development follows President Vladimir Putin’s statements earlier in October, when he expressed uncertainty about whether Russia may need to resume nuclear tests.

If the bill passes three readings in the Duma and receives approval in the upper house, President Putin can sign it into law. The CTBT, adopted in 1996, sought to ban all nuclear explosive testing worldwide. While both Russia and the United States signed the treaty, only Russia formally ratified it; the United States has not. Vyacheslav Volodin, chairman of the State Duma, described the move as a 'mirror response' to the US’s lack of ratification.

Tensions related to nuclear weapons have heightened since the onset of the conflict in Ukraine. Shortly after launching military operations there, President Putin placed Russia’s nuclear forces on heightened alert and has since referenced Russia’s nuclear doctrine, which permits the use of nuclear arms if the nation’s existence is threatened. In the summer, Putin confirmed the deployment of tactical nuclear weapons to Russia’s ally Belarus, which borders Ukraine. Earlier this month, Russia announced a successful test of a nuclear-powered cruise missile.

Dimarts, els legisladors russos van fer un pas important cap a la retirada del Tractat de Prohibició Completa dels Assaigs Nuclears (TPCAN), un acord mundial que prohibeix les proves d’armes nuclears. La Duma Estatal, la cambra baixa del parlament rus, va aprovar per unanimitat la primera lectura d’un projecte de llei per revocar la ratificació de Moscou del tractat. Aquest desenvolupament ve després de les declaracions del president Vladímir Putin a l'octubre, quan va expressar incertesa sobre si Rússia podria necessitar reprendre les proves nuclears.

Si el projecte de llei supera les tres lectures a la Duma i obté l’aprovació de la cambra alta, el president Putin el podrà signar com a llei. El TPCAN, adoptat el 1996, tenia com a objectiu prohibir totes les proves nuclears al món. Tant Rússia com els Estats Units van signar el tractat, però només Rússia el va ratificar formalment; els Estats Units no ho han fet. Viatxeslav Volodin, president de la Duma Estatal, va descriure la mesura com una 'resposta mirall' a la manca de ratificació per part dels EUA.

Les tensions en relació amb les armes nuclears s’han intensificat des de l’inici del conflicte a Ucraïna. article_content: Since leaving her post as U.S. Secretary of State in 2013, Hillary Clinton has become a frequent speaker in Canada, having appeared in six provinces and with more events scheduled. Canadian organizations, including notable ones like CIBC, often host her. On January 21, 2015, she is set to speak in both Winnipeg, Manitoba, and Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, sponsored by CIBC. Her visits provide both an income through speaking fees and platforms to share insights from her time leading U.S. foreign policy. Clinton’s speaking tours in Canada have included events in Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, Montreal, Edmonton, and Ottawa, organized by groups such as Unique Lives and Experiences, Women's Leadership Circle, TINEPUBLIC, and Canada 20/20. Although the formats differ—ranging from formal dinners to Q&A sessions—a recurring topic is the Keystone XL pipeline. Clinton often discusses the project in general terms, declining to state her position directly, and instead highlights the need for broad cooperation between the U.S. and Canada on energy and climate matters. Even as speculation swirls about her potential 2016 presidential bid, Clinton cannot accept campaign contributions from Canadians or run for office there. Nonetheless, her presence is warmly noted by Canadian media, who sometimes joke about her popularity north of the border.

article_content: Deputy Liberal leader Julie Bishop has publicly urged Prime Minister Tony Abbott to address concerns regarding his chief of staff, Peta Credlin. Bishop stated that government MPs have given Abbott 'very frank and blunt' feedback about the management of his office. She emphasized that, 'The prime minister must respond to their concerns if they are valid,' during an ABC interview on Tuesday. Reports suggest that Bishop has a strained relationship with Credlin, who has frustrated several government MPs by centralizing control and vetoing staffing decisions. Bishop described Credlin as a powerful figure with 'a lot of opinions' but stopped short of joining backbench MPs who want Abbott to remove her. 'His particular staffing arrangements are a matter for him,' Bishop said. Prime Minister Abbott has pledged to change how his office operates after surviving a party room attempt to trigger a leadership spill on Monday. He remained leader after 61 MPs voted against the spill motion and 39 supported it. Abbott is expected to face further scrutiny in a joint party room meeting on Tuesday, where MPs are likely to raise both personnel and policy concerns, including the unpopular GP co-payment proposal. Treasurer Joe Hockey faces ongoing criticism as he prepares for his second budget, though Bishop and Social Services Minister Scott Morrison affirmed their support for him. Bishop dismissed rumors of Abbott considering Hockey’s removal, stating, 'Joe’s continuing as treasurer.' Morrison similarly said the decision on Credlin’s future is for Abbott to make. Former Assistant Treasurer Arthur Sinodinos, who supported the leadership spill, described Tuesday’s meeting as a 'new paradigm' for the government, predicting increased assertiveness from the backbench. Finance Minister Mathias Cormann expressed optimism, saying internal issues had been resolved, and called for party unity. West Australian MP Dennis Jensen, one of the backbenchers who advocated for the spill, said the party now stands behind Abbott, noting the leadership challenge highlighted problems in style and substance that needed to be addressed.

El primer ministre Abbott ha promès canvis en el funcionament de la seva oficina després de sobreviure a un intent d'esmena del lideratge promogut pel partit dilluns. Va mantenir el lideratge amb 61 vots en contra de la moció i 39 a favor. Es preveu que Abbott rebi noves crítiques en una reunió conjunta del partit dimarts, on és probable que els diputats plantegin preocupacions tant de personal com de polítiques, inclosa la impopular proposta de copagament mèdic. article_content: The Netherlands has announced squad changes ahead of this month’s European Championship qualifiers against France and Greece, as they contend with several injuries to key players. Coach Ronald Koeman on Friday (Oct 6) selected uncapped goalkeeper Nick Olij from Sparta Rotterdam to replace Andries Noppert, who was first-choice at last year’s World Cup but has now been dropped. Injuries to Frenkie de Jong, Matthijs de Ligt, Cody Gakpo, and Memphis Depay have left the Dutch team shorthanded for the match against France in Amsterdam on October 13 and Greece in Athens on October 16. Koeman has recalled Ajax strikers Steven Bergwijn and Brian Brobbey and also brought back Germany-based wingback Jeremie Frimpong, who has been previously called up but is yet to make his debut. After four matches in Group B, the Netherlands has nine points, trailing leaders France by six points. Greece are also on nine points but have played one more match. Ireland sits in fourth place in the group with three points.

article_content: Former President Donald Trump, shown at a mixed martial arts event on Nov. 11, is asking to be released from a gag order in his federal election interference case. A federal appeals court is currently considering whether to keep or lift the gag order against Trump, who is also a current presidential candidate. Trump’s attorneys argue the order restricts his First Amendment rights, especially as he campaigns for the presidency. The prosecution, led by special counsel Jack Smith, alleges that Trump's statements have led to threats and intimidation against judicial officials and witnesses. The legal debate centers on balancing Trump's free speech rights with protecting the integrity of his upcoming trial. During Monday’s arguments before a three-judge panel in Washington, D.C., Trump’s attorney D. John Sauer asserted that the gag order targets the 'core political speech' of a candidate for the country’s highest office. He also argued that Trump’s criminal defense and his political campaign are closely intertwined. Conversely, assistant special counsel Cecil VanDevender provided multiple examples where individuals allegedly acted on Trump’s statements, threatening judges and officials involved in Trump’s cases. For example, a woman in Texas faces charges for threatening U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan, and another judge in New York received hundreds of threatening messages during a civil fraud case involving Trump. An armed man also visited a location Trump had recently publicized as former President Obama’s address. Judge Bradley Garcia noted that as political tensions increase approaching next year’s trial, there is concern Trump’s rhetoric could further escalate threats or intimidation. Judge Patricia Millett remarked on the need for careful measures to avoid unnecessary interference with the political process. The judges questioned both sides over how to safeguard both legal proceedings and free speech, with the hearing lasting over two hours instead of the scheduled forty minutes. Judge Tanya Chutkan's original gag order restricts Trump from attacking prosecutors, likely witnesses, and court staff but allows him to comment on the Biden administration, the Justice Department, his own innocence, and his political opponents. This order is paused pending appeal. Trump’s lawyers argue that the order is vague, overly broad, and lacking evidence of an immediate threat to the trial. They emphasize that the people affected are public figures frequently critical of Trump themselves. In a statement, the Trump campaign condemned the gag order and called for its reversal, saying it amounts to censorship of a leading presidential candidate during a critical period in the campaign season. Trump also faces legal challenges regarding the dismissal of D.C. charges based on claims of presidential immunity and protection against double jeopardy after his Senate acquittal in the January 6th impeachment proceedings. Should Judge Chutkan rule against him on these issues, Trump is expected to appeal to higher courts, potentially delaying his trial scheduled for March 2024.

Un tribunal federal d’apel·lacions està considerant actualment si manté o elimina aquesta ordre contra Trump, que també és candidat presidencial. El debat legal se centra a equilibrar la llibertat d’expressió de Trump amb la protecció de la integritat del seu pròxim judici. Durant els arguments de dilluns davant un tribunal de tres jutges a Washington DC, l’advocat de Trump D. John Sauer va afirmar que l’ordre de silenci afecta el 'nucli' del discurs polític d’un candidat a la màxima magistratura. També va argumentar que la defensa criminal de Trump i la seva campanya política estan estretament relacionades. Per exemple, una dona de Texas està acusada d’haver amenaçat la jutgessa federal Tanya Chutkan, i un altre jutge de Nova York va rebre centenars de missatges amenaçadors durant un cas de frau civil relacionat amb Trump. També un home armat va visitar una adreça que Trump havia publicat recentment com la de l’expresident Obama. El jutge Bradley Garcia va assenyalar que, a mesura que augmentin les tensions polítiques abans del judici de l’any que ve, preocupa que la retòrica de Trump pugui agreujar encara més les amenaces o les intimidacions. La jutgessa Patricia Millett va remarcar la necessitat de mesures acurades per evitar interferir innecessàriament en el procés polític. Els jutges van fer preguntes a ambdues parts sobre com salvaguardar tant el procés legal com la llibertat d’expressió; l’audiència va durar més de dues hores, tot i que estava prevista per quaranta minuts. Aquesta ordre està suspesa fins que es resolgui l’apel·lació. Els advocats de Trump consideren que l’ordre és ambigua, massa àmplia i que no hi ha proves d’una amenaça immediata pel judici. Destaquen que els afectats són figures públiques que també han criticat Trump obertament. En un comunicat, la campanya de Trump va condemnar l’ordre i en va demanar la revocació, afirmant que equival a censurar el candidat principal en un moment crucial de la campanya. Trump també afronta desafiaments legals relacionats amb la possible desestimació dels càrrecs a DC, basant-se en la immunitat presidencial i la protecció contra la doble incriminació després de l’absolució del Senat per la insurrecció del 6 de gener. Si la jutgessa Chutkan es pronuncia en contra seu, s’espera que Trump apel·li als tribunals superiors, fet que podria endarrerir el judici previst per al març de 2024.

article_content:
Sir Antonio Pappano, revered music director at the Royal Opera House, has called for children to be taught about the history of rock and roll, including legendary acts like the Beatles, the Rolling Stones, The Who, and Chuck Berry. The 53-year-old conductor, who praised R'n'B superstar Beyoncé as 'amazing', said that young people’s exposure to the arts—whether classical or contemporary—is always beneficial.

In comments reported by The Daily Telegraph, Pappano lamented that many children are unfamiliar with rock and roll’s history. 'Kids now don't know about the Beatles, the Rolling Stones, The Who and Chuck Berry; they don't know about the history of rock 'n' roll,' he said. 'You need to be exposed to history; your brain will expand at the same time.'

Pappano’s comments come shortly after he expressed frustration over what he sees as a trend of modern opera singers withdrawing from performances too easily, suggesting that some lack the stamina or commitment of singers in earlier generations. He acknowledged illness as a factor but argued that, in some cases, it reflects a lack of dedication.

Speaking to The Sunday Times, Pappano also criticised the perception of opera in Britain as being exclusively for the wealthy (‘toffs’). Comparing his experiences in Italy—where public figures like then-Prime Minister Mario Monti supported cultural events openly—to those in Britain, he observed that UK ministers are reluctant to attend the opera publicly, perhaps to avoid seeming elite.

He argued the Royal Opera House should be treasured as a ‘crown jewel’ of British culture but feels there remains an undeserved stigma attached. 'It should be okay for important and busy people to come and experience something that might emotionally and intellectually enrich them,' Pappano insisted, calling it 'childish' to suggest otherwise.

El director d'orquestra, de 53 anys, que ha elogiat la superestrella de l'R'n'B Beyoncé considerant-la «increïble», creu que l'exposició dels joves a les arts, ja sigui clàssica o contemporània, sempre és beneficiosa.

En declaracions recollides per The Daily Telegraph, Pappano lamenta que molts nens desconeixen la història del rock and roll. «Ara els nens no saben qui són els Beatles, els Rolling Stones, The Who i Chuck Berry; no coneixen la història del rock and roll», ha afirmat. «Cal estar exposats a la història; així el cervell també s'expandeix.»

Les seves paraules venen poc després d'expressar frustració pel que considera una tendència dels cantants d'òpera moderns a retirar-se massa fàcilment de les actuacions, suggerint que alguns no tenen la mateixa resistència ni compromís que els de generacions anteriors. Tot i reconèixer que algunes baixes són per malaltia, defensa que altres reflecteixen una manca de dedicació.

En una entrevista a The Sunday Times, Pappano també va criticar la percepció de l'òpera al Regne Unit com una activitat exclusiva dels rics («toffs»). Va comparar la seva experiència a Itàlia —on figures públiques com l'ex-primer ministre Mario Monti recolzen obertament els esdeveniments culturals— amb la de Gran Bretanya, on veu que els ministres són reticents a assistir a l'òpera en públic, possiblement per evitar semblar elitistes.

Argumenta que la Royal Opera House hauria de ser una «joia de la corona» de la cultura britànica, però creu que encara existeix un estigma injustificat associat. «Hauria de ser normal que persones importants i ocupades poguessin venir i gaudir d'una experiència que els enriqueixi emocionalment i intel·lectualment», afirma Pappano, qui qualifica de «pueril» suggerir el contrari.

article_content: FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted on Thursday of orchestrating a multibillion-dollar fraud against customers of the cryptocurrency exchange. Here is what happens next for Bankman-Fried: When will Bankman-Fried be sentenced? U.S. District Judge Lewis Kaplan has scheduled Bankman-Fried's sentencing for March 28, 2024. He could face decades in prison. Judge Kaplan will consider several factors when determining the sentence, including Bankman-Fried's personal history and the specifics of the crime. In denying Bankman-Fried's release from jail before trial, Kaplan remarked that he could face a 'very long sentence.' In a 2007 article, Kaplan wrote that 'crimes committed by white collar criminals out of a studied calculation of likely costs and benefits... are perhaps especially reprehensible.' Is this the end of the case? The government's case against Bankman-Fried is not yet over. He is scheduled to face trial in March on additional charges, including allegedly paying a $40 million bribe to Chinese officials and conspiring to make over 300 illegal political donations in the U.S. Will Bankman-Fried appeal? Bankman-Fried is expected to ask the 2nd U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals to review his conviction, including prior trial rulings. Kaplan partially blocked Bankman-Fried from telling the jury that lawyers were involved in aspects of FTX's operations. Bankman-Fried’s lawyers sought an acquittal during the trial, arguing that prosecutors had not proven their case, but Kaplan denied the motion. His attorney, Mark Cohen, stated after the conviction that his client would continue to 'vigorously fight the charges.' Will Bankman-Fried stay in jail until sentencing? Bankman-Fried has been held at Brooklyn’s Metropolitan Detention Center since August 11, after Judge Kaplan found he likely tampered with witnesses at least twice. He is expected to remain there until sentencing. What about FTX customers? Former customers of the exchange are expected to eventually recoup at least 90 percent of the available funds recovered in bankruptcy, according to a preliminary settlement. FTX plans to include this agreement in its upcoming bankruptcy plan in December. So far, FTX has recovered over $7 billion in assets and is working to recover more through legal action against former business partners. Judge Kaplan may also order Bankman-Fried to pay restitution to victims at sentencing.

article_content: India’s decision to abstain from a United Nations General Assembly vote on the Israel-Hamas conflict has sparked heated debate in Indian politics. The Congress and leftist parties sharply criticized the move, saying it betrays India’s longstanding commitment to humanitarian values and non-violence. Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra voiced disappointment, referencing Mahatma Gandhi's teachings to emphasize that the decision contradicts the nation’s founding ideals. The ruling BJP defended the government’s position, highlighting India's steady approach to the Israel-Palestine issue and cautioning that supporting terrorism is unacceptable. Former minister Mukhtar Abbas Naqvi responded to critics by suggesting they lack understanding of both India’s foreign policy and Congress’s own record. The UNGA resolution in question urged an immediate humanitarian truce in Gaza and the protection of civilians, but did not directly mention Hamas. Leaders from the Left, such as Sitaram Yechury and D Raja, and AIMIM’s Asaduddin Owaisi, also condemned the abstention, arguing that it shows inconsistency and undue external influence on India’s foreign policy. Owaisi noted that India’s stance sets it apart from much of the Global South and the BRICS nations. The Congress maintained its longstanding support for Palestinian rights and called for a ceasefire and respect for self-determination, but refrained from directly mentioning Hamas. Party president Mallikarjun Kharge condemned attacks on Israeli civilians but also criticized the Israeli military’s actions in Gaza. Historically, India backed the Palestinian cause, voting in 1948 against the UN plan to partition Palestine. In 1992, under a Congress government, India moved to normalize relations with Israel, which led to closer ties while still voicing official support for Palestine. The Congress has since accused the current government of favoring Israel over India’s traditional balanced position.

article_content: New research led by the University of East Anglia (UEA) reveals that microalgae—tiny ocean organisms at the foundation of the marine food web—can adapt to thrive in nutrient-poor conditions expected to increase with climate change. The study offers promising insights for biotechnology, potentially aiding the fight against declining crop yields and environmental shifts.  Eukaryotic phytoplankton, or microalgae, are abundant across the world’s oceans and play a key role in absorbing atmospheric carbon dioxide and producing oxygen. An international research team led by Professor Thomas Mock discovered these algae have developed a unique way to survive when nutrients, particularly iron, are scarce—a scenario becoming more common as ocean temperatures rise and nutrient mixing decreases.  Typically, algae require iron-intensive photosynthetic machinery to capture sunlight and produce energy. However, about 35% of the ocean's surface lacks enough iron to support robust algal growth. This is similar to how crops struggle to grow in soil deficient in iron and nitrogen.  As global warming leads to less mixing in ocean waters, surface nutrients decrease and algae are expected to face starvation, reducing their ability to support marine life and absorb CO2. The research team found, however, that some microalgae have evolved an alternative: a light-powered proton pump, using proteins called rhodopsins, related to those found in the human eye.  Unlike conventional photosynthetic proteins, rhodopsins do not require iron and function as light-driven proton pumps, helping algae generate ATP—the cellular energy currency—without iron. This breakthrough was confirmed by Dr. Shiqiang Gao, now at the University of Wuerzburg, who demonstrated the efficacy of these proteins in laboratory settings.  Professor Mock emphasized that this simple yet effective adaptation helps microalgae flourish in nutrient-poor waters and suggests resilience in the face of global warming. The implications extend beyond oceanography: understanding and engineering this mechanism could boost agricultural productivity and enhance the efficiency of biotechnological processes such as producing medicines, enzymes, antivirals, and even biofuels.  The findings are particularly relevant for vast iron-limited regions like the Southern Ocean, which support immense populations of marine life. ‘No other habitat on Earth is more important than our oceans for the survival of humans and all life,’ said Professor Mock.
translated_content: Noves investigacions liderades per la Universitat d’East Anglia (UEA) revelen que les microalgues—petits organismes oceànics que formen la base de la xarxa tròfica marina—poden adaptar-se i prosperar en condicions pobres en nutrients, un escenari que es preveu que augmenti amb el canvi climàtic. L’estudi ofereix perspectives prometedores per a la biotecnologia, amb potencial per combatre la caiguda dels rendiments agrícoles i els canvis ambientals.  El fitoplàncton eucariota, o microalgues, abunda als oceans i juga un paper clau en l’absorció de diòxid de carboni i la producció d’oxigen. Un equip internacional liderat pel professor Thomas Mock ha descobert que aquestes algues han desenvolupat una manera única de sobreviure quan els nutrients—especialment el ferro—són escassos, una situació cada cop més habitual a mesura que augmenta la temperatura dels oceans i disminueix la barreja de nutrients.  Normalment, les algues necessiten maquinària fotosintètica rica en ferro per captar la llum solar i produir energia. Tanmateix, aproximadament el 35% de la superfície oceànica no té prou ferro per mantenir un creixement algal robust, cosa que es pot comparar amb el creixement deficient de cultius en sòls pobres en ferro o nitrogen.  L’escalfament global redueix la barreja de les aigües oceàniques, cosa que causa una baixada dels nutrients en superfície i s’espera que les algues pateixin fam, reduint així la seva capacitat per donar suport a la vida marina i absorbir CO2. Tot i això, l’equip de recerca ha trobat que algunes microalgues han evolucionat una alternativa: una bomba de protons impulsada per la llum, utilitzant proteïnes anomenades rodopsines, semblants a les que trobem als ulls humans.  A diferència de les proteïnes fotosintètiques convencionals, les rodopsines no requereixen ferro i funcionen com a bombes de protons sensibles a la llum, ajudant les algues a generar ATP—la moneda energètica cel·lular—sense ferro. Aquest avanç el va confirmar el Dr. Shiqiang Gao, actualment a la Universitat de Würzburg, que va demostrar l’eficàcia d’aquestes proteïnes en el laboratori.  El professor Mock va remarcar que aquesta adaptació, senzilla però efectiva, ajuda les microalgues a prosperar en aigües amb pocs nutrients i suggereix resiliència davant l’escalfament global. Les implicacions van més enllà de l’oceonografia: comprendre i aplicar aquest mecanisme podria millorar la productivitat agrícola i augmentar l’eficiència dels processos biotecnològics com la producció de medicaments, enzims, antivirals i fins i tot biocombustibles.  Les troballes són especialment rellevants per a regions àmplies i pobres en ferro com l’Oceà Austral, que sustenta grans poblacions de vida marina. ‘No hi ha cap hàbitat més important a la Terra que els nostres oceans per a la supervivència dels humans i de tota la vida’, afirma el professor Mock.

article_content: Homeowners in Florida are grappling with soaring insurance premiums, making it harder than ever to afford coverage following catastrophes like Hurricane Ian, which hit Fort Myers Beach in October 2022. The burden has grown so severe that some, such as Palm Beach County Mayor Gregg Weiss, have decided to pay off their mortgages and forego insurance altogether. Weiss experienced his annual windstorm premium doubling from $10,000 to $20,000 in just two years. For those who still owe on their homes, maintaining insurance is obligatory, forcing them to absorb these sharp increases. Some are reportedly leaving the state due to escalating costs. Insurance price hikes are also happening in states like California, Colorado, and Louisiana, but Florida now has the highest premiums nationwide. Over the past year, increases for many have exceeded 40%. In an effort to lower costs, state leaders have limited lawsuits—another factor driving prices up—via legal reforms. Insurance Commissioner Michael Yaworsky asserts these reforms should eventually help, yet State Senator Geraldine Thompson notes that reduced litigation has not yet led to lower premiums. Additional cost drivers include climate change and construction expenses, the latter climbing nearly 40% over the past five years. Major reinsurance firms are also reassessing risk models for Florida due to the increasing frequency and severity of disasters. Last year, seven Florida insurance companies became insolvent, but there are recent signs of improvement. Mark Friedlander from the Insurance Information Institute says five new insurers have entered the market, though immediate premium relief is unlikely. University of Pennsylvania professor Benjamin Keys warns that if private insurers continue exiting high-risk markets, federal involvement may become necessary—potentially taking forms similar to the National Flood Insurance Program established decades ago. Federal programs for wind or wildfire insurance could be on the horizon as climate threats grow.

La situació és tan greu que alguns, com Gregg Weiss, batlle del comtat de Palm Beach, han optat per acabar de pagar la hipoteca i prescindir de l’assegurança. Weiss va veure com l’assegurança de tempestes duplicava el preu anual, passant de 10.000 a 20.000 dòlars en només dos anys. Els increments de preu també són notables a Califòrnia, Colorado i Louisiana, però Florida lidera amb les primes més altes del país. Aquest darrer any, molts han vist pujades superiors al 40%. Per mirar de rebaixar costos, s’han impulsat reformes legals per limitar les demandes, un factor clau en el preu. QPR rounded off their win with two late goals: Hoilett fired in a stunning shot in the 89th minute, and Austin sealed the result with a header in stoppage time.

article_content: Security in Brussels intensified on Wednesday as the city prepared for a two-day European Union summit. Police began searching for a man in relation to vague threats, with authorities later confirming they had detained someone and were working to verify his identity. This security response followed an incident one week earlier, when a Tunisian national identified as an Islamic extremist fatally shot two Swedish citizens and injured another in Brussels. The suspect died in a police operation during an attempted arrest. Investigations revealed gaps in Belgium's government and judiciary, allowing the attacker to remain at large even though Tunisia had requested his extradition. As a result, Belgium's justice minister resigned over the weekend. In light of recent events, Belgium raised its terror threat alert to the second-highest level, indicating a serious threat. On Wednesday, prosecutors also reported detaining another person connected to the rifle used in last week’s attack; further questioning was planned before charges would be determined.

Aquesta resposta de seguretat s'ha produït després d'un incident una setmana abans, quan un ciutadà tunisià identificat com a extremista islàmic va matar a trets dos ciutadans suecs i en va ferir un altre a Brussel·les. El sospitós va morir durant una operació policial quan intentaven detenir-lo. Les investigacions van revelar deficiències al govern i al sistema judicial belga, que van permetre que l'atacant es mantingués en llibertat tot i que Tunísia n'havia sol·licitat l'extradició. Com a conseqüència, el ministre de Justícia de Bèlgica va dimitir el cap de setmana passat. article_content: SpaceX, the private aerospace firm led by Elon Musk, is seeking an experienced farmer to manage its vast 900-acre research site in McGregor, Texas. This distinctive job merges traditional farming responsibilities with the dynamic setting of nearby rocket development, including projects like Grasshopper and Falcon 9. Candidates need at least ten years of crop farming experience specific to central Texas, along with strong familiarity in servicing John Deere equipment. The position requires flexibility—the work environment presents challenges such as dirt, weather extremes, physical demands, and fluctuating schedules due to ongoing rocket tests. Despite being Earth-based, the role is positioned as a chance to contribute to SpaceX’s broader vision of advancing human space exploration and preparing for future planetary colonization. Under the headline 'Engineer the Future', the job ad calls for applicants who are motivated, resourceful, skilled, and deeply curious. Key duties involve planning farm operations, boosting crop yields, adapting to changing weather, leveraging digital tools, and ensuring agricultural work does not clash with rocket testing at the site. In the wider context, NASA is also working on agricultural experiments in space, such as the VEGGIE project—which SpaceX helped deliver to the International Space Station—that grows crops like red romaine lettuce in microgravity using specially designed chambers. With over 3,000 employees in locations from California to Texas and Florida, SpaceX is now expanding its team by recruiting experts with hands-on agricultural backgrounds to further its pioneering ambitions. While the role is not about leaving Earth, it offers experienced farmers a unique way to support humanity’s next steps in space.

article_content: Rockstar Games has confirmed that the first trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) will be released in December, though the actual launch date of the game has not been announced. The announcement comes a decade after Grand Theft Auto 5 (GTA 5) was released, which has become the second best-selling video game ever after Minecraft, with over 185 million copies sold. Rockstar officially announced in February 2022 that it was developing GTA 6. On Wednesday, company president Sam Houser stated that the first trailer would coincide with Rockstar’s 25th anniversary celebration. The original Grand Theft Auto game was released in 1997 to mixed reviews. Over the last 25 years, the franchise has received critical acclaim, shipped more than 405 million units, and is frequently recognized among the greatest and best-selling video game series. Rockstar Games and Rockstar North received honors as best studio and best developer from Edge magazine for GTA 5, and were awarded the BAFTA Academy Fellowship at the 10th British Academy Video Games Awards. Fans have been eagerly awaiting a new entry, and excitement surged after the trailer announcement. Rumors about GTA 6 have circulated for nearly a decade. In September 2022, a major leak revealed over 90 videos and screenshots from early GTA 6 development. Rockstar acknowledged the hack’s legitimacy, confirming that an unauthorized party accessed confidential information, including development footage. Rockstar expressed disappointment about the leak and reiterated its commitment to updating fans and properly introducing the new game when ready. The leaked material hinted at a return to modern Vice City and introduced characters Jason and Lucia, who appear to collaborate in a Bonnie and Clyde-style story. Before GTA 5’s release in 2013, the longest wait between main series games had been five years. Advancements in video game technology, hardware, and online features now allow studios to update games continually rather than creating new ones from scratch. Mini-games and downloadable content make frequent additions possible, sometimes for an extra fee. Rockstar, a division of Take-Two Interactive Software Inc., is known for producing visually impressive games. GTA 5’s depiction of Los Santos remains notable even a decade later, reflecting significant development time. Take-Two has patented new animation technology to ensure that GTA 6 features highly dynamic and realistic character movement. Grand Theft Auto is not Rockstar’s only hit franchise; their open-world western series, Red Dead Redemption, is also a major seller and receives regular updates. To keep fans engaged ahead of GTA 6, Rockstar has released compilations and remastered earlier titles in the series, but anticipation for the upcoming game is at its peak.

L'anunci arriba una dècada després del llançament de Grand Theft Auto 5 (GTA 5), que s'ha convertit en el segon videojoc més venut de la història després de Minecraft, amb més de 185 milions de còpies venudes. Rockstar va anunciar oficialment al febrer de 2022 que estava desenvolupant GTA 6. Dimecres, el president de la companyia, Sam Houser, va afirmar que el primer tràiler coincidirà amb la celebració del 25è aniversari de Rockstar. El joc original de Grand Theft Auto es va llançar el 1997 amb crítiques mixtes. Al llarg dels últims 25 anys, la franquícia ha rebut aclamació crítica, ha venut més de 405 milions d'unitats i sovint és reconeguda com una de les millors i més exitoses sèries de videojocs. Rockstar Games i Rockstar North van ser reconeguts com a millor estudi i millor desenvolupador per la revista Edge per GTA 5 i van rebre el BAFTA Academy Fellowship als 10ns British Academy Video Games Awards. Els fans han estat esperant una nova entrega durant molt de temps, i l'entusiasme es va disparar després de l'anunci del tràiler. Els rumors sobre GTA 6 han circulat durant gairebé una dècada. Al setembre de 2022, una gran filtració va revelar més de 90 vídeos i captures de pantalla del desenvolupament inicial de GTA 6. Rockstar va reconèixer l'autenticitat de la intrusió i va confirmar que una tercera part no autoritzada va accedir a informació confidencial, inclòs material de desenvolupament. Rockstar va expressar la seva decepció per la filtració i va reiterar el seu compromís d'informar els fans i presentar el nou joc de manera adequada quan estigui llest. El material filtrat apuntava a un retorn a Vice City en l'actualitat i presentava els personatges Jason i Lucia, que semblen col·laborar en una història al més pur estil Bonnie i Clyde. Abans del llançament de GTA 5 el 2013, l'espera més llarga entre jocs principals de la sèrie havia estat de cinc anys. Els avenços en tecnologia de videojocs, maquinari i característiques en línia permeten ara que els estudis actualitzin els jocs regularment en comptes de crear-ne de nous des de zero. Els mini-jocs i els continguts descarregables permeten afegir novetats de manera més freqüent, de vegades amb un cost extra. Rockstar, una divisió de Take-Two Interactive Software Inc., és coneguda per crear jocs visualment impactants. La representació de Los Santos a GTA 5 encara impressiona una dècada més tard, resultat d'un gran treball de desenvolupament. Take-Two ha patentat nova tecnologia d'animació per assegurar que GTA 6 tingui moviments de personatges molt dinàmics i realistes. Grand Theft Auto no és l'única franquícia d'èxit de Rockstar; la seva sèrie western de món obert, Red Dead Redemption, també té molt èxit i rep actualitzacions regularment. Per mantenir l'interès abans de GTA 6, Rockstar ha publicat recopilacions i remasteritzacions d'entregues anteriors, però l'expectació per al nou joc és màxima.

article_content: Jeorgia Wood, 30, from Hampshire, has lived with type 1 diabetes since she was a child. Faced with negative feelings about her body image, she began practicing diabulimia—intentionally skipping or reducing insulin doses to lose weight. Over the years, this behavior brought her severe health consequences, including vision loss, nerve damage, the amputation of part of her foot, and concerns about her ability to have children. Jeorgia's struggle with her weight intensified as a teenager when insulin therapy caused her to gain significant weight. Social pressures and a strong desire to fit in led her to miss important insulin doses, which negatively affected her health. Even as her doctors warned her about potential blindness and disability, the pursuit of thinness continued to dominate her decisions, reinforced by the positive comments she received. A particularly tragic chapter occurred when Jeorgia and her fiancé Ross Fowler lost a pregnancy due to medical advice: complications made continuing it too dangerous for both mother and baby. She suffered from hyperemesis gravidarum (severe morning sickness), and the underlying damage caused by diabulimia made pregnancy life-threatening. After eventually seeking help through rehabilitation programs in her late twenties, Jeorgia was confronted with lasting health problems: recurring hospitalizations, surgeries for infections and tissue damage, severe gastrointestinal and eye diseases. She is now dependent on Ross for much of her daily support, as she is no longer able to drive or perform many tasks independently. Jeorgia now hopes to rebuild her life and explore options for motherhood, including a pancreas transplant and the potential for surrogacy. She shares her story to warn others with type 1 diabetes about the life-altering dangers of diabulimia. Medical professionals, including Diabetes UK advisor Deepa Khatri, highlight how skipping insulin for weight control—a practice still not officially classified as a separate mental health condition—can cause serious complications like vision loss, amputations, and even strokes. Jeorgia's experience serves as a cautionary tale and underscores the need for increased awareness and support for those at risk.

Ja no pot conduir i depèn de Ross per les tasques del dia a dia. Jeorgia vol ara refer la seva vida i mira opcions per poder ser mare, com un trasplantament de pàncrees o la gestació subrogada. El cas de la Jeorgia és una advertència clara i evidencia la necessitat d'una millor conscienciació i més suport per a qui ho pateixi.

article_content: Four-year-old Shakira bears the scars of severe burns from her early childhood. While she has her eyelashes, she lacks eyebrows, is missing several fingernails, and her tightened skin has taken away her ability to frown, though she can still smile. Shakira’s name, meaning 'thankful,' symbolizes her new beginning in the United States. Her caretaker, Hashmat Effendi, is hopeful that the reconstructive surgery planned for January will mark a fresh start for her. Shakira was found as a young child abandoned with serious burns in Pakistan’s Swat Valley, an area then affected by violence. Although it wasn't clear how she sustained her injuries, local reports mentioned a drone attack, though U.S. officials deny such actions in the area. Of three girls discovered, only Shakira survived after urgent treatment. With no relatives claiming her despite widespread appeals, Effendi authorized Shakira’s medical care and gave her the name 'Shakira.' Attempts to trace her family with the help of local authorities were unsuccessful. Shakira spent three years in a charity ward at Shalimar Hospital in Lahore, before Effendi was able to bring her to Houston. Now in the United States, Shakira is adjusting quickly, learning English and new cultural habits, including her first taste of McDonald’s chicken nuggets. Effendi, a mother of three grown sons, describes Shakira as a joyful presence and a constant companion. Soon, Shakira will undergo reconstructive surgery with Dr. Robert McCauley at the Shriners Hospital in Galveston. The process will begin with her right hand, but some aspects of her injuries, like missing eyebrows and discoloration, can’t be fully restored. She must avoid spicy foods, which can irritate her sensitive skin. Despite emotional challenges adjusting to new surroundings and relationships, Shakira is building connections with Effendi and dedicated volunteers, like Larry Maxwell, whom she calls 'Nana.' Finding a sense of belonging remains a gradual process for her. Effendi, who has three decades of experience with children, says Shakira continually teaches her new things. She hopes Shakira can eventually be adopted by a family in the U.S., as there is no support for her in Pakistan. For now, Shakira is beginning her new life, surrounded by caregivers who believe in the hopeful promise carried by her name.

El seu nom, que significa 'agraïda', simbolitza aquest nou començament als Estats Units. La seva cuidadora, Hashmat Effendi, confia que la cirurgia reconstructiva prevista al gener serà un nou inici. Shakira va ser trobada de petita, abandonada i amb cremades severes a la vall del Swat, al Pakistan, una zona afectada per la violència. De les tres nenes trobades, només Shakira va sobreviure gràcies a una atenció mèdica urgent. Haurà d’evitar menjar picant, ja que irrita la seva pell sensible. Tot i les dificultats emocionals d’adaptar-se a un nou entorn i relacions, Shakira comença a fer vincles amb Effendi i voluntaris dedicats com Larry Maxwell, a qui anomena 'Nana'. Confia que algun dia pugui ser adoptada per una família nord-americana, ja que al Pakistan no hi té cap suport. De moment, Shakira comença la seva nova vida envoltada d’aquells que creuen en l’esperança que porta el seu nom.

article_content: Children's Day celebrates and promotes children's well-being, quality education, and their rights, shining a spotlight on the importance of play and ensuring safety online. The theme for 2023, 'For every child, every right,' emphasizes securing every child's rights and building a better future. In India, Children's Day is observed on November 14th, commemorating Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru's birthday. Affectionately called 'Chacha Nehru,' he was a fervent supporter of children's education and rights. Globally, Universal Children's Day is marked on November 20th, established by the United Nations General Assembly. This date honors the adoption of the Declaration of the Rights of the Child in 1959 and the Convention on the Rights of the Child in 1989. The day underscores the necessity of raising children in safe, healthy environments, while also highlighting ongoing issues like poverty, lack of education, inadequate healthcare, and child labor faced by children worldwide. Schools and colleges host creative events and joyful competitions for children to enjoy learning and showcase their abilities. The importance of play, recreation, and fostering social and creative skills is at the heart of these activities. With the increase in digital engagement among youth, Children's Day has expanded to include awareness about cyberbullying, internet safety, and responsible online behavior. Overall, Children's Day is an opportunity to appreciate and support children's unique abilities, guaranteeing their right to education, health, nourishment, and opportunities for growth. Elsewhere, India is experiencing economic momentum from a strong services sector, telecom stakeholders are questioning new technology proposals, and there's a proposal to increase the GST evasion prosecution threshold.

A l'Índia, el Dia del Nen té lloc el 14 de novembre, coincidint amb l'aniversari de Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru. Estimat com a 'Chacha Nehru', va ser un ferm defensor de l'educació i dels drets dels infants. Arreu del món, el Dia Universal dels Infants es celebra el 20 de novembre, establert per l'Assemblea General de les Nacions Unides. Aquesta data commemora l'adopció de la Declaració dels Drets de l'Infant (1959) i la Convenció sobre els Drets de l'Infant (1989). La jornada posa el focus en la necessitat que els infants creixin en ambients segurs i saludables, tot destacant problemàtiques com la pobresa, la manca d'escolarització, la falta d'accés a la salut i el treball infantil. Escoles i universitats organitzen activitats creatives i concursos perquè els infants gaudeixin aprenent tot mostrant les seves capacitats. El valor del joc, l’oci i el desenvolupament social i creatiu és central en aquestes propostes. Amb la creixent presència digital dels joves, el Dia del Nen també impulsa la conscienciació sobre l’assetjament digital, la seguretat en línia i l’ús responsable d’Internet. En essència, el Dia del Nen vol reconèixer i donar suport a les habilitats úniques dels infants, garantint-los la seva educació, salut, alimentació i oportunitats de desenvolupament. D'altra banda, l'economia índia està en creixement gràcies al sector serveis, el sector de les telecomunicacions qüestiona noves propostes tecnològiques i es debat incrementar el límit per sancionar penalment l'evasió fiscal.

article_content: Chinese authorities have launched an investigation into Zhongzhi Enterprise Group (ZEG), one of the country's largest shadow banks, which has lent billions to real estate firms. At its peak, ZEG's asset management arm reportedly managed assets exceeding one trillion yuan ($139 billion; £110 billion). Over the weekend, authorities announced an investigation into 'suspected illegal crimes' involving the company. This follows reports that ZEG had declared insolvency. Last week, the struggling firm reportedly told investors its liabilities—up to $64 billion—exceeded its assets, now estimated at about $38 billion. Officials stated they have taken 'criminal coercive measures' against 'many suspects,' but the identities and roles of these individuals remain unclear. ZEG's founder, Xie Zhikun, passed away in 2021. ZEG is a major player in China's shadow banking sector—a network of lenders, brokers, and credit intermediaries operating outside traditional banking regulations. Shadow banks are not subject to the same risk, liquidity, and capital requirements as regulated banks. China’s shadow banking sector is valued at around $3 trillion and often provides crucial financing to the property sector. Recently, the industry has faced a severe credit crunch, pushing some of its largest firms toward collapse. Andrew Collier, an expert at Orient Capital Research, commented that China’s property boom relied on capital from individual investors attracted by high returns, a dynamic that sustained growth until property prices stalled. Shadow banking expanded notably after the global financial crisis in 2008, when conventional credit became scarce in China. With China's slowing economy and a crisis in the real estate sector, Collier warns ZEG's collapse could signal broader troubles affecting other shadow banks and even traditional lenders. Property developers currently owe Chinese banks sums totaling up to 30% of the banks’ assets—a situation expected to take a long time to resolve. The unfolding situation at ZEG has triggered concerns about further instability in the world’s second-largest economy, especially in the wake of the collapses of property developer Evergrande and financial problems at Country Garden. China's property sector—including housing, rentals, brokerage services, construction materials, and apartment-related goods—accounts for about a third of the country’s economic activity. Recent figures show China's economy grew by 4.9% between July and September 2023, a slowdown from the 6.3% growth recorded in the previous quarter.
translated_content: Les autoritats xineses han iniciat una investigació sobre Zhongzhi Enterprise Group (ZEG), un dels majors bancs a l’ombra del país, que ha prestat milers de milions a empreses immobiliàries. En el seu punt àlgid, la divisió de gestió d’actius de ZEG suposadament gestionava actius per valor de més d’un bilió de iuans (139.000 milions de dòlars; 110.000 milions de lliures). El cap de setmana passat, les autoritats van anunciar la investigació per 'presumptes delictes il·legals' relacionats amb l’empresa. Això arriba després que es publiqués que ZEG havia declarat insolvent. La setmana passada, la firma en problemes va comunicar als inversors que els seus passius —fins a 64.000 milions de dòlars— superaven els seus actius, ara estimats en uns 38.000 milions de dòlars. Els funcionaris van indicar que han pres 'mesures coercitives penals' contra 'molts sospitosos', però la seva identitat i el seu paper dins de l’empresa encara no són clars. El fundador de ZEG, Xie Zhikun, va morir el 2021. ZEG és un actor destacat en el sector bancari a l’ombra de la Xina—una xarxa de prestadors, intermediaris i agents de crèdit fora de la regulació bancària tradicional. Aquests bancs a l’ombra no estan sotmesos als mateixos requisits de risc, liquiditat i capital que els bancs regulats. El sector bancari a l’ombra de la Xina està valorat en uns 3 bilions de dòlars i sovint dona finançament essencial al sector immobiliari. Recentment, la indústria ha patit una greu crisi de crèdit, que ha acostat algunes de les seves grans empreses al col·lapse. Andrew Collier, expert d’Orient Capital Research, comenta que el boom immobiliari de la Xina es va basar en el capital d’inversors individuals atrets pels alts rendiments, una dinàmica que va mantenir el creixement fins que els preus dels habitatges es van estancar. El sector del banc a l’ombra va créixer especialment després de la crisi financera global de 2008, quan l’accés al crèdit convencional a la Xina es va restringir. Amb l’economia xinesa alentida i una crisi al sector immobiliari, Collier adverteix que la fallida de ZEG podria fer aflorar problemes més amplis en altres bancs a l’ombra i fins i tot als bancs tradicionals. Actualment, els promotors immobiliaris deuen als bancs xinesos sumes equivalents al 30% dels seus actius—una situació que trigarà temps a resoldre’s. La situació de ZEG ha generat inquietud sobre possible inestabilitat addicional a la segona economia més gran del món, especialment arran de la fallida del gegant immobiliari Evergrande i dels recents problemes financers de Country Garden. El sector immobiliari xinès—que engloba habitatges, lloguers, serveis de mediació, materials de construcció i indústries relacionades—representa aproximadament un terç de l’activitat econòmica del país. Les últimes dades mostren que l’economia xinesa va créixer un 4,9% entre juliol i setembre de 2023, una desacceleració respecte al 6,3% del trimestre anterior.

article_content: Many people don’t realize that artificial intelligence (AI) has a history spanning decades. AI isn’t just a recent tech trend; it’s a distinct field of computer science designed to create systems that can learn and solve problems much like humans. Rather than requiring constant human oversight, AI systems improve through experience and data. The origins of AI reach back to the 1950s. Pioneers like Alan Turing, who proposed the Turing Test to measure a machine’s intelligence, and John McCarthy, inventor of the influential LISP programming language, set the groundwork. Major moments included the Stanford Cart’s autonomous navigation in the 1970s and the creation of what is now the Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AAAI). AI development has also faced challenges. From 1987 to 1993, funding and research slowed during the 'AI Winter,' caused by unmet expectations and limited progress. However, the early 1990s brought AI closer to home, such as robotic vacuum cleaners and speech-to-text systems, sparking a fresh wave of innovation. IBM was pivotal in moving AI forward. In 1997, Deep Blue made history by defeating chess champion Garry Kasparov. Years later, Watson's victory on Jeopardy! in 2011 showcased how computers could process massive datasets and understand human language. Watson’s technology soon aided healthcare professionals, improved customer service with virtual assistants, and enabled groundbreaking scientific research. Tech giants further accelerated AI’s impact. Amazon and Apple introduced Alexa and Siri, voice assistants that made it easy for people to interact with technology through speech. Amazon also uses AI for personalized product recommendations and offers infrastructure for global AI development through AWS. Google’s influence is clear in its work with DeepMind and advances in deep learning, such as training neural networks to identify images without labels. Open-source tools like TensorFlow allowed broader access to cutting-edge AI technology. Google's work in language processing, image recognition, and predictive analytics shaped major products like Search and Photos. The last few years have ushered in generative AI—AI that generates realistic text, pictures, and more. OpenAI, with its GPT-3 model and the rapid popularity of ChatGPT (gaining a million users within a week), has become central to conversation technology. Major investments from Microsoft helped OpenAI expand, introducing custom AI assistants and enterprise tools. Startups like Anthropic were created with a focus on making AI safer and more ethical, developing large language models guided by rules to minimize bias and maximize helpfulness. This focus on responsible development has attracted support from companies like Google and Amazon. On the hardware side, companies like Intel and NVIDIA developed the powerful processors and graphics cards essential for training the advanced AI systems we use today. As artificial intelligence plays a bigger role in society, there is a push for 'responsible AI,’ which covers ethics, transparency, and fairness. Solutions like Credo AI, led by Navrina Singh, help organizations manage risk, comply with regulations, and prevent harmful outcomes. Now, spatial AI lets robots and drones interpret and interact with their environments, enabling smart automation and complex real-world tasks. There’s a noticeable shift from AI focused mainly on infrastructure to AI designed around real human needs. Innovations from companies like AIXplain, led by Hassan Sawaf, now let users deploy tailored AI solutions with ease. Acknowledging the teams and organizations behind these achievements highlights the collaborative advancements in deep learning, natural language processing, and accessible hardware. Their dedication is shaping a future where AI is deeply woven into modern life.

A diferència dels programes tradicionals, la IA millora sola gràcies a l’experiència amb les dades. Els inicis de la IA se situen als anys 50 amb pioners com Alan Turing, que va establir el Test de Turing, i John McCarthy, creador del llenguatge LISP. També hi destaca la navegació autònoma de l’Stanford Cart als anys 70 i la fundació de l’Associació per a l’Avançament de la Intel·ligència Artificial (AAAI). IBM va marcar una fita: el 1997, Deep Blue va vèncer el campió d’escacs Garry Kasparov. Més endavant, Watson va guanyar al Jeopardy! el 2011, demostrant la seva capacitat de processar grans dades i entendre el llenguatge natural. Aquesta tecnologia va ajudar el sector de la salut, el servei al client i la recerca científica. Els gegants tecnològics van seguir avançant. Amazon i Apple van presentar Alexa i Siri, fent més fàcil la interacció per veu. Amazon fa servir la IA per recomanar productes i, amb AWS, facilita la investigació global en IA. Google ha impulsat la IA amb DeepMind i avenços com el deep learning per identificar imatges sense etiquetes. TensorFlow ha democratitzat l’accés a la IA avançada. Google ha millorat la cerca, la gestió de fotos i la predicció gràcies a la intel·ligència artificial. En els darrers anys ha destacat la IA generativa que crea textos i imatges realistes. OpenAI, amb GPT-3 i l’auge de ChatGPT (un milió d’usuaris en una setmana), ha canviat la manera com interactuem amb la tecnologia. Grans inversions de Microsoft han ajudat a impulsar OpenAI, que avui ofereix assistents personalitzats i eines professionals. Antropic, una startup amb aposta clara per la seguretat i l’ètica, desenvolupa models de llenguatge grans i regulats per normes per reduir els biaixos i ser útils. Google i Amazon han donat suport a aquest enfocament responsable. Intel i NVIDIA han estat fonamentals pel desenvolupament del hardware necessari per entrenar els sistemes avançats d’IA que tenim avui. Amb la IA més present, pren força la idea de la ‘IA responsable’, centrada en l’ètica, la transparència i la justícia. Plataformes com Credo AI, liderades per Navrina Singh, ajuden les empreses a gestionar riscos i garantir el compliment normatiu. La IA espacial fa que robots i drons entenguin i interactuïn millor amb el món físic, obrint noves oportunitats d’automatització i tasques complexes. S’observa una transició de la IA orientada a infraestructures cap a aplicacions que resolen realment les necessitats de les persones. AIXplain, amb Hassan Sawaf, fa possible el desplegament ràpid de solucions personalitzades d’IA. Cal reconèixer els equips i organitzacions pioners d’aquests progressos. La seva feina conjunta en deep learning, llenguatge natural i hardware ha marcat una nova era, i segueix teixint el futur de la IA en la nostra vida digital.

article_content: For 17 years, broadcaster Lee Thomas has been living with vitiligo, a condition that causes loss of skin pigment. He’s learned to manage the intrusive looks he receives when not wearing makeup and is open to questions about his appearance. Thomas recounts a lighthearted moment when his daughter’s friend innocently compared his skin to a cow, and, after learning about vitiligo, immediately wanted to play Frisbee. Thomas believes the real challenge isn’t simply ignorance about vitiligo, but rather the negative attitudes some adults display. Early on, he responded defensively to stares, but eventually chose to engage people positively, letting his smile and conversation break the ice. Vitiligo is a non-contagious and incurable skin disorder that affects around 100 million people globally, according to the Vitiligo Research Foundation. It's caused by the loss or malfunction of pigment-producing cells called melanocytes, leaving patches of skin without color. The disorder can affect anyone but is most visible in those with darker skin. Michael Jackson is perhaps the most famous person with vitiligo, reportedly wearing a glove to conceal affected areas, a tactic Thomas also tried. There’s no cure for vitiligo, but treatments exist. These include topical creams, light therapy like laser treatments, and some surgical options. However, effectiveness varies and sometimes treatments result in uneven skin healing. Advances in research are promising, with experts hopeful for better therapies in the coming decade. Aside from physical changes, vitiligo can take an emotional toll. As a television personality, Lee Thomas worried about the impact on his career. Initially, he always wore makeup to hide his condition, but eventually decided to be open about it, finding support from his colleagues. He still uses makeup on camera to minimize distraction but is comfortable going without it off-air. Dr. Mark Lebwohl of Mount Sinai stresses that vitiligo is not just cosmetic—it's psychologically debilitating for many. Yan Valle, also living with the condition since childhood, has witnessed discomfort and avoidance from others. Now, as a leader at the Vitiligo Research Foundation, Valle works to provide resources for patients and medical professionals. Thomas, author of 'Turning White,' also started what he says was the first vitiligo support group in Detroit. He’s passionate about helping others overcome social barriers associated with the disease, offering hope and solidarity to those struggling in silence.

Thomas creu que el veritable repte no és només la desconeixença sobre el vitiligen, sinó també les actituds negatives d’alguns adults. article_content: Britain may soon see its skies filled with drones in the next decade, according to Paul Cremin, the Department for Transport’s head of aviation safety. With the rollout of sophisticated 'detect and avoid' systems, drones could become a common sight as early as 2023. Experts expect drone technology to be widely used for both surveillance and delivery, potentially changing how people shop. Cremin highlighted the rapid growth in civilian drone applications, similar to innovation spurred by the arrival of the internet. Amazon made headlines in December 2013 by proposing drone-based deliveries. By August, the company sought approval from the Federal Aviation Administration to fly drones delivering packages up to 5 pounds at speeds exceeding 50 mph. According to Amazon, this covers about 86% of its deliveries. Google’s Project Wing, developed at Google X, features drones with a wingspan of about 1.5 meters, four electric propellers, and a total weight of around 10 kg including packages. These drones take advantage of hybrid designs for both fast flight and hovering, lowering parcels safely to the ground with a tether and monitoring delivery with a built-in sensor called the 'egg'. Google envisions their drones playing roles in disaster relief, wildlife tracking, crop spraying, monitoring traffic, and delivering donor organs. Field trials have already explored many of these uses. However, drones have also been tied to crime: reports from April indicated that criminals were modifying low-cost drones bought from stores with infrared cameras to find illegal cannabis farms based on heat signatures, then stealing the crops for street sales. The House of Lords EU internal market, infrastructure and employment sub-committee has debated the need for unified regulations across the EU. Mark Steyn, of London-based onDrone, suggests that as public comfort with autonomous cars grows, drones delivering goods will become widely accepted.

Els experts esperen que la tecnologia dels drons s’utilitzi àmpliament tant per a la vigilància com per a la repartició, cosa que podria transformar la manera de comprar. Cremin destaca el ràpid creixement de les aplicacions civils dels drons, en una evolució similar a la que va portar internet. Amazon va captar atenció el desembre de 2013 quan va proposar fer enviaments mitjançant drons. L’agost següent, la companyia va demanar permís a l’Administració Federal d’Aviació dels EUA per volar drons capaços de lliurar paquets de fins a 5 lliures a més de 80 km/h. Segons Amazon, això cobriria aproximadament el 86% dels seus enviaments. Google preveu utilitzar aquests drons no només per a l’ajuda en desastres, sinó també per al seguiment d’animals, la polvorització de conreus, el monitoratge de trànsit i el lliurament d’òrgans donats. article_content: British retail sales volumes unexpectedly fell in October as financially stretched consumers chose to stay home, according to official figures released Friday—another warning sign for the economy. The Office for National Statistics (ONS) reported retail sales volumes declined by 0.3% month-on-month, following a revised 1.1% decrease in September, which was worse than initially estimated. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast a 0.3% rise in October sales volumes, but the figures fell short of expectations. The ONS noted that retailers suggested cost of living pressures, reduced shopper numbers, and wet weather during the second half of the month contributed to the decrease. These results fit with the deteriorating outlook for Britain's economy. Economic growth remains sluggish, and although price pressures are easing, the process is slow. Investors anticipate that these economic conditions may push the Bank of England to lower interest rates in 2024. Statistics also revealed a slight downward revision in retail sales for the third quarter. As the UK only barely avoided an economic contraction in preliminary data last week, the new numbers raise the possibility that GDP could be revised to show a decline. Nevertheless, retailers hope the upcoming Christmas shopping period will bring improvement. Despite subdued macroeconomic data and declining consumer surveys, leading retailers—including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Next, Primark, and Marks & Spencer—have expressed confidence about their prospects heading into the holidays. In other business news: the Indian government is examining the legality of transferring unclaimed Sahara-Sebi Refund Account funds to the Consolidated Fund of India, while still providing for later investor claims; Apple plans to produce nearly ₹1 lakh crore worth of iPhones in India by March 2024, having already surpassed ₹60,000-crore in production in the first seven months; and Nawaz Modi, estranged wife of Gautam Singhania, is reportedly seeking three-quarters of his $1.4 billion net worth for herself and their daughters in a family settlement.
