article_content: Liverpool, England – Luis Diaz will decide for himself whether to play in Liverpool’s Premier League match at Luton Town on Sunday (Nov 5), following the kidnapping of his parents, according to manager Juergen Klopp. Diaz’s mother, Cilenis Marulanda, and father, Luis Manuel Diaz, were abducted by armed men while driving in La Guajira province, northern Colombia, on Saturday. Marulanda was freed within hours, and on Thursday, the kidnappers announced that Diaz’s father would also be released. “If he feels right, he will be with us. You can see he hasn’t slept much,” Klopp told reporters on Friday. “The news from Colombia gives us some hope. I can’t say what we will do. It’s up to him to decide if he makes himself available or not.” Klopp also provided an update on Thiago Alcantara, who has not been training fully with the first-team squad due to lingering issues from a hip injury that has sidelined the midfielder since April. “Thiago’s situation is ongoing. We can’t put pressure on him. We hope he’ll be back at the start of the new year,” Klopp said. Klopp noted that the return timeline for Stefan Bajcetic remains uncertain. Liverpool currently sit fourth in the Premier League table with 23 points, three behind leaders Tottenham Hotspur and one point behind both Arsenal and Manchester City. Luton Town, Liverpool’s next opponent, is in 18th place with five points. Despite their ranking, Klopp warned against underestimating promoted Luton, who have managed just one point in four home games at Kenilworth Road this season. “We’ll probably face a low block and have to deal with quality set-pieces,” he said. “All I need is a pitch, an opponent and our team there. It’s exciting; I love the story.”

Depèn d’ell decidir si està disponible o no”. No podem posar-li pressió. Esperem que torni a principis del nou any”, va dir Klopp. Klopp ha reconegut que encara no se sap quan podrà tornar Stefan Bajcetic. El Liverpool actualment ocupa la quarta posició a la classificació de la Premier League amb 23 punts, tres menys que el líder Tottenham Hotspur i un menys que Arsenal i Manchester City. El proper rival, el Luton Town, és divuitè amb cinc punts. article_content: Leonard Allan Cure, wrongfully imprisoned for 16 years, died after being shot by a deputy during a traffic stop in Camden County, Georgia, on Monday morning. Cure, 53, had been exonerated in December 2020 thanks to efforts by the Innocence Project and Florida’s Broward County State Attorney’s Office, which uncovered evidence proving he was not involved in a 2003 armed robbery. The Georgia Bureau of Investigations reports that the incident started around 7:30 a.m. when Cure was pulled over for allegedly speeding. The Camden County Sheriff’s Office stated Cure followed the deputy’s instructions, including exiting his car. The situation escalated once Cure found out he was being arrested, according to police accounts. Authorities said that after Cure allegedly assaulted the deputy, the officer used a stun gun, then a second time and a baton, before firing his gun when Cure did not comply. Cure was given medical care on the scene but died; no officers were injured. State investigators are reviewing the shooting, and the case will be presented to the Brunswick Judicial Circuit District Attorney’s Office. Cure was heading home from visiting his mother in South Florida and had just received $817,000 from Florida’s legislature as compensation for his wrongful incarceration. He had been planning to enroll in college for music or radio, and to purchase a home. Cure was praised by prosecutors and advocates as intelligent, thoughtful, and caring. After his release, he helped train prosecutors, sharing his story to support justice reform. The Innocence Project noted that a store receipt proved Cure was far from the crime scene, and issues with photo line-ups contributed to his wrongful conviction.

Cure tornava a casa després de visitar la seva mare al sud de Florida i acabava de rebre 817.000 dòlars del parlament floridià en compensació per la injusta condemna. Planejava inscriure’s a la universitat per estudiar música o producció radiofònica i volia comprar-se una casa. Fiscalia i defensors de l’Innocence Project han elogiat Cure com una persona intel·ligent, reflexiva i altruista. Un cop alliberat, va ajudar a formar fiscals explicant la seva experiència per millorar la justícia. L’Innocence Project va remarcar que un rebut d’una botiga va demostrar que estava lluny de l’escena del crim i que les identificacions policials poc fiables van contribuir a la condemna errònia.

article_content: BENGALURU: Health officials announced on Saturday that there is no outbreak of the Zika virus in Bengaluru, after recent samples tested at the National Institute of Virology in Pune returned negative results. According to authorities, all 30 samples collected from Bengaluru and Chikkaballapur districts came back negative for the mosquito-borne virus. Karnataka had been placed on high alert when a mosquito pool sample from Chikkaballapur tested positive for Zika. To ensure public safety, health teams collected a range of samples, including three human serum samples from fever cases and 24 from antenatal clinic surveillance among pregnant women in Chikkaballapur. All tested negative, health commissioner D Randeep told STOI. Additionally, samples from a suspected case and two contacts from JP Nagar, Bengaluru, were also sent for testing. These samples likewise tested negative, confirmed Dr. Mahmood Shariff, the state program officer at the National Center for Vector Borne Diseases Control. In the JP Nagar instance, a doctor suspected Zika symptoms in one patient, prompting tests for the patient and two close contacts. All proved negative.

Segons les autoritats, les 30 mostres recollides dels districtes de Bangalore i Chikkaballapur van donar negatiu per al virus transmès per mosquits. Karnataka s’havia posat en alerta màxima després que una mostra de mosquits de Chikkaballapur donés positiu de Zika. Per garantir la seguretat pública, els equips de salut van recollir diverses mostres, incloent tres de sèrum humà de casos de febre i 24 de la vigilància d’ambulatoris prenatals entre dones embarassades a Chikkaballapur. Totes van resultar negatives, va afirmar el comissionat de salut D Randeep a l’STOI. A més, es van enviar per analitzar mostres provinents d’un cas sospitós i de dos contactes de JP Nagar (Bangalore). article_content: A widow has spoken of her heartbreak after being deceived by a conman into giving away over £105,000, including the proceeds from the sale of her home. Beverly Healey, 69, of Brislington, Bristol, formed a relationship with handyman Jamie Evans, who over two years convinced her to hand over money with a series of false claims, such as being attacked by loan sharks. He even showed her fabricated bruises as evidence. Ms. Healey sold her house, giving Evans £52,000 to supposedly pay off debts. Left with just £17,000, she accepted his marriage proposal—only for him to vanish shortly afterward. Evans, using the alias James Price and claiming to be a separated father, gained Ms. Healey's trust. He said he needed money to fend off loan sharks, replace work vans, and take his children on holiday. In total, Ms. Healey gave substantial sums for various reasons: £2,000 for van repairs, £7,500 for a Disneyland Paris trip, and £8,000 after he claimed he was burglarized. Evans continued to manipulate her, turning up with fake bruises and asserting that loan sharks would hurt him unless he paid. Distressed, Ms. Healey eventually agreed to sell her home to help him. After selling the house, Evans claimed he was arrested in France and needed more money to avoid jail. When he disappeared, Ms. Healey reported him to the police in June 2010. Evans, 38, appeared at Bristol Crown Court, pleaded guilty to two fraud charges, and received an eight-month suspended sentence, 100 hours of unpaid work, and a three-month nightly curfew. Ms. Healey now lives in a small flat, relying on her pension and savings of £2,000. She says the experience has left her wary and determined not to trust so easily again. She hopes her story will serve as a warning to others.

Evans, de 38 anys, va comparèixer davant del Tribunal de la Corona de Bristol, es va declarar culpable de dos càrrecs de frau i va rebre una condemna suspesa de vuit mesos, 100 hores de treball comunitari i un toc de queda nocturn de tres mesos. article_content: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un is reportedly in hospital after fracturing both his ankles. The 31-year-old leader’s weight and indulgent lifestyle have been cited as contributing factors to his health problems. According to a source recently returned to Seoul, Kim remains under guard at a Pyongyang hospital. Security measures are tight, and there has been a noticeable increase in elite officials visiting him, as reported by Seoul's Chosun Ilbo newspaper. The source’s claims were corroborated by an intelligence official who noted a lack of movement from Kim’s official car in recent weeks. Kim is said to have sustained the injuries during an intensive tour of military bases and factories, possibly exacerbated by the high-heeled shoes he wears to enhance his stature. Footage broadcast by North Korea’s Central TV recently showed Kim limping during a visit, though the exact date was not specified. Reports suggest Kim’s fondness for rich foods, in particular Swiss cheese acquired during his student years in Switzerland, may have contributed to his weight gain since assuming power. Rumors of gout and binge drinking have circulated, but state media has instead highlighted Kim’s continued work despite his health issues. The Rodong Sinmun newspaper reported that he persisted in visiting various facilities, braving the summer heat. Kim’s recent absence from a regular session of the Supreme People’s Assembly has fueled further speculation about his health. State TV offered a rare admission, airing footage of him limping and confirming he was unwell. There are also reports that a team of European doctors visited North Korea, reinforcing speculation that someone of high rank required specialized medical treatment. Separately, the North Korean military has modified its aging Soviet-era Antonov An-2 biplanes for low-tech stealth missions, replacing metal parts with wood and fabric to evade radar detection. The fleet is largely grounded due to shortages of parts and fuel, but the aircraft could be deployed as bombers if conflict resumed with South Korea. A political observer in Seoul suggested that recovering from his health problems would require Kim to adopt a simpler lifestyle. The article notes that many in North Korea experience malnutrition and food insecurity, as the country relies heavily on foreign aid following decades of economic challenges and the loss of Soviet support in the 1990s.

article_content: OpenAI held its first-ever DevDay in San Francisco’s Hayes Valley neighborhood, also known as 'Cerebral Valley' because of the growing AI and tech communities. The event attracted around 900 developers. During the keynote, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced several new features and company plans for its AI products. A key highlight was the introduction of a GPT store, similar to an app store, which is expected to launch later this month. This platform will enable anyone to build and share custom versions of ChatGPT tailored for specific purposes. OpenAI also launched GPT-4 Turbo, a more advanced, developer-friendly, and cost-effective large language model. Currently, more than 100 million people use ChatGPT weekly. OpenAI is introducing a revenue-sharing model for developers publishing chatbots in the GPT store, incentivizing expansion of OpenAI’s ecosystem. The company has lowered prices for GPT-4 Turbo to prioritize user access. In line with Amazon, Microsoft, and IBM, OpenAI said it will protect businesses using its tools from potential copyright claims related to AI-generated content. Analysts view these moves as strengthening OpenAI’s position against competitors such as Anthropic AI and Google’s Bard. (Originally published on Nov 7, 2023.)

article_content: About 66 million years ago, an enormous asteroid roughly 10 kilometers wide struck Earth near Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula. The resulting disaster caused huge tsunamis, wildfires, earthquakes, and wiped out about 75% of all life forms—including the dinosaurs. Yet, out of this catastrophe arose significant changes in plant life. Researchers from the University of Arizona, led by Dr. Benjamin Blonder, analyzed about 1,000 fossilized plant leaves from the Hell Creek formation in southern North Dakota. Their study found that following the asteroid impact, slow-growing evergreen plants gave way to fast-growing, seasonal deciduous species. The findings suggest that this global upheaval acted as a reset, favoring plants that could adapt quickly—specifically those able to shed and regrow leaves as conditions changed. The so-called ‘impact winter,’ caused by debris blocking sunlight, dropped global temperatures by around 7°C for several decades, much like a nuclear winter. This harsh climate proved especially challenging for species accustomed to humid, warm environments. Deciduous plants, which grow and replace their leaves more cheaply and rapidly, were better equipped to survive than evergreens, which rely on slower, resource-intensive growth. Dr. Blonder notes that this research helps explain why modern forests are dominated by seasonal plants. It also demonstrates that plant extinctions after the impact were not random—traits related to how plants acquire resources played a key role in survival and have shaped Earth's current vegetation.

Tot i la catàstrofe, es van produir canvis importants en la vida vegetal. Investigadors de la Universitat d'Arizona, liderats pel Dr. Benjamin Blonder, van analitzar prop de 1.000 fòssils de fulles de la formació Hell Creek, al sud de Dakota del Nord. El seu estudi va revelar que després de l'impacte, les plantes perennes de creixement lent van donar lloc a espècies de creixement ràpid i de fulla caduca. Les troballes indiquen que aquest gran canvi va actuar com un reinici global, afavorint plantes amb capacitat d’adaptació ràpida—especialment aquelles que podien perdre i tornar a fer fulles segons les condicions. El conegut ‘hivern d’impacte’, causat per la pols que bloquejava la llum solar, va fer baixar la temperatura global uns 7 °C durant diverses dècades, semblant al que passaria amb un hivern nuclear. Aquestes condicions dures van ser especialment difícils per a espècies adaptades a climes càlids i exuberants. Les plantes de fulla caduca, que creixen i renoven les fulles més de pressa i a menor cost, van tenir més opcions de sobreviure que les perennes, que depenen d’un creixement més lent i costós. El Dr. Blonder afirma que la recerca ajuda a entendre per què els boscos moderns estan formats principalment per plantes estacionals. També demostra que l’extinció de plantes després de l’impacte no va ser un procés aleatori—les característiques relacionades amb l’adquisició de recursos van ser claus en la supervivència i han modelat la vegetació actual de la Terra.

article_content:
Should Sen. Kyrsten Sinema choose to pursue re-election in Arizona, she’s anticipated to encounter a particularly tough race. McKay Coppins’ book 'Romney: A Reckoning' reports that Sinema has told Republican Sen. Mitt Romney she feels no anxiety about her future after the Senate, believing she could take on any role she wants and is satisfied with her Congressional achievements—especially, in her view, preserving the Senate filibuster. Sinema’s spokesperson, Hannah Hurley, questioned the depiction of these remarks, stressing that the senator is more focused on delivering results than on her own re-election prospects.

It’s quite common for senators who step down to take positions on corporate boards or head universities, such as Ben Sasse, who became the University of Florida’s president after leaving the Senate. Sinema, along with West Virginia's Joe Manchin, stood against efforts to weaken the filibuster—a rule requiring 60 votes to advance most Senate bills—even as many Democrats pushed for changes.

Throughout her time in the Senate, Sinema has developed a reputation for bipartisan deal-making, which sometimes alienated her Democratic allies. The book notes that Romney admired her steadfastness and that both senators bonded over their outsider status. Sinema worked on significant bipartisan legislation during President Biden’s first years, like the infrastructure law, gun safety measures, and the Respect for Marriage Act. Yet, Sinema and Manchin opposed broader Democratic priorities, including changing filibuster rules to pass voting rights legislation and blocking the original Build Back Better plan. These actions won her praise from Republicans but cost support within her former party.

Sinema left the Democratic Party in December 2022. Soon after, Rep. Ruben Gallego, a Democrat, announced his challenge for her seat, and former Republican gubernatorial candidate Kari Lake is also expected to run. Polls currently suggest Sinema trails both, although her campaign insists she can put together a winning coalition of Democrats, Republicans, and independents.

Segons recull el llibre de McKay Coppins, 'Romney: A Reckoning', Sinema hauria dit al senador republicà Mitt Romney que no li preocupa el seu futur un cop deixi el Senat, ja que considera que pot encapçalar qualsevol càrrec i que està satisfeta amb els seus èxits legislatius, especialment per haver preservat el filibuster a la cambra alta. La seva portaveu, Hannah Hurley, ha posat en dubte la descripció d’aquestes converses, destacant que la senadora està molt més centrada en aconseguir resultats que en la reelecció.

És bastant habitual que exsenadors acabin ocupant llocs en consells d’administració o com a presidents universitaris, com Ben Sasse, que va esdevenir president de la Universitat de Florida després de deixar el Senat. Sinema, juntament amb Joe Manchin de Virgínia Occidental, es va oposar als intents de molts demòcrates de modificar el filibuster—la norma que exigeix 60 vots per aprovar la majoria de lleis al Senat.

Al llarg del seu mandat, Sinema s’ha fet coneguda pel seu paper en acords bipartits, cosa que li ha costat suports entre antics aliats demòcrates. El llibre destaca que Romney admirava la seva determinació, i que tots dos s’unien pel seu paper d’outsiders. Sinema va col·laborar en algunes de les lleis bipartides més importants durant els primers anys de Biden, com la d’infraestructures, la de control d’armes i la Respect for Marriage Act. No obstant, tant Sinema com Manchin es van oposar a projectes demòcrates més ambiciosos, com modificar les regles del filibuster per aprovar lleis de dret al vot, o tirar endavant el projecte Build Back Better. Aquestes decisions li van valdre elogis republicans però li van fer perdre suport dins el seu partit anterior.

Sinema va sortir del Partit Demòcrata el desembre de 2022. Poc després, el diputat demòcrata Ruben Gallego va anunciar la seva candidatura per al seu escó, i s’espera que l’excandidata republicana a governadora Kari Lake també es presenti. article_content:
A team of researchers has documented menopause and post-reproductive survival among wild female chimpanzees in Uganda’s Kibale National Park, challenging prior assumptions that menopause is unique to humans and certain whales among mammals. Their findings, published in the journal Science, draw on two decades of observation within the Ngogo chimpanzee community.

"Demographic and hormonal evidence for menopause in wild chimpanzees," co-authored by UCLA anthropologist Brian Wood and colleagues, presents new demographic and physiological data. Until this study, such traits had only been confirmed in a few species of toothed whales and humans among primates. The discovery may help scientists better understand why menopause and post-fertile survival occur in wild populations and their evolutionary significance.

Brian Wood noted the important societal roles of postmenopausal women globally, as providers of care and wisdom and as economic contributors. He described the evolution of this life cycle in humans as a fascinating and complex question. The research team—also including Kevin Langergraber (Arizona State University), Jacob Negrey (University of Arizona), and Ngogo Chimpanzee Project co-directors John Mitani and David Watts—found that menopause and post-fertile survival can emerge in social systems that differ greatly from humans, lacking grandparental support.

The 'grandmother hypothesis' posits that post-reproductive females enhance their genetic legacy by supporting the survival of grandchildren. While evidence supports this effect in humans, older female chimpanzees generally do not live with or care for their daughters’ offspring; nonetheless, many Ngogo females were observed living well beyond their childbearing years.

Prior reports of significant post-reproductive lifespans came mostly from captive primates, not wild populations. Favorable conditions in Ngogo, such as abundant food and low predation, may contribute to this finding, but it could also reflect an evolved trait suppressed elsewhere by human-associated disease and environmental disruption. Chimpanzees are highly susceptible to human-borne diseases, underlining the need for careful management in research settings.

The team analyzed demographic data from 185 female chimpanzees collected between 1995 and 2016 and measured hormone levels from the urine of 66 individuals, aged 14 to 67, representing various life stages. Hormonal analyses revealed a menopause-like transition starting around age 50, marked by hormone profiles similar to humans: increased follicle-stimulating and luteinizing hormones, and decreased estrogens and progestins. Childbearing ceased by age 50, with females who matured at 14 spending roughly one-fifth of adulthood post-reproductive—about half the span seen in hunter-gatherer humans.

The study relied on years of direct fieldwork and meticulous sample collection. Co-author Jacob Negrey emphasized that only through this extensive commitment could they confirm prolonged survival after reproduction in wild chimpanzees.

The authors argue these findings broaden our understanding of menopause and post-fertile survival, highlighting the importance of favorable ecological conditions and lowering predation in the evolution of extended lifespans. Further behavioral observations are needed to determine how older chimpanzees contribute to their social groups. Sustained, long-term studies of wild primates remain essential to advancing such discoveries.

Un equip d'investigadors ha documentat la presència de la menopausa i la supervivència post-reproductiva en ximpanzés femelles salvatges al Parc Nacional Kibale d’Uganda, qüestionant la creença que la menopausa era exclusiva d’humans i algunes balenes entre els mamífers. Les seves troballes, publicades a la revista Science, es basen en dues dècades d’observació de la comunitat de ximpanzés de Ngogo.

L’article «Demographic and hormonal evidence for menopause in wild chimpanzees», coescrit per l’antropòleg Brian Wood de la UCLA i col·laboradors, presenta noves dades demogràfiques i fisiològiques. Fins a aquest estudi, només s’havia confirmat aquesta característica en espècies de balenes amb dents i en humans dins dels primats. Aquest descobriment pot ajudar a entendre millor per què la menopausa i la supervivència postfèrtil es donen a les poblacions salvatges i la seva importància evolutiva.

Brian Wood destaca el paper rellevant de les dones postmenopàusiques a tot el món, tant en l’àmbit econòmic com en la cura i el consell. Va descriure l’evolució d’aquest tret vital com una qüestió fascinant i complexa. L’equip de recerca, també format per Kevin Langergraber (Arizona State University), Jacob Negrey (University of Arizona) i els codirectors del Ngogo Chimpanzee Project John Mitani i David Watts, va descobrir que la menopausa i la supervivència postfèrtil poden aparèixer en sistemes socials molt diferents dels humans, sense suport d’avis.

La «hipòtesi de l’àvia» sosté que les femelles postreproductives afavoreixen la distribució dels seus gens ajudant a la supervivència dels néts. Tot i que s’ha comprovat aquest efecte en humans, les ximpanzés grans generalment no viuen amb les filles ni cuiden els néts; tot i així, moltes femelles de Ngogo van viure força més enllà de la seva etapa reproductiva.

Les primeres observacions de vides postreproductives venien majoritàriament de primats en captivitat, no de poblacions salvatges. Les condicions favorables de Ngogo, com abundància d’aliments i baixa predació, en poden ser la causa, però també podria ser un tret evolutiu desaprofitat en altres poblacions per l’impacte humà. Els ximpanzés són especialment sensibles a malalties transmeses per humans, així que cal una gestió acurada en la recerca.

L’equip va analitzar dades demogràfiques de 185 femelles (1995–2016) i va mesurar nivells hormonals en mostres d’orina de 66 individus de 14 a 67 anys. L’anàlisi hormonal va revelar una transició a la menopausa a partir dels 50 anys, amb patrons hormonals semblants als humans: més FSH i LH, i menys estrògens i progestines. No es va observar reproducció més enllà dels 50 anys, i les femelles adultes des dels 14 van viure més o menys una cinquena part de la seva vida adulta en etapa postreproductiva —la meitat del que s’observa en humans caçadors-recol·lectors.

L’estudi es basa en anys de treball de camp i recollida detallada de mostres. El coautor Jacob Negrey va subratllar que aquest esforç de llarga durada és el que ha permès confirmar la supervivència postreproductiva en ximpanzés salvatges.

Els autors conclouen que aquests resultats amplien la comprensió de la menopausa i la supervivència postfèrtil, posant en valor la importància de les condicions ecològiques favorables i la baixa predació en l’evolució d’una vida llarga. Cal més observació del comportament de les ximpanzés grans per entendre el seu paper en el grup. Els estudis a llarg termini de primats salvatges són essencials per continuar avançant en aquest camp.

article_content: As laws become less restrictive across the United States, more Americans are reporting regular marijuana use than ever before, according to a new survey from the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration. The National Survey on Drug Use and Health, the largest of its kind, is conducted annually. Over the past five years, the results have shown a continual rise in marijuana use, with last year being no exception. In 2012, 7.3% of Americans aged 12 or older said they regularly used marijuana, up from 7% in 2011. While the year-to-year change is modest, the contrast is more striking when compared to 2007, when just 5.8% reported regular use. This increase could reflect more Americans using marijuana, or more people willing to admit to using it as stigma decreases. Marijuana has received significant public attention in recent years. Last week, U.S. Attorney General Eric Holder announced the federal government would stop prosecuting individuals for marijuana use in states where it is legal, provided there are laws preventing access by children. Previously, federal charges could apply despite state legality. Washington and Colorado have legalized recreational marijuana, and around 20 other states permit medical use. The survey, which examines drug and alcohol use broadly, also found that prescription drug abuse—which had been rising—has now plateaued, while heroin use has escalated, increasing by about 80% since 2007. Nearly 24 million Americans, or 9.2% of the population, report using illicit drugs. The survey raises the question of whether American attitudes toward marijuana are reaching a tipping point.

L'Enquesta Nacional sobre l'Ús de Drogues i Salut, la més gran del seu tipus, es realitza anualment. Durant els últims cinc anys, els resultats han mostrat un augment continuat en l’ús de marihuana, incloent-hi l’any passat. El 2012, el 7,3% dels nord-americans de 12 anys o més van dir que feien servir regularment marihuana, en comparació amb el 7% el 2011. Tot i que el canvi d’any a any és modest, la diferència és més notòria si es compara amb el 2007, quan només el 5,8% va reportar un ús regular. Aquest augment podria reflectir més nord-americans fent servir marihuana, o bé més gent disposada a admetre’n l’ús a mesura que s’esvaeix l’estigma. La marihuana ha rebut una gran atenció pública en els últims anys. La setmana passada, el Fiscal General dels Estats Units, Eric Holder, va anunciar que el govern federal deixaria de processar persones per ús de marihuana als estats on és legal, sempre que hi hagi lleis que n’impedeixin l’accés als infants. Prèviament, es podien presentar càrrecs federals tot i complir la llei estatal. Washington i Colorado han legalitzat l’ús recreatiu de marihuana, i uns 20 altres estats permeten l’ús mèdic. L’enquesta, que analitza l’ús de drogues i alcohol en general, també va trobar que l’abús de fàrmacs amb recepta —que havia anat augmentant— ara s’ha estabilitzat, mentre que l’ús d’heroïna ha augmentat, creixent aproximadament un 80% des de 2007. L’enquesta planteja si les opinions dels nord-americans sobre la marihuana estan arribant a un punt d’inflexió.

article_content: The Delhi Police has contacted Meta to obtain the URL and user details of the account that shared a 'deepfake' video of actress Rashmika Mandanna on social media, according to officials on Saturday. This step follows the recent registration of an FIR in connection with the incident. Deepfake videos are synthetic media where a person in an existing image or video is digitally replaced with someone else's likeness. Hemant Tiwari, Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) of the Intelligence Fusion and Strategic Operations (IFSO) unit, stated that the police are seeking information about individuals who shared the video online. "We have requested Meta for the account URL ID used to circulate the video and have begun technical analysis," Tiwari said. The FIR was registered under sections 465 (forgery) and 469 (forgery for purpose of harming reputation) of the Indian Penal Code, and sections 66C and 66E of the Information Technology Act, following a complaint from the Delhi Commission for Women (DCW), which took suo-moto cognizance of the video. A dedicated team of officers has been assigned to the case, and authorities are optimistic about resolving it soon. The video, believed to have been created using artificial intelligence, went viral last week. The original video reportedly featured a British-Indian influencer, but Rashmika Mandanna's face was digitally added. The remainder of the article covers recent updates on India's industrial growth, investments in edtech, and commentary from business leaders unrelated to the deepfake incident.

Aquesta acció es produeix després del recent registre d’una denúncia policial (FIR) per l’incident. Els vídeos deepfake són mitjans sintètics on una persona en una imatge o vídeo existent és reemplaçada digitalment pel rostre d’una altra. Hemant Tiwari, comissari adjunt de policia (DCP) de la Unitat d’Intel·ligència, Fusions i Operacions Estratègiques (IFSO), ha declarat que la policia està buscant informació sobre les persones que van compartir el vídeo en línia. "Hem demanat a Meta l’identificador d’URL del compte utilitzat per difondre el vídeo i hem començat l’anàlisi tècnica", ha assenyalat Tiwari. La denúncia es va registrar segons els articles 465 (falsificació) i 469 (falsificació amb intenció de perjudicar la reputació) del Codi Penal Indi, i segons els articles 66C i 66E de la Llei de Tecnologies de la Informació, arran d’una queixa de la Comissió de Dones de Delhi (DCW), que va intervenir d’ofici. S’ha assignat un equip especialitzat d’agents al cas i les autoritats són optimistes d’obtenir resultats aviat. article_content: A rapidly expanding sinkhole in Spring Hill, Florida, has sparked fear among homeowners as it threatens nearby properties. The sinkhole has doubled in size since first being spotted on Saturday, with portions of a street and a driveway already collapsing into the hole. Residents are now worried the sinkhole may soon reach their homes, potentially forcing them to relocate. Authorities say the sinkhole was initially reported at 25 yards by 25 yards and 30 feet deep. By the end of Saturday, it had grown to 40 yards by 40 yards, and its size continues to increase. The sudden appearance of the sinkhole has also attracted onlookers. Some locals have jokingly considered setting up lemonade or beer stands for the crowds gathering to view the phenomenon. Cate Carter, a nearby resident, told Fox 13, 'I thought about putting a lemonade stand out here, maybe a beer stand, charging them.' However, she acknowledged the seriousness of the situation: 'Looking at the road, it looks like it's dropped six or seven inches. This is bad. Who knows which way it'll go? It's very scary.' As a precaution, four homes were evacuated over the weekend. By Sunday afternoon, only one home remained evacuated. Officials have called in contractors to assess the full extent of the sinkhole and evaluate risks to surrounding properties.

Julie Griffiths, 43, has received a five-year Anti-Social Behaviour Order (ASBO) after repeatedly disturbing her neighbors with loud arguments and shouting at her husband, Norman, 63, over a three-year period. According to court proceedings, Griffiths breached a noise abatement order 47 times in just three months this year. Neighbors reported enduring constant noise, which prevented them from sleeping.

The initial notice was served to Mrs. Griffiths in 1999, and she was fined £500 following a further breach in 2010. Despite this, her disruptive behavior continued, prompting environmental health officers to install monitoring equipment in a neighbor’s home in July. Griffiths pleaded guilty to failing to comply with a noise abatement notice at Staffordshire Magistrates Court. The ASBO restricts her from engaging in behaviors that might cause nuisance, disturbance, or alarm to her neighbors and specifically prohibits creating noise audible to neighboring properties, shouting or banging on doors, or contacting neighbors. Any breach could result in a five-year jail sentence.

Prosecutor Lisa Hall described the case as the most severe noise complaint a local environmental health officer had encountered. Steve Lee, defending, said Griffiths' actions stemmed from exhaustion after working long shifts, adding that she did not intend harm and her outbursts did not involve violence. Councillor Tony Kearon commended the outcome and underscored the council’s commitment to addressing anti-social behavior. Neighbors expressed relief at the court’s decision, describing life next to Griffiths as extremely challenging and expressing sympathy for her husband.

Segons els procediments judicials, Griffiths va incomplir una ordre de prohibició de soroll 47 vegades només en tres mesos aquest any. Els veïns van informar que van patir sorolls constants que els impedien dormir.

Tot i això, la seva conducta molesta va continuar, fet que va portar els agents de salut ambiental a instal·lar equips de monitoratge a casa d’un veí el juliol passat. L’ASBO li impedeix dur a terme conductes que puguin causar molèsties, disturbis o alarma als veïns i, específicament, li prohibeix crear soroll audible a les propietats properes, cridar, picar portes interiors o contactar amb els veïns. Qualsevol incompliment podria comportar una pena de fins a cinc anys de presó.

La fiscal Lisa Hall va descriure el cas com la denúncia per soroll més greu que un inspector de salut ambiental local havia tractat mai. Steve Lee, l’advocat defensor, va argumentar que les accions de Griffiths derivaven de l'esgotament després de llargues jornades laborals, tot remarcat que no tenia intenció de fer mal i que els seus esclats no comportaven violència. El regidor Tony Kearon va elogiar la decisió i va subratllar el compromís del consell per lluitar contra el comportament antisocial. Els veïns van expressar alleujament per la decisió judicial, descrivint la convivència amb Griffiths com a extremadament difícil i mostrant simpatia pel seu marit.

article_content: Jason Dufner became an unexpected internet sensation after a photo captured him slouched against a wall during a charity event at J. Erik Jonsson Community School in Dallas. In the photograph, taken by Christine Lee of KXAS-TV, Dufner is seen in a red golf shirt sitting next to two attentive children, looking vacant and expressionless—a reflection of his famously stoic personality. The photo quickly went viral after it was posted to Twitter by sports anchor David Watkins, sparking a trend known as 'dufnering,' in which people imitated Dufner's relaxed, slumped pose. Golfers like Keegan Bradley, Luke Donald, Rory McIlroy, Bubba Watson, and many from the public joined in, posting their own versions on social media. Dufner explained that the class was discussing focus and relaxation, and he was simply tired after sitting for hours. He took the sudden attention in stride, even retweeting photos of others 'dufnering.' Despite humorous speculation, Dufner emphasized that his demeanor was typical for him, both in and out of competition. The event at the school was tied to the Byron Nelson Championship, whose charitable proceeds benefit students there. Dufner, last year’s tournament winner, was making a publicity appearance as defending champion. He has become known on the PGA Tour for his calm presence, famously showing little emotion even during high-stakes tournaments. As the meme spread, it drew in fellow golfers and fans, with Keegan Bradley noting how rapidly his own Twitter filled with 'dufnering' photos. Rory McIlroy remarked on the meme’s popularity at the Houston Open, and Brandt Snedeker commented humorously that Dufner’s pose resembled someone being put in 'timeout.' Dufner, who only a few years ago was relatively unknown, has since become a household name, owing in part to his steady golfing and now this viral moment. He remarked that the attention mostly amused him, joking that his wife, Amanda, gets to see him 'dufnering' more than anyone.

A la fotografia, presa per Christine Lee de KXAS-TV, Dufner apareix amb una samarreta vermella de golf, assegut al costat de dos nens atents i amb una expressió buida i impassible—una mostra de la seva personalitat conegudament estoica. La foto es va fer viral ràpidament després que el periodista esportiu David Watkins la pengés a Twitter, donant peu a una tendència anomenada 'dufnering', en què la gent imitava la postura relaxada i enfonsada de Dufner. Golfistes com Keegan Bradley, Luke Donald, Rory McIlroy, Bubba Watson i molts aficionats s’hi van sumar i van penjar les seves pròpies versions a les xarxes socials. Dufner va explicar que la classe tractava sobre la concentració i la relaxació, i que simplement estava cansat després d'hores assegut. Es va prendre tota l’atenció amb filosofia, arribant fins i tot a repiular fotos d'altres fent 'dufnering'. Tot i les especulacions en clau d’humor, Dufner va remarcar que aquesta actitud és habitual en ell, tant dins com fora de la competició. L’acte a l’escola estava relacionat amb el Byron Nelson Championship, del qual una part dels beneficis es destina als alumnes. Dufner, el guanyador del torneig de l’any anterior, hi feia una visita publicitària com a campió defensor. És conegut al circuit PGA per la seva presència calmada i per mostrar poques emocions, fins i tot en moments de màxima pressió. A mesura que el meme es va escampar, va atreure companys golfistes i aficionats. Keegan Bradley va destacar com de ràpid es va omplir el seu propi Twitter de fotos de 'dufnering'. Rory McIlroy va comentar la popularitat del meme a l’Houston Open, i Brandt Snedeker va fer broma dient que la pose de Dufner semblava la d’algú que està de cara a la paret castigat. Dufner, que fa només uns anys era poc conegut, s’ha convertit ara en un nom destacat, en part per la seva constant trajectòria i ara per aquest moment viral. Va dir que tota l’atenció li feia força gràcia, i va bromejar que la seva dona, l’Amanda, és qui més el veu fent 'dufnering'.

article_content: Over the past two years, Nigeria has seen its inflation rate rise almost every month, according to an analysis of data from the National Bureau of Statistics. From October 2021 to October 2023, inflation increased 24 out of 25 months, with only one brief slowdown in December 2022. During this period, the rate jumped from 15.99% to 27.33%, sharply raising living costs for most Nigerians. Inflation refers to the continued rise in prices for goods and services, making money less valuable over time. As a result, people's incomes buy less than before. For example, where a monthly salary of N100,000 used to cover half of a household's expenses, the same amount now pays for far less, leaving little room for saving. A June 2023 report from the National Bureau of Statistics revealed that persistent inflation and ongoing depreciation of the naira eliminated N13.72 trillion in salary gains for Nigerian workers over the past four years. The impact has been severe. The World Bank’s June 2023 Nigeria Development Update estimated that about four million Nigerians fell into poverty in just the first five months of 2023, mainly due to rapid inflation eroding purchasing power. The World Bank notes that Nigeria's inflation is among the highest in the world, fueled by currency troubles, trade restrictions, and deficit financing by the Central Bank. Economist Prof. Sheriffdeen Tella from Olabisi Onabanjo University explained that repeated spikes in inflation start a cycle of economic hardship—reduced purchasing power cuts demand, which then forces businesses to scale back and lay off staff. People are forced to spend more on basic needs like food, leaving little for non-essentials, which in turn hits manufacturers. This shift in spending habits is causing real difficulties for companies, with the Manufacturers Association reporting that some goods can no longer find buyers. Prolonged inflation is causing a ripple effect throughout Nigeria’s economy.

Des de l'octubre de 2021 fins a l'octubre de 2023, la inflació va créixer en 24 dels 25 mesos, amb només una petita aturada al desembre de 2022. En aquest període, la taxa va passar del 15,99% al 27,33%, augmentant significativament el cost de la vida per a la majoria de nigerians. La inflació fa referència a l'increment continuat dels preus de béns i serveis, fent que els diners perdin valor amb el temps. Això fa que els ingressos comprin menys que abans. Per exemple, un salari mensual de 100.000 Naira abans cobria la meitat de les despeses d'una llar; ara, aquesta mateixa quantitat es queda molt curta i l'estalvi es redueix. Un informe del juny de 2023 de l'Oficina Nacional d'Estadística va destacar que la inflació persistent i la depreciació del naira han eliminat 13,72 bilions de naires en guanys salarials assolits pels treballadors nigerians en els darrers quatre anys. L'impacte ha estat greu. L'actualització de desenvolupament del Banc Mundial de juny de 2023 estima que uns quatre milions de nigerians van caure en la pobresa només entre gener i maig de 2023, principalment pel ràpid augment de la inflació i la pèrdua de poder adquisitiu. El Banc Mundial assenyala que la inflació a Nigèria és de les més elevades arreu del món, impulsada per problemes monetaris, restriccions comercials i finançament del dèficit pel Banc Central. L'economista professor Sheriffdeen Tella, de la Universitat Olabisi Onabanjo, explica que els constants augments de la inflació desencadenen un cercle viciós: la pèrdua de poder adquisitiu redueix la demanda, la qual cosa obliga les empreses a reduir producció i acomiadar personal. La gent es veu obligada a centrar la despesa en necessitats bàsiques com el menjar, deixant poc marge per a altres productes, la qual cosa afecta el sector dels fabricants. Aquesta reorientació del consum genera problemes reals al teixit productiu, i l'Associació de Fabricants adverteix que alguns productes ja no tenen sortida al mercat. La inflació persistent està provocant una ona de conseqüències a tota l'economia de Nigèria.

article_content: James Files, a former mob hitman, has renewed his claim that he was behind the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. Files asserts that on November 22, 1963, he fired the fatal shot from the grassy knoll in Dallas, targeting Kennedy as the presidential motorcade passed by. He contends that the other shot striking President Kennedy was fired by his boss, Charles 'Chuckie' Nicoletti, who he says was positioned in the Texas School Book Depository—the same building where Lee Harvey Oswald was believed to have been at the time. Files claims Oswald did not fire any shots during the assassination. He detailed his account in a recent Newsmax TV documentary, 'I Killed JFK.' According to Files, he chose the grassy knoll to blend in with railroad workers, allowing him to approach and leave undetected. Files describes aiming for Kennedy's right eye through a rifle scope, firing once, and then walking away unnoticed, even by two police officers he said were nearby. He also says his boss, Nicoletti, was in the book depository at the time, not Oswald. Files alleges he left a shell casing at the scene, which he bit as a sort of calling card. Decades later, a shell casing matching Files’ description was reportedly found by a boy and his father in the grassy knoll area. Former FBI agent Zack Shelton has expressed belief in parts of Files' story, stating he was able to verify some elements. However, five official government investigations into President Kennedy’s assassination have concluded that Oswald acted alone. Files has repeated these claims multiple times, including in a 2010 Playboy interview. He is currently serving a 50-year prison sentence following a 1991 conviction for the attempted murder of two police officers.

article_content:
On December 2, 2012, a deadly incident took place in the Sasago Tunnel, located about 50 miles west of Tokyo on the Chuo Expressway. Several concrete ceiling panels, each approximately 20 centimeters thick, unexpectedly fell, causing a fire and trapping vehicles inside the tunnel. Nine people lost their lives in the accident, while two others were injured and transported to the hospital.

Rescue operations were complicated by heavy smoke and ongoing risks of further collapses, leading authorities to temporarily suspend the search until the tunnel’s structure was reinforced. The Sasago Tunnel, a key part of the expressway connecting Tokyo with central Japan, remains closed as a precaution.

Central Japan Expressway Co.—the tunnel’s operator—has launched inspections of similar tunnels, with President Takekazu Kaneko announcing expanded safety checks. Police and the highway authority are still investigating what caused the concrete panels to fall. The disaster has deeply shocked Japan and highlighted concerns about the safety of critical infrastructure.

article_content: Sonic Dream Team will be released exclusively on Apple Arcade on December 5, as confirmed by an October 2 IGN report. This upcoming game brings a fresh twist by blending elements from Sega’s renowned NiGHTS series into the Sonic universe. The story focuses on Dr. Eggman, Sonic’s long-time adversary, who discovers The Reverie—a mysterious ancient device that can turn dreams into reality. With this powerful artifact, Eggman’s dreams of world domination suddenly seem possible as the world becomes a dream-like realm. Sonic and his friends must act quickly to stop Eggman and prevent his eccentric, possibly catastrophic dreams from coming true. Players can control several characters, including Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and Amy. The game also marks the return of Cream, absent in recent years, and features Rouge. Each character comes with unique abilities suited to three distinct movement styles, which are essential for navigating 12 levels set across four surreal dream worlds. The dream realms are filled with challenging environments—such as shifting gravity and wall-running. Each realm ends with a boss battle that tests players’ mastery of movement mechanics. In addition, a new character, Ariem—a ram inspired by the zodiac sign Aries and marked with a moon tattoo on her forehead—joins the adventure; her role remains a mystery but adds intrigue to the game. Sonic Dream Team is not Sega’s first release on Apple Arcade; it follows Sonic Racing and Sonic Dash+, making it the third Sonic-based game on the platform. Other Sega titles on Apple Arcade include Samba de Amigo: Party-To-Go and Football Manager 2023. A key feature of Sonic Dream Team is its seamless cross-platform play, enabling fans to enjoy the game on iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple TV. This integration expands access to the Sonic universe across all Apple devices. Image Credit: Apple Store; Sonic Dream3D.

article_content: Ahead of Diwali, Israel's ambassador to India, Naor Gilon, has called on Indians to light a 'Diya of Hope' for the 240 Israelis held hostage by Hamas since the October 7 attack. In a video posted on X, Gilon compared the ritual of lighting diyas to celebrate Lord Ram's return on Diwali to the hope for the safe return of their loved ones, inviting people to participate and share their photos with the hashtag #DiyaOfHope. Gilon condemned Hamas for the October 7 assault, stating that eliminating the group would reduce the risk of escalating instability in the region. He asserted that Israel gave civilians time to evacuate to southern Gaza, but accused Hamas of using civilians as human shields and hiding in hospitals. Gilon also remarked on international pressure regarding Israel's military operations. Recalling the events of October 7, Gilon recounted that Hamas fighters infiltrated 30 Israeli communities, killing 1,400 people and abducting 240 others, in addition to launching thousands of rockets toward Israel. He claimed that approximately 2,000 rockets have fallen short inside Gaza itself. Israel waited nearly three weeks before launching a ground operation, during which time they repeatedly urged civilians in North Gaza to evacuate southward. Gilon also commented on the broader political context, suggesting that the conflict is part of larger regional power struggles, with countries like the US, Russia, Iran, Qatar, and Turkey playing significant roles. Meanwhile, the Israeli Defence Forces (IDF) released images of weapons reportedly seized from Hamas, including grenades, explosive belts, firearms, rockets, and missiles. The IDF stated these weapons were used in attacks resulting in the deaths of over 1,400 Israeli civilians. Speaking to ABC News, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that Israel would maintain security responsibility over Gaza for an indefinite period following the conflict, citing concerns over a resurgence of Hamas if Israel withdraws.

article_content: Israeli airstrikes continued on Tuesday, striking multiple locations across the Gaza Strip and resulting in the deaths of dozens of Palestinians. One of the deadliest incidents occurred at a school in the Bureij camp, where at least 20 people, including children, were killed. According to the Palestinian news agency Wafa, thousands of displaced people were taking shelter in the school. In separate attacks, Israeli strikes killed at least 19 people and injured many more after a family home was hit in Shujayea, east of Gaza City. An additional 15 people were reported killed in the bombing of three homes in the Sabra neighborhood of Gaza City, with six killed in the Nuseirat refugee camp and four in Jabalia. According to the Health Ministry in the blockaded enclave, the Palestinian death toll from Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip has risen to 14,128 as of Tuesday.

article_content: Rescue teams in Uttarakhand, India, are making progress as they work to free 41 workers trapped inside a collapsed tunnel, officials say. Hopes are high that the operation will succeed by Thursday afternoon. The workers became trapped on November 12 when a landslide damaged the tunnel during construction. Since then, emergency crews have maintained contact with the workers and sent essential supplies—including oxygen, food, and water—through a pipeline originally intended for tunnel construction. Officials provide regular updates on the situation, but frustration and worry among the workers’ families persist due to the prolonged timeline. On Monday, relatives were temporarily reassured when a camera inserted through a new pipe captured video of the trapped men. Authorities confirmed their identities on camera and reiterated their commitment to rescuing the team. The wider pipe allows greater delivery of supplies, including medicine, mobile phones, chargers, and, after ten days, the first hot meal—rice and lentils sent in bottles. Drilling resumed at the tunnel entrance early Wednesday, but iron rods in the debris slowed progress and required a switch to metal cutters. Despite these setbacks, officials remain confident of a successful rescue by Thursday afternoon. Four pipes 900mm wide have been inserted, with an 800mm pipe now being advanced using a telescopic tunneling method. The rescue strategy involves connecting pipes to form a roughly 60-meter-long micro-tunnel for the workers to crawl through to safety. Loose soil, rocks, and debris have led to delays, though parallel plans involve rescuing the men from the tunnel’s opposite end or through vertical drilling from above. Medical staff remain on site, staying in communication with the men. The Silkyara tunnel is part of a federal highway improvement scheme, meant to make religious sites in the Himalayas more accessible. The area’s mountainous terrain is also particularly prone to landslides and earthquakes.

Hi ha esperances elevades que l’operació tingui èxit abans de dijous a la tarda. Els treballadors van quedar atrapats el 12 de novembre quan un despreniment de terres va malmetre el túnel durant la seva construcció. Des de llavors, els equips d’emergència han mantingut el contacte amb els treballadors i els han fet arribar subministraments essencials—com oxigen, menjar i aigua—per una canonada destinada inicialment a la construcció del túnel. Els responsables informen sobre la situació regularment, però la frustració i la preocupació entre les famílies dels treballadors persisteix per la llarga espera. Dilluns, els familiars van sentir cert alleujament quan una càmera inserida per una nova canonada va captar les imatges dels homes atrapats. Les autoritats van confirmar-ne la identitat a càmera i van reiterar el seu compromís d’alliberar-los aviat. La nova canonada, més ampla, permet enviar més subministraments, incloent medicaments, telèfons, carregadors i, per primer cop en deu dies, un àpat calent—arròs i llenties dins d’ampolles. Dimecres al matí, es van reprendre els treballs de perforació a l’entrada del túnel, però la presència de barres de ferro en les runes va endarrerir l’avenç i va requerir l’ús de talladores metàl·liques. Tot i aquests entrebancs, les autoritats mantenen la confiança que el rescat s’aconseguirà abans de dijous a la tarda. Ja s’han instal·lat quatre canonades de 900 mm d’amplada i ara se n’està afegint una de 800 mm mitjançant una tècnica telescòpica. L’estratègia consisteix a connectar les canonades per crear un microtúnel d’uns 60 metres perquè els treballadors puguin sortir arrossegant-se. El terreny inestable i les runes han provocat alguns retards, tot i que s’estan considerant altres opcions, com intentar el rescat des de l’altre extrem del túnel o perforar verticalment des de la part superior. El personal mèdic segueix a lloc i es manté en contacte amb els atrapats. El túnel de Silkyara forma part d’un projecte federal per millorar les vies d'accés als llocs de pelegrinatge hindús a l’Himàlaia, una àrea muntanyosa especialment vulnerable als despreniments i als terratrèmols.

article_content: Bulgarian politician Ahmed Dogan survived an assassination attempt today when an armed man approached him during a speech in Sofia. The attacker, identified as Oktai Enimehmedov, pointed a gun at Dogan's head, but the weapon misfired, allowing Dogan to react and knock the attacker's hand away. Security personnel and conference delegates quickly subdued Enimehmedov, tackling him to the ground and restraining him until police arrived. Photographs and television footage showed the dramatic moment Enimehmedov rushed the stage and was later detained. Enimehmedov, who suffered visible injuries during the incident, was arrested and found to be carrying two knives in addition to the firearm. According to Ceyhan Ibryamov, a Movement for Rights and Freedoms (MRF) official, Ahmed Dogan was unharmed and the situation remained under control. The attack occurred at the MRF party’s annual conference in Sofia, Bulgaria's capital. The MRF is a liberal party that represents ethnic Turks and other Muslims, accounting for about 12 percent of Bulgaria’s population of 7.3 million. Dogan, 58, has led the party for nearly 25 years and is regarded as one of Bulgaria’s most influential politicians. Although political violence is rare in Bulgaria, there have been previous high-profile cases, such as the assassination of former Prime Minister Andrei Lukanov in 1996. The MRF was previously a junior partner in a Socialist-led government, later joining the opposition after the 2009 elections. In this incident, security measures ensured Dogan’s safety, and the attacker is in police custody. Authorities are investigating the case further.

El MRF havia estat soci menor en un govern socialista, i es va passar a l’oposició després de les eleccions del 2009. En aquest cas, les mesures de seguretat van garantir la seguretat de Dogan, i l’atacant es troba sota custòdia policial. Les autoritats continuen investigant els fets.

article_content:
Chelsea will begin their Barclays Under-21 Premier League title defense against Manchester City on August 15. Last season’s beaten finalists, Manchester United, will open their campaign on the same evening against Norwich City.

The new Under-21 season introduces a fresh format: instead of a 22-team division, the league is now split into two divisions of 12 teams each, with the play-off system removed. Key matches will be televised live on Sky Sports and BT Sport for the first time, increasing coverage and exposure.

Chelsea claimed last season’s title by defeating Manchester United 2-1 at Old Trafford, with young talents Charly Musonda and Lewis Baker scoring. Manager Jose Mourinho recently endorsed Baker and fellow prospects Izzy Brown and Dominic Solanke, expressing his belief they could play for England.

The opening Chelsea vs. Manchester City match will take place at Aldershot Town’s Recreation Ground. Manchester United will host Norwich at Leigh Sports Village, both matches scheduled for August 15.

Each team in their respective division will play all others home and away. At season's end, two teams will be relegated and two promoted between divisions.

Division One includes Chelsea, Manchester City, Manchester United, Norwich City, Everton, Fulham, Leicester City, Liverpool, Southampton, Sunderland, Tottenham, and West Ham. Division Two features Arsenal, Aston Villa, Blackburn Rovers, Bolton Wanderers, Brighton & Hove Albion, Derby County, Middlesbrough, Newcastle United, Reading, Stoke City, West Bromwich, and Wolves. Brighton and Derby are new additions to the top flight after earning Category One academy status.

Opening fixtures include:

Division One – Friday, August 15:
- Chelsea vs Manchester City, Aldershot Town, 7.05pm
- Manchester United vs Norwich City, Leigh Sports Village, 7pm

Monday, August 18:
- Everton vs Leicester City, Southport FC, 7pm
- Southampton vs Fulham, Staplewood Training Ground, 2.30pm
- Sunderland vs Liverpool, Eppleton Colliery Welfare Ground, 7pm
- Tottenham vs West Ham, Lamex Stadium, 7pm

Division Two – Friday, August 15:
- Derby County vs Middlesbrough, iPRO Stadium, 7pm
- Reading vs Arsenal, Basingstoke Town, 7pm

Monday, August 18:
- Aston Villa vs Stoke City, Bodymoor Heath Training Ground, 1pm
- Bolton vs Newcastle United, Lancashire FA Headquarters, 7pm
- Brighton vs Blackburn, Sussex County FA Headquarters, 7pm
- West Bromwich vs Wolves, The Hawthorns, 7pm

Matches will generally be played on Thursday, Friday, and Monday evenings, complementing the senior league schedules. More fixtures will be held at club main stadiums, offering fans more opportunities to attend matches at venues like Old Trafford, Anfield, and the Emirates.

Teams may select up to three outfield players and one goalkeeper older than 21 for each match, allowing first-team players recovering from injury to participate. The Premier League aims to create a senior matchday atmosphere for Under-21 games, including pre-match handshakes, pitch-side advertising, and official interview backdrops.

Sportsmail will provide full coverage of the Under-21 Premier League, along with the FA Youth Cup, UEFA Youth League, and England youth internationals throughout the season.

article_content: Seoul has launched a new tourist police force, with officers wearing uniforms designed by Korean fashion designer Kim Seo-ryong, who is known for creating costumes for 'Gangnam Style' singer Psy. During the inauguration at Gwanghwamun Square, officers performed Psy's famous horse-riding dance as 'Gangnam Style' played. The Korea Tourism Organization (KTO) stated that the force, consisting of 101 men and women, was established in response to increasing numbers of visitors to Seoul. The tourist police will patrol major areas such as Myeong-dong, Insa-dong, the Itaewon Tourist Special Zone, and Hongdae. In addition to maintaining law and order and preventing overcharging by merchants and taxi drivers, the officers will assist tourists in English, Japanese, and Chinese. According to the KTO, complaints involving shopping among foreign tourists rose from 23.6% of all complaints in 2008 to 34.7% last year. Overcharging by taxi and other transportation operators accounted for 15-20% of complaints in the past five years, as reported by Chosun.com. Currently, tourist police operate only in Seoul, but plans are underway for expansion to other regions. Ryou Hyun-cheol, director of the foreign affairs planning division at the National Police Agency, told The Korea Times that the government plans to recruit more officers. The force is expected to launch next in Jeju Island, and later expand to cities like Busan and Incheon. This is not the first time South Korean tourism officials have used Psy's international fame to attract visitors. The 'Gangnam Style' music video has received over 1.79 billion views on YouTube, making it one of the most-watched videos on the platform. In April, Psy was appointed as South Korea’s tourism ambassador, appearing in TV commercials aired in 70 countries to promote the country. In these commercials, Psy showcases food, activities, and places in South Korea, including Dongdaemun’s late-night shopping district and Myeongdong’s ‘Cosmetic Road,’ known for its makeup shops. Psy accepted minimal compensation for this role, saying it was meaningful to represent his country. Frances Cha contributed to this report.

Durant la inauguració a la plaça Gwanghwamun, els agents van fer el famós ball del cavall de Psy mentre sonava 'Gangnam Style'. L'Organització de Turisme de Corea (KTO) ha declarat que la nova força, formada per 101 homes i dones, s'ha creat com a resposta a l'augment de visitants a Seül. La policia turística patrullarà zones importants com Myeong-dong, Insa-dong, la Zona Especial Turística d'Itaewon i Hongdae. A més de mantenir l'ordre i evitar que comerciants i taxistes cobrin de més, els agents ajudaran els turistes en anglès, japonès i xinès. Segons la KTO, les queixes dels turistes estrangers relacionades amb compres van augmentar del 23,6% del total de queixes el 2008 al 34,7% l'any passat. Els cobraments excessius per part de taxistes i altres operadors de transport van suposar entre el 15 i el 20% de les queixes als darrers cinc anys, segons ha informat Chosun.com. Actualment, la policia turística només opera a Seül, però hi ha plans per expandir el servei a altres regions. Ryou Hyun-cheol, director de la divisió de planificació d'afers exteriors de l'Agència Nacional de Policia, va dir a The Korea Times que el govern vol contractar més agents. Es preveu que el servei s'estreni properament a l’illa de Jeju, i més endavant a ciutats com Busan i Incheon. No és el primer cop que les autoritats turístiques de Corea del Sud fan servir la fama internacional de Psy per atraure visitants. El vídeo musical de 'Gangnam Style' té més de 1,79 mil milions de visualitzacions a YouTube, convertint-se en un dels vídeos més vistos a la plataforma. A l'abril, Psy va ser nomenat ambaixador de turisme de Corea del Sud, apareixent en anuncis televisius emesos a 70 països per promocionar el país. En aquests anuncis, Psy mostra menjar, activitats i llocs de Corea del Sud, com el barri comercial nocturn de Dongdaemun i el 'Cosmetic Road' de Myeongdong, conegut per les seves botigues de maquillatge. Psy va acceptar una compensació mínima per aquest paper, afirmant que era significatiu representar el seu país. Frances Cha ha col·laborat en aquest reportatge.

article_content: Two men were rescued late Monday night after their 19-foot motorboat became disabled on the Niagara River. The vessel was anchored about two miles upstream from Niagara Falls, deep within a protected exclusion zone created for safety. The Coast Guard’s Buffalo station received a distress call at around 9:15 pm, but shallow river conditions prevented rescue boats from reaching them. Responders then dispatched a helicopter from the Detroit air station, which hoisted the men to safety just before midnight. The dramatic nighttime rescue was captured using night vision technology. State and local police were also involved in the response. The stranded boat remains on the river and will be retrieved by a commercial salvage service. No injuries were reported.

Per aquest motiu, es va enviar un helicòpter des de l’estació aèria de Detroit, que va evacuar les dues persones poc abans de mitjanit. article_content: StudioCanal has partnered with Mercis and SUPERPROD Animation to develop and produce a new CGI animated series based on the classic children's character Miffy. The series, currently in development with CANAL+, is scheduled to premiere on the channel in 2025. The announcement was made by Françoise Guyonnet, Executive Managing Director of TV Series at StudioCanal, during Brand Licensing Europe (BLE) in London, alongside Marja Kerkhof, Managing Director at Mercis, and Clément Calvet and Jérémie Fajner, co-founders of SUPERPROD Group. International sales for the series will be managed by Mercis in the Netherlands and Japan, and by StudioCanal and SUPERIGHTS in other regions. Mercis will also oversee all merchandising and publishing rights for the new series. In related news, Magic Frame Animation and Creation Entertainment Media have announced the upcoming animated feature film 'Rebellious', which will debut at AFM in November. The project brings together writers Annalisa LaBianco (The Beverly Hills Chihuahua, Tom and Jerry in New York) and Jeffery Spencer (Secret Magic Control Agency), with Sasha Shapiro (Dirty Grandpa) serving as producer. 'Rebellious' is described as a modern fairytale following a strong-willed princess who is kidnapped by an evil sorcerer named Kezabor. Her resourceful fiancé must embark on an epic quest to rescue her, while the princess actively challenges her captors and plans a daring escape. Sefi Carmel, CEO of Creation Entertainment Media, commented, 'The incredible team behind this film have brought this modern fairytale to life through its dynamic characters, and we are delighted to share it with potential buyers next month at AFM. Inspired by some of the most popular fairytales, Rebellious offers a brave princess and plenty of action.'

article_content: West Coast beachcombers may encounter somber discoveries in the coming months, as experts anticipate human remains could wash ashore following the 2011 Japanese tsunami. Among the estimated 1.5 million tons of debris traveling the 3,500-mile route from Japan toward Alaska and other parts of North America, dozens of bones are expected to surface. Oceanographer Curt Ebbesmeyer, co-creator of the Ocean Surface Current Simulator, warned at a recent symposium in Washington that respectful handling of any human remains is crucial. 'We're expecting 100 sneakers with bones in them,' he said. Those who come across such remains are advised to contact authorities; DNA testing may help identify victims still missing since the disaster struck in March 2011. Items of all kinds, from fuel canisters to beer crates, are already turning up on Montague Island, Alaska, where a 12-day cleanup is underway. Montague, the largest uninhabited U.S. island, lies 120 miles southeast of Anchorage and has been inundated with buoys, Styrofoam, lunch boxes, and other debris. Patrick Chandler from the Center for Alaskan Coastal Studies described the findings from initial beach surveys as containing an unprecedented amount of high-floating material. Alongside everyday items, beachcombers have discovered unusual objects, such as a Harley-Davidson motorcycle found on Graham Island, British Columbia, and a football that was reunited with its owner, a Japanese teenager named Misaki Murakami, after it washed ashore on Middleton Island, Alaska. Recent computer models and satellite imagery predict that massive amounts of debris—possibly stretching 4,000 miles across—will begin washing up in greater quantities this October and continue through late 2013. About 4.8 million tonnes of material, including building parts, vehicles, and household items, were swept out to sea during the tsunami, with 1.5 million tonnes of lighter debris expected to drift to North America. Earlier projections suggested most debris would arrive between March 2013 and March 2014, but updated forecasts from Japanese and U.S. agencies now push the date forward. Many lighter objects started arriving as early as November last year. While Alaska, British Columbia, Washington, and Oregon are expected to see the majority of the debris, ocean currents will likely protect most of California. Hawaii may also receive deposits. The US Navy and Coast Guard are monitoring the situation due to potential navigational hazards. Authorities emphasize that, despite concerns, the debris field is spread thinly across the Pacific and is not presenting as a massive, concentrated mass.

Dins dels aproximadament 1,5 milions de tones de deixalles que recorre els 5.600 km des del Japó fins a Alaska i altres parts d’Amèrica del Nord, s’espera que surtin a la llum diverses restes òssies. L’oceanògraf Curt Ebbesmeyer, cocreador del simulador de corrents oceànics a la superfície, va advertir en un simposi recent a Washington que és crucial tractar amb respecte qualsevol resta humana trobada. “Esperem trobar un centenar de sabatilles amb ossos dins”, va dir. Es recomana a qui trobi aquestes restes que contacti amb les autoritats; les proves d’ADN podrien ajudar a identificar les víctimes encara desaparegudes des del desastre del març de 2011. Tot tipus d’objectes, des de bidons de combustible fins a caixes de cervesa, ja estan apareixent a l’illa de Montague, Alaska, on s’està duent a terme una neteja de 12 dies. Montague, la illa inhabitada més gran dels EUA, es troba a 120 milles (193 km) al sud-est d’Anchorage i ha estat inundada de boies, poliestirè, carmanyoles i altres deixalles. Patrick Chandler, del Center for Alaskan Coastal Studies, va descriure els resultats de les primeres inspeccions com una quantitat sense precedents de material flotant. A més d’objectes quotidians, s’han trobat peces insòlites, com una motocicleta Harley-Davidson trobada a Graham Island (Colúmbia Britànica) i una pilota de futbol que va arribar de nou al seu propietari, un adolescent japonès anomenat Misaki Murakami, després que sortís a la platja de Middleton Island (Alaska). Els models per ordinador i les imatges per satèl·lit recents preveuen que grans quantitats de deixalles —potser s’estenent fins a 6.400 km— començaran a arribar en més volum aquest octubre i fins a finals de 2013. Aproximadament 4,8 milions de tones de materials, incloent-hi parts d’edificis, vehicles i objectes domèstics, van ser arrossegats al mar durant el tsunami, dels quals 1,5 milions de tones de residus lleugers podrien arribar a Amèrica del Nord. Primeres previsions suggerien que la major part de deixalles arribarien entre març del 2013 i març del 2014, però estimacions recents d’agències del Japó i dels EUA avancen la data. Molts objectes lleugers ja van començar a arribar tan aviat com al novembre passat. Tot i que s’espera que Alaska, Colúmbia Britànica, Washington i Oregon rebin la major part de les deixalles, els corrents marins probablement protegiran la major part de Califòrnia. Hawaii també podria rebre dipòsits. La Marina dels EUA i la Guàrdia Costanera estan vigilant la situació pels possibles riscos per a la navegació. Les autoritats subratllen que, malgrat les preocupacions, el camp de deixalles es dispersa per tot el Pacífic i no arriba a ser una massa compacta ni amenaçadora.

article_content: If you’re shopping for a serious coffee lover, this curated gear list draws from a decade of experience behind the counter and a lifelong passion for great coffee. These recommendations aren’t just trendy picks—they’re handpicked essentials, tried and tested in the real world. From classic brewers to innovative gadgets, the list blends coffee lore, smart design, and everyday practicality.  1. Fellow Stagg Kettle ($165, Fellow/Amazon) Exceptional water makes exceptional coffee, and the Fellow Stagg sets the standard among electric kettles. Designed for precision, with the ability to heat and hold water at exactly the right temperature for up to an hour, it transforms your pour-over ritual. A built-in timer replaces the need for extra gadgets, and its modern look elevates any kitchen. Simpler than the Pro version—it skips unnecessary Wi-Fi features for pure function.  2. Vintage Popcorn Popper (~$60, Ebay) Legendary among home roasting enthusiasts, vintage hot air popcorn poppers are an affordable gateway into roasting your own green coffee beans. While the process is not highly precise and roasting beans in this manner fills your house with grassy aromas, it’s a surprisingly fun, hands-on way for coffee fans to experiment at home. Pair a popper with beans from Sweet Maria’s and their guides to get started—but be careful: these devices get hot!  3. xBloom Coffee Machine ($799, xBloom/Amazon) The xBloom represents a leap forward in home coffee automation. It uses special air-sealed xPods with fresh beans, and when tapped, the machine reads the RFID and automatically adjusts grind, water temperature, and pouring for each specific bean batch—essentially letting celebrated roasters fine-tune your cup. It’s like a personal barista, offering both expertly preset settings and in-app customization for true aficionados.  4. Ozeri Pronto Digital Scale ($14.95, Amazon) Sometimes, simple is best. The Ozeri Pronto scale is a durable, reliable option trusted by pros for years, outlasting fancier options that cost much more. Battery-powered and straightforward, it does one job well: weighing ingredients. No distracting extras—just accuracy, consistency, and a price point that makes it a perfect stocking stuffer.  5. Wilfa Performance Coffee Maker ($249, Ladera) After early missteps, Wilfa’s innovative coffee maker is back and better than ever, combining Scandinavian design with barista-level brewing. It features clear guides for brewing ratios and allows manual control over water flow, while a special reservoir keeps your coffee at the perfect temperature. After rigorous European reviews and fixes, it’s now finally on offer in the U.S.—a standout for quality and aesthetics.  6. Chemex ($49.50, Chemex/Amazon) An American design icon since the 1930s, the Chemex pour-over is loved for its elegant laboratory-inspired look and unique filtration. Invented by Dr. Peter Schlumbohm, this glass vessel delivers clear, flavorful coffee and has permanent status in design museums. It’s a staple no serious coffee lover should miss.  7. Breville Dose Control Pro Grinder ($159.95, Breville/Target) A consistent grind is key to great coffee, and the Dose Control Pro offers solid performance with 60 precise settings using professional-grade burrs. Its intuitive design, large hopper, and reliable construction make it a favorite for those who brew regularly across different styles, from espresso to French press.  8. Nespresso Inissia ($179, Amazon) While traditional espresso makers can be expensive and complex, the Nespresso Inissia is an affordable, consistent alternative. It delivers quality espresso with minimal fuss and maintenance—ideal for anyone who wants café-style shots at home without the learning curve or price tag. Sometimes, convenience wins.  9. Kinto Travel Mug ($37, Kinto/Amazon) The Kinto tumbler brings Japanese minimalism and advanced design together in a travel companion. Its double-walled, vacuum-insulated build keeps drinks hot or cold for hours, while thoughtful features like a slow-pouring lid and leak-proof seals make it a pleasure to use anywhere. Available in multiple sizes and colors, it’s a go-to gift for those on the move.  10. UniTerra Nomad Espresso Maker ($300, UniTerra) For adventurous coffee fans, the Nomad produces authentic espresso shots off-grid—no electricity needed, just hot water and a simple pump action. Its unique looks and engineering make it both a conversation starter and a real performer, praised for shot quality and portability. While it’s a bit of a splurge, it doubles as a fun outdoor gadget and a stylish at-home display piece.
