article_content: MEXICO CITY – Thousands of people gathered on Saturday to watch Mexico City's Day of the Dead parade, where costumed dancers, drummers, and colorful floats traveled down Paseo de la Reforma boulevard to the historic main square. Marching bands dressed as skeletons and dancers with skull face paint performed in Indigenous attire. The aroma of traditional resinous copal incense filled the air. A skeleton drum group played samba-style rhythms, while nearby, dancers wore skirts painted like the wings of monarch butterflies, symbolizing their traditional migration to Mexico during the Day of the Dead. Reflecting social change, a group of drag performers appeared as 'Catrinas,' skeletal figures in elaborate 1870s-style dress. The holiday begins on October 31, honoring those who died in accidents. It continues on November 1 for those who passed away in childhood and concludes on November 2 by celebrating adults who have died. The city also features a massive altar and hosts a procession of vibrant sculptures known as 'alebrijes.' Such parades were not originally part of most Day of the Dead traditions in Mexico, although Oaxaca's 'muerteadas' have a similar festive vibe. Mexico City adopted the parade format in 2016, inspired by the James Bond movie 'Spectre' from 2015. The film, whose opening scenes were shot in the capital, depicted Bond pursuing a villain amid a fictional parade of skeletons and floats. After the movie popularized the imagery, the city created its own real-life celebration. Mexico City resident Rocío Morán, who wore skull makeup to the parade, welcomed the mix of old and new traditions. Morán, who manages a ratings measurement company, said, 'It became popular after the James Bond movie, and I think it's positive because it brings economic activity to the city. I like it. I like progress, and I like that tourists come to see this.' She added, 'I think Day of the Dead has always existed. Now they’re marketing it and showing the whole world.'

article_content: Critics, such as Mitt Romney, have often alleged that President Obama embarked on an 'apology tour' by apologizing for America’s actions abroad. Romney repeated this at the Republican National Convention and in presidential debates, claiming Obama visited several Middle Eastern countries, criticized the United States, and purposely avoided traveling to Israel, a key ally. Fact-checkers and Obama himself have rejected this accusation. Reviews of Obama’s speeches in Europe and the Middle East reveal he acknowledged past U.S. missteps but never directly apologized. Instead, these remarks were part of broader efforts to encourage stronger international relationships, understanding, and shared responsibility. For example, during a 2009 speech in France, Obama noted that America had sometimes acted arrogantly or dismissively, but he also criticized European anti-American sentiments and underscored the importance of unity in addressing global challenges. In a speech to the Turkish parliament, Obama addressed both American and Turkish historical issues while emphasizing the need for cooperation. In Cairo, he called for a new relationship built on 'mutual interest and mutual respect,' acknowledging difficult moments after 9/11 but reaffirming America’s security commitments. Although Obama had not visited Israel as president at the time, he had traveled there during his 2008 campaign. Consistently, analysts and fact-checkers have determined there is no evidence supporting the 'apology tour' claim. Obama’s statements aimed to strengthen partnerships, not to offer apologies.

Els verificadors de fets i el mateix Obama han rebutjat aquesta acusació. Les anàlisis dels discursos d’Obama a Europa i a l’Orient Mitjà mostren que va reconèixer errors dels EUA però mai es va disculpar explícitament. Al contrari, aquestes referències formen part d'un esforç més ampli per promoure relacions internacionals més sòlides, comprensió i responsabilitat compartida. Per exemple, en un discurs de 2009 a França, Obama va reconèixer que els Estats Units havien actuat de vegades amb arrogància o menyspreu, però també va criticar l’antiamericanisme europeu i va remarcar la importància de la unitat davant reptes globals. Al Caire, va demanar una nova relació basada en 'interès i respecte mutu', reconeixent moments difícils després de l’11 de setembre però reafirmant els compromisos de seguretat americans. Tot i que Obama no havia viatjat a Israel com a president en aquell moment, sí que hi havia anat durant la seva campanya de 2008. De manera consistent, analistes i verificadors de fets han determinat que no hi ha proves que recolzin la idea de la 'gira d'excuses'. Les declaracions d’Obama pretenien enfortir les col·laboracions, no pas demanar disculpes.

article_content: SEBI Chairperson Madhabi Puri Buch stated on Thursday that the regulator's proceedings regarding the Sahara group will continue, even after the death of the company's founder, Subrata Roy. Roy, aged 75, passed away in Mumbai on Tuesday following a prolonged illness. Speaking to reporters at a FICCI event, Buch remarked that for SEBI, the Sahara issue concerns the conduct of the entity itself and will proceed irrespective of changes in individual leadership. Addressing questions about the limited refunds to investors, Buch explained that paybacks were handled through a Supreme Court-appointed committee, based on documented claims submitted by investors. To date, only Rs 138 crore has reportedly been refunded, despite SEBI instructing the Sahara group to deposit over Rs 24,000 crore for this purpose. The Sahara group has faced numerous allegations, including accusations of operating a Ponzi scheme. Difficulties intensified for Subrata Roy in November 2010 when SEBI directed two Sahara entities to cease raising funds from the public or the capital markets, also restricting Roy from seeking public investment. Roy was arrested in 2014 on Supreme Court orders after missing a court appearance related to the non-refund of over Rs 20,000 crore to investors. Though he was granted bail, business challenges persisted. The companies in question—Sahara India Real Estate Corporation (SIRECA) and Sahara Housing Investment Corporation—had raised funds during 2007–08 through Optionally Fully Convertible Debentures (OFCD). In June 2011, SEBI instructed these companies to refund the money collected via OFCDs to investors, with applicable returns. After a lengthy legal process, the Supreme Court in 2012 mandated the return of investor deposits with 15% interest. Sahara was ultimately told to deposit about Rs 24,000 crore with SEBI for onward refund to investors, while the group consistently argued that most investors had already been paid directly, making it a 'double payment.'

Roy, de 75 anys, va morir a Bombai dimarts després d'una llarga malaltia. Parlant amb periodistes en un esdeveniment de la FICCI, Buch va remarcar que per a la SEBI, el cas Sahara fa referència al comportament de l'entitat i continuarà independentment dels canvis en la direcció individual. En resposta a preguntes sobre els reemborsaments limitats als inversors, Buch va explicar que els pagaments es van efectuar mitjançant un comitè nomenat pel Tribunal Suprem, en funció de les reclamacions documentades presentades pels inversors. Fins ara, només s'han retornat aproximadament 138 crores de rúpies, tot i que la SEBI va ordenar al grup Sahara que diposités més de 24.000 crores de rúpies per a aquest propòsit. El grup Sahara s'ha enfrontat a nombroses acusacions, incloent les d'operar un esquema Ponzi. Les dificultats per a Subrata Roy van augmentar el novembre de 2010, quan la SEBI va ordenar a dues entitats de Sahara que deixessin de recaptar fons del públic o dels mercats de capitals, restringint també a Roy de buscar inversió pública. Roy va ser arrestat el 2014 per ordre del Tribunal Suprem després de no comparèixer davant el tribunal en un cas relacionat amb el no retorn de més de 20.000 crores de rúpies als inversors. Tot i que se li va concedir la llibertat sota fiança, els seus negocis van continuar tenint dificultats. Les empreses implicades—Sahara India Real Estate Corporation (SIRECA) i Sahara Housing Investment Corporation—van recaptar fons durant 2007–08 mitjançant Debentures Opcionalment Totalment Convertibles (OFCD). El juny de 2011, la SEBI va ordenar a aquestes empreses que retornessin els diners recaptats a través de les OFCD als inversors, amb els rendiments corresponents. Després d’un llarg procés judicial, el Tribunal Suprem va manar el 2012 la devolució dels dipòsits als inversors amb un 15% d'interès. Finalment, es va exigir a Sahara que diposités uns 24.000 crores de rúpies amb la SEBI per al retorn als inversors, mentre el grup va defensar reiteradament que la majoria d'inversors ja havien estat pagats directament, i que això representava un 'doble pagament'.

article_content: The Central Perk Coffeehouse in Boston is a reimagined version of the beloved café from the sitcom 'Friends.' For fans of the 1994–2004 series, Central Perk is the iconic hangout for the show's six main characters: Rachel (Jennifer Aniston), Monica (Courteney Cox), Phoebe (Lisa Kudrow), Ross (David Schwimmer), Joey (Matt LeBlanc), and Chandler (Matthew Perry). Many have wondered how the group always managed to get a spot on the famous orange couch and have wished for a place like Central Perk themselves. Now, Boston fans can visit their own version. Warner Bros. Discovery Global Themed Entertainment and CenPer Holdings, LLC have officially opened Central Perk Coffeehouse in Boston today. Located in a historic brownstone on Newbury Street, the café was designed by Glen & Company to blend nostalgia with a modern twist. Features include a revamped orange couch as the main centerpiece, custom artwork by Burton Morris, and an 'Orange Room'—a semi-private space with a replica orange couch and a neon sign that reads 'The One With…'. This Boston café is the first of a planned franchise expansion. The menu pays homage to 'Friends' by offering a variety of traditional coffees, cold brews, and specialty drinks crafted from six signature Central Perk Coffee Co blends: How You Doin'? (medium roast), Pivot Blend (medium dark roast), We Were On a 'Coffee Break' (dark roast), Oh My Gawd! (cold brew), Moo Point (decaf), and Gunther (espresso). Food items include Joey’s Meatball Sandwich, The Moist Maker Turkey Sandwich, Grandma’s Chicken Salad, Mama’s Little Bakery Cheesecake, and more—each inspired by moments from the series. The décor features subtle references to the show, including artwork and coffee cup sleeves with iconic quotes from the six Friends. On opening day, customers can get a special Chandler Bing 'Can I Interest You in a Sarcastic Comment?' sleeve, honoring Matthew Perry’s life and legacy. Central Perk Coffeehouse is located at 205 Newbury Street, Boston, and is open daily from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. For details, visit centralperk.com. Now, fans finally have a real Central Perk to hang out in!

article_content: Argentinians have cast their votes in a tense and closely watched presidential runoff between Economy Minister Sergio Massa, representing the mainstream Peronist coalition, and Javier Milei, a libertarian outsider. The two candidates present starkly different paths for Latin America’s third-largest economy, which is currently struggling with triple-digit inflation, deepening poverty, and decades of economic mismanagement. Polling data suggests the race is extremely close, with neither candidate holding a clear lead. Polls closed at 6pm local time (21:00 GMT), and while provisional results could be available by Sunday evening, the electoral commission has warned that a final count might take up to five days if the margin is narrow. Sergio Massa, 51, is a seasoned and charismatic politician aiming to reassure voters despite the economy’s current troubles during his tenure as minister—annual inflation has soared to 143% along with record poverty levels. By contrast, Javier Milei, 53, is an economist and political newcomer. He has energized voters with promises to cut government spending, replace the peso with the US dollar, and abolish the central bank. Many Argentinians, frustrated by the economic crisis, are seeking change, even if it means taking a risk. 'One has to vote for the lesser evil,' said Maria Paz Ventura, 26, a doctor who chose Milei. 'I think we are currently doing badly, so a change can’t be bad. You have to take a bet.' Milei surprised observers by rapidly rising to the forefront of the race, appearing at the polls in a black leather jacket surrounded by supporters. On social media, he depicted himself wielding a chainsaw—a symbol for the spending cuts he advocates—alongside figures like former US President Donald Trump and Brazil’s Jair Bolsonaro. Milei, who sometimes raises concerns about electoral fraud (though analysts argue this is unfounded in Argentina), is often compared to those former leaders for his outsider and confrontational style. Massa has portrayed himself as a calm, statesmanlike alternative, telling voters after casting his ballot that 'we are beginning a new stage of Argentina.' In the October first-round vote, Massa led with nearly 37%, while Milei received about 30%, leaving both candidates jockeying for support from the electorate of eliminated rivals. Patricia Bullrich, the third-place center-right candidate, has endorsed Milei. In response, Milei has softened some of his more radical positions to appeal to Bullrich’s moderate supporters, assuring voters, 'We are not going to privatize health and education. We are not going to allow the unrestricted carrying of guns.' He has also retreated from earlier threats to eliminate these ministries entirely. Massa represents the Peronist movement, known for its focus on state intervention and welfare programs. Some voters, such as 16-year-old first-time voter Trinidad Bazan, remain skeptical of Milei’s agenda. 'The situation in the country is horrible, the economy is very bad. People want change, but it would be a change for the worse with Milei,' she said. Massa has distanced himself from outgoing President Alberto Fernandez and Vice President Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner, the latter of whom was convicted of fraud last year; both are now largely absent from public view.

Els dos candidats ofereixen camins molt diferents per a la tercera economia més gran d’Amèrica Llatina, que ara pateix una inflació de tres dígits, més pobresa i dècades de gestió econòmica deficient. Les enquestes mostren que la cursa està realment renyida, sense que cap candidat tingui un avantatge clar. Les urnes es van tancar a les 18h hora local (21:00 GMT), i tot i que els resultats provisionals podrien arribar diumenge al vespre, la junta electoral ha advertit que el recompte final podria trigar fins a cinc dies si la diferència és mínima. Sergio Massa, de 51 anys, és un polític experimentat i carismàtic que vol transmetre confiança als votants tot i la complicada situació durant la seva gestió; la inflació anual ha arribat al 143% i la pobresa és rècord. Pel contrari, Javier Milei, de 53 anys, és economista i nouvingut a la política que ha mobilitzat molts votants prometent reduir la despesa pública, substituir el peso pel dòlar i tancar el banc central. Molts argentins, davant la crisi econòmica, volen un canvi encara que comporti riscos. 'Cal votar el mal menor', diu Maria Paz Ventura, de 26 anys, metgessa que aposta per Milei. 'Ara mateix les coses van malament, així que un canvi no pot ser dolent. Cal arriscar-se.' Milei ha sorprès tothom ascendint ràpidament a la primera línia, arribant a votar amb jaqueta de cuir negre i envoltat de seguidors. A xarxes socials s’ha mostrat amb una motoserra—símbol de les retallades que proposa—al costat de figures com Donald Trump i Jair Bolsonaro. Milei, que ha expressat preocupació sobre un possible frau electoral (tot i que els analistes creuen que no és un problema a l’Argentina), sovint es compara amb aquests expresidents pel seu estil d’outsider i de confrontació. Massa es presenta com una opció més serena i d’estadista, afirmant després de votar que 'comencem una nova etapa per a l’Argentina'. A la primera volta d’octubre, Massa va obtenir gairebé un 37%, mentre que Milei es va quedar al 30%, i tots dos volen sumar suports dels que han quedat fora. Patricia Bullrich, la candidata de centredreta que va quedar tercera, dona suport a Milei. Per aconseguir els seus electors més moderats, Milei ha matisat algunes propostes, assegurant: 'No privatitzarem la salut ni l’educació. No s’autoritzarà el lliure accés a armes.' També ha deixat enrere la idea de suprimir aquests ministeris. Massa representa el moviment peronista, conegut per la intervenció de l’Estat i les polítiques de benestar. Algunes persones, com Trinidad Bazan, de 16 anys i votant per primer cop, desconfien de Milei: 'La situació és horrible, l’economia està fatal. La gent vol canvi, però amb Milei seria pitjor', diu. Massa s’ha distanciat del president sortint Alberto Fernández i de la vicepresidenta Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, condemnada per frau l’any passat; tots dos fa temps que no apareixen en públic.

article_content: Jeff Bezos, the founder of Amazon, announced that he is relocating from Seattle to Miami. This decision is motivated by his desire to be closer to his parents, who recently moved back to Miami—where Bezos spent part of his youth—and to the Cape Canaveral operations of Blue Origin, his space exploration company. Bezos shared the news on Instagram, expressing that the move was an emotional decision for him after living in Seattle for 29 years. He reflected fondly on his memories in Seattle and paid tribute to the city, saying it would always have a place in his heart. He stated that his parents have always supported him and that the move would allow him to spend more time with them. Bezos highlighted his connection to Miami, mentioning that he graduated from Miami Palmetto High School in 1982. Bezos’s biological father, Ted Jorgensen, was not part of his life as a child, and his mother, Jacklyn, later married Miguel ‘Mike’ Bezos, a Cuban immigrant who helped raise him. Currently, Bezos is listed as the world’s third-richest person by the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. He posted a video on Instagram that included footage of himself in the Seattle garage where Amazon began in 1994. Bezos is widely credited with contributing to Seattle’s transformation into a major technology center, with Amazon remaining the city’s largest private employer. In 2021, Bezos stepped down as Amazon’s CEO, becoming executive chairman, with Andy Jassy taking over as CEO. Bezos recently purchased a seven-bedroom mansion in Indian Creek, part of the greater Miami area. He owns additional homes in Washington, D.C., New York City, Los Angeles, and Maui, as well as a 300,000-acre ranch in Texas, the site of Blue Origin’s New Shepard rocket launches. Other notable news covered included disputes between Indian telecom companies and tech giants over messaging platforms, a government probe involving Apple concerning alleged hacking attempts on opposition members’ iPhones, and developments regarding the Go First airline’s leased aircraft.

Vanport 1948 is more than just a vodka—it’s a tribute to Portland’s unique history, drawing inspiration from the city of Vanport. The brand balances a respect for the past with a forward-looking approach to design, flavor, and striking modern label art. Vanport 1948 takes its name from the historic city which, at its peak in 1948, was Oregon’s second largest city and featured the country’s largest housing development, supporting Portland’s bustling shipyards during World War II. At one point in 1944, Vanport’s population reached around 40,000, with as many as 10,000 African American residents. On Memorial Day in 1948, Vanport was devastated when the Columbia River broke a dike and flooded the city. At least 15 people died, and over 18,000 residents were left homeless. The tragedy intensified local racial tensions and contributed to a growing housing crisis as Portland’s population rapidly increased.

Vanport 1948 vodka symbolizes both remembrance and revival. Crafted with care in Portland and honoring the strength of the city’s original residents, the brand is dedicated to superior quality and sustainable practices. The vodka, distilled locally, is smooth, consistent, and embodies the spirit of Oregon. Vanport 1948 is bottled in Portland and distributed by the nation’s first eco-friendly distributor. The company supports environmental efforts by purchasing more than 300,000 pounds of carbon offsets, benefiting projects in Oregon and beyond. The brand’s commitment to excellence ensures every bottle has a strong body, remarkable taste, and smooth finish. Vanport 1948 stands out for quality and its mission. “The spirit of rising” is more than a motto—it reflects the resilience of the Vanport community and its lasting impact on Portland. Vanport 1948 celebrates innovation, evolution, and a commitment to both the past and the future.

article_content: Bradley Cooper spent six years developing the film 'Maestro.' He wrote, directed, and stars as Leonard Bernstein. At Deadline’s Contenders Film: Los Angeles event, Cooper shared that working on 'Maestro' left him feeling like he lost track of time. Reflecting on Bernstein, who passed away in 1990, Cooper said, “I swear I knew him. This movie has really bent time for me.” Cooper’s fascination with conducting dates back to his childhood, well before acquiring the rights to Bernstein’s story. He recalls asking Santa Claus for a conductor’s baton after seeing one in Bugs Bunny cartoons, spending countless hours pretending to conduct music. Recently, his own daughter coincidentally asked for a baton, which Cooper found especially meaningful. Cooper’s dedication to conducting and his intention to highlight Bernstein’s relationship with his wife, Felicia Montealegre (played by Carey Mulligan), helped gain the Bernstein family’s endorsement. Mulligan joined the project before the script was written and conducted extensive research, even visiting Montealegre’s family in Chile. Mulligan shared that discovering Montealegre’s background enriched her portrayal. The film also explores Bernstein’s bisexuality and his relationship with David Oppenheim (portrayed by Matt Bomer). Bomer delved into the correspondence between Oppenheim and Bernstein at the Library of Congress, even copying some letters by hand to share with Cooper. Bomer described how the letters revealed a deep connection, love, and shared ambitions between the two men. Cooper took on conducting for several scenes in 'Maestro' to honor Bernstein’s musical legacy. The film’s score is comprised of Bernstein’s original works. Cooper expressed hope that the story, told to the rhythm of Bernstein's music, would resonate with viewers. 'Maestro' will be released in theaters on November 22 and will be available on Netflix starting December 20.

article_content:
The pivotal COP28 climate summit is taking place in Dubai from November 30 to December 12, marking the 28th annual assembly of world leaders dedicated to addressing climate change under the United Nations.

COP stands for Conference of the Parties, referring to the 198 signatories, including the European Union, to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), originally adopted in Brazil in 1992. These conferences have occurred every year since 1995, except COP26 in Glasgow, which was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Each COP is numbered in order, with the United Arab Emirates hosting COP28, following Egypt’s presidency during COP27.

Similar conferences exist under other UN conventions, addressing issues such as desertification and biodiversity.

COPs are characterized by intricate negotiations among world leaders, NGOs, lobbyists, and various observers, often continuing past official deadlines. Decisions require consensus, necessitating compromise between competing interests—all in the name of climate action. While some summits yield limited progress, others have marked milestones: COP21 in 2015 led to the historic Paris Agreement, uniting countries behind the goal of keeping global temperature increases well below 2°C, aiming for 1.5°C if possible. Conversely, COP15 in Copenhagen (2009) is widely regarded as a missed opportunity, and environmental activists, including Greta Thunberg, have criticized some COPs as ineffective.

For the first time at COP26, fossil fuels were formally identified as the main cause of global warming. However, the final agreement, influenced by China and India, called for a 'phasedown' of coal rather than a complete 'phaseout.'

This year, COP28 is expected to host a record 80,000 participants. The appointment of Sultan Al Jaber, CEO of the UAE’s national oil giant ADNOC, as summit president has stirred controversy among environmental advocates, though some argue his role offers a unique perspective on the energy transition. Key goals for 2030 include tripling global renewable energy capacity, doubling energy efficiency, and expanding hydrogen production.

COP28 will also feature the first 'global stocktake' of progress toward the Paris Agreement goals. A recent technical report from September confirms global efforts are not on track, and much greater action is needed. Climate finance remains a focal point of contention: Wealthier nations have pledged support for developing countries to help them adapt and reduce emissions. The historic 'loss and damage' fund, established at COP27 for countries most vulnerable to climate impacts, still has unresolved details about its governance and funding.

La cimera climàtica clau COP28 se celebra a Dubai del 30 de novembre al 12 de desembre, marcant la 28a trobada anual de líders mundials dedicada a afrontar el canvi climàtic sota el paraigua de les Nacions Unides.

COP significa Conferència de les Parts, i fa referència als 198 signants, inclosa la Unió Europea, de la Convenció Marc de les Nacions Unides sobre el Canvi Climàtic (CMNUCC), adoptada originalment al Brasil l'any 1992. Aquestes conferències s'han celebrat anualment des de 1995, excepte la COP26 de Glasgow, que es va ajornar a causa de la pandèmia de la COVID-19. Cada COP s'ordena cronològicament, amb els Emirats Àrabs Units acollint la COP28 després de la presidència de la COP27 a Egipte.

També s’organitzen conferències similars per altres convencions de l’ONU sobre desertificació i biodiversitat.

Les COPs es caracteritzen per negociacions complexes entre líders mundials, ONG, lobbistes i tot tipus d'observadors, sovint allargant-se més enllà del calendari previst. Les decisions requereixen consens, cosa que obliga a arribar a compromisos entre diferents interessos, sempre amb la mirada posada en l’acció climàtica. Algunes cimeres han tingut poc impacte, però d’altres han assolit fites importants: la COP21 de 2015 va donar lloc a l’acord històric de París, que va unir els països amb l’objectiu de limitar l’augment de la temperatura global molt per sota dels 2°C, intentant quedar-se a 1,5°C si és possible. En canvi, la COP15 de Copenhaguen (2009) es considera una oportunitat perduda, i activistes com Greta Thunberg han criticat algunes COP per ser poc efectives.

Per primera vegada, a la COP26 es van identificar formalment els combustibles fòssils com la principal causa de l’escalfament global. Tot i això, sota la influència de la Xina i l’Índia, l’acord final només va parlar de “reducció progressiva” del carbó, i no d’abolició total.

Enguany, s’espera que la COP28 aculli un rècord de 80.000 assistents. El nomenament de Sultan Al Jaber, conseller delegat de la petroliera nacional d’Emirats ADNOC, com a president de la cimera, ha generat controvèrsia entre els activistes ambientals, tot i que alguns defensen que el seu perfil pot aportar una visió única sobre la transició energètica. Els objectius clau fins al 2030 inclouen triplicar la capacitat mundial d’energies renovables, duplicar l’eficiència energètica i ampliar la producció d’hidrogen.

La COP28 també servirà per fer el primer “examen global” dels avenços cap als objectius de París. Un informe tècnic publicat al setembre confirma que els esforços mundials no van pel bon camí i que calen mesures molt més ambicioses. El finançament climàtic segueix sent motiu de debat: els països més rics s'han compromès a ajudar les nacions en vies de desenvolupament a adaptar-se i a reduir emissions. El fons històric de “pèrdues i danys”, creat a la COP27 per als països més vulnerables als impactes climàtics, encara té detalls sense resoldre sobre la seva gestió i finançament.

article_content: DARPA, the US Army’s main research and development agency, is studying ways to protect soldiers from 'cognitive attacks' that might cause nausea and other symptoms while using HoloLens mixed reality headsets. Such attacks can exploit the close interaction between users and MR devices, such as by overloading displays with distracting items, accessing eye-tracking data, or introducing misleading information to induce illness. According to a recent document first reported by The Register, DARPA’s initiative aims to develop defenses using formal methods and cognitive models. Microsoft, the maker of the HoloLens headsets used by the Army, says it is aware of these potential threats and is working on methods to reduce the risks. Microsoft emphasized that security is a central concern in developing products for national security and that identifying and addressing such risks has always been a part of their security process. In 2021, the Army awarded Microsoft a $21.9 billion contract to provide about 120,000 modified HoloLens headsets, equipped with augmented and virtual reality functions for battlefield mapping, holographic images, and training applications. Internal military reports have noted significant discomfort with earlier headset models, such as nausea, headaches, and eye strain. Over 80% of affected soldiers reported symptoms within three hours of use, leading Congress to decline approval for more headsets. Microsoft and the Army are now collaborating on a lighter, more balanced headset to reduce physical issues. Microsoft says new prototypes were delivered ahead of schedule, with early feedback from the Army citing major improvements and prompting renewed acquisition efforts for the updated models.

Aquests atacs poden explotar la interacció propera entre els usuaris i els dispositius de realitat mixta, per exemple, sobrecarregant les pantalles amb elements que distreuen, accedint a dades del seguiment ocular o introduint informació enganyosa per provocar malestar. Segons un document recent, publicat per primera vegada per The Register, la iniciativa de la DARPA pretén desenvolupar defenses utilitzant mètodes formals i models cognitius. Microsoft, fabricant dels cascos HoloLens utilitzats per l'Exèrcit, afirma que és conscient d'aquestes possibles amenaces i està treballant en mètodes per reduir els riscos. Microsoft ha destacat que la seguretat és una preocupació fonamental en el desenvolupament de productes per a la seguretat nacional i que identificar i abordar aquests riscos sempre ha format part del seu procés de seguretat. El 2021, l’Exèrcit va atorgar a Microsoft un contracte de 21.900 milions de dòlars per proporcionar aproximadament 120.000 cascos HoloLens modificats, equipats amb funcions de realitat augmentada i virtual per a la cartografia en camp de batalla, imatges hologràfiques i aplicacions d’entrenament. Informes militars interns han assenyalat un important malestar amb els models anteriors dels cascos, com ara nàusees, mals de cap i fatiga visual. Més del 80% dels soldats afectats van informar de símptomes en menys de tres hores d’ús, fet que va portar el Congrés a rebutjar l’aprovació de més cascos. Microsoft i l’Exèrcit ara col·laboren en un casc més lleuger i equilibrat per reduir aquests problemes físics. article_content: Bank of India recorded a substantial 52% rise in net profit, reaching Rs 1,458 crore for the latest quarter compared to the same period last year. This growth was chiefly attributed to a 13% increase in net interest income, which totaled Rs 5,740 crore. Managing Director and CEO Rajneesh Karnatak shared that the bank plans to keep its net interest margin above 3% throughout the year, with the margin currently at 3.08%. Bank of India's gross advances rose by 10% to Rs 5,43,128 crore, while deposits grew by 8% to Rs 7,03,751 crore. Notably, the retail loan portfolio surpassed Rs 1 lakh crore for the first time, with home loans comprising 54% of this segment—an 11.6% annual increase. Personal loans experienced the most rapid growth, up 33% to Rs 7,818 crore from a smaller base. The bank's non-interest income also rose by 19% to Rs 1,688 crore. The gross non-performing assets ratio improved to 5.84%. By September 30, 2023, the Capital Adequacy Ratio stood at 15.63%. In comparison, Bank of Baroda posted a 28% increase in quarterly net profit to Rs 4,253 crore, driven by faster loan growth. However, this performance was tempered by defaults in two large accounts and regulatory restrictions on acquiring new customers for the bobWorld digital platform.

article_content: Delhi's air quality has sharply declined, reaching the 'severe' category. In response, authorities have enacted Stage III of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP). All primary schools in the city will be closed for two days. Restrictions have been placed on older, higher-emission vehicles across several districts in the National Capital Region (NCR), and most construction, stone crushing, and mining activities are suspended, except for critical infrastructure work like railway, metro, airport, and national security projects. The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) has called on states to strictly limit BS III petrol and BS IV diesel vehicles in Delhi, Gurgaon, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, and Gautam Budh Nagar. To address increased demand for transportation, the Delhi Metro will add 20 more train trips from Friday, supplementing 40 extra weekday services already in operation. Non-polluting and dust-free activities are still allowed, but the ban on construction and demolition will negatively affect daily-wage laborers in the building industry. Meteorological conditions, more frequent farm fires, and winds carrying pollutants toward Delhi are blamed for the worsening air quality. The CAQM is closely monitoring the situation, urging expanded public transportation and differential fare rates to promote off-peak travel. Emergency actions include shifting all primary classes to online learning and ramping up dust control through measures like water sprinkling, mechanical road sweeping, and banning open burning of waste. Authorities are also considering biomining at three landfills to further reduce pollution. Experts say that while such steps are vital, tackling the pollution at its sources is still lacking. Anumita Roychowdhury (Centre for Science and Environment) underscored the need for these rapid interventions when pollution is already concentrated. Sunil Dahiya (Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air) criticized failures to address major contributors such as stubble burning and traffic emissions. Recently, Delhi’s AQI rose from 351 at 8 a.m. to 417 by 8 p.m. at key stations like Mundka and Anand Vihar, indicating hazardous pollution levels. Minimal overnight air movement and light daytime winds prevented pollutant dispersal. The deteriorating air quality is having significant impacts on health and the economy, especially for daily-wage workers in affected sectors.

També s’han imposat restriccions als vehicles antics i amb més emissions a diversos districtes de la Regió de la Capital Nacional (NCR), i la majoria d’activitats de construcció, trituració de pedra i mineria han estat suspeses, excepte les obres d’infraestructures essencials com el ferrocarril, el metro, l’aeroport i projectes de seguretat nacional. La Comissió per a la Gestió de la Qualitat de l'Aire (CAQM) ha demanat als estats que limitin rigorosament la circulació de vehicles de benzina BS III i dièsel BS IV a Delhi, Gurgaon, Faridabad, Ghaziabad i Gautam Budh Nagar. Les activitats no contaminants i sense pols es permeten, però la prohibició de la construcció i la demolició afectarà negativament als treballadors diaris del sector de la construcció. Les condicions meteorològiques, l’augment de cremades agrícoles i els vents que arrosseguen contaminants cap a Delhi s’identifiquen com a causes del deteriorament de la qualitat de l’aire. La CAQM està supervisant de prop la situació, demanant més transport públic i tarifes diferenciades per incentivar els viatges fora de les hores punta. Les accions d'emergència inclouen traslladar totes les classes de primària a la modalitat en línia i reforçar el control de la pols mitjançant reg de carreteres, escombradores mecàniques i prohibint la crema de residus a l’aire lliure. També es considera la biomineria als tres abocadors per reduir la contaminació. Els experts apunten que, tot i ser mesures importants, encara falta abordar el problema des de l’arrel. Anumita Roychowdhury (Centre for Science and Environment) remarca la necessitat d’aquestes intervencions ràpides quan la contaminació ja està concentrada. Sunil Dahiya (Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air) critica la manca d’accions per combatre les principals causes, com la crema de rostolls i les emissions del trànsit. Recentment, l’Índex de Qualitat de l’Aire (AQI) de Delhi va augmentar de 351 a les 8 h del matí fins a 417 a les 8 h del vespre a estacions claus com Mundka i Anand Vihar, indicant nivells perillosos de contaminació. Durant la nit l’aire es va mantenir estàtic i, durant el dia, vents suaus van impedir la dispersió dels contaminants. El deteriorament de la qualitat de l’aire té un impacte destacat en la salut i l’economia, especialment entre els treballadors de salaris diaris dels sectors afectats.

article_content: Emma Lignum, a 26-year-old mother from Middleton, Greater Manchester, is taking legal action to be reunited with her four-year-old son, Yiannis. She says that last May, Yiannis’s father, Achilles Mouzakitis, took their son to Corfu and has since stopped all contact. Emma has been unable to see Yiannis for months and reports that Mouzakitis has not appeared at several court hearings related to custody. Authorities are still searching for Mouzakitis and Yiannis, as he reportedly provided courts with an old address. Legal custody of Yiannis remains with Emma, and an arrest warrant for Mouzakitis is active. To help find her son, Emma is offering a reward for information about Yiannis’s whereabouts. Emma and Mouzakitis met while she worked as a holiday rep in Greece, and they later lived together in Athens. Their son was born in 2008. They separated roughly a year ago, and Emma was preparing to return to the UK with Yiannis. During her move, Mouzakitis took care of the child, but when he was due for return, claimed Yiannis was ill. The next day, when Emma went to collect Yiannis, both were missing. Emma managed to briefly speak to Mouzakitis, who said he had taken Yiannis to Corfu, but soon afterward he changed his number, cutting off communication. Emma traveled to Corfu to search for her son, but people in the village where Mouzakitis’s family lived said they hadn’t seen them. She has since issued public appeals and is asking anyone, including tourists, with possible information on Yiannis or Mouzakitis to contact her through her Facebook page.

article_content: Perth teenager Stephen Milne is aiming to conclude an impressive Commonwealth Games by achieving 'something special' in the 1500m freestyle final. The 19-year-old faces the challenge of surpassing his strong performances so far at Glasgow 2014. Milne was part of the Scotland relay team that pushed the favored Australians to the limit in the 4x200m freestyle relay, ultimately earning a silver medal. On Monday lunchtime, he followed up by closely challenging reigning champion and Olympic silver medallist Ryan Cochrane in the 1500m heat—cutting over 12 seconds off his personal best. Milne finished the heat in 15:03.38, just nine-hundredths of a second behind Canadian Ryan Cochrane after 30 lengths of the Tollcross pool. He also reached the 400m final. Reflecting on his race, Milne said: 'I was very happy with how the swim went. I just focus on the small details to improve for (Tuesday's) final and hopefully I do well.' "My coach and I have worked well all season, and the taper seems to be going well, but the job isn't done yet. I still need to refocus for the final and hopefully do something special then." Milne and teammates Daniel Wallace, Duncan Scott, and Robbie Renwick put up a thrilling fight in Sunday night's relay, with the Scots finishing less than two seconds behind Australia and within the champions' previous Games record. Milne reflected: 'The 1500 is the event I've looked forward to most. I'm glad it's here, but I was really, really happy to compete in the 4x2. It was a huge privilege to be with those guys swimming in that final. I'll never forget that night. The team did so well, including the guys in the heats who helped us prepare for the evening.' He added: 'We knew from last time the boys got silver and this time we aimed to do as well if not better. We all swam really well.' The Tollcross crowd has strongly supported the Scottish swimmers, and Milne wants to thank them. 'It's absolutely amazing; the crowd has been wonderful, and it's great having all that cheering for us,' he said. 'It's inspiring for us, and we want to put on a good show for them.'

Milne va formar part de l'equip de relleus d'Escòcia que va posar contra les cordes els australians favorits als 4x200 metres lliures, guanyant finalment una medalla de plata. Dilluns al migdia, va continuar competint i va desafiar de prop el campió vigent i medallista d’argent olímpic Ryan Cochrane a la seva sèrie de 1.500 metres—rebaixant més de 12 segons la seva millor marca personal. Milne va acabar la sèrie amb un temps de 15:03.38, només nou centèsimes darrere del canadenc Ryan Cochrane després de 30 llargades a la piscina de Tollcross. També va arribar a la final dels 400 metres. Reflexionant sobre la seva cursa, Milne va dir: 'Vaig quedar molt content amb com va anar la natació. Només em centro en els petits detalls per millorar de cara a la final de dimarts i espero fer-ho bé.' "El meu entrenador i jo hem treballat molt bé tota la temporada, i la posada a punt sembla anar bé, però la feina encara no està feta. Encara he de tornar a centrar-me per a la final i espero fer alguna cosa especial aleshores." Milne i els seus companys d'equip Daniel Wallace, Duncan Scott i Robbie Renwick van oferir una actuació emocionant al relleu de diumenge a la nit, amb els escocesos quedant a menys de dos segons d'Austràlia i dins del rècord anterior del campionat. Milne va reflexionar: 'Els 1.500 metres són la prova que més esperava. Estic content que ja sigui aquí, però realment em va fer molta il·lusió nedar el 4x2. Va ser un privilegi estar amb aquells nois a la final. Aquella nit no l'oblidaré mai. L'equip va fer molt bona feina, incloent els nois de les sèries que ens van ajudar a preparar-nos per a la nit.' Va afegir: 'Sabíem que l'altre cop els nois van aconseguir la plata i aquest cop volíem fer-ho igual de bé o fins i tot millor. Tots vam nedar molt bé.' El públic de Tollcross ha donat un gran suport als nedadors escocesos i Milne vol agrair-ho. 'És absolutament increïble; el públic ha estat meravellós i és genial sentir tot aquest ànim per a nosaltres', ha dit. 'Ens inspira i volem donar un bon espectacle per a ells.'

article_content: Two Liverpool supporters have received suspended prison sentences for their involvement in a large brawl at Liverpool Lime Street train station after a match against Manchester City last year. The incident occurred on April 13, following Liverpool's 3-2 home win over Manchester City in the Premier League. CCTV footage captured clashes between Liverpool and Manchester City fans at the station after the game. Stephen Foster and Stephen Jeffers, both Liverpool supporters, entered the station where Foster was seen bumping into an unidentified City fan and then headbutting him. The altercation escalated when Manchester City supporters Paul Knight and Waine Hamilton intervened, leading to a fight that involved around 15 people at the Skelhorne Street entrance and inside the station. During the brawl, several punches were thrown before Knight was arrested by plainclothes police officers. Police examined the footage and identified Foster (32) and Jeffers (44), described as part of Liverpool FC's Urchins group. Foster, a scaffolder with a previous conviction for football-related violence, was sentenced at Liverpool Crown Court to 12 months in prison, suspended for two years. Jeffers, a gas fitter, received a nine-month sentence, also suspended for two years. Judge Recorder Shaw told the men their behavior was 'disgraceful' and emphasized the public's right to safety. Manchester City fans Knight and Hamilton, both from Cheadle, Manchester, were sentenced to 12-month community orders and 150 hours of unpaid work; Knight was also ordered to pay £250 in compensation to a police officer he assaulted. The judge's remarks highlighted the importance of maintaining public order and safety.

L'incident va tenir lloc el 13 d'abril, després de la victòria local del Liverpool per 3-2 davant el Manchester City a la Premier League. Les càmeres de seguretat van capturar enfrontaments entre aficionats del Liverpool i del Manchester City a l'estació després del partit. Els comentaris del jutge van destacar la importància de mantenir l'ordre públic i la seguretat.

article_content: Google is enhancing its Workspace platform with a new AI-powered assistant called Duet AI. This innovative side panel is built to help users manage an array of tasks more efficiently. With a new icon placed next to your profile avatar in Workspace web apps, you can launch Duet AI’s chat window to ask for summaries of emails and documents or have it generate presentations, as reported by 9to5Google. Ahead of the new Duet AI side panel’s rollout, Google updated its privacy policy to explain data handling as Duet AI’s capabilities grow. Google says users’ emails, documents, and spreadsheets are not accessible to human reviewers unless anonymized and grouped with other data. Users should avoid inputting personal data into Duet AI prompts. Workspace Labs, which runs these AI features, collects user prompts, direct input (like highlighted text), selected emails and docs, and prompt edit histories. Google stores Workspace Labs data separately from user accounts for 18 months. If human reviewers interact with this data, it might be retained for up to four years. If you leave the Workspace Labs program, rejoining later might not be possible. Debuting at Google’s I/O developer conference, Duet AI serves as a smart assistant across Google apps, directly challenging Microsoft’s Copilot.

Amb una icona nova al costat de l’avatar de perfil a les aplicacions web de Workspace, pots obrir la finestra de xat de Duet AI per demanar resums de correus electrònics i documents o fins i tot perquè et generi presentacions, segons informa 9to5Google. Abans de la implementació del nou panell lateral de Duet AI, Google ha actualitzat la seva política de privacitat per explicar com es gestionaran les dades a mesura que augmentin les capacitats de Duet AI. Google emmagatzema les dades de Workspace Labs separades dels comptes dels usuaris durant 18 mesos. Si revisors humans arriben a veure o modificar aquestes dades, es poden conservar fins a quatre anys. Si deixes el programa Workspace Labs, potser no podràs tornar a unir-t’hi en el futur. Duet AI, presentat a la conferència de desenvolupadors Google I/O, és un assistent intel·ligent per a totes les aplicacions de Google i competeix directament amb Copilot de Microsoft.

article_content: Former footballer and BT Sport pundit Rio Ferdinand has identified three promising young footballers poised to impress at the upcoming World Cup in Brazil. Leading the list is James Rodriguez from Colombia and Monaco, a 22-year-old attacking midfielder renowned for his exceptional balance, speed, and skilled left foot. With Radamel Falcao, his Colombia and Monaco teammate, out due to injury, Rodriguez may take on a central role in leading Colombia’s offense. Paul Pogba of France and Juventus also makes Ferdinand’s selection. Reflecting on his Manchester United days, Ferdinand recalls Pogba's remarkable talent and ambition, viewing him as a dynamic player reminiscent of Patrick Vieira, but with even greater versatility. Pogba joined Manchester United from Le Havre at age 16 and left due to contractual issues, which Ferdinand regards as a regrettable loss for the club. The third young standout is Germany and Schalke’s Julian Draxler. At just 20 years old, Draxler is already a regular in the Bundesliga and scored a noteworthy long-range volley in the 2011 German cup final. While competition for a starting spot in Germany’s squad is fierce, Draxler’s imagination and technical skill could see him play a significant role. Ferdinand currently serves as an interviewer and football analyst for BT Sport.

article_content: Ukamaka Okoh, the captain and small forward of MFM Women Basketball Club, recently led her team to its first Zenith Bank Women’s Basketball League title. In this interview, Okoh shares her team’s journey to the championship, personal challenges, her shoemaking venture, and future ambitions. The MFM Women Basketball Club joined the Nigeria Basketball Federation Women’s League in 2018, finishing in the top four. In 2019, they were runners-up, and in 2023, they clinched the championship. Okoh described immense pride and happiness at achieving this milestone—especially as captain, within a year she won two trophies, including the Dr & Dr (Mrs) D. K. Olukoya Women’s Basketball Tournament held in July. Discussing this season, Okoh explained it was the first women’s league since 2019, but MFM continued training and competing in other tournaments. Their morale soared after winning the Dr & Dr (Mrs) D. K. Olukoya Tournament. They went unbeaten in Benin City during qualifiers and repeated that in Asaba, finally overcoming First Bank and boosting their confidence further. Okoh always believed in the team’s potential, driven by constant preparation and victories in Benin City and Asaba. The most challenging opponents were the Bayelsa Blue Whales and particularly First Bank, whom they defeated for the first time in Asaba—ending their previous losing streak against them. Commenting on women’s basketball in Nigeria, Okoh recognized progress but calls for more competitions to raise the sport’s standard and ensure teams are prepared for continental contests. She is a strong proponent for equal pay in sports, stating female athletes should be compensated equally since they face the same training and competition demands as men. Okoh recounted facing initial resistance from her father, who disapproved of her athletic interests. Despite this, she persevered, participating in athletics, football, and basketball, ultimately winning his support through her commitment and performance. She chose basketball after discovering a genuine passion for it, which made her happiest. As her parents didn’t buy her kits, Okoh took the initiative to purchase them herself. Okoh credits MFM General Overseer Dr Daniel Olukoya and his wife Dr Shade Olukoya for fostering a supportive environment with good facilities, regular salaries, allowances, encouragement, and prayers. She aspires to play abroad to further her career. Her best memories include leading MFM to national victory and earning MVP honors twice in 2018 playoffs. The toughest moments were losses to First Bank. Apart from basketball, she runs the shoe brand Foot Maka. Okoh admits balancing both roles is not easy; she focuses on basketball during the season and shoe making in the off-season. She is still considering whether to pursue shoemaking full-time post-retirement.

article_content:
Trains are an essential part of life for India's population of over one billion people, similar to the importance of cars in the United States. This context makes recent accusations against the Railway Ministry for overlooking widespread casualties on the tracks especially significant. Each year, an estimated 15,000 people die while attempting to cross India's vast railway network, much of which dates back to colonial times. This data comes from a recent safety report that sharply criticizes the government for not implementing enough safety measures on a railway system utilized daily by some 20 million Indians.

Many slums are situated alongside the tracks, where people live in close proximity to trains and walk the railway lines daily as part of their routine. The safety panel, established in September following a series of train accidents, found that many deaths can be attributed to outdated technology and insufficient infrastructure. 'The reluctance of Indian Railways to accept responsibility for these fatalities, which are not categorized as formal train accidents but are nonetheless incidents involving trains, cannot be ignored,' stated the High Level Safety Review Committee. 'No civilized society can tolerate such a large-scale loss of life on their railway system.'

The panel observed that 6,000 of these deaths occur in Mumbai's commuter rail system alone, emphasizing that the situation there requires urgent, intensified efforts. The report notes that fatalities continue because of unmanned crossings, as well as a lack of safety features such as barriers, fences, and pedestrian bridges. Additionally, some platforms are too narrow, and many stations lack essential facilities like elevators for people with disabilities. Another 1,000 deaths are associated with passengers falling from overcrowded compartments or being involved in train collisions. Minor incidents and near-misses are not part of these statistics. The report recommended several safety improvements and proposed a budget of approximately $20 billion over the next five years for these initiatives. 'Demands on the railway system are increasing rapidly, but investments in upgraded technology and modernization have not kept pace,' the report stated.

article_content: A stunningly detailed image of Jupiter’s icy moon, Europa, has been unveiled, showing what the surface would look like to the naked eye. Created by reworking data from NASA's Galileo spacecraft missions of the late 1990s, the photo reveals the moon’s largest visible region at an unprecedented resolution of about one mile (1.6 km) per pixel. Europa’s frozen exterior is crisscrossed with cracks and ridges, where the surface ice has fractured and then refrozen into intricate patterns. The image also displays a variety of surface colors: blues and whites point to relatively pure water ice, while reddish and brown areas suggest the presence of other, still unidentified, materials. NASA scientists believe these could be clay-like substances. The polar regions of Europa appear bluer than the equatorial regions, likely due to differences in ice grain size. To simulate the appearance to a human observer, scientists combined Galileo’s near-infrared, green, and violet imagery. Europa is slightly smaller than Earth’s moon and, like it, is tidally locked to its parent planet—always keeping the same side facing Jupiter. Scientists think a global, salty ocean lies beneath the icy shell, covering the entire moon above a rocky mantle and possibly an iron core. Despite its distance from the Sun and the freezing temperatures, Europa’s subsurface ocean—kept warm by Jupiter’s tidal energy—raises hopes for habitability. The exchange of substances between the ocean and the ice shell could supply chemical energy to support simple life. Evidence gathered by the Hubble Space Telescope in 2013 revealed water vapor plumes bursting from Europa’s surface, pointing to possible geysers and continued geological activity below the ice layer. More recent findings indicate tectonic movements similar to Earth’s, with shifting surface blocks, making Europa the only other celestial body in the solar system known to display this type of geology. Notable surface features like the 11-mile (18 km) wide Cilix crater are rare, as Europa’s active surface renews itself, erasing older features over millions of years. Together, these discoveries keep Europa high on the list of places in our solar system most likely to harbor life.

Els científics de la NASA suposen que podrien ser substàncies argiloses. Les regions polars d’Europa es veuen més blaves que les equatorials, probablement per diferències en la mida del gra del gel. Tot això reforça la idea que Europa és capdavantera en la recerca de vida fora de la Terra.

article_content: British TV reporter Mark Stone was briefly detained by Chinese police while filming at Tiananmen Square, Beijing, as China officially appointed its new president, Xi Jinping. Stone, a Sky News correspondent, was accompanied by cameraman Andy Portch. The two were reporting on China’s leadership transition when officers approached and asked them to stop filming. Despite the interruption, Stone managed to broadcast live from the back of the police van and as they arrived at the station. He explained that the authorities intervened after hearing him mention the 1989 student-led protests in Tiananmen Square. The journalists were led to a nearby police station, where they were filmed by the authorities. Although a Sky News spokesman later confirmed their release, Stone described the experience as surreal, clarifying it wasn’t staged. He noted that while Chinese police remained entirely civil, they were still being detained. At the police station, officers informed the news team they were being held because they were not displaying special accreditation passes required for visible filming in Tiananmen Square. However, Sky News claimed that they had the necessary permissions. Stone said it was remarkable he was allowed to broadcast live, as the police appeared unaware he was on air. The officer eventually asked for the camera to be switched off and told them to wait for officials, even offering to translate. Xi Jinping’s official appointment as president at the National People’s Congress marks a significant transition in China, with hopes of advancing the 'Chinese Dream' to elevate millions into the middle class in the coming decades. Stone, based in Beijing, began his career at ABC News in 2002, joined Sky News in 2005, and has covered conflicts in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya, as well as riots in London.

article_content: A film adaptation of Walter Isaacson’s best-selling biography of Elon Musk is reportedly in development. Indie studio A24 has acquired the rights to the book, following a competitive bidding process. Acclaimed director Darren Aronofsky, known for films like 'The Whale,' 'Requiem for a Dream,' and 'The Wrestler,' is attached to direct and will likely bring his production company Protozoa Pictures on board. Aronofsky has previously collaborated with A24 on 'The Whale.' The biography, released in September, provides an in-depth look at Musk's life and career. While specific details about the film's cast and production are still unknown, reports from Variety and Puck indicate the project has been greenlit, according to sources familiar with the matter. An A24 spokesperson has confirmed the accuracy of Puck's reporting. There is speculation about who might portray Elon Musk, but no official casting announcements have been made. Names discussed in the media include Nicolas Cage, Jesse Plemons, Jim Caviezel, and Robert Downey Jr., with each offering a distinct interpretation. The film is expected to explore Musk’s complex public persona and recent controversies. While Aronofsky is known for his surreal, arthouse filmmaking, a biopic of one of the world's richest and most controversial figures represents a new direction for him. This project adds to Aronofsky’s diverse body of work and is likely to generate significant interest.

article_content: French President Francois Hollande has changed course, now opting to await the United Nations inspectors’ report on the alleged chemical attack in Syria. This comes despite his earlier insistence that immediate action was necessary and there was no need to delay for the U.N. findings. After extended talks between U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry and European Union foreign ministers in Lithuania, the EU released a statement blaming Syrian President Bashar al-Assad for using chemical weapons, labeling the incident a grave violation of international law, a war crime, and a crime against humanity. The EU called for a significant international response but maintained that any action should follow the U.N. inspectors’ preliminary findings. Hollande’s turnabout follows U.S. President Obama’s decision to seek Congressional approval for military strikes, which left France in need of broader international and domestic backing before moving ahead with intervention. Diplomats indicate Hollande reached a deal with EU partners: in exchange for stronger political support from European countries, France would wait for the U.N. report. This led all 28 EU countries to sign a unified statement, a departure from the earlier situation where only a few (France, the U.K., and Spain) supported military action, as indicated in the G-20 statement. Germany, initially absent from the G-20 group of supporters, later publicly endorsed the position, and reportedly called for the EU to issue its official statement. While the EU statement falls short of directly urging military action, sources say it is interpreted as political backing for strikes if the U.N. inspectors’ report supports it, though some EU nations remain opposed regardless. Diplomats note that awaiting the preliminary UN report should not significantly delay possible intervention, since U.N. Secretary-General Ban Ki Moon has instructed inspectors to speed up their work. A number of EU nations require some form of U.N. endorsement—although not necessarily a full Security Council resolution—to lend legitimacy to any support for operations in Syria. This arrangement allows Hollande to secure EU political support, gives European governments the legitimacy they seek through U.N. engagement, and offers Obama the international consensus he’s looking for. Kerry said he welcomed the EU’s support and would pass their statement along to President Obama’s team. U.S. officials saw the EU move as an encouraging sign of European approval, even if Obama has not formally committed to waiting for the U.N. report—something Hollande and possibly other European leaders require before backing any action.

article_content: Skywatchers around the world were treated to a stunning lunar spectacle this Saturday night. A full moon, referred to by experts as a 'perigee moon,' appeared noticeably bigger and brighter as it made its annual closest approach to Earth—just over 221,000 miles away. According to NASA, the phenomenon causes the moon to be about 14% larger and 30% brighter than usual. People from various countries, including Iceland and Sri Lanka, took the opportunity to capture detailed images of the moon's surface. Halldor Sigurdsson in Reykjavik, Iceland, marveled at the view of the moon glowing over the mountains. In Lake Wylie, South Carolina, Beth Wade celebrated the event by taking photos from her lakeside home, expressing her appreciation for the moon's natural beauty. Scientists recommend watching the super moon as it rises or sets, when the moon looks largest due to an optical illusion caused by objects on the horizon. NASA scientist James Garvin clarified that while a super moon means the full moon is a little closer to Earth, the difference in size is actually quite modest. Some observers, such as Ben Jason Tesiorna from the Philippines, found the apparent change less dramatic than anticipated, but most viewers reported feeling awe and excitement at the unique event. Overall, the super moon offered a chance for people worldwide to come together in admiration of a rare and beautiful occurrence in the night sky.

Segons la NASA, el fenomen fa que la lluna sigui un 14% més gran i un 30% més brillant del que és habitual. Persones de diversos països, com Islàndia i Sri Lanka, van aprofitar per capturar imatges detallades de la superfície lunar. Alguns observadors, com Ben Jason Tesiorna, des de les Filipines, van considerar que el canvi no era tan espectacular com s’esperaven, però la majoria d’espectadors van sentir admiració i entusiasme per aquest fenomen únic. article_content: Four minority British languages—Jersey French, Guernsey French, Manx, and Cornish—are under threat of extinction unless urgent action is taken. A newly published map highlighting Europe's endangered languages draws attention to those in the UK that are most at risk. Speaker numbers for these languages have dwindled significantly: Cornish is listed as critically endangered with just 574 speakers. Manx is also critically endangered, while Jersey French and Guernsey French are classified as severely endangered, according to research conducted by Dr. Christopher Moseley of UCL’s School of Slavonic and East European Studies. Dr. Moseley collaborated with a travel website to create an interactive map of Europe’s most endangered languages, aiming to encourage visitors to explore these regions and help sustain local tongues. The study, which uses data from the UNESCO Languages in Danger project (launched in 1993), found that 90 percent of Europe’s 250 languages are endangered. Globally, over half of the world’s languages may disappear by the end of this century. Of the 24 critically and severely endangered European languages shown on the map, Livonian in Latvia stands out, as it no longer has native speakers—only about 40 to 50 people speak it as a second language. The last native speaker, Grizelda Kristina, passed away last year at age 103. Other at-risk European languages include Ter Sami, the most easterly Sami dialect spoken by indigenous people in northern Europe, and Gottscheerisch, a unique language with Slovenian roots that is now spoken by a small community in Queens, New York. Within the UK, the four threatened languages face different prospects. There are approximately 1,700 speakers of Manx, 574 of Cornish, 1,327 of Guernsey French, and around 2,000 of Jersey French. However, Cornish and Manx show some promise for revival thanks to structured language education initiatives in local schools. Dr. Moseley noted that reviving Manx, for instance, has required significant effort since its last native speaker died in 1974. Since then, regular language classes and a dedicated school have been established. Proponents suggest that increased tourism could help support minority languages. Naren Shaam, CEO of GoEuro, stated, 'We hope this information encourages ethical tourism, allowing people to benefit regions where endangered languages teeter on the brink of extinction and to enjoy unique cultural experiences closer to home.' GoEuro has published a blog to help travelers plan visits to communities where these languages are still spoken.
translated_content: Quatre llengües minoritàries britàniques —el francès de Jersey, el francès de Guernsey, el manx i el còrnic— estan en perill d’extinció si no es prenen mesures urgents. Un nou mapa que destaca les llengües amenaçades d’Europa posa el focus en les del Regne Unit que es troben més amenaçades. El nombre de parlants d’aquestes llengües ha disminuït dràsticament: el còrnic es considera ‘críticament en perill’ amb només 574 parlants. El manx també es troba en situació crítica, mentre que el francès de Jersey i el de Guernsey estan classificats com a ‘greument amenaçats’, segons la recerca del Dr. Christopher Moseley de l’Escola d’Estudis Eslavs i de l’Est d’Europa de la UCL. El Dr. Moseley ha col·laborat amb una web de viatges per crear un mapa interactiu de les llengües europees més amenaçades, amb l’objectiu d’encoratjar els visitants a explorar aquestes regions i ajudar a mantenir les llengües locals. L’estudi, que utilitza dades del projecte UNESCO Languages in Danger (iniciat el 1993), constata que el 90% de les 250 llengües d’Europa estan en perill. A nivell mundial, més de la meitat de les llengües podrien desaparèixer abans d’acabar el segle. D’entre les 24 llengües europees en perill crític i greu que apareixen al mapa, destaca el livoni (Letònia), ja que no té parlants natius —només unes 40 o 50 persones el parlen com a segona llengua. L’última persona nativa, Grizelda Kristina, va morir l’any passat als 103 anys. Altres llengües europees en risc inclouen el ter sami, el dialecte sami més oriental parlat pels indígenes del nord d’Europa, i el gottscheerisch, una llengua singular d’origen eslovè que ara parla una petita comunitat a Queens, Nova York. Al Regne Unit, les quatre llengües amenaçades tenen perspectives diverses. Hi ha aproximadament 1.700 parlants de manx, 574 de còrnic, 1.327 de francès de Guernsey i uns 2.000 de francès de Jersey. Tot i així, el còrnic i el manx tenen una certa esperança de recuperació gràcies a iniciatives organitzades d’ensenyament de la llengua a les escoles locals. El Dr. Moseley ha destacat que la revitalització del manx, per exemple, ha requerit un gran esforç des que el seu últim parlant natiu va morir l’any 1974. Des de llavors, s’han establert classes regulars i una escola dedicada. Diversos especialistes assenyalen que augmentar el turisme podria ajudar a donar suport a aquestes llengües minoritàries. Naren Shaam, director general de GoEuro, ha afirmat: «Esperem que aquesta informació fomenti el turisme ètic, permetent que la gent doni suport a regions on les llengües en perill estan a punt de desaparèixer i gaudeixi d’experiències culturals úniques més a prop de casa». GoEuro ha publicat un blog per ajudar els viatgers a planificar visites a comunitats on aquestes llengües encara es parlen.

article_content: Facebook is more than just a place to connect with friends—it's also a valuable tool for earning extra income online at no cost. The platform offers a range of money-making opportunities, from its buy-and-sell Marketplace to content monetization features. Here are some of the top ways you can earn on Facebook. One of the simplest and quickest paths to earning is selling items on Facebook Marketplace. The process is straightforward—you don’t need to meet special requirements to list products. Just go to Facebook Marketplace, select 'Create New Listing,' upload photos, add a description and set your price. Facebook Pages and Groups are ideal platforms for building a community and reaching a larger audience. Once you gather enough followers or members, you can leverage your influence for affiliate marketing, selling products or services, or directing traffic to a website—each offering potential long-term revenue. Creating a page or group is free, but you can pay to boost their visibility. All kinds of content—whether videos, live streams, or articles—can be monetized on Facebook as long as you meet eligibility criteria. For many monetization options, you’ll need at least 10,000 followers or 250 return viewers, plus 50,000 post engagements or 180,000 watch minutes in the last 60 days. Another opportunity is working as a social media manager for businesses or influencers. In this role, you help clients maintain and grow their Facebook presence, which may include managing content and engagement to increase reach. Video creators can monetize through in-stream ads placed within their videos. You have the flexibility to select where ads appear, letting you earn while delivering content with minimal disruption to viewers. Facebook pays out revenue from in-stream ads around the 21st of each month, provided you meet the $100 minimum payout. To secure more predictable earnings, consider offering monthly subscriptions to your followers for exclusive content. Subscribers might receive special discounts or personalized interactions. On web payments, you’ll receive the full amount (after applicable taxes and fees), while mobile payments incur a 30% deduction due to app store fees. As your audience grows, you might be approached by brands seeking sponsorships. These partnerships can allow you to earn by promoting products or services relevant to your niche. Sponsorship deals may be arranged independently of Facebook's monetization tools, letting you keep the full payment. How easy it is to make money on Facebook depends on your strategy and commitment. Some find it a great alternative to traditional jobs, while others may face challenges in meeting eligibility thresholds. With the right approach and consistency, Facebook offers considerable potential for supplementary income.

article_content:
Kim, Kourtney, and Khloe Kardashian do not need to spend millions on marketing to stay in the spotlight—Twitter does the work for them. In an upcoming episode of 'Piers Morgan Tonight,' Morgan notes that all three sisters are among the top 100 most-followed people on Twitter worldwide. Kourtney ranks 72nd, Khloe 47th, and Kim sits at sixth place with six million followers—nearly on par with President Barack Obama. Kourtney called Twitter 'the best decision-maker,' explaining that she seeks feedback from fans on everything from fragrance bottle designs to outfit choices and dinner ideas.

Morgan, who has gained 200,000 followers in just six weeks on the platform, asked the sisters for advice to boost his own following, describing their online influence as 'fascinating.' Given the sway their opinions hold, Morgan also broached the topic of politics, referencing both Obama and Sarah Palin. Kourtney associated Palin with 'hunter,' while Kim shared that Obama was the first presidential candidate to inspire her to vote.

When asked about potential talents for 'America's Got Talent,' Kim pointed to marketing as a skill, while also noting that fashion is significant to the sisters—all of whom have worked as stylists and currently own three successful clothing stores.

The Kardashians highlighted their commitment to promoting a healthy body image, emphasizing that none of them fit the 'stick skinny' stereotype. Kourtney admitted to being a size zero but, at 5 feet tall, described herself as petite and curvy. Kim, at 5'3", fluctuates between sizes 4 and 6. 'We're not trying to fit in the same mold,' said Kim. 'We know that we feel our best when we look our best.'

Kim said she is 'super honest' about plastic surgery rumors, acknowledging she tried Botox but asserting her breasts are 'completely real.' Kourtney admitted to having implants. Kim also shared that she uses shapewear and other accessories to enhance her appearance and confidence, especially on the red carpet.

On extravagant purchases, Kim mentioned buying a $115,000 watch, noting she 'got a really good deal.' Few people realize that Ryan Seacrest is the executive producer of 'Keeping Up with the Kardashians.' Kim joked that he is 'pretty evil,' but described him as a trusted friend who understands their vision.

Regarding privacy, Kim said she shares only selective aspects of her relationships. When asked about her romantic life with Kris Humphries, she emphasized her desire to keep things private this time. The sisters credited their strong values and work ethic for keeping them grounded.

Kim, who finds talking about money 'inappropriate,' said she donates 10 percent of her yearly income to her church, a habit instilled in her by her family. Kourtney, with a laugh, said she plans to start doing the same, admitting she had forgotten about it.

'Piers Morgan Tonight' airs weeknights at 9 p.m. ET.

article_content: In Accra, Ghana's capital, local trader Eric Foreson proudly sports a shirt and jeans by prominent brands, but his outfit’s true source may surprise you. Rather than coming from luxury boutiques, these clothes arrived as part of the enormous stream of second-hand garments exported from the UK, originally donated to British charity shops. Rather than being distributed freely to those in need, these pre-owned clothes support a buzzing trade in Ghana’s markets, with Accra and Kumasi featuring as major hubs. Each year, the UK spends about £60 billion on new clothing; much of the discarded apparel ends up in charity shops, which then send unsold items to recycling centers for export, commonly to Africa. Ghana is one of the largest recipients, bringing in nearly 30,000 tonnes of used clothing annually—so much so that locals call it 'oboni wawu' or 'dead white man’s clothes.' For Ghanaians looking for affordable choices, these markets are vital. As Foreson describes, with just 50 Ghana cedis (around £8), shoppers can purchase several shirts at the market, whereas the same budget would only buy one or two new ones. Most imported clothing comes from different UK cities, and there’s strong demand for British styles due to their fit and perceived quality. Boutique owners, like Ase Adu, highlight that UK clothes are preferred for their sizing and durability. The best quality items are snapped up by boutique customers, while the lower grades find their way to rural markets—where the poorest buyers can get items for as little as 25p. This flourishing trade can be hugely profitable for wholesalers, with some earning as much as £25,000 in a single day. Yet, the thriving market comes at a high cost. Textile factories such as Akasombo Textiles near Lake Volta have experienced a dramatic 75% drop in production since 2009, prompting serious concern from managers like Steve Dutton. Alongside economic changes are shifts in culture. Historian Ode Bonsu notes how Ghanaians have increasingly favored Western products, names, and foods over their own, endangering traditional customs and identity. So while the second-hand clothing business creates significant opportunities for some, it also presents real challenges to local industries and Ghana’s cultural heritage.
