En comptes de venir de botigues de luxe, aquestes peces formen part del gran flux de roba de segona mà exportada des del Regne Unit, originalment donada a botigues benèfiques britàniques. Lluny de ser distribuïdes gratuïtament entre qui més ho necessita, aquestes peces usades donen vida a un negoci vibrant als mercats de Ghana, amb Accra i Kumasi com a punts neuràlgics. El Regne Unit gasta anualment uns 60 mil milions de lliures en roba nova; gran part de la que es descarta acaba a les botigues benèfiques, que envien allò que no venen a centres de reciclatge per exportar-ho, habitualment, a l'Àfrica. Ghana és un dels principals destinataris i importa prop de 30.000 tones de roba usada cada any — tant que els locals l’anomenen 'oboni wawu' o 'roba de l’home blanc mort.' Per als ghanesos que busquen opcions assequibles, aquests mercats són essencials. Com explica Foreson, amb només 50 cedis ghanesos (uns 8 lliures), un pot comprar diverses camises al mercat, mentre que amb la mateixa quantitat només podria comprar-ne una o dues de noves. La major part de la roba importada prové de diverses ciutats britàniques, i hi ha molta demanda pels estils anglesos per la seva talla i qualitat percebuda. Propietaris de botigues, com Ase Adu, destaquen que prefereixen la roba del Regne Unit per la seva mida i durabilitat. Les peces de millor qualitat són adquirides pels clients de botigues selectes, i les de qualitat inferior acaben als mercats rurals, on els compradors amb menys recursos poden aconseguir peces per només 25 penics. Aquest negoci en plena expansió pot ser molt rendible per als majoristes, alguns dels quals guanyen fins a 25.000 lliures en un sol dia. Tot i això, aquest mercat tan fructífer té un cost elevat. Fàbriques tèxtils com Akasombo Textiles, prop del llac Volta, han vist disminuir la producció un 75% des del 2009, la qual cosa preocupa seriosament gestors com Steve Dutton. Als canvis econòmics s’hi sumen transformacions culturals. L’historiador Ode Bonsu observa com els ghanesos tendeixen cada cop més a preferir productes, noms i menjars occidentals per damunt dels propis, cosa que posa en perill les seves tradicions i identitat. Així, mentre el negoci de la roba de segona mà crea oportunitats per a alguns, també suposa reptes reals per a la indústria local i el patrimoni cultural de Ghana.

article_content: A Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) supporter was stabbed in Milan on Monday night ahead of the French club’s Champions League match against AC Milan, according to Italian police. The French man, aged 34, reportedly sustained two stab wounds to his leg and was taken to a hospital. Police stated that his injuries were serious but not life-threatening.  The incident took place in Milan’s Navigli district, a popular nightlife area known for its bars and cafes. Witnesses reported to police that a clash erupted between roughly 50 AC Milan fans and French supporters. Social media footage shared by Italian news outlets shows men running along the canal, some wearing hoods and carrying what appear to be batons, as flares go off.  This attack comes less than two months after a Newcastle United supporter was stabbed in the same area ahead of a Champions League match with Milan.  On Tuesday, seven-time European champions AC Milan are set to host PSG at the San Siro stadium. PSG, who currently lead Group F by two points, are considered favorites after defeating Milan 3-0 at home two weeks ago.  Tensions are expected to run high, particularly due to the return of Italian goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma, who left Milan for PSG as a free agent in 2021. With just four points separating all teams in the group, the outcome of this match could be crucial for reaching the Champions League knockout stages.  AC Milan are at the bottom of Group F with only two points and have yet to score a goal in their first three matches.

L’incident va tenir lloc al districte de Navigli de Milà, una zona lúdica coneguda pels seus bars i cafès. Testimonis van dir a la policia que es va produir un enfrontament entre aproximadament 50 aficionats de l’AC Milan i seguidors francesos. Les imatges a les xarxes socials compartides per mitjans italians mostren homes corrent al llarg del canal, alguns amb caputxes i portant el que semblen ser porres, mentre s’encenen bengales.  Aquesta agressió arriba menys de dos mesos després que un seguidor del Newcastle United fos apunyalat a la mateixa zona abans d’un partit de Lliga de Campions amb el Milan.  Aquest dimarts, el set vegades campió europeu AC Milan rep el PSG a l’estadi de San Siro. El PSG, que actualment lidera el Grup F amb dos punts d’avantatge, és considerat favorit després de guanyar el Milan per 3-0 a casa fa dues setmanes.  S’espera un ambient molt tens, especialment per la tornada del porter italià Gianluigi Donnarumma, que va deixar el Milan per fitxar pel PSG el 2021. Amb només quatre punts de diferència entre tots els equips del grup, el resultat d’aquest partit pot ser decisiu per arribar a les eliminatòries de la Lliga de Campions.  L’AC Milan és últim al Grup F amb només dos punts i encara no ha marcat cap gol en els tres primers partits.

article_content: Barbara Walters, the pioneering ABC News journalist, has been hospitalized after a fall at an inauguration celebration in Washington, D.C. She suffered a cut on her forehead but was admitted to the hospital primarily as a precaution, according to ABC. The accident means Walters will not be able to participate in Monday’s ABC News coverage of President Barack Obama’s second inauguration. She was in the capital for this assignment when she tripped on a step at the home of Britain’s U.S. ambassador, Sir Peter Westmacott. ABC News spokesperson Jeffrey Schneider reported that Walters remains alert and in good spirits at the hospital, though her release date is still unknown. In Walters’ absence, Diane Sawyer and George Stephanopoulos will anchor the network’s inauguration coverage. At age 83, Walters is recognized for her remarkable career as network television’s first female anchor and for her influential interviews with world leaders and entertainment icons. She also launched ‘The View’, a successful morning talk show, in 1997. After a 2010 heart surgery, Walters resumed her demanding television schedule, including regular appearances on ‘The View’, leading major interviews, and hosting her popular ‘10 Most Fascinating People’ annual special. In December, she interviewed New Jersey Governor Chris Christie about his presidential ambitions, to which he responded positively while acknowledging his weight. Walters continues to remain active in television, recently appearing at events like the Daytime Emmy Awards.

L'accident impedeix que Walters pugui participar en la cobertura de la inauguració del segon mandat del president Barack Obama aquest dilluns per part d’ABC News. Era a la capital per cobrir aquest esdeveniment quan va ensopegar amb un graó a la residència de l’ambaixador britànic als EUA, Sir Peter Westmacott. Als 83 anys, Walters és reconeguda per la seva carrera extraordinària com a primera dona presentadora de notícies en cadena i per les seves influents entrevistes amb líders mundials i icones de l’entreteniment. També va llançar ‘The View’, un talk show matinal amb gran èxit, el 1997. article_content: Basketball star Kobe Bryant has expressed his passion for soccer while doing charity work in South Africa during the 2010 World Cup. The five-time NBA champion told CNN he was introduced to soccer as a child while living in Italy. Bryant, who recently helped the Los Angeles Lakers secure another NBA title, moved to Europe at age six when his father, Joe 'Jelly Bean' Bryant, played professional basketball in Italy. Born in Philadelphia, Bryant speaks fluent Italian and Spanish, and grew up as a fan of Serie A club AC Milan—his favorite player was former Dutch striker Marco van Basten. 'AC Milan was always my favorite team growing up,' Bryant shared. 'When I first moved to Italy, I would go to the basketball courts to play alone, but there were soccer goalposts under the basket. I wanted to play basketball but would find a group of kids ready for a soccer match. They made me the goalkeeper because of my long arms and legs, and my job was to stop everything. Eventually, they let me play on the field.' While in South Africa for the World Cup, Bryant visited a new football center in Soweto on his first visit to the continent. The center runs a football and life skills program for 20,000 South African children annually, giving them opportunities to develop their talents. Notably, the center also provides HIV/AIDS education, including counseling and testing, addressing a significant need in a country with the world's largest HIV-positive population. Speaking to CNN's Pedro Pinto, Bryant said that athletes have an important role off the field in inspiring future champions worldwide. 'It's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for me to see the World Cup and South Africa,' Bryant said. 'Even though I'm a basketball player, the core messages are the same. I was once a kid like them—it's about achieving dreams. I believe it's important to give back and help the next generation reach their goals too.' Bryant continues to excel on the court after helping the Lakers win their 17th NBA title against the Boston Celtics, 4-3 in the finals. When asked to compare this championship to his previous four, Bryant called it his favorite due to the effort required. 'It's the best because it was so hard to achieve. The championship is about how the team comes together to accomplish a goal,' he said.

Bryant, que recentment va ajudar els Los Angeles Lakers a aconseguir un altre títol de l'NBA, es va traslladar a Europa als sis anys quan el seu pare, Joe 'Jelly Bean' Bryant, va jugar a bàsquet professional a Itàlia. Nascut a Filadèlfia, Bryant parla fluidament italià i castellà, i va créixer sent aficionat del club de la Serie A AC Milan—el seu jugador preferit era l'holandès Marco van Basten. 'AC Milan sempre va ser el meu equip preferit de petit,' va explicar Bryant. 'Quan vaig arribar a Itàlia, anava sol a les pistes de bàsquet, però hi havia porteries de futbol sota la cistella. Jo volia jugar a bàsquet però em trobava amb un grup de nens preparats per un partit de futbol. Em posaven de porter perquè tenia els braços i les cames llargues, i havia d’aturar-ho tot. Amb el temps, finalment, em van deixar jugar al camp.' Durant la seva estada a Sud-àfrica pel Mundial, Bryant va visitar un nou centre de futbol a Soweto en el seu primer viatge al continent. El centre ofereix un programa de futbol i habilitats de vida a 20.000 nens sud-africans cada any i els dona oportunitats per desenvolupar el seu talent. A més, el centre també proporciona educació sobre la SIDA/VIH, amb assessorament i proves, una necessitat important en un país amb la població VIH positiva més gran del món. Parlant amb Pedro Pinto de CNN, Bryant va dir que els esportistes tenen un paper important fora del camp per inspirar futurs campions arreu del món. 'És una oportunitat única a la vida poder veure el Mundial i conèixer Sud-àfrica,' va dir Bryant. 'Tot i que sóc jugador de bàsquet, el missatge bàsic és el mateix. Jo també era un nen com ells—es tracta de complir els somnis. Crec que donar suport i ajudar la següent generació a assolir els seus objectius és molt important.' Bryant segueix triomfant a la pista després d'ajudar els Lakers a guanyar el 17è títol de l'NBA contra els Boston Celtics, per 4-3 a les finals. Quan li van preguntar si aquest campionat era diferent dels altres quatre que havia guanyat, Bryant va dir que era el seu preferit per l’esforç que va suposar. 'És el millor perquè ens va costar molt aconseguir-lo. El campionat tracta de com l’equip s’uneix per aconseguir un objectiu,' va afirmar.

article_content: Writing convincingly about sex in fiction is a challenge even for acclaimed novelists. Throughout literary history, some of the world’s greatest writers have produced awkward and unrealistic passages when depicting intimacy. Australian author Richard Flanagan is the latest to join this club, thanks to a controversial passage in his Booker Prize-winning novel, The Narrow Road to the Deep North. Flanagan’s scene, featuring imaginative descriptions involving body exploration, knicker elastic, a howling dog, and a dying fairy penguin, has earned him a nomination for the 'Bad Sex in Fiction' award. This annual award, created by Auberon Waugh in 1993, aims to spotlight poorly written, perfunctory, or redundant sexual descriptions in modern novels and discourage such writing. The award, however, does not cover overtly pornographic or erotic literature. An excerpt from the book reads: 'Whatever had held them apart, whatever had restrained their bodies before, was now gone... He kissed the slight, rose-coloured trench that remained from her knicker elastic, running around her belly like the equator line circling the world... As they lost themselves in the circumnavigation of each other, there came from nearby shrill shrieks that ended in a deeper howl. Dorrigo looked up. A large dog stood at the top of the dune. Above blood-jagged drool, its slobbery mouth clutched a twitching fairy penguin.' Flanagan joins a distinguished list of previous nominees and winners, including Sebastian Faulks, Norman Mailer, and A.A. Gill. This year, he faces strong competition. Pulitzer Prize-winner Michael Cunningham is a frontrunner for a vivid climax scene in his novel The Snow Queen. Haruki Murakami has also been nominated for a passage in Colorless Tsukuru Tazaki and His Years of Pilgrimage, where he employs unique analogies to describe intimacy. Despite winning the prestigious 2014 Booker Prize for The Narrow Road to the Deep North, Flanagan now finds himself in the spotlight for a less flattering literary accolade.

Al llarg de la història literària, alguns dels millors escriptors del món han creat passatges incòmodes i poc realistes sobre la intimitat. L'autor australià Richard Flanagan s'ha afegit a aquest club gràcies a un fragment polèmic a la seva novel·la guanyadora del Premi Booker, The Narrow Road to the Deep North. L’escena de Flanagan, amb descripcions imaginatives com l’exploració corporal, la goma de les calces, un gos udolant i un pingüí fada moribund, li ha valgut una nominació al premi 'Bad Sex in Fiction'. Aquest premi anual, creat per Auberon Waugh el 1993, vol posar en evidència les descripcions sexuals mal escrites, superficials o redundants en la ficció moderna i dissuadir-ne l’ús. No s’aplica a literatura oberta o expressament eròtica o pornogràfica. Un fragment del llibre diu: 'Tot el que els havia mantingut separats, tot el que havia retingut els seus cossos abans, ara ja no hi era... Va besar la lleugera trinxera de color rosa que havia quedat de la goma de les seves calces, que voltava el seu ventre com la línia de l’equador encerclant el món... Mentre es perdien en la circumnavegació de l’un de l’altre, es van sentir prop d’allí crits aguts que acabaven en un udol més profund. Dorrigo va alçar la mirada. Un gran gos era dalt de la duna. Damunt la bava tacada de sang, la seva boca bavosa subjectava un pingüí fada tremolós.' Flanagan se suma a una llista distingida d’anteriors nominats i guanyadors, com Sebastian Faulks, Norman Mailer i A.A. Gill. Enguany, té una forta competència. El guanyador del Premi Pulitzer Michael Cunningham és un dels favorits per la descripció d’una escena climàtica molt intensa a The Snow Queen. Haruki Murakami també ha estat nominat per un fragment a Colorless Tsukuru Tazaki and His Years of Pilgrimage, on utilitza analogies úniques per descriure la intimitat. Tot i haver guanyat el prestigiós Premi Booker 2014 per The Narrow Road to the Deep North, Flanagan es troba ara a l’epicentre d’un premi literari menys afalagador.

article_content: As winter storm Juno sweeps across much of America's East Coast, one puppy is happily embracing the cold while discovering ice and snow. Quinn, a Bernese Mountain Dog, shows no fear as she attempts to run across an ice-covered hill at Loon Mountain in New Hampshire. Her owner, TJ Parker from Somerville, Massachusetts, captures the moment in super-slow motion as Quinn slides playfully down the New Hampshire road. Once she touches the ice, Quinn quickly realizes that moving on a slippery surface is much different from running on dry ground. Surprised but determined, the nearly five-month-old pup tries to regain her balance, though her legs slide uncontrollably beneath her. Eventually, she gives up on standing, drops to her stomach, and gleefully glides down the ice toward the camera. The video, posted on Instagram by Parker, showcases Quinn’s transformation from surprise and uncertainty to joy. Parker told ABC News the puppy went from 'freaking out in shock to pure bliss.' He regularly shares videos of Quinn’s snowy adventures, including clips of her heading down a playground slide and frolicking through mounds of snow, often captured in slow motion.

article_content:
A video recently captured a tourist surviving a snapped bungee cord over the Zambezi River on New Year’s Eve, raising concerns about bungee jumping from the Victoria Falls Bridge. Still, Victoria Falls offers so much more than extreme sports. Frequently listed among the world’s greatest natural wonders, this site boasts jaw-dropping views of the waterfalls and their surrounding gorges. Renamed 'Victoria Falls' by Scottish explorer David Livingstone in 1855 in honor of Queen Victoria, the original local name 'Mosi-oa-Tunya'—meaning 'the smoke that thunders'—is a vivid description of the tumbling water’s roar and mist.

Stretching across the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe, Victoria Falls is at the heart of two national parks—Mosi-oa-Tunya in Zambia and Victoria Falls in Zimbabwe—recognized together as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The falls are not the highest or widest globally, but many believe their width of 1.7 kilometers and towering 100-meter drop make them the most awe-inspiring.

When to go depends on what you want to see. February and March bring dramatic cascades as the Zambezi River swells, sending over 500 million liters of water per minute over the edge. In November, the falls calm, providing a quieter but equally unique view. Whether you explore from the Zambian or Zimbabwean side, both offer unforgettable perspectives.

Beyond bungee, white water rafting on the Zambezi is a must, with day tours from companies like Zambezi Safari and Travel Company starting at $135. Canoeing or river cruising suits quieter adventurers. For a cultural experience, visit Livingstone, about 10 kilometers away—once Zambia’s colonial capital and now home to the Livingstone Museum, where visitors can discover artifacts from the famous explorer and exhibits on Zambia’s history.

Adrenaline seekers can try the Knife Edge Bridge for dizzying views or swim in Devil’s Pool, perched on the brink of the falls. For aerial vistas, opt for a helicopter or microlight flight, while nostalgic travelers can ride the historic steam train across Victoria Falls Bridge.

Thanks to the constant spray, the local ecosystem thrives, and visitors might encounter elephants, hippos, zebras, giraffes, leopards, baboons, buffalo, as well as birds like black eagles and falcons. Safari options include elephant-back rides, walking with lions, and bird-watching tours.

The area offers stays for every budget: Fawlty Towers hostel in Livingstone offers beds from $10 and amenities like a pool and garden, while the Royal Livingstone hotel provides luxurious colonial-style rooms from $700 close to the falls. Stanley and Livingstone, a boutique hotel bordering Zimbabwe’s Zambezi National Park, features suites starting at $245.

Un vídeo recent mostra una turista que va sobreviure després que la seva corda de bungee es trenqués sobre el riu Zambezi la nit de Cap d’Any, fet que genera cautela respecte els salts des del pont de Victoria Falls. Tot i així, Victoria Falls ofereix molt més que esports extrems. Sovint reconeguda com una de les grans meravelles naturals del món, la zona brinda vistes espectaculars sobre les cascades i les seves gorges. Rebatejada com a 'Victoria Falls' per l’explorador escocès David Livingstone el 1855 en honor a la reina Victòria, el seu nom local original, 'Mosi-oa-Tunya', que vol dir 'el fum que trona', descriu perfectament el rugit i la boira de l’aigua.

Les cascades creuen la frontera de Zàmbia i Zimbabwe, al cor de dos parcs nacionals —Mosi-oa-Tunya a Zàmbia i Victoria Falls a Zimbabwe— reconeguts conjuntament com a Patrimoni Mundial de la UNESCO. Tot i que no són les més altes ni amples del planeta, molts pensen que amb 1,7 quilòmetres d’amplada i caigudes de fins a 100 metres, són les més impactants.

El millor moment per visitar-les depèn del que vulguis veure. Entre febrer i març, el Zambezi creix espectacularment i llança més de 500 milions de litres d’aigua cada minut cascada avall. Al novembre, les cascades són molt més tranquil·les però també ofereixen un encant especial. Tant si les veus des del costat zambià com del de Zimbabwe, les perspectives són sorprenents.

A part del bungee, el ràfting pel Zambezi és molt popular, amb excursions d’un dia a partir de 135 dòlars a través d’empreses com Zambezi Safari and Travel Company. Per a activitats més relaxades, pots fer canoa o un creuer pel riu. Si t’interessa la cultura, visita Livingstone —a uns 10 km— on trobaràs el Museu Livingstone, amb artefactes de l’explorador i exposicions sobre la història de Zàmbia.

Els més atrevits poden afrontar el repte del pont Knife Edge o banyar-se a la Devil’s Pool, just tocant les cascades. Pots veure-les des de l’aire en helicòpter o microlight, i per als fans de la nostàlgia, hi ha el tren de vapor pel pont històric de Victoria Falls.

La boira constant propicia un ric ecosistema, i podràs veure elefants, hipopòtams, zebres, girafes, lleopards, babuïns, búfals, i aus com les àguiles negres i falcons. Hi ha safaris amb elefants, caminades amb lleons i sortides especialitzades d’ocells.

Hi ha allotjaments per a totes les butxaques: el Fawlty Towers de Livingstone té llits des de 10 dòlars, amb piscina i jardí; el Royal Livingstone hotel, d’estil colonial, ofereix luxe a partir de 700 dòlars prop de les cascades; el Stanley and Livingstone hotel boutique, al costat del parc nacional del Zambezi a Zimbabwe, té suites des de 245 dòlars.

article_content: A devastating series of six bombings struck Baghdad within an hour on Wednesday, killing at least 95 people and injuring 563 others, according to the Iraqi Interior Ministry. The attacks made it the deadliest day in Iraq since U.S. combat troops withdrew from major cities nearly two months ago, transferring security responsibilities to Iraqi forces. The most damaging explosion occurred when a truck bomb detonated outside the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, just outside Baghdad's secure International Zone, also known as the Green Zone. The blast severely damaged the ministry, sent vehicles flying, and left the area scattered with wreckage. Iraqi security personnel looked on in disbelief as ambulances rushed to the scene. Another truck bomb exploded near the Ministry of Finance, while additional bombs went off on Kifa Street, in the Salhiya neighborhood, and two more in eastern Baghdad’s Beirut Square. A day earlier, security forces in Salhiya had managed to prevent casualties by defusing another truck bomb. Responding to the attacks, Prime Minister Nuri al-Maliki called for a re-evaluation of security plans and strategies. U.S. Ambassador Chris Hill and General Ray Odierno, the top U.S. commander in Iraq, jointly condemned the violence, stating the attacks served no legitimate purpose and would not deter efforts to build a stable and prosperous Iraq. Iraqi military officials reported the arrest of two individuals suspected of involvement in the bombings. The suspects, thought to be senior al Qaeda in Iraq members, were detained while traveling in a car rigged with explosives. Since June 30, the U.S. military has played a supporting role, with Iraqi forces assuming primary responsibility for urban security. The Iraqi government has since ordered the removal of certain concrete barriers and checkpoints around Baghdad, though protective measures remain in place for key government buildings and the Green Zone. CNN correspondents Arwa Damon and Mohammed Tawfeeq contributed to this report.

L’explosió més greu va ser la d’un camió bomba davant del Ministeri d’Afers Exteriors, just fora de la Zona Internacional de Bagdad, també coneguda com la Zona Verda. La detonació va fer grans destrosses a l’edifici, va llançar vehicles pels aires i va deixar la zona contínuament plena de runes. El personal de seguretat iraquià mirava commocionat mentre les ambulàncies arribaven ràpidament. Un altre camió bomba va esclatar prop del Ministeri de Finances, mentre altres bombes explotaven al carrer Kifa, al barri de Salhiya i dues més a la plaça Beirut, a l’est de Bagdad. El dia anterior, les forces de seguretat de Salhiya havien evitat víctimes desactivant un altre camió bomba. L’ambaixador nord-americà Chris Hill i el general Ray Odierno, el màxim comandant dels Estats Units a l’Iraq, van condemnar conjuntament la violència, afirmant que els atacs no tenen cap propòsit legítim i que no impediran els esforços per construir un país estable i pròsper. Fonts militars iraquianes van informar de la detenció de dues persones sospitoses de participar en els atacs. Segons sembla, els sospitosos, que serien alts càrrecs d’Al-Qaida a l’Iraq, van ser detinguts mentre circulaven en un cotxe carregat amb explosius. Els corresponsals d’CNN Arwa Damon i Mohammed Tawfeeq han contribuït a aquest reportatge.

article_content: Blizzard is hosting a competition this month featuring a uniquely chilling PC. The game studio, known for popular titles like 'Diablo IV' and 'Overwatch,' is giving away a custom liquid-cooled PC infused with human blood as a promotional tie-in. The computer includes high-end components such as an Nvidia GeForce RTX 4090 graphics card, Intel Core i9 CPU, 3TB SSD storage, and a Quantum Vector GPU Waterblock. According to Nvidia, the system will be 'infused' with human blood, engineered as part of the campaign for the newest Diablo IV season — 'Season of Blood' — which launched on October 17 and showcases vampire powers. Blizzard is encouraging gamers to donate blood at local clinics or blood banks to help their communities. Players aged 18 or older who donate blood will receive in-game rewards, though anyone can enter the giveaway for the blood-infused PC regardless of age. The blood drive runs from October 20 to November 20. Importantly, the donated blood will not actually be used in the PC hardware. Once the goal of 666 quarts of donated blood is reached, Blizzard will start the giveaway for the unique computer. Additionally, as players contribute to reaching donation milestones, they will unlock special in-game items like new weapons and armor in Diablo IV. While the idea of a 'blood-infused' item giveaway might seem unusual, Blizzard is not the first to promote products containing blood. article_content: A 19-year-old man has been charged with the murder of Antoin Akpom, who died after being assaulted on Kent Street, Leicester, on the evening of Thursday, September 12. Leicestershire Police are investigating whether Akpom’s killing is linked to a house fire that occurred hours later, which claimed the lives of a family of four: Shehnila Taufiq, her 19-year-old daughter Zainab, and her sons Bilal, 17, and Jamal, 15. The fire happened at their home in Wood Hill, Leicester, in the early hours of Friday. Detectives have considered the possibility that the fire was a mistaken act of revenge for Akpom’s death, but at present, police have found no evidence connecting the two cases. Authorities have emphasized that none of the fire victims had any link to Mr Akpom’s murder. A Crown advocate from the Crown Prosecution Service East Midlands Complex Casework Unit reviewed the evidence and determined there was sufficient basis for charging the suspect, adding that prosecution serves the public interest. The man charged with Akpom’s murder will remain in custody and is expected to appear at Leicester Magistrates' Court soon. In connection with the fatal fire, a 49-year-old man arrested as part of the investigation has been released on bail, while police continue to question an 18-year-old man. Three women aged 19, 20, and 27 who were arrested have also been released on bail. Police reiterated that the investigation has found no links between the murder of Mr Akpom and those who died in the house fire. Comments on this matter are not being accepted due to legal reasons.

article_content: Labour leader Ed Miliband has called for limits on how much MPs can earn from outside interests, asserting it is time to restrict lucrative second jobs for politicians. Miliband argued that there should be a cap on additional earnings by MPs, after reports revealed that many hold significant roles outside Parliament. These remarks came in the wake of controversy over union influence in the Labour Party, especially allegations that Unite manipulated the Labour candidate selection in Falkirk. Miliband criticized Unite's actions in Falkirk, calling them 'a symbol of what is wrong with politics.' He announced planned reforms, including a code of conduct for candidates and open primary elections for selecting Labour’s London mayoral candidate. Major union leaders largely welcomed the proposals, though Unite leader Len McCluskey initially described the 'opt-in' plan as 'unworkable' before later supporting them. Lord Collins, a former TGWU assistant general secretary, has been chosen to oversee the party rule changes. Miliband advocates ending lucrative second jobs for MPs in professions such as law or corporate advisory work, saying MPs should represent their constituents as their main priority. Recent disclosures show 295 of 650 MPs declared outside income, with 20 earning more than the £65,738 MP salary. High earners include Gordon Brown (£1.4 million, all directed to charity), Stephen Phillips (£740,000), Geoffrey Cox, Nicholas Soames, Sir Malcolm Rifkind, Alistair Darling, John Redwood, and Jack Straw. Conservative MPs reported £4.3 million in outside earnings, while Labour MPs reported £2.4 million. Miliband is calling for new rules regarding outside earnings and conflicts of interest, urging Prime Minister David Cameron and Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg to back these reforms. Clegg rejected the proposal, describing it as a distraction from Labour's union issues, and emphasized the importance of transparency and accountability. Miliband's proposals would require union members to ‘opt in’ to contribute an annual £3 donation to Labour, instead of the current automatic payment. While this could reduce union donations to Labour, Miliband argued it would increase engagement among active members. After initial criticism, some union leaders expressed support for the plan. Conservative Party Chairman Grant Shapps dismissed Miliband's reforms as superficial, arguing union leaders would retain their influence over Labour's policies and candidate choices. Former Prime Minister Tony Blair supported the changes, calling them overdue and an example of decisive leadership. Despite positive reactions, there are doubts about whether these reforms will significantly reduce union power, as union members continue to hold considerable voting power in Labour leadership elections and at party conferences. Critics warn that unless leadership and voting rules are also reformed, union leaders may still have a disproportionate say. The Conservative Party has called for further investigation into Unite's activities following reports that the union had considerable influence on Labour policies and Parliamentary debate topics.

article_content: Indian wrestler Yogeshwar Dutt has refrained from either praising or criticizing the new selection policy introduced by the IOA-appointed ad-hoc panel for wrestling. According to this policy, grapplers who secure Olympic quota spots must compete against a challenger to qualify for the Paris 2024 Olympics. The selection for the wrestling squad will follow a two-step process. First, wrestlers who have earned quota places for India will face challengers on June 1, with the winners progressing to represent the country at the Olympics. Yogeshwar Dutt emphasized that it is the responsibility of the federation to decide and amend selection policies. 'In the past, wrestlers who qualified would go on to compete in the Olympics. Under the current policy, for example, Antim Panghal, who has secured an Olympic quota, is not guaranteed a spot; she will need to win a trial,' Dutt told PTI at the Khelo India Para Games mascot and logo launch event. He added, 'Until now, there were no such trials during our time. Whoever won the quota represented the country. But the rules are made by the federation, and we must respect them.' Currently, only Antim Panghal, the World Championships bronze medalist in the 53kg category, has earned a quota spot and will have to compete in this trial on June 1. She could face Vinesh Phogat, if the 2018 Asian Games gold medalist qualifies as the challenger, which will be determined on May 31. The ad-hoc committee has stated that all challengers will be finalized on May 31, and the trial matches (wrestle-offs) will take place the following day. Yogeshwar Dutt explained that the new policy can have both positive and negative aspects. 'On the one hand, those who secure the quota can prepare with a clear focus for the Olympics, but knowing there's a trial ahead may also cause distraction. The competition has increased now. Sushil Kumar played in three Olympics, I played four, as there were fewer competitors then. Now, many wrestlers are emerging, and they deserve opportunities.' While only Antim Panghal has clinched a quota spot so far, more Indian wrestlers are expected to earn spots at the upcoming Asian Olympic Qualifier in Kyrgyzstan (April 19–21) and the World Olympic Qualifiers in Turkey (May 9–12). India has a chance to win up to 17 more quotas—six apiece in men's freestyle and Greco-Roman, and five in the women's competition. All future quota place winners will also need to compete in trials to confirm their Olympic berths. Sarita Mor, World Championship bronze medalist in 2021, declined to comment, stating she was not yet familiar with the new selection policy.

article_content: Alexander Westgarth is the founder and CEO of WineCap, an investment platform aiming to make wine investment accessible, transparent, and straightforward. Wine technology has evolved over thousands of years—from early machines like the wine press, dating back 6,000 years, to innovations like Champagne pioneered by the French monk Dom Pérignon, and the Romans' use of barrels for transportation. Today, technological advancements are transforming the wine industry once again. Modern developments are creating exciting opportunities for both producers and investors. AI is now being used in winemaking. For example, winemakers Anthony Aubert and Jean-Charles Mathieu collaborated with ChatGPT to produce an organic wine, following the platform’s guidance for both production and branding. The result was a vintage named 'The End.' Additionally, AI platforms are being tested as digital sommeliers. Blockchain is also providing new layers of authentication and traceability. Organizations like VDP in Germany have worked with startups such as VINiD to use blockchain, NFTs, and NFC technology to fight forgery and securely document wine provenance. Wine collectors and investors can track bottles digitally, monitoring their journey from winery to cellar, storage conditions, and ownership history. While potential risks like regulatory gaps or fraudulent NFTs exist, blockchain adoption is growing. Many companies now include scanning technologies on bottles to provide authenticated histories, with some pairing these records with NFT art or exclusive experiences. Machine learning is assisting investors with data-driven decisions, reducing the impact of human bias. Research by Morningstar shows that bias is widespread among investors and can lead to financial loss. By analyzing big data, machine learning can identify promising wine investment opportunities. Online wine trading platforms are on the rise, reminiscent of Robinhood’s impact on the stock market. About 25 platforms for fine wine trading can now be found online, attracting a younger and more tech-savvy audience. There is a trend towards enabling fractional wine ownership, opening up investment potential to more people. Business leaders are encouraged to leverage cutting-edge technologies to stay competitive, whether by enhancing user experience online, integrating AI into decision-making, or exploring blockchain uses. Although challenges exist, such as ensuring proper fit and hiring creative experts, embracing innovation could help businesses stand the test of time. article_content: Nearly two weeks after Superstorm Sandy struck, New York continues to grapple with widespread outages and shortages. On Long Island, some 150,000 homes and businesses remain without electricity, with roughly 60,000 requiring major repairs before restoration efforts can even start. Frustrations have mounted, prompting Congressmen Peter King and Steve Israel to request intervention from the Army Corps of Engineers and the Department of Energy, citing insufficient action by the Long Island Power Authority. In the face of ongoing fuel shortages, Mayor Michael Bloomberg has imposed emergency gas rationing. Using a system based on license plate numbers, only drivers with plates ending in odd numbers can purchase fuel on odd days, and those with even numbers on even days. The rules do not apply to taxis, buses, emergency vehicles, commercial vehicles, or those with medical plates. About 25% of gas stations in New York City are currently operational. Some remain closed either due to depleted fuel supplies or lack of electricity. Although queues at open stations remain long, they have shortened significantly since rationing began, with many drivers reporting drastically reduced wait times. Hurricane Sandy's impact severely damaged the region’s petroleum infrastructure, and authorities predict fuel shortages may persist for several more weeks. In neighboring New Jersey, Governor Chris Christie has implemented similar rationing, including a 10-gallon purchase limit. Federal assistance from FEMA has included delivering gasoline and occasionally providing it for free, though these efforts have sometimes resulted in overcrowding and incidents at gas stations. Mayor Bloomberg has emphasized that rationing is intended to ensure fair fuel distribution and alleviate lengthy lineups, stressing the measure’s necessity. Those visiting from other states must also follow the new guidelines while fuel shortages persist. The reopening of New York Harbor is expected to support fuel supplies; however, persistent long lines and rising tempers remain a daily challenge, evoking memories of the 1973 Arab oil embargo when New York last enforced widespread rationing. Ultimately, the region faces a tough path to full recovery, still dealing with extensive blackouts, shortages, and public frustration in Sandy’s aftermath.

article_content: Robert Fico is once again leading Slovakia's government, now pursuing a more populist, Eurosceptic, and pro-Russian stance. Just hours before Thursday’s summit, Slovakia announced it would no longer support European efforts to provide military aid to Kyiv as it defends against Russia. The ongoing war between Israel and Hamas in the Middle East turned the European summit into a de facto war council. While Ukraine remains a constant topic, this time the conflict between Israel and Hamas in Gaza took up much of the discussion. On Thursday, President of the European Council Charles Michel stated, 'A total siege is not in line with international law. I confirm, it's a principle of international law.' He also emphasized the worsening humanitarian situation in Gaza, saying the EU should do all it can to ensure humanitarian access. Global Gateway Summit Commences Before the summit, some EU leaders attended the second day of the Global Gateway forum, the EU's infrastructure partnership meant to compete with China's Belt and Road Initiative in fields such as digitalization, climate and energy, health, and education. The EU announced new investment agreements with developing countries in Africa and Asia. The €300 billion Global Gateway plan, extending through 2027, is designed to expand the EU's geopolitical influence. On Wednesday, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen described the EU as a 'better choice' for development cooperation, pointing out that other investment options often come with hidden restrictions and high costs, sometimes at the expense of the environment, workers’ rights, or national sovereignty. Among the new partners is Bangladesh, with nearly €400 million in agreements. With 170 million people, Bangladesh has moved from being one of the world's poorest countries to nearing ‘middle-income’ status in 50 years of independence. Although Bangladesh is a participant in China’s Belt and Road Initiative, it continues to welcome support from Europe. Bangladesh's Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina told Euronews: 'I think this is a big opportunity, because we’ve just been reclassified and graduated from Least Developed Country. That will help our country develop further.' She added that Bangladesh’s foreign policy is clear: friendship to all. 'We get loans and repay them with interest, so we look for what benefits our country most.' UN Secretary-General Faces Criticism The war in the Middle East continued to dominate headlines, in part because of strong criticism directed at UN Secretary-General António Guterres. The Israeli government demanded his resignation after he remarked on 'clear violations' of humanitarian law by Israel, stressing that no state is above the law. Guterres faces political pressure from Israel and its allies, and while he has not retracted his remarks, the controversy may grow in significance.

article_content: Two men serving life sentences for murder are set to have the first same-sex wedding in a British prison. Mikhail Ivan Gallatinov, 40, who was jailed in 1997 for murder, will marry fellow prisoner Marc Goodwin, 31, who was convicted in 2007 for his involvement in a fatal assault. Gallatinov strangled a 28-year-old man, Adrian Kaminsky, after contacting him through a chat line. Goodwin was found guilty of leading a group that attacked men, resulting in the death of Malcolm Benfold, 57. The two men met while incarcerated at HMP Full Sutton, Yorkshire, and have been granted official permission to marry. The ceremony will take place in the prison with no cost to taxpayers, and they will not be allowed to share a cell after the wedding. A notice of the marriage was posted at the register office in Beverley, with both listing their occupation as bar staff. The Ministry of Justice stated that prisoners are entitled to apply to be married under the Marriages Act 1983. It is believed that the pair previously considered a civil partnership, but a change in law in March 2014 legalized same-sex marriage in Britain. There have been notable prison weddings in the UK before, including East End gangster Reggie Kray's marriage in 1997 and Mickey McAvoy's ceremony at HMP Leicester after the Brink’s-Mat robbery. Gallatinov, from Manchester, was sentenced to a minimum of 20 years, while Goodwin, originally from Airdrie near Glasgow, was sentenced to life with a minimum of 18 years. Both remain ineligible for parole for several years. Gallatinov's case was notable for his prior offenses and because he was under police surveillance at the time of his crime. Goodwin has reportedly expressed remorse to his victim’s family.

Gallatinov va estrangular un home de 28 anys, Adrian Kaminsky, després de contactar-lo per una línia de xat. Goodwin va ser declarat culpable d'encapçalar un grup que atacava homes, fet que va derivar en la mort de Malcolm Benfold, de 57 anys. Els dos homes es van conèixer mentre estaven empresonats a HMP Full Sutton, Yorkshire, i han rebut permís oficial per casar-se. La cerimònia es farà a la presó sense cap cost per al contribuent, i no se'ls permetrà compartir cel·la després del casament. S'ha publicat un avís de casament a l'oficina del registre civil de Beverley, on tots dos consten com a empleats de bar. El Ministeri de Justícia afirma que els presos tenen dret a sol·licitar casar-se segons la Llei de Matrimonis de 1983. Es creu que la parella havia considerat primer una unió civil, però un canvi legal al març de 2014 va legalitzar el matrimoni entre persones del mateix sexe a Gran Bretanya. Anteriorment, ja hi ha hagut casaments destacats a presons britàniques, com el de l gàngster de l'East End Reggie Kray l'any 1997 i el de Mickey McAvoy a HMP Leicester després del robatori Brink’s-Mat. Gallatinov, de Manchester, va ser condemnat a un mínim de 20 anys, mentre que Goodwin, originari d'Airdrie, prop de Glasgow, va rebre cadena perpètua amb un mínim de 18 anys. Cap dels dos no és elegible per a la llibertat condicional encara durant diversos anys. El cas de Gallatinov destaca pels seus delictes previs i perquè estava sota vigilància policial durant el crim. Goodwin hauria expressat remordiment a la família de la seva víctima.

article_content: You Me At Six, the popular English rock band, have announced their first performance at Aberdeen's P&J Live, scheduled for February 2024. Following the release of their album 'Truth Decay,' the Surrey-based group will celebrate the 10th anniversary of 'Cavalier Youth' by headlining shows with special guests Deaf Havana. You Me At Six previously achieved success with their 2021 album 'Suckapunch,' their second UK number one. Band members Josh Franceschi (lead vocals), Max Helyer (guitar), Chris Miller (guitar), Matt Barnes (bass), and Dan Flint (drums) continue to discuss the future direction of their music. Franceschi explained, 'For this album, we wanted to focus on a specific identity for the band. We needed to reflect on our journey to decide where we wanted to go next.' 'Truth Decay,' released in January 2023, highlights You Me At Six's career as one of the UK's leading modern rock bands and explores new creative directions. Franceschi said, 'We are at our best when all five of us contribute fully. That's what 'Truth Decay' represents.' The band aims to remind fans of their reputation for crafting dynamic emo-rock, with Franceschi asserting, 'There's nobody else that comes close.' The recent album showcases You Me At Six enjoying their influence on the music scene while embracing new possibilities. Louise Stewart, Head of Entertainment, Exhibitions, and Marketing at P&J Live, commented, 'After releasing their eighth album 'Truth Decay' at the start of 2023, the band has built up an impressive catalog of hits.' article_content: Afghanistan defeated defending champions England by 69 runs in a major upset at the ICC Cricket World Cup 2023, held at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in New Delhi. Afghanistan, batting first after England won the toss, set a competitive total of 284 thanks to a rapid 80 from opener Rahmanullah Gurbaz and a half-century from wicketkeeper Ikram Alikhil. England's bowlers, led by leg-spinner Adil Rashid (3-42), picked up wickets but struggled to contain the Afghan batsmen, who reached 284 before being bowled out. Gurbaz was on course for a century, hitting eight fours and four sixes, but was run out for 80 after a risky single called by captain Hashmatullah Shahidi. Lower-order contributions from Rashid Khan (23) and Mujeeb Ur Rahman (28) helped Afghanistan post a challenging target. England, with a strong batting lineup, lost early wickets as Fazalhaq Farooqi dismissed Jonny Bairstow in the second over. Afghanistan's spinners dominated, with Mujeeb Ur Rahman bowling Joe Root for 11, Mohammad Nabi removing Dawid Malan for 32, and Naveen-ul-Haq dismissing England captain Jos Buttler for 9. Star spinner Rashid Khan took the wickets of Liam Livingstone and Adil Rashid, further derailing England's chase. Harry Brook fought back with a 66-run innings, but fell to Mujeeb Ur Rahman, leaving England struggling at 169-8 and eventually all out for 215. Mujeeb Ur Rahman was named player of the match for his all-round performance. He expressed pride in beating the defending champions, mentioning the achievement's significance for Afghanistan and the broader region. Rashid Khan shared hopes the win would bring joy to people in Afghanistan, where recent earthquakes have caused much hardship. England, currently fifth in the group, have one win from three matches, while Afghanistan moved up with this victory. Afghanistan had lost heavily to Bangladesh and India in previous matches and came into this game with just one prior World Cup win. England’s captain Jos Buttler called it 'a tough loss', acknowledging that Afghanistan outplayed his side. The cricketing world praised Afghanistan’s spirited performance and underdog victory.

article_content: Market expert Madhusudan Kela emphasizes a long-term investment approach in India, advising investors to exercise patience and maintain realistic expectations. He identifies four major growth themes for the next 10-15 years: carbon neutrality, artificial intelligence (AI), cybersecurity, and biotechnology, noting that these sectors present both significant challenges and opportunities for the market. Kela observes that while equities have generally performed well, outsized returns depend on finding the right themes and companies and holding them over many years. Over recent years, market indices such as the Nifty have only delivered modest returns in the 3-5% range, but select individual stocks have rewarded patient investors handsomely. He stresses that successful investing is rooted in a long-term perspective, similar to investment approaches in real estate or fixed deposits. Unrealistic expectations and a focus on short-term tips are discouraged; instead, investors should consider their time horizon and investment amount as key factors. Highlighting India’s economic resilience and improved global reputation, Kela points to a strong policy framework supporting growth. He also warns of the dangers of market exuberance, especially in high-valuation segments such as small- and mid-cap stocks, and advises caution. While recognizing risks like political instability or unexpected external events, Kela does not foresee any major corrections in Indian markets unless such unpredictable developments occur. He anticipates continued foreign investment into India, particularly after the 2024 elections if stability prevails. Kela shares that he has invested in themes like energy transition, citing his stake in Waaree, and remains focused on finding opportunities in AI, cybersecurity, and biotechnology. He believes a disciplined, patient approach will help identify long-term market winners. He concludes that Indian equities should outperform other asset classes for patient investors, advocating thorough research, discipline, and realistic expectations for long-term wealth creation.
translated_content: L’expert de mercat Madhusudan Kela posa l’èmfasi en un enfocament inversor a llarg termini a l’Índia, i recomana als inversors paciència i expectatives realistes. Identifica quatre grans temàtiques de creixement pels pròxims 10-15 anys: neutralitat de carboni, intel·ligència artificial (IA), ciberseguretat i biotecnologia, assenyalant que aquests sectors tenen desafiaments i oportunitats importants. Kela observa que, segons la seva experiència, tot i que les accions han tingut un bon resultat en general, obtenir grans rendiments depèn de trobar els temes adequats i empreses clau, i mantenir-les a llarg termini. En els darrers anys, índexs com el Nifty només han proporcionat rendiments del 3-5%, però algunes accions individuals han recompensat inversors pacients. Destaca que l’èxit inversor requereix una visió a llarg termini, similar a la compra d’immobles o dipòsits a termini. Desaconsella les expectatives poc realistes i buscar guanys ràpids; proposa que els inversors tinguin present l’horitzó temporal i la quantitat invertida com a variables clau. Kela subratlla la resiliència econòmica de l’Índia i el seu prestigi internacional creixent, juntament amb un marc de polítiques que recolza el creixement. Avisa de l’excés d’optimisme als mercats, especialment en segments com les small i mid-caps, i recomana precaució. Malgrat que hi pot haver riscos com la inestabilitat política o esdeveniments imprevistos, Kela no preveu correccions importants al mercat indi llevat d’esdeveniments excepcionals. Creu que la inversió estrangera continuarà arribant a l’Índia, especialment després de les eleccions de 2024 si es manté l’estabilitat. Comenta que ha invertit en temàtiques com la transició energètica, citant la seva participació a Waaree, i segueix vigilant oportunitats en IA, ciberseguretat i biotecnologia. Considera que la disciplina i la paciència ajudaran a identificar guanyadors de llarg termini. En conclusió, afirma que la borsa índia superarà altres classes d’actius pels inversors pacients, i defensa la recerca, la disciplina i tenir expectatives realistes per crear riquesa a llarg termini.

article_content: Sohna and Mohna, conjoined twin brothers from Amritsar, India, have defied overwhelming odds to celebrate their ninth birthday. Diagnosed with dicephalic parapagus—a rare condition in which twins share a torso and legs but have two heads and four arms—they are among only a handful of known survivors with this condition. Living in an orphanage after their parents felt unable to care for them, Sohna and Mohna attend school daily, read and write, and lead spirited lives. Despite sharing a body, both boys maintain distinct individualities, independently controlling their own arms and legs, and experiencing separate sensations and routines. Their remarkable journey is the focus of the documentary 'The Twins Who Share a Body - A Body Shock Special,' airing on Channel 4. Medical professionals, including Dr. Rakesh Chouhan, continue to study how the twins coordinate actions and maintain independence, observing that each brain controls one side of their shared body. Dicephalic parapagus is exceptionally rare, with more than half of affected twins being stillborn and an overall survival rate of just 25 percent. The twins’ caretaker, Parmjit Kaur, notes their independence, stating that each boy carries out his own personal hygiene and other activities. The documentary also briefly follows six-month-old Brazilian conjoined twins, Jesus and Emmanuel, who share a heart, presenting significant challenges for their doctors. Despite the immense difficulties posed by their condition, Sohna and Mohna exemplify resilience and individuality, continuing to inspire both medical professionals and caregivers alike.
translated_content: Sohna i Mohna, germans bessons siamesos d'Amritsar, Índia, han desafiat totes les probabilitats arribant a celebrar el seu novè aniversari. Diagnosticats amb dicefàlic parapagus —una condició molt poc freqüent on els bessons comparteixen tronc i cames però tenen dos caps i quatre braços—, es troben entre els pocs supervivents coneguts d'aquesta afecció. Resideixen en un orfenat després que els seus pares sentissin que no podien fer-se'n càrrec, i assisteixen cada dia a l'escola, llegeixen, escriuen i duen una vida plena. Malgrat compartir un sol cos, cadascun manté la seva pròpia individualitat, controlant de manera independent els seus braços i cames, i experimentant sensacions i rutines per separat. El seu viatge extraordinari és el focus del documental 'Els Bessons Que Comparteixen un Cos - Especial Body Shock', emès a Channel 4. Els professionals mèdics, com el doctor Rakesh Chouhan, estudien com els bessons coordinen accions i mantenen la seva independència, tot observant que cada cervell controla una banda del cos compartit. El dicefàlic parapagus és extremadament rar: més de la meitat dels bessons amb aquesta condició neixen morts, i la taxa general de supervivència dels siamesos és només del 25%. La cuidadora dels germans, Parmjit Kaur, destaca la seva independència, posant d'exemple que cadascun s'ocupa del seu higiene i altres tasques personals. El documental també segueix breument a Jesús i Emmanuel, bessons siamesos brasilers de sis mesos, que comparteixen cor i afronten grans reptes mèdics. Malgrat totes les adversitats, Sohna i Mohna són símbol de fortalesa i individualitat, i continuen inspirant tant a professionals mèdics com a cuidadors.
post_content: Meet Sohna & Mohna: conjoined twins in India living life to the fullest! 🎉 Despite one-in-a-million odds, they go to school & inspire everyone around them. #Inspiration #AgainstAllOdds #Twins

article_content:
X, formerly Twitter, has launched a test that requires new users in New Zealand and the Philippines to pay $1 per year to use basic features such as tweeting, retweeting, liking, and replying. Those who do not subscribe can still read posts, watch videos, and follow accounts, but cannot interact with posts.

According to X, this pilot aims to fight spam, bots, and manipulation on the platform. New users must also verify their phone numbers, though accounts limited to reading are still free. Elon Musk, who owns X, Tesla, and SpaceX, has indicated all X users could eventually be charged.

Since Musk’s $44 billion purchase last year, X’s revenue has consistently dropped. The company insists that the fee is mainly meant to discourage bots, which are inexpensive to create but become costly if a payment is required.

X Premium subscribers gain additional features for a higher fee—$8 per month in the US, with prices varying by country—while most revenue continues to come from ads. Experts warn that paywalls could cause user loss and lower ad earnings.

In recent weeks, X has been investigated by the European Union for potentially spreading terrorist, violent, and hateful content after Hamas attacked Israel. Australia’s internet safety agency also fined X for insufficient cooperation with a child abuse investigation.

X, anteriorment conegut com a Twitter, ha engegat una prova en què els nous usuaris de Nova Zelanda i les Filipines han de pagar 1 dòlar anual per utilitzar funcions bàsiques com ara tuitejar, fer retuits, donar m’agrada i respondre a publicacions. Aquells que no paguin podran llegir, veure vídeos i seguir comptes, però no podran interactuar amb les publicacions.

Segons X, aquesta mesura vol combatre l’spam, els bots i la manipulació a la plataforma. Els nous usuaris també hauran de verificar el seu número de telèfon, però els comptes només de lectura es mantindran gratuïts. Elon Musk, propietari d’X, Tesla i SpaceX, ha assenyalat que en el futur tots els usuaris podrien haver de pagar.

Després de la compra per 44.000 milions de dòlars l’any passat, X ha patit una davallada constant d’ingressos. L’empresa assegura que aquesta taxa vol evitar la proliferació de bots, molt barats de crear però que serien més costosos si s’hagués de pagar.

El servei X Premium ofereix més funcions per una quota superior—actualment 8 dòlars mensuals als Estats Units, amb preus variables segons el país—mentre que la publicitat continua sent la principal font d’ingressos. Alguns experts adverteixen que posar funcions de pagament podria reduir el nombre d’usuaris i fer baixar els ingressos publicitaris.

Darrerament, la Unió Europea investiga X per la possible difusió de continguts terroristes, violents i d’odi després de l’atac de Hamas a Israel. A més, el regulador de seguretat digital d’Austràlia ha multat X per no col·laborar prou en una investigació sobre l’abús infantil.

article_content: Despite having been mocked and criticized, Justin Bieber's involvement in Calvin Klein's latest campaign dramatically enhanced the brand's online profile. According to WWD, since Bieber and model Lara Stone appeared as the faces of the spring campaign, Calvin Klein has gained 3.6 million new followers across all social media platforms. In just the first 48 hours, the campaign's hashtag #mycalvins was tweeted 1.6 million times—five times more than the #breaktheinternet hashtag used during Kim Kardashian's viral Paper Magazine shoot. Addressing his critics, the 20-year-old pop star highlighted the hard work he invested in preparing for the campaign. Working out with his trainer Patrick Nilsson, Bieber did 45-minute sessions, five times a week, targeting various muscle groups and working on his abs every other day. He shared that although he doesn't follow a strict diet, he tries to make healthy choices most of the time, casually adding, 'I am a 20-year-old guy!' Recently, Bieber was seen in Los Angeles with Hailey Baldwin, the duo spotted together in a black car, unconcerned about being noticed. Lara Stone, Bieber's co-star in the Calvin Klein campaign and wife of actor David Walliams, joined him as they presented at the Fashion Rocks event.

Segons WWD, des que Bieber i la model Lara Stone van aparèixer com a imatges de la campanya de primavera, Calvin Klein ha sumat 3,6 milions de nous seguidors a totes les seves xarxes socials. Només en les primeres 48 hores, l’etiqueta #mycalvins de la campanya es va tuitejar 1,6 milions de vegades – cinc vegades més que l’etiqueta #breaktheinternet, utilitzada durant el viral de la Paper Magazine de Kim Kardashian. Responent als crítics, el cantant de 20 anys va ressaltar l'esforç que va posar en preparar-se per a la campanya. Treballant amb el seu entrenador Patrick Nilsson, Bieber feia sessions de 45 minuts, cinc cops per setmana, centrant-se en diferents grups musculars i fent abdominals cada dos dies. Va explicar que, tot i que no segueix una dieta estricta, procura menjar saludablement la major part del temps, i va afegir amb naturalitat: 'Tinc 20 anys!' Recentment, Bieber va ser vist a Los Angeles amb Hailey Baldwin, tots dos junts en un cotxe negre sense preocupar-se per ser vistos. Lara Stone, companya de Bieber a la campanya de Calvin Klein i esposa de l’actor David Walliams, es va unir a ell per presentar plegats a l’esdeveniment Fashion Rocks.

article_content: On Monday, Sierra Leone's President Julius Bio welcomed a high-ranking delegation from ECOWAS and Nigeria following recent attacks in Freetown. The delegation, comprising Nigeria's National Security Adviser Nuhu Ribadu, Chief of Defence Staff General Christopher Musa, Chief of Defence Military Intelligence Major General Emmanuel Udiandeye, and ECOWAS Commission President Dr. Omar Alieu Touray, conveyed messages of support and a shared commitment to uphold democracy and good governance. The representatives delivered expressions of solidarity from Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, the current ECOWAS chair, as well as other regional leaders. Their visit followed violent clashes the previous day when armed assailants stormed a military armoury and several prisons in the capital, resulting in prolonged fighting with security forces. President Bio posted updates and photos from the meeting on his X account, voicing strong appreciation for the regional support. He reiterated his government’s unwavering commitment to democracy, justice, the well-being of citizens, and thanked allies for their encouragement since Sierra Leone’s civil war ended 21 years ago. In response to Sunday's unrest, the Sierra Leonean government lifted the daytime curfew but maintained a nightly one from 9:00 pm to 6:00 am. The public was encouraged to stay alert while resuming daily activities. Sierra Leone, a West African country where English is the official language, has been grappling with political challenges since the June elections. ECOWAS and Nigeria have reiterated their support for ongoing efforts to maintain peace and prevent further disturbances.
translated_content: Dilluns, el president de Sierra Leone, Julius Bio, va rebre una delegació d'alt nivell de la CEDEAO i Nigèria després dels atacs recents a Freetown. La delegació, formada pel conseller nacional de seguretat de Nigèria, Nuhu Ribadu; el cap de l'Estat Major de Defensa, el general Christopher Musa; el cap d'Intel·ligència Militar, el general major Emmanuel Udiandeye; i el president de la Comissió de la CEDEAO, Dr. Omar Alieu Touray, va transmetre missatges de suport i el compromís compartit per defensar la democràcia i el bon govern. Els representants van lliurar mostres de solidaritat del president de Nigèria, Bola Ahmed Tinubu, actual president de la CEDEAO, així com dels altres líders de la regió. La visita va seguir als enfrontaments violents del dia anterior, quan homes armats van assaltar una armeria militar i diverses presons a la capital, provocant llargues hores de combats amb les forces de seguretat. El president Bio va publicar actualitzacions i imatges de la trobada al seu compte d’X, mostrant la seva forta gratitud pel suport regional. Va subratllar el compromís inalterable del seu govern amb la democràcia, la justícia i el benestar de la població, i va donar les gràcies als aliats pel seu suport des que la guerra civil del país va acabar fa 21 anys. Després dels fets de diumenge, el govern de Sierra Leone va aixecar el toc de queda diürn, però manté el toc de queda nocturn de 21:00 a 6:00. Es demana a la ciutadania que es mantingui vigilants mentre reprèn la vida quotidiana. Sierra Leone, país de parla anglesa de l’Àfrica Occidental, afronta dificultats polítiques des de les eleccions del mes de juny. La CEDEAO i Nigèria han reiterat el seu suport als esforços per preservar la pau i evitar més disturbis.

article_content: A widely shared photograph from November 14 captured New York police officer Lawrence DePrimo assisting a barefoot man in Times Square by buying him a pair of winter boots. The officer noticed the man, later identified as Jeffrey Hillman, suffering from significant blisters, and offered him socks before purchasing boots from a nearby store. Unbeknownst to DePrimo, tourist Jennifer Foster photographed the act, and the image quickly went viral after being posted on the NYPD's Facebook page. Initially believed to be homeless, Hillman has since been identified as a military veteran with an apartment in the Bronx, provided through the federal Veterans Affairs Support Housing program. City officials say Hillman is known to have housing but sometimes returns to the street, which they describe as not uncommon among people with similar backgrounds. Hillman's brother, Kirk, expressed surprise at seeing his brother barefoot in the cold, noting his history of homelessness. City Homeless Services Commissioner Seth Diamond emphasized that Hillman has stable housing and receives ongoing support, but that engagement with such services can fluctuate. Authorities remain committed to helping Hillman and others lead safer, healthier lives.
translated_content: Una fotografia àmpliament compartida del 14 de novembre va captar l’agent de la policia de Nova York Lawrence DePrimo ajudant un home descalç a Times Square comprant-li unes botes d’hivern. L’agent va veure l’home, identificat després com a Jeffrey Hillman, que patia butllofes importants, i li va oferir mitjons abans de comprar-li unes botes en una botiga propera. Sense que DePrimo ho sabés, la turista Jennifer Foster va fotografiar el gest, i la imatge es va fer viral després de ser publicada a la pàgina de Facebook del NYPD. Inicialment es pensava que Hillman era sense sostre, però s’ha esbrinat que és un veterà militar amb un apartament al Bronx, proporcionat a través del programa federal d’Habitatge per a Veterans. Les autoritats municipals expliquen que Hillman té habitatge, però de vegades torna al carrer, una situació habitual entre persones amb experiències semblants. El seu germà, Kirk, es va mostrar sorprès de veure’l descalç al fred, tot destacant el seu passat com a persona sense llar. El comissionat de Serveis per a Persones Sense Sostre, Seth Diamond, destaca que Hillman disposa d’habitatge estable i rep suport continuat, tot i que la vinculació amb aquests serveis pot fluctuar. Les autoritats segueixen compromeses a ajudar Hillman i d’altres a viure de manera més segura i saludable.
post_content: NYC officer’s viral act of kindness: He bought boots for a barefoot man in Times Square. Turns out the man, a military vet, has housing but still struggles. Inspiring moment sparks bigger convo on homelessness. #NYC #Kindness #HomelessnessAwareness

article_content: Saudi Arabia has introduced stricter requirements for issuing visas to recruit domestic workers from abroad. Under the new rules, the minimum age for a single employer to obtain a visa is 24 years. The recently announced regulations, issued by Musaned—a government platform overseeing domestic labor—define who is eligible to apply for domestic worker visas. Eligible applicants include Saudi citizens, Gulf nationals, foreign wives of Saudi men and their mothers, as well as holders of Saudi premium residency permits, subject to financial requirements. This move is part of Saudi Arabia's ongoing efforts to better manage and regulate its domestic labor market. The Ministry of Human Resources established Musaned to provide information on rights, obligations, and available services to employers and workers. Services include visa issuance, recruitment requests, contract authentication, and dispute resolution. Musaned also enables digital wage transfers for domestic workers through apps such as STC Pay and Urpay. The platform supports the transfer of house workers' services between employers and provides an official channel for contract management. The Ministry emphasizes that all contracting for domestic workers must be carried out via Musaned, which serves as the official recruitment platform. A wide range of domestic workers are covered by these regulations, including housekeepers, drivers, housemaids, cleaners, cooks, guards, farmers, tailors, live-in nurses, tutors, and nannies. These changes are designed to increase transparency and efficiency in the recruitment process, and to ensure the rights of both employers and domestic workers are protected.
translated_content: Aràbia Saudita ha introduït requisits més estrictes per a l’expedició de visats per contractar treballadors domèstics de l’estranger. Segons les noves normes, l’edat mínima que ha de tenir un sol sol·licitant per obtenir un visat és de 24 anys. Les regulacions anunciades recentment, emeses per Musaned—una plataforma governamental que supervisa el treball domèstic—defineixen qui pot sol·licitar visats per a treballadors domèstics. Els sol·licitants elegibles inclouen ciutadans saudites, nacionals del Golf, esposes estrangeres d’homes saudites i les seves mares, així com titulars de permisos de residència premium d’Aràbia Saudita, subjectes a requisits econòmics. Aquesta mesura forma part dels esforços continus d’Aràbia Saudita per gestionar i regular millor el seu mercat de treball domèstic. El Ministeri de Recursos Humans va establir Musaned per proporcionar informació sobre drets, obligacions i serveis disponibles tant per a ocupadors com per a treballadors. Els serveis inclouen l’expedició de visats, sol·licituds de contractació, autenticació de contractes i resolució de conflictes. Musaned també permet la transferència digital de salaris per als treballadors domèstics a través d’aplicacions com STC Pay i Urpay. La plataforma dona suport a la transferència de servei de treballadors domèstics entre ocupadors i proporciona un canal oficial per a la gestió de contractes. El Ministeri recalca que tots els contractes de treballadors domèstics s’han de fer a través de Musaned, que actua com a plataforma oficial de contractació. Aquestes regulacions cobreixen una àmplia varietat de treballadors domèstics, com ara amos/as de casa, conductors/es, empleats/es domèstics/ques, netejadors/es, cuiners/es, guàrdies, pagesos/es, sastres/es, infermers/es interns, tutors/es i mainaderes. Aquests canvis pretenen augmentar la transparència i l’eficiència del procés de contractació i assegurar la protecció dels drets tant dels ocupadors com dels treballadors domèstics.

article_content: After the abrupt departure of Russian-American coach Galina Bukharina from the Athletics Federation of India last winter, India’s 400-metre runners found themselves in a state of uncertainty. Bukharina, who joined the Indian team at the age of 72, spent five years fostering strong relationships with her athletes. Although relay team performance dipped toward the end of her tenure, she remained a respected figure among the runners. It was understandable, then, that the quarter-milers were initially hesitant to accept Jamaican coach Jason Dawson, who took over the 400m camp earlier this year. Despite early resistance, Dawson gradually gained the athletes' trust and played a pivotal role in guiding the men’s 4x400m relay team to new heights. Under his leadership, the team broke the three-minute barrier for the first time, finishing second in their heats at the World Championships in Budapest. They followed up by recording another sub-three-minute time (2:59.92) in the final, finishing fifth. The relay team further cemented their strong season with a gold medal at the Asian Games. Dawson recalls, “When I arrived, I realized my task was challenging. There was a lot of resistance, which was actually the hardest part. I knew many of my methods were new to the athletes.” Some athletes felt his regime was too intense, with one squad member saying, “A lot of us suffered injuries due to the heavy lifting and intense training.” Nevertheless, Dawson remained committed to his philosophy: pushing hard is the path to achievement. “They were always concerned about injuries. I used to tell them, if you want to avoid injuries, you should retire. There's always a risk, even warming up. Their biggest fear was trying something new, and it affected them mentally,” he explained. Building trust took time, with Rajesh Ramesh—famed for his anchor leg at the World Championships heats—being the first to embrace Dawson’s methods. Dawson credits collaboration with senior relay coach Premanand for helping to foster this change. As Ramesh improved, the others soon followed. Dawson notes, however, that progress is still ongoing. Dawson also highlighted the need to raise expectations, stating that Indian athletes often set cautious goals. “Setting modest targets isn’t enough. Sometimes there's a little fear before competing, which can be problematic. They were afraid of being challenged,” he observed. Dawson aimed to guide each athlete individually before uniting them as a team. This approach appeared effective: Ramesh’s performance at the Worlds, where he directly challenged an American rival, reflected the team’s newfound belief. Dawson recounts telling Ramesh, “No matter what happens, just keep going. When you leave the track, the nation of India must be smiling.” Looking ahead, Dawson believes this is only the beginning. He wants the team to become a respected force on the global stage and has already outlined a plan for their next objectives. For now, though, the team will take a brief break before working toward loftier goals.
translated_content: Després de la marxa sobtada de l'entrenadora russoamericana Galina Bukharina de la Federació d'Atletisme de l'Índia l'hivern passat, els corredors indis de 400 metres es van trobar en situació d'incertesa. Bukharina, que es va unir a l'equip indi als 72 anys, va passar cinc anys creant vincles forts amb els seus atletes. Tot i que el rendiment de l'equip de relleus va disminuir cap al final de la seva etapa, va continuar sent una figura respectada entre els corredors. Era comprensible, per tant, que els quarter-milers fossin inicialment reticents a acceptar l'entrenador jamaicà Jason Dawson, que va assumir el control del camp de 400m a principis d'enguany. Tot i la resistència inicial, Dawson va guanyar gradualment la confiança dels atletes i va tenir un paper clau a l'hora de portar l'equip masculí de relleus 4x400m a nous nivells. Sota la seva direcció, l'equip va trencar per primer cop la barrera dels tres minuts, quedant segons a les seves sèries als Campionats del Món de Budapest. Van repetir una altra marca inferior als tres minuts (2:59.92) a la final, obtenint la cinquena posició. L'equip de relleus va consolidar encara més la seva bona temporada amb una medalla d'or als Jocs Asiàtics. Dawson recorda: “Quan vaig arribar vaig adonar-me que la meva tasca seria difícil. Hi havia molta resistència, i de fet això va ser el més complicat. Sabia que molts dels meus mètodes eren nous per als atletes.” Alguns atletes van sentir que el seu règim era massa intens, amb un membre de l'equip comentant: “Molts vam patir lesions a causa de les càrregues i l'entrenament intens.” Tot i això, Dawson es va mantenir fidel a la seva filosofia: cal apretar fort per assolir els objectius. “Sempre estaven preocupats per les lesions. Els deia que si volen evitar lesions, haurien de retirar-se, perquè sempre hi ha un risc, fins i tot escalfant. La seva por més gran era afrontar coses noves, i això els afectava mentalment”, va explicar. Construir la confiança va requerir temps, amb Rajesh Ramesh — conegut pel seu relleu final als Campionats del Món — sent el primer a acceptar els mètodes de Dawson. Dawson reconeix la col·laboració amb el veterà entrenador de relleus Premanand per ajudar en aquest canvi. A mesura que Ramesh va millorar, la resta el va seguir. Tot i així, Dawson apunta que encara hi ha camí per recórrer. Dawson també va destacar la necessitat d’augmentar les expectatives, afirmant que els atletes indis sovint es conformen amb objectius prudents. “Fixar fites modestes no és suficient. Hi ha una mica de por abans de competir, i això pot ser problemàtic. Tenien por que altres atletes els reptessin”, va observar. Dawson va voler guiar cada atleta individualment abans d’unir-los com a equip. Aquest mètode sembla haver funcionat: l’actuació de Ramesh als Mundials, on va desafiar directament un rival americà, va reflectir la nova confiança de l’equip. Dawson recorda que va dir a Ramesh: “No importa què passi, segueix endavant. Quan surtis de la pista, la nació índia ha d’estar somrient.” De cara al futur, Dawson creu que això només és el començament. Vol que l’equip sigui reconegut com una força respectable a escala mundial i ja ha traçat un pla per als propers objectius. Ara per ara, però, l’equip prendrà una petita pausa abans de lluitar per metes més grans.
