A yellow and black-striped jumpsuit famously worn by Bruce Lee in 'Game of Death' sold at auction in Hong Kong for HK$780,000 (about $100,500). The auction, which included 14 personal items from the martial arts legend, exceeded expectations by earning more than HK$2 million ($258,000)—double initial estimates.

The jumpsuit, one of only two used during filming, was bought by an anonymous online bidder who purchased six pieces in total. Its lasting impact on pop culture is seen in works like Quentin Tarantino's 'Kill Bill' and several 'Grand Theft Auto' video games.

Other highlights: nunchaku used by Lee in a key fight scene were sold to British investor George Philips for HK$540,000 ($69,000), and a bamboo whip from the movie went for HK$96,000 ($12,000).

Anna Lee, Spink's vice-chairperson, noted this was the first auction of these items in Hong Kong. The pieces, offered by an unnamed U.S. film industry collector, all came with certificates of authenticity from Lee's friends and family. Many had been gifts to his student Taky Kimura or friend George Lee, who created many of Lee's fight props. Lee also designed a jade pendant, featuring gold dragons, sold for HK$156,000 ($20,000); his brother Robert retrieved and kept it after Bruce Lee's death.

Additional items included Lee's kung fu shoes, a signed karate training book, a commemorative brochure, and two hand-drawn artworks. The artworks—one a sketch of a monk for an unrealized film project, the other expressing Lee's philosophy of flexibility—sold for HK$66,000 ($8,500) and HK$78,000 ($10,000).

Globally recognized as a martial arts icon and accomplished artist, Bruce Lee was born in San Francisco in 1940, but he spent his youth in Hong Kong. He died unexpectedly in July 1973 from an allergic reaction to medication during the production of 'Game of Death.' The movie saw a posthumous release in 1978. This auction was part of commemorations marking the 40th anniversary of his passing.

William Davis, a 92-year-old decorated war veteran, was found dead in his home in Willenhall, West Midlands. Charlotte Doody, 35, a neighbor who often delivered meals to Davis, was arrested on suspicion of his murder and was being questioned by police. Davis, known as Bill, was widely respected in the community for his independence and his service in the Royal Navy during World War II.

Davis was last seen alive around 3pm on Sunday, April 1, 2012, when a neighbor brought him lunch. Sometime in the following three hours, he suffered fatal head injuries from a blunt instrument. Paramedics were called to his home that evening, but Davis was pronounced dead at the scene. Police confirmed there were no signs of forced entry or theft.

Neighbors described Davis as a friendly, active man, well known for his stories and pride in his wartime service. His house remains sealed off as forensic teams continue their investigation. Detective Superintendent Richard Baker appealed for anyone in the area of Fisher Street and Hobley Street on Sunday, or anyone who knows someone with unexplained blood-stained clothing, to come forward.

Davis, who lost his wife Clara in 2006, was a father, grandfather, and great-grandfather. The community has expressed deep shock and sadness at his death.

Charlotte Doody, de 35 anys, una veïna que sovint li portava menjar, va ser detinguda sota sospita del seu assassinat i està sent interrogada per la policia. Davis, conegut com a Bill, era molt respectat per la comunitat per la seva independència i pel seu servei a la Royal Navy durant la Segona Guerra Mundial.

Davis va ser vist per última vegada viu al voltant de les 3 de la tarda de diumenge, 1 d’abril de 2012, quan un veí li va portar el dinar. En les tres hores següents va patir lesions mortals al cap per un objecte contundent. Els serveis mèdics van ser avisats aquella tarda, però Davis va ser declarat mort al lloc dels fets. La policia va confirmar que no hi havia indicis d'entrada forçada ni de robatori.

Els veïns el descriuen com un home amable i actiu, molt conegut per les seves històries i per l’orgull que sentia del seu passat militar. La seva casa segueix precintada mentre els equips forenses continuen la investigació. El superintendent detectiu Richard Baker ha fet una crida perquè qualsevol persona que es trobés a la zona de Fisher Street i Hobley Street diumenge, o que conegui algú amb roba tacada de sang sense explicació, es posi en contacte amb la policia.

Davis, que va perdre la seva esposa Clara el 2006, era pare, avi i besavi. La comunitat està profundament commocionada i trista per la seva mort.

article_content: Thierry Henry, the renowned former Arsenal and French international footballer, has received approval from local planners to demolish his £6 million mansion in Hampstead, north London, and rebuild it with a striking new design featuring a three-storey, 5,500-gallon fish tank. The ambitious project faced significant opposition from neighbours, notably actor Tom Conti, who led objections due to concerns about noise, prolonged disruption, and the new design not fitting the character of the area. Despite the pushback, Henry’s plans were approved by Camden Council with a 9-2 vote after a meeting lasting more than three hours. Henry, who currently plays for the New York Red Bulls and is Arsenal’s all-time top scorer, did not attend the proceedings. The approved design includes a £250,000 aquarium, a swimming pool, and a gym. According to documents submitted by Henry’s agents, Montagu Evans, the existing home, built in 1999, is considered dated and poorly optimized for family living. Tom Conti and several other locals argued that the demolition would cause severe disruption for residents, many of whom are retired or work from home. Conti suggested that if Henry wanted a larger home, he should buy one elsewhere. The house’s original architect, Sir Richard MacCormac, and the Heath and Hampstead Society, a local civic group, also opposed the development. MacCormac insisted the property remained in good condition, attributing issues to poor maintenance rather than design. Henry is among several celebrities who have installed extravagant aquariums in their homes, joining the likes of Madonna, the Beckhams, Cher, and footballers such as Stephen Ireland, Joe Hart, and Micah Richards. Henry bought the Hampstead property in 2001 when married to model Claire Merry. The couple divorced in 2007, but Henry is keen to keep a London base to remain close to their daughter, Tea. The redevelopment is expected to take about six months to complete.

article_content: The Tuscan island of Elba marked the bicentennial of Napoleon Bonaparte’s 1814 arrival by hosting lively celebrations that attracted both enthusiasts and residents. Reenactments showed the French emperor’s historic landing, with participants in vintage dress and ceremonial cannon salutes. Despite Napoleon’s own eagerness to leave Elba, he governed the island for close to 300 days after being exiled from France. Locals still hold Napoleon in high regard for his contributions to island life, commemorating him with a Mass at the Church of Mercy every May 5. The 200th anniversary saw even grander events, including an exhibition of Napoleon’s military campaign tent, the Napoleon’s Regatta yacht race landing in Portoferraio on June 13, and walking tours of sites linked to his legacy. A favorite spot for Roman tourists, Elba is home to museums in Napoleon’s former residences—Villa dei Mulini and Villa Napoleonica di San Martino. For those interested in history, the Albergo Ape Elbana hotel in Portoferraio offers a unique connection, having once hosted guests of Napoleon himself.

S’hi van fer recreacions de l’històric desembarcament de l’emperador francès, amb participants vestits d’època i salves de canó. Tot i que Napoleó tenia moltes ganes d’abandonar Elba, va governar l’illa durant gairebé 300 dies després de ser exiliat de França. Els habitants de l’illa encara tenen en gran consideració Napoleó pels canvis que va aportar, i el commemoren cada 5 de maig amb una missa a l’Església de la Misericòrdia. El 200è aniversari va incloure celebracions encara més destacades, com una exposició de la tenda de campanya militar de Napoleó, la regata de iots “Regata de Napoleó” que arriba a Portoferraio el 13 de juny, i visites guiades als llocs més emblemàtics del seu llegat. Destinació preferida dels romans, Elba acull museus a les antigues residències de Napoleó — la Villa dei Mulini i la Villa Napoleonica di San Martino. Per als amants de la història, l’hotel Albergo Ape Elbana de Portoferraio també destaca per la seva relació amb el passat, ja que va allotjar alguns convidats de Napoleó.

article_content: A memorial service was held in Washington, D.C., for Richard Holbrooke, the renowned U.S. diplomat who died last month following surgery to repair an aortic tear. The service at the Kennedy Center was attended by President Barack Obama, Vice President Joe Biden, former President Bill Clinton, Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, former Secretaries of State Colin Powell and Madeleine Albright, Pakistani President Asif Zardari, FBI Director Robert Mueller, and Joint Chiefs Chairman Admiral Mike Mullen, among others. President Obama commended Holbrooke as a leading figure among American diplomats since the Vietnam era, noting his career reflected major milestones in U.S. foreign policy and combined ideals with pragmatism. Obama announced an annual Richard C. Holbrooke Award for Diplomacy to honor outstanding contributions to the field. Pakistani President Zardari described Holbrooke as a dedicated and effective diplomat in a past CNN interview. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton praised Holbrooke as one of America's most accomplished diplomats, highlighting his integrity and resolve in advancing U.S. interests. Holbrooke, 69, died on December 13. He most recently served as special representative for Afghanistan and Pakistan under the Obama administration. He was widely recognized as the principal architect of the Dayton Peace Accords, signed December 14, 1995, ending the conflict in the former Yugoslavia. Holbrooke’s career spanned five decades and included work in Vietnam, the Balkans, and efforts against the Taliban and Al Qaeda in Afghanistan and Pakistan. He also worked as a journalist and investment banker but was best known for his frank and determined diplomatic approach. Madeleine Albright remembered working alongside Holbrooke during numerous international crises, especially in Bosnia and Kosovo, highlighting his creativity, commitment, and tenacity. Appointed in 2008 by President Obama as special representative for Afghanistan and Pakistan, Holbrooke tackled one of the most challenging diplomatic roles in the fight against terrorism. While his assertive style proved effective in the Balkans, it sometimes conflicted with the more measured diplomatic customs of Afghanistan and Pakistan, leading to perceptions of abrasiveness among some officials, including Afghan President Hamid Karzai. Nevertheless, Karzai’s office acknowledged Holbrooke’s significant contributions to the U.S. government and its people. Holbrooke spoke candidly about the difficulties of negotiating peace in the region, emphasizing the diversity and number of militant groups involved. He pointed out the lack of a single negotiating authority, noting adversaries like the Afghan Taliban, Pakistani Taliban, Haqqani network, Lashkar-e-Tayyiba, and Al Qaeda, which made diplomatic progress particularly complex.

Tot i així, l'oficina de Karzai va reconèixer les importants contribucions de Holbrooke al govern i al poble nord-americà. Holbrooke va parlar obertament de les dificultats per aconseguir la pau a la regió, destacant la diversitat i el nombre de grups militants implicats. Va assenyalar la manca d'una autoritat única amb qui negociar, citant adversaris com els talibans afganesos, talibans del Pakistan, la xarxa Haqqani, Lashkar-e-Tayyiba i Al Qaeda, cosa que feia especialment complex avançar diplomàticament.

article_content: Hassan Rouhani, a centrist, has been elected president of Iran after running a campaign promoting ‘hope and prudence’. He drew support from both conservatives and reformists, promising reforms while showing respect for the country’s leadership and institutions. Rouhani, once the national security council chief and an experienced nuclear negotiator, pledged to expand personal freedoms, strengthen Iran’s economy, and improve relations with foreign nations by addressing nuclear-related sanctions. He also hinted at the release of political and media prisoners. Iranians of all ages celebrated his victory, gathering in the streets, honking horns, and displaying the sign of victory. In a message through Fars News Agency, Rouhani, 65, thanked the nation, calling the result a win for moderation, wisdom, and unity, and crediting supporters across the political spectrum. World leaders responded quickly. The UK’s Foreign Office called on Rouhani to guide Iran toward openness, international cooperation, and better human rights. The U.S. government hoped Iran’s rulers would honor voters’ wishes and indicated a willingness for diplomacy on nuclear issues, while highlighting election restrictions on speech and assembly. UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon congratulated Rouhani, urging Iran to engage constructively in regional and global affairs. Meanwhile, leaders of Syria’s opposition called on Rouhani to reconsider Iran’s support for the Assad government and to sympathize with Syrians seeking freedom. The election saw nearly 73% voter turnout, with Interior Minister Mostafa Mohammad-Najjar stating over 36 million ballots were cast. Rouhani received 50.7% of the votes, with main challengers Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf and Saeed Jalili trailing behind. Despite his new role, Rouhani does not hold the ultimate authority in Iran. True power resides with Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, bolstered by conservatives and the security apparatus. Rouhani’s background includes service as a cleric, air defense commander, and law scholar, with degrees from Iran and Scotland. Rouhani is considered skilled at forging consensus, maintaining links to both conservatives and reformers. He has also criticized state censorship and clashed with the supreme leader over dealings with the world. The Guardian Council, a 12-member unelected body under the supreme leader, limited the presidential race to six men, barring notable candidates like Ahmadinejad’s ally Mashaei and all women applicants. Rouhani’s campaign drew attention after he denounced censorship on national TV, and he gained support from former President Rafsanjani and parts of the reform movement. He pointed out voting irregularities, noting that ballots still included a withdrawn candidate, Mohammed Aref. Events from the disputed 2009 election still resonate: Massive protests followed claims of fraud, and the state’s severe response led to arrests and house arrests, notably of opposition figure Mir Hossein Moussavi since 2011.

article_content: House Speaker Mike Johnson met with Senate Republicans on Wednesday to discuss his proposed Israel-only aid package, seeking their support for advancing the measure. Johnson expressed his intention to also provide aid to Ukraine, but emphasized that the Israel assistance package would have to move forward first, and as a separate bill. During the hour-long closed-door meeting, Johnson highlighted his new willingness to help Ukraine, even though he has previously voted against such aid. He is pushing for a House vote on Thursday for a bill offering more than $14 billion in aid to Israel. This proposal does not include $61 billion in Ukraine aid, which President Joe Biden, House and Senate Democrats, and many Senate Republicans want to be part of the same legislative package. Sen. Mike Rounds (R-S.D.) commented, 'He made it very clear that he understands how critical Ukraine aid is.' However, Johnson indicated that passing Ukraine aid would require significant concessions from the Biden administration, Senate Democrats, and Senate Republicans, including Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, who have favored pairing Ukraine aid with funding for Israel, Taiwan, and border initiatives. According to several attendees, Johnson told the senators that Israel aid would have to be addressed separately first, explaining he could not secure enough support in the House to combine them. Sen. Josh Hawley (R-Mo.) added, 'He wants to do Israel first. Then he said their next order of business would be Ukraine and the border.' Aid for Israel generally enjoys broad support in both congressional chambers and is likely to pass. However, the House bill offsets the cost of Israel aid by reducing IRS funding from the Inflation Reduction Act—a move Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer criticized as a 'partisan and woefully inadequate package' with 'poison pills' that benefit tax evaders. Before Johnson’s meeting with Senate Republicans, McConnell emphasized on the Senate floor the importance of continued U.S. support for Ukraine, warning that disengagement from global leadership would be costly. After Wednesday's meeting, senators were unsure whether Johnson was willing to remove the IRS provision to pass a clean Israel aid package. Nonetheless, Johnson was firm that Israel aid must be approved before the House considers Ukraine assistance. Johnson outlined plans for the House to pursue a separate bill combining Ukraine funding and border security only after finalizing the Israel package. Sen. John Cornyn (R-Texas), who is involved in crafting border policy changes, said Johnson sees Ukraine and border issues as closely linked. 'It's pretty clear to me that he doesn't intend to leave Ukraine behind... but there's also going to be a price to be paid on the border,' Cornyn noted, referring to policy changes sought by Republicans. Sen. J.D. Vance (R-Ohio) highlighted the centrality of a border deal for progress on Ukraine aid, indicating that House conservatives view such funding as conditional on border measures. Johnson also presented 12 questions posed to the White House about the intended outcome in Ukraine. Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.), a proponent of Ukraine aid, called Johnson's performance 'a home run' and felt optimistic about the path forward. Johnson further informed senators that a stopgap funding bill would likely be necessary to prevent a government shutdown after November 17. Sen. Markwayne Mullin (R-Okla.) noted the proposed short-term funding measure may not be acceptable to all senators, but would serve as a starting point for negotiations. Johnson said this measure would likely postpone the funding deadline into the next year to allow further debate on budget appropriations. Reporting contributed by ABC News' Mariam Khan.
translated_content: El president de la Cambra, Mike Johnson, es va reunir dimecres amb els republicans del Senat per parlar de la seva proposta d’ajuda només per a Israel, buscant el seu suport per tirar endavant la mesura. Johnson també va expressar la seva intenció d'oferir ajuda a Ucraïna, però va subratllar que, primer, el paquet d’ajuda per a Israel hauria de tramitar-se de forma prioritària i per separat. En la trobada a porta tancada d’una hora, Johnson va mostrar una nova predisposició a ajudar Ucraïna, tot i haver votat anteriorment en contra. Està impulsant una votació dijous a la Cambra per un projecte de llei que preveu més de 14.000 milions de dòlars d’ajuda per a Israel. Aquesta proposta no inclou els 61.000 milions per a Ucraïna, que tant el president Joe Biden, com els demòcrates de la Cambra i el Senat, i molts republicans del Senat, volen afegir al mateix paquet legislatiu. El senador Mike Rounds (R-S.D.) va comentar: «Va deixar molt clar que entén la importància de l’ajuda a Ucraïna». Tot i així, Johnson va indicar que aprovar l’ajuda a Ucraïna exigiria concessions importants de part del govern Biden, demòcrates del Senat i també republicans, incloent el líder de la minoria Mitch McConnell, que han preferit vincular l’ajuda a Ucraïna amb finançament per Israel, Taiwan i la frontera. Segons diversos assistents, Johnson va explicar als senadors que l’ajuda per a Israel aniria per separat primerament, perquè la seva majoria a la Cambra no donarà suport a un paquet combinat. El senador Josh Hawley (R-Mo.) va afegir: «Vol prioritzar Israel. I després va dir que tocarien Ucraïna i la frontera». L’ajuda per a Israel té un fort suport a les dues cambres i gairebé segur que s’aprova. Però la proposta de la Cambra inclou retallades a l'IRS dins la Llei de Reducció de la Inflació per compensar el cost, una mesura que el líder de la majoria del Senat, Chuck Schumer, ha qualificat de 'paquet partidista i molt insuficient' amb 'píndoles verinoses' que afavoreixen als evasors fiscals. Abans de la trobada amb els republicans al Senat, McConnell havia insistit a la cambra alta en la importància de mantenir el suport dels EUA a Ucraïna, advertint del cost que té desentendre's del lideratge global. Després de la reunió de dimecres, els senadors no tenien clar si Johnson estaria disposat a eliminar la mesura sobre l’IRS per intentar passar una llei d’ajuda neta a Israel. Però Johnson va ser clar que cal assegurar el finançament per a Israel abans de considerar l’ajuda per a Ucraïna. Johnson va exposar que la Cambra podria tramitar després un projecte diferent ajuntant l’ajuda per a Ucraïna i la seguretat fronterera només després d’haver aprovat el paquet per a Israel. El senador John Cornyn (R-Texas), implicat en negociacions sobre política fronterera, va dir que Johnson considera la frontera i la qüestió d’Ucraïna estretament vinculades. «Em sembla evident que no vol abandonar Ucraïna... però també hi haurà un preu a pagar sobre la frontera», va remarcar Cornyn referint-se als canvis de política reclamats pels republicans. El senador J.D. Vance (R-Ohio) va destacar que un acord de frontera és clau perquè avanci l’ajuda a Ucraïna, apuntant que els conservadors de la Cambra volen condicionar aquest finançament a reformes en matèria fronterera. Johnson també va presentar als senadors 12 preguntes que ha plantejat a la Casa Blanca sobre els objectius finals a Ucraïna. El senador Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.), defensor de l’ajuda, va considerar brillant l’exposició de Johnson i va dir que veu clar el camí a seguir. Johnson va avançar igualment als senadors que probablement caldrà una llei de finançament provisional per evitar un tancament del govern després del 17 de novembre. El senador Markwayne Mullin (R-Okla.) va advertir que la proposta temporal no agradarà a tots, però servirà de punt de partida per negociar. Johnson va dir que permetria retardar la data límit fins a l’any que ve per poder debatre els pressupostos més detingudament. Informació aportada per Mariam Khan d’ABC News.

article_content: Before his arrest on fraud and money laundering charges last year, Sam Bankman-Fried was recognized for his casual appearance. Despite being a billionaire on paper, he often wore a dirty T-shirt and cargo shorts, even when speaking at conferences alongside figures like Bill Clinton and Tony Blair. Many magazine profiles noted his habit of sleeping in a beanbag while working at FTX, his now-defunct cryptocurrency exchange. However, former FTX executive Nishad Singh testified during Bankman-Fried's criminal trial that, behind the scenes, Bankman-Fried spent lavishly and aimed to move in elite social circles. Singh described frequently questioning Bankman-Fried's spending and investments, but said his concerns were usually dismissed. 'I would hear that my opinions were already factored in, and I didn't need to continue sharing them,' Singh testified. On one occasion, Singh said Bankman-Fried told him to stop sharing his views in front of other FTX employees, an experience Singh called 'pretty humiliating.' Singh testified that until September 2022, he was unaware Bankman-Fried was using FTX customer funds for extravagant purchases. Bankman-Fried is facing seven criminal charges, including wire fraud, securities fraud, and money laundering. He has pleaded not guilty, while several former FTX and Alameda executives, including Singh, Caroline Ellison, and Gary Wang, have pleaded guilty and are cooperating with prosecutors. Singh pleaded guilty in February to six criminal charges, including wire fraud and conspiracy. The US Securities and Exchange Commission additionally filed a civil complaint accusing Singh of misusing about $6 million from FTX for personal expenses, including buying a multi-million dollar home. Singh’s attorneys have stated he is 'deeply sorry' for his actions and has accepted responsibility. Singh said he met Bankman-Fried through a friendship with Bankman-Fried's younger brother, Gabe. After graduating from the University of California, Berkeley with degrees in electrical engineering and computer science, Singh worked at Facebook before joining Alameda as a software engineer in 2017. He moved to FTX in mid-2019, eventually becoming Head of Engineering. As Singh gained seniority, his financial stake in FTX grew, receiving equity instead of bonuses from 2020 onwards, which made him, at one point, an on-paper billionaire. By 2021, Singh was living in a penthouse in the Bahamas with Bankman-Fried, his girlfriend, and other executives. He described his relationship with Bankman-Fried as complicated: 'I've always been intimidated by Sam. Sam's a formidable character. Brilliant. And so I had a lot of respect for him. Over time, that eroded, and I became distrustful.' Singh testified they often disagreed over money. In September 2022, Singh claimed he discovered an $8 billion deficit in FTX's finances, which he attributed to spending on real estate, venture capital, speculative investments, and campaign donations. Bankman-Fried allegedly directed over $1 billion in spending on Genesis (a crypto mining company in Kazakhstan), as well as investments of $200 million in Sequoia Capital, $500 million in the AI company Anthropic, and $50 million in NFT company Yuga Labs. FTX also spent $1.3 billion on sponsorships, including more than $150 million for Miami Heat’s arena, $150 million for Major League Baseball, $100 million for League of Legends promotions, and $45 million sponsoring the Tomorrowland festival. Bankman-Fried signed endorsement deals worth tens of millions of dollars with celebrities such as Tom Brady, Gisele Bündchen, Steph Curry, Kevin O'Leary, and Larry David, despite Singh’s objections to celebrity partnerships. The tension increased when Bankman-Fried invested $200 million in K5 Global after a post-Super Bowl dinner hosted by Michael Kives. Notable guests included Hillary Clinton, Katy Perry, Orlando Bloom, Ted Sarandos (Netflix’s CEO), Jeff Bezos, Kate Hudson, Leonardo DiCaprio, Corey Gamble, Kris Jenner, and Kendall Jenner. Singh said he didn't recognize some names and found the investment 'value extractive' and 'toxic' to FTX’s culture. Despite his protests, Bankman-Fried told Singh, 'it's basically done,' meaning the decision would not change. Singh testified that FTX customer money was used for this investment. Singh and Bankman-Fried also disagreed about administrative expenses, including the purchase of a $35 million Albany penthouse in the Bahamas. Singh recalled opposing the purchase due to its high cost and ostentatiousness, but Bankman-Fried prevailed. Singh said Bankman-Fried usually got his way on major company decisions.
translated_content: Abans de ser detingut l'any passat per càrrecs de frau i blanqueig de capitals, Sam Bankman-Fried era conegut pel seu aspecte informal. Tot i ser multimilionari sobre el paper, sovint portava una samarreta bruta i pantalons curts fins i tot en conferències amb figures com Bill Clinton i Tony Blair. Molts perfils de revista destacaven el seu costum de dormir en un puf mentre treballava a FTX, la seva plataforma de criptomonedes avui desapareguda. Tanmateix, l'executiu de FTX Nishad Singh va declarar durant el judici penal que, en privat, Bankman-Fried gastava de manera desmesurada i volia accedir a cercles socials d'elit. Singh va descriure com sovint qüestionava les despeses i inversions de Bankman-Fried, però normalment ignoraven les seves preocupacions. "Em deien que la meva opinió ja s'havia tingut en compte i no calia seguir compartint-la", va declarar Singh. En una ocasió, Singh va afirmar que Bankman-Fried li va demanar deixar d'expressar el seu punt de vista davant d'altres treballadors d'FTX, una experiència que Singh va trobar humiliant. Singh va dir que fins al setembre de 2022 desconeixia que Bankman-Fried utilitzava fons de clients de FTX per a compres extravagants. Bankman-Fried afronta set càrrecs criminals, incloent-hi frau electrònic, frau de valors i blanqueig de capitals. Ell s'ha declarat innocent, mentre que diversos exexecutius de FTX i Alameda, incloent Singh, Caroline Ellison i Gary Wang, s'han declarat culpables i col·laboren amb la fiscalia. Singh es va declarar culpable al febrer de sis càrrecs criminals, incloent-hi frau electrònic i conspiració. La Comissió de Valors i Borsa dels EUA també va presentar una denúncia civil acusant Singh d'haver gastat prop de 6 milions de dòlars de FTX per a despeses personals, inclosa la compra d'una casa milionària. Els seus advocats diuen que està 'profundament penedit' i ha acceptat la responsabilitat. Singh va conèixer Bankman-Fried a través del seu germà petit, Gabe. Després de llicenciar-se a la Universitat de Califòrnia, Berkeley en enginyeria elèctrica i informàtica, Singh va treballar a Facebook abans d'entrar a Alameda com a enginyer de programari el 2017. Va passar a FTX el 2019 i més endavant en va ser cap d'enginyeria. A mesura que pujava de categoria, la seva participació a FTX anava creixent, passant a rebre accions en comptes de primes a partir de 2020, convertint-lo temporalment en multimilionari sobre el paper. El 2021, Singh vivia en un àtic a les Bahames amb Bankman-Fried, la seva parella i altres executius. Va qualificar la seva relació amb Bankman-Fried de complicada: "Sempre m'ha intimidat en Sam. És un personatge formidable i brillant, li tenia molt respecte. Amb el temps, però, va desaparèixer i vaig començar a desconfiar." Singh va testificar que sovint discrepaven sobre diners. Al setembre de 2022, Singh va afirmar que va descobrir un forat de 8.000 milions de dòlars a les finances d'FTX, que va atribuir a despeses en immobles, capital risc, inversions especulatives i donatius a campanyes. Suposadament, Bankman-Fried va dirigir més de 1.000 milions a Genesis (mineria de criptomonedes al Kazakhstan), 200 milions a Sequoia Capital, 500 milions a l'empresa d'IA Anthropic i 50 milions a Yuga Labs (NFT). Bankman-Fried va signar acords de patrocini per desenes de milions de dòlars amb celebritats com Tom Brady, Gisele Bündchen, Steph Curry, Kevin O'Leary i Larry David, tot i que Singh no hi estava d'acord. article_content: Dr. Vivek Bhandari is the CTO at Powerledger and a recognized leader in engineering, IT, and sustainability. Blockchain validation, particularly through proof-of-work (PoW) protocols, is often debated due to its electricity consumption, but it's important to consider the broader context. Contrary to common belief, blockchain validation (sometimes referred to as mining) can benefit the power grid and the environment if managed appropriately. This is similar to the integration of electric vehicles, air conditioners, or data centers into the grid: when handled properly, these technologies can benefit all stakeholders. This article addresses widespread misconceptions about blockchain validation.  Myth 1: Blockchain Validation Is Always Harmful to the Environment Due to High Energy Consumption Fact: While blockchain validation can be energy-intensive, it is not inherently harmful to the environment. The key is to utilize renewable energy sources, such as hydroelectric or solar power, which greatly reduce carbon emissions. For instance, the World Economic Forum cites Digital Power Optimization in New York, which runs 400 mining computers with surplus electricity from a hydroelectric dam in Hatfield, Wisconsin. The misunderstanding is that all blockchain validation is environmentally damaging, but focusing on clean energy can mitigate its impact. Many validators situate operations near renewable sources like hydro, wind, or nuclear plants, thus lowering their carbon footprint.  Myth 2: Blockchain Validation Unnecessarily Strains the Grid Fact: Most validators operate around the clock, providing a steady and predictable demand for electricity. This can help the grid by absorbing surplus electricity during low-demand periods, reducing waste and the need for further grid expansion. According to CNBC, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) has 'demand response' programs that pay miners to reduce consumption during peak demand, such as hot weather when air conditioning use spikes. Rather than destabilizing the grid, blockchain validation can support its reliability.  Myth 3: Blockchain Validation Is Always Wasteful Fact: Validation is essential for securing blockchain networks and facilitating transactions, which enables adoption across sectors like supply chain management and healthcare, not just finance. For example, Gridless partners with energy producers to establish validation operations near rural communities, utilizing excess electricity that would otherwise be wasted.  Myth 4: Blockchain Validation Is Incompatible with Environmental Sustainability Fact: The blockchain industry has encouraged renewable energy innovation, including solutions such as co-location with renewables and demand response programs. As reported by the Cambridge Center for Alternative Finance, 29% of surveyed validators used renewable energy in 2020, a figure that continues to grow. This trend is propelled by a desire to lower operational costs and meet global sustainability goals.  Myth 5: Blockchain Validation Is a Major Contributor to Carbon Emissions Fact: The White House estimates that selected blockchain activities in the U.S. cause 25–50 million metric tons of CO2 emissions annually (0.4%–0.8% of total U.S. greenhouse gas emissions). Although some operations still depend on fossil fuels, the blockchain sector is transitioning to cleaner energy, incentivized by environmental responsibility and cost reductions.  The Takeaway Like any sector, the environmental impact of blockchain validation depends on its practices. When powered by renewable energy and operated sustainably, blockchain validation can support grid stability and the adoption of cleaner technologies. By dispelling myths and encouraging responsible practices, blockchain can move toward a more sustainable future. article_content: This dramatic moment in Kwando Concession Park, Botswana, shows why the honey badger is considered one of Africa's toughest animals. Caught in the open by a pride of young lions, a 20-pound honey badger found itself surrounded. Rather than fleeing, it boldly faced at least four lions, each much larger than itself. The honey badger’s thick skin and fierce attitude proved challenging for the lions, who could not deliver a fatal bite despite their efforts. Remarkably, the honey badger held off the predators for over 30 minutes. Wildlife photographer James Haskins witnessed the event, saying, 'Such a scene is rare to witness. The young lions tried hard to hunt the honey badger, likely for the first time, but they couldn’t figure out how to kill it.' The honey badger withstood biting, clawing, and chewing, continually growling and fighting back. Even when one lion managed to clamp down on the badger, its tough hide prevented any serious harm. Haskins reported leaving the scene with the lions still uncertain about how to overpower the resilient animal. Honey badgers, found throughout Africa and India, are known for their intelligence and fearless attitude, often facing off against much bigger animals like lions, hyenas, and rhinos. As members of the mustelid family, they share traits with both badgers and weasels. In African culture, the honey badger’s reputation for toughness is so strong that a South African military vehicle is named after it. One famous honey badger, Stoffel, gained fame in the BBC2 documentary 'Honey Badgers: Masters of Mayhem' for repeatedly escaping his enclosure and even breaking into his owner's house.

article_content: A new United Nations report finds that global greenhouse gas emissions grew by about 1% between 2021 and 2022. This rise follows the hottest year on record and highlights that emissions of planet-warming gases are still increasing. The annual report from the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) shows that the world is significantly behind in reducing pollution, the majority of which results from burning oil, gas, and coal. This warning is issued just ahead of the upcoming UN climate summit in Dubai. Scientists say emissions need to decrease rapidly to prevent catastrophic climate impacts, including extreme sea level rise, dangerous heatwaves, and mass extinctions. According to the analysis, even if all current promises under the Paris Agreement are fulfilled, the planet could still warm by at least 4.5°F (2.5°C) this century, compared to pre-industrial levels. If promised climate finance—like support for renewable energy in less wealthy countries—is not delivered, warming could surpass 5°F (2.8°C). The projected warming is marginally less than last year’s estimate, indicating limited progress in reducing emissions. While the world has made some advances since the 2015 Paris Agreement—when 8°F (4.4°C) of warming was forecast—progress has been far too slow. The Paris Agreement aims to limit warming to well below 3.6°F (2°C), ideally closer to 2.7°F (1.5°C), but countries would need to reduce emissions at least 28% more than current trajectories to achieve these targets. The lower target now appears completely out of reach, a conclusion supported by another recent study that points to slow progress on phasing out fossil fuels. The analysis emphasizes that stopping new oil, gas, and coal extraction is essential to avoid catastrophic warming. It finds that if all currently planned fossil fuel extraction proceeds, countries would collectively emit enough greenhouse gases to hit or exceed the higher Paris Agreement temperature threshold. Yet, many countries—including the United States—continue to approve new fossil fuel projects.

L’informe anual del Programa de les Nacions Unides per al Medi Ambient (PNUMA) demostra que el món està molt endarrerit en la reducció de la contaminació, la major part de la qual prové de la combustió de petroli, gas i carbó. Aquest avís es publica poc abans de la propera cimera climàtica de l’ONU a Dubai. Els científics adverteixen que cal reduir ràpidament les emissions per evitar impactes catastròfics com la pujada extrema del nivell del mar, onades de calor perilloses i extincions massives. Segons l’anàlisi, fins i tot si es compleixen totes les promeses actuals de l’Acord de París, el planeta podria escalfar-se almenys 2,5°C (4,5°F) aquest segle respecte als nivells preindustrials. Si no s’aporten els fons promesos per finançar l’energia renovable als països amb menys recursos, l’escalfament podria superar els 2,8°C (5°F). La previsió d’escalfament és lleugerament inferior a l’estimada l’any passat, i això evidencia els escassos avenços en la reducció d’emissions. Tot i que des de l’Acord de París de 2015 s’han fet alguns progressos —quan es preveia un escalfament de 4,4°C (8°F)—, el ritme continua sent massa lent. L’Acord de París pretén limitar l’escalfament a menys de 2°C (3,6°F), i idealment acostar-lo a 1,5°C (2,7°F), però caldria reduir almenys un 28% més les emissions respecte a les previsions actuals per assolir aquests objectius. L’objectiu inferior sembla ja inabastable, segons corrobora un altre estudi recent, que apunta a l’endarreriment en eliminar progressivament els combustibles fòssils. L’anàlisi subratlla que aturar l’extracció de nous jaciments de petroli, gas i carbó és clau per evitar un escalfament catastròfic. Es conclou que si s’exploten tots els projectes fòssils en marxa, els països emetrien prou gasos d’efecte hivernacle per arribar o superar el límit superior de temperatura de l’Acord de París. Tot i així, molts països, inclosos els Estats Units, encara autoritzen nous projectes de combustibles fòssils.

article_content: Contrary to popular belief, experts suggest that comfort—not discomfort or bad news—can undermine your career. Creating a bit of disruption and embracing discomfort can actually fuel professional growth. Consider your reaction to employees who challenge routines and disrupt the status quo: while you might expect discipline or even dismissal, these so-called 'troublemakers' often become catalysts for positive change. Those who speak out, question norms, and push against 'the way things have always been done' are often the ones who spark innovation and drive organizations forward. Jessica Elefante, in her book 'Raising Hell, Living Well,' notes, 'To break a mold, defy a norm, or restructure a structure, you need to ruffle a few feathers.' She highlights that influential figures in history were often seen as outliers before their ideas were recognized. By refusing to conform, these individuals have paved new paths, enabling progress for others. Growth, it turns out, only occurs when we step outside our comfort zone. Great leaders and companies are those willing to embrace change and the uncertainty that comes with it. Bill Eckstrom, CEO and founder of EcSell and author of 'The Coaching Effect,' shares a personal story about how being fired—a moment of intense discomfort—ultimately set him on a path to greater growth. Eckstrom describes 'Growth Rings,' a model outlining different environments: Stagnation (characterized by routine and excessive procedures), Chaos (marked by unpredictability and lack of control), Order (predictable and comfortable, but potentially stagnating), and Complexity (where outcomes are unpredictable and real growth happens). Although most people instinctively avoid discomfort, Eckstrom argues that confronting and embracing it leads to sustained or exponential development. The concept of 'good trouble,' as coined by the late John Lewis, captures the value of constructive disruption. Recent workplace changes—sparked notably by Gen Z and movements like the Great Resignation—illustrate how challenging old expectations can bring about meaningful shifts. Singer-songwriter MILCK, for instance, left a major record label to pursue her career on her own terms, motivated by a desire for self-expression and growth despite uncertainty. The experiences of individuals like Bill Eckstrom and MILCK demonstrate that stepping into discomfort and 'making good trouble' can be an essential part of personal and professional advancement.

Pensa en la teva reacció davant empleats que desafien les rutines i trenquen l’statu quo: podries esperar que els sancionin o fins i tot que els acomiadin. Però aquests anomenats 'creadors de problemes' sovint esdevenen motors de canvi positiu. Les persones que parlen, qüestionen les normes i desafien el 'sempre s'ha fet així' són, sovint, les que encenen la innovació i impulsen les organitzacions. Jessica Elefante, al seu llibre 'Raising Hell, Living Well,' destaca: 'Per trencar un motlle, desafiar una norma o reestructurar una estructura, cal incomodar a alguns.' Ella remarca que figures influents de la història sovint eren vistes com a inadaptats abans que es reconeguessin les seves idees. Refusar la conformitat ha obert noves vies i ha permès progressar als altres. El creixement, al cap i a la fi, només es produeix quan sortim de la nostra zona de confort. Els grans líders i empreses estan disposats a acceptar el canvi i la incertesa que l’acompanya. Bill Eckstrom, CEO i fundador d’EcSell i autor de 'The Coaching Effect,' comparteix una història personal sobre com el fet de ser acomiadat—un moment d’intensa incomoditat—el va portar, finalment, per un camí de més creixement. Eckstrom descriu els 'Anells de Creixement', un model que descriu diferents entorns: Estagnació (caracteritzada per rutines i excés de procediments), Caos (marcat per la imprevisibilitat i la manca de control), Ordre (previsible i còmode, però potencialment estancat) i Complexitat (on els resultats són impredictibles i es produeix el veritable creixement). Tot i que la majoria de persones eviten la incomoditat de manera instintiva, Eckstrom defensa que afrontar-la i abraçar-la porta a un desenvolupament sostingut o exponencial. El concepte de 'good trouble', encunyat pel difunt John Lewis, recull el valor de la disrupció constructiva. Els recents canvis a la feina—impulsats sobretot per la Generació Z i moviments com la Gran Renúncia—il·lustren com desafiar les expectatives antigues pot portar a canvis significatius. L’artista MILCK, per exemple, va deixar una discogràfica important per seguir la seva carrera en els seus propis termes, moguda pel desig d’expressar-se i créixer tot i la incertesa. Les experiències de persones com Bill Eckstrom i MILCK demostren que abraçar la incomoditat i fer 'good trouble' pot ser clau per avançar personalment i professionalment.

article_content: Marks & Spencer (M&S) has announced plans to open seven new stores in the final two months of the year, just in time for the holiday season. This expansion aims to meet rising customer demand and enhance the overall shopping experience. The first store will open at Birmingham Bullring on November 7, featuring clothing, home, and beauty departments, along with a renovated M&S Foodhall offering a marketplace atmosphere. The store will also include an enlarged bakery with fresh produce displays, a variety of bread, cakes, pastries, and a dedicated wine shop. The Birmingham location will be open from 9am to 8pm Monday through Saturday, and from 11am to 5pm on Sunday. M&S plans to launch 20 new 'bigger and better' full-line stores this financial year, which include both home and clothing ranges. Additionally, the company intends to increase the number of its food-only M&S stores from 316 to 420 to adapt to changing consumer preferences. The second new store opens in Uckfield at Ashdown Business Park on November 8. The 15,000-square-foot store will feature a grocery section and bakery. Additional openings include Lakeside Thurrock on November 15, Earlsfield on November 16, Barnsley (date to be confirmed, expected in autumn), Manchester Trafford Centre (opening in late November, date to be announced), and Wrexham on December 1. This expansion will bring M&S closer to more customers for the festive season. The list of new stores opening before Christmas includes: Birmingham Bullring (Nov 7), Uckfield (Nov 8), Barnsley (autumn), Lakeside Thurrock (Nov 15), Earlsfield (Nov 16), Wrexham (Dec 1), and Manchester Trafford Centre (winter). M&S's ongoing growth and commitment to offering a diverse shopping experience demonstrate the company's focus on serving its customers’ needs by making shopping more accessible and enjoyable.

article_content: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has identified a new virus that may have contributed to the death of a Kansas man, according to an announcement made Friday. Named the Bourbon virus after Bourbon County, where the patient resided, it is believed to be spread through tick or insect bites. In the spring of 2014, a 50-year-old man received multiple tick bites while working outdoors on his property. He became ill over the next two days, sought medical attention on the third day, and was hospitalized. He died of a heart attack 11 days after falling ill. During his hospitalization, tests for numerous infectious diseases were negative. A blood sample sent to the CDC led to the discovery of this new virus. The man’s symptoms included fever, fatigue, rash, headache, other body aches, nausea, vomiting, and low blood cell counts that help fight infections and prevent bleeding. Though there is only one confirmed case, the CDC believes the Bourbon virus is likely transmitted through tick or insect bites. The agency recommends using insect repellent, wearing long-sleeved clothing, avoiding bushy and wooded areas, and checking for ticks after time outdoors. Bourbon virus belongs to the thogotovirus group, previously identified in Europe, Asia, and Africa, but this is the first time such a virus has caused illness in the United States.

Va emmalaltir en dos dies, es va atendre al metge el tercer dia i va ser hospitalitzat. Va morir d’un atac de cor 11 dies després d’emmalaltir. L’agència recomana fer servir repel·lents d’insectes, portar roba de màniga llarga, evitar zones boscoses i amb molta vegetació, i revisar si hi ha paparres després de passar temps a l’exterior. El virus Bourbon pertany al grup dels thogotovirus, identificats prèviament a Europa, Àsia i Àfrica, però és la primera vegada que un virus d’aquest grup causa una malaltia als Estats Units.

article_content: A 23-year-old British man is experiencing such pronounced and continuous déjà vu that it has severely disrupted his life. The feeling that he is repeatedly reliving his actions—like being caught in a time loop—became so intense that he stopped watching TV, listening to the radio, and reading newspapers. Eventually, he left university and even found his symptoms worsened during a holiday abroad. Doctors diagnosed him with severe déjà vu, an exceptionally rare condition, and this appears to be the first known case triggered by anxiety rather than by neurological conditions such as epilepsy or dementia. Typically, déjà vu—a French term meaning 'already seen'—is a fleeting sensation of familiarity that most people experience at some point. For this man, however, these feelings were much more intense, persistent, and distressing. According to a study published in the Journal of Medical Case Reports, clinicians from Sheffield Hallam, Exeter, Leeds, King's College London, and universities in Canada and France found no neurological abnormalities in his brain scans. Previous research has mainly associated persistent déjà vu with conditions like temporal lobe epilepsy or dementia, but this is the first instance linked to anxiety. Psychologist Dr Christine Wells from Sheffield Hallam University described this as a possible first recorded case of anxiety-induced, or psychogenic, déjà vu. Despite knowing the experience was not real, the man’s episodes increased in frequency and intensity over three years, becoming debilitating. The case highlights that déjà vu is a recognized phenomenon, reported by over 70 percent of people at some point, and is most common in those aged 15 to 25. Yet, persistent déjà vu remains extremely rare. Scientists continue to debate its origins: some suggest it may stem from brief neural misfirings, similar to what happens during epileptic seizures, leading to a false sense of familiarity. Notably, the man began experiencing such episodes at age 20, and after taking LSD at university, the déjà vu episodes became more prolonged. His anxiety was so severe at times that he would shower multiple times a day and compulsively wash his hands. Dr Wells notes that if confirmed, this could redefine our understanding of déjà vu as not solely related to neurological conditions but also potentially triggered by psychiatric factors such as anxiety. The distress caused by déjà vu may, in turn, heighten anxiety, creating a feedback loop. Currently, there is no definitive treatment for his symptoms.

Finalment, va abandonar la universitat i fins i tot va notar que els seus símptomes empitjoraven durant unes vacances a l’estranger. Els metges li van diagnosticar un déjà vu greu, una condició excepcionalment rara, i sembla ser el primer cas conegut desencadenat per l’ansietat en lloc de per condicions neurològiques com l’epilèpsia o la demència. Normalment, el déjà vu—un terme francès que significa ‘ja vist’—és una sensació fugaç de familiaritat que la majoria de persones experimenta en algun moment. En aquest cas, però, aquestes sensacions són molt més intenses, persistents i angoixants. Segons un estudi publicat al Journal of Medical Case Reports, clínics de Sheffield Hallam, Exeter, Leeds, King’s College London i universitats del Canadà i França no van trobar cap anormalitat neurològica en les seves proves cerebrals. Investigacions prèvies han associat principalment el déjà vu persistent amb condicions com l’epilèpsia del lòbul temporal o la demència, però aquest és el primer cas vinculat a l’ansietat. La psicòloga Christine Wells, de la Sheffield Hallam University, descriu el cas com el possible primer enregistrament de déjà vu induït per l’ansietat o psicogènic. Tot i saber que l’experiència no era real, els episodis del jove van augmentar en freqüència i intensitat durant tres anys, arribant a ser incapacitants. El cas posa de manifest que el déjà vu és un fenomen reconegut, reportat per més del 70% de la població en algun moment, i que és més comú entre persones d’entre 15 i 25 anys. No obstant això, el déjà vu persistent és extremadament rar. Els científics segueixen debatent les seves causes: alguns suggereixen que podria derivar de petits errors neuronals, semblants als que ocorren durant crisis epilèptiques, donant lloc a una falsa sensació de familiaritat. Cal destacar que el noi va començar a patir aquests episodis als 20 anys, i després de consumir LSD a la universitat, els episodis de déjà vu es van allargar. L’ansietat era tan greu que es dutxava diverses vegades al dia i es rentava compulsivament les mans. Segons la Dra. Wells, si es confirma, aquest cas podria redefinir la nostra comprensió del déjà vu com un fenomen que no només està relacionat amb condicions neurològiques, sinó que també pot ser desencadenat per factors psiquiàtrics com l’ansietat. L’angoixa provocada pel déjà vu pot, al seu torn, augmentar l’ansietat i crear un bucle de retroalimentació. Actualment, no hi ha cap tractament definitiu per als seus símptomes.

article_content: Istanbul is preparing for more confrontations after Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdogan told protestors in Taksim Square they have 24 hours to leave. This warning follows two weeks of protests triggered by a disputed redevelopment plan for Gezi Park. The European Parliament has criticized the Turkish authorities for using excessive force during these protests. In response, Erdogan rejected European criticism, defending Turkey's autonomy over internal affairs. What started as an environmental sit-in in Gezi Park has turned into national protests against Erdogan's government and policies. Demonstrations are now occurring in many cities across the country, bringing thousands of people into the streets each evening. Protest scenes include makeshift barricades, damaged city structures, and frequent use of tear gas and water cannons by police. The toll is steep: more than 5,000 people have been injured, at least five have died, and officials report about 600 police injuries. Among the casualties is 26-year-old Ethem Sarisuluk, who died after being struck by a tear gas canister during protests in Ankara. Despite government threats and proposals for a referendum on Gezi Park’s future, hundreds of protestors have refused to leave, with Taksim Square serving as a central point of gathering. The European Parliament passed a resolution condemning both the heavy-handed police tactics and Erdogan’s divisive approach. Still, Erdogan insists on removing protestors from the area and dismisses foreign involvement. International attention continues to focus on Istanbul as authorities prepare for possible escalation while calls for a peaceful solution persist.

article_content:
South Korean shop owners have launched a nationwide boycott of Japanese products amid an ongoing territorial dispute between the two countries. Oh Ho-suk, President of the Save Local Stores Alliance, says that most of the group's 7.2 million members are expected to join the boycott. They are refraining from selling popular Japanese goods such as Mild Seven cigarettes, Asahi beer, and Sony electronics. Some South Korean car mechanics have stated they will refuse to repair vehicles from Japanese automakers like Toyota, Honda, and Nissan.

"We will continue this boycott until we receive a sincere apology from the Japanese government," Oh said. The group is protesting Japan's continued claim to a group of islands situated between the two countries—referred to as Dokdo in South Korea and Takeshima in Japan. Both nations assert ownership, although the islands are currently administered by South Korea.

The Dokdo/Takeshima dispute is one of several ongoing territorial disagreements in the East and South China Seas, where the ownership of islands can grant exclusive fishing and resource exploitation rights. In a related context, major Japanese exporters such as Toyota and Canon experienced declining sales in China last fall following a separate island dispute, which resulted in a large-scale boycott and violent protests after the Japanese government's purchase of the Diaoyu/Senkaku islands.

This boycott marks the first major protest sparked by the recent tensions between South Korea and Japan. According to police, more than 200 people participated in a protest in Seoul to launch the boycott, chanting slogans, throwing eggs at signs featuring Japanese brand logos, and waving South Korean flags. Protesters displayed banners reading "Dokdo is our territory" and "The Japanese government must apologize." Many women attended in traditional Korean hanbok. The protesters marched from Topgol Park to Gwanghwamun Square, distributing 50,000 flyers about the boycott.

March 1 is a national holiday in South Korea commemorating the 1919 independence movement against Japanese rule. Japan Tobacco, owner of Mild Seven, and Asahi Breweries declined to comment on the situation. 

Reporting contributed by Junko Ogura in Tokyo for CNN.

article_content: Anthony Waters, a 48-year-old shopkeeper in Bradford, died by suicide soon after British Gas cut the electricity to his shop due to unpaid bills. Despite Waters offering £1,000 as a partial payment toward his £5,000 debt and warning workers he intended to harm himself, the disconnection went ahead. The British Gas team later contacted police, who found Waters deceased in his locked store. Waters’ father, Keith, criticized the company for a lack of empathy, saying their actions pushed his son to desperation. The Waters family had run the store for decades, but financial difficulties, including a recalled bank loan, forced the closure of several shops. British Gas claimed they had tried to resolve the debt over a two-year period and obtained a court warrant for the shutoff. The coroner found Waters was under considerable stress trying to save the family business, and ended his life when he felt there were no options left. British Gas offered their condolences after the incident.

article_content: Nikkita Pereira experienced a traumatic childbirth when her newborn son Ziah was initially believed to be dead shortly after delivery by emergency C-section at The Royal Free Hospital in London. Moments after doctors announced the infant's time of death as 11:02 a.m., Ziah unexpectedly began to breathe and let out his first cry. Miss Pereira, 22 at the time, had planned a natural birth, but complications during labor in February 2012 led to an emergency Caesarean section. Doctors found the umbilical cord wrapped around Ziah's neck, causing his heartbeat to weaken. After Ziah was born and showed no signs of breathing, the medical team tried for eight minutes to resuscitate him before pronouncing him dead, according to Pereira. Immediately after, Ziah began breathing. Ziah was then rushed to the neonatal unit where he stayed for eight days. Despite these challenges, he recovered fully and is now healthy. Miss Pereira recalls the ordeal and expresses immense gratitude, stating there isn't a day that goes by without her feeling thankful for Ziah's survival. A spokesperson for The Royal Free Hospital clarified that Ziah's death was never officially recorded. According to their records, five inflation breaths were administered for resuscitation and Ziah required oxygen and neonatal intensive care, but was not declared dead. He was discharged on February 27, 2012. Miss Pereira commemorates this experience with a bracelet for Ziah, engraved with the time he was born and the moment he started breathing.

article_content: Scientists have uncovered previously hidden tectonic plates deep within the Earth's mantle beneath western North America, fundamentally challenging four decades of geological theory about the region's formation. It was long believed that the mountainous terrain of western North America was formed by the eastward movement and subduction of the Farallon plate, which dragged islands along its path until they became part of the continent's western edge. However, a research team from Ludwig Maximilians University in Munich and the British Columbia Geological Survey has revealed, through advanced seismic tomography, that the process involved not just the Farallon plate, but several other plates now named Angayucham and Mezcalera. Using earthquake shockwaves and powerful computers, the scientists created a three-dimensional map of these ancient plates, which now lie 500 to 1,200 miles below the Earth's surface. Lead author Karin Sigloch and colleague Mitch Mihalynuk describe these plate remnants as tall, vertical walls hundreds of feet thick, previously undetected due to the limitations of older technology. Their findings suggest that these plates were sandwiched between and eventually overridden by a westward-moving North American plate and an eastward-moving Farallon plate. The study, published in Nature, indicates that the complex collision and subduction history explains longstanding mysteries about the region's geology, such as the original formation of the Rocky Mountains. Seismic data shows these ancient slabs are colder and denser than surrounding mantle, and their distinct properties allowed researchers to trace their locations with unprecedented precision. This new model proposes that as Pangaea began to break apart 200 million years ago, a vast ocean and an offshore archipelago existed between North America and the Farallon plate, with the Angayucham and Mezcalera plates submerged beneath long-lost seas. The revised understanding helps explain the intricate geology of western North America, such as rocks found thousands of miles from their points of origin, and deepens insight into the continent's violent tectonic history. Geologist Robert Hildebrand, not involved in the study, supports the plausibility of these findings, noting that previous models failed to match the observed evidence in the mantle. The research also suggests that these tectonic processes have impacted more than just landforms, affecting climate, ocean patterns, ecosystems, and mineral deposits. According to Mihalynuk, this discovery is a pivotal moment for geology, but changing the prevailing scientific view will take time as the new theory gains acceptance.
translated_content: Els científics han descobert plaques tectòniques ocultes profundament dins del mantell terrestre sota l'oest d’Amèrica del Nord, desafiant fonamentalment quatre dècades de teoria geològica sobre la formació d’aquesta regió. Durant molt de temps s’havia cregut que el terreny muntanyós de l’oest nord-americà es va formar pel moviment cap a l’est i la subducció de la placa Farallon, que arrossegava illes fins que s’incorporaven a la vora occidental del continent. No obstant això, un equip de recerca de la Ludwig Maximilians Universität de Munic i el British Columbia Geological Survey ha revelat, mitjançant tomografia sísmica avançada, que el procés implicava no només la placa Farallon, sinó també altres plaques anomenades Angayucham i Mezcalera. Amb ones sísmiques i ordinadors potents, els científics han creat un mapa tridimensional d’aquestes antigues plaques, que ara es troben entre 800 i 2.000 quilòmetres sota la superfície terrestre. La investigadora principal Karin Sigloch i el seu col·lega Mitch Mihalynuk descriuen aquests vestigis com a murs verticals de centenars de metres de gruix, indetectables amb la tecnologia d’abans. Les troballes suggereixen que aquestes plaques estaven encaixades i finalment van ser superades per una placa nord-americana avançant cap a l’oest i per una Farallon avançant cap a l’est. L’estudi, publicat a Nature, indica que la complexa història de col·lisions i subduccions explica misteris geològics persistents de la regió, com la formació inicial de les Muntanyes Rocalloses. Les dades sísmiques mostren que aquests antics fragments són més freds i densos que el mantell que els envolta i, per les seves propietats úniques, els investigadors els han pogut situar amb precisió sense precedents. Aquest nou model proposa que, quan Pangea començà a fragmentar-se fa 200 milions d'anys, hi havia un gran oceà i un arxipèlag offshore entre Amèrica del Nord i la placa Farallon, amb les plaques Angayucham i Mezcalera submergides sota mars ara desaparegudes. Aquesta comprensió revisada ajuda a explicar la geologia complexa de l’oest d’Amèrica del Nord, com ara roques trobades milers de quilòmetres lluny del seu lloc original, i aprofundeix en la història tectònica violenta del continent. El geòleg Robert Hildebrand, que no va participar a l’estudi, corrobora la plausibilitat d’aquestes troballes, destacant que els models anteriors no quadraven amb l’evidència observada al mantell. La recerca també apunta que aquests processos tectònics han tingut impacte més enllà del relleu, afectant clima, oceans, ecosistemes i dipòsits minerals. Segons Mihalynuk, aquest descobriment és un moment clau per a la geologia, tot i que caldrà temps perquè la nova teoria s’imposi.

article_content: During a disruptive weekend at OpenAI, CEO Sam Altman was ousted by the board, who cited his lack of transparency in communications. Such a move is rare and disruptive, especially from a company responsible for leading AI technology like GPT-4, raising questions about governance and the importance of public accountability. Elon Musk, who previously supported OpenAI and now leads a rival AI venture, made public calls for transparency regarding Altman’s removal. Musk highlighted that as AI becomes more advanced, OpenAI’s decision-making process becomes critical for everyone. OpenAI’s guiding principles, unlike typical tech firms, requires it to prioritize humanity’s interests over profitability. This increases the board’s responsibility to ensure that actions taken align with societal benefit, particularly regarding AI safety. Media outlets and analysts suggest several factors could have led to Altman’s removal. One is his rumored efforts to launch a new AI chip startup, Tigris, potentially raising conflict-of-interest concerns. Another theory points to disagreements within leadership over the pace and safety of AI development, with cofounder Ilya Sutskever reportedly urging more caution. These events have sparked speculation about divisions inside OpenAI, reminiscent of earlier episodes when other founders left to form safety-focused startups such as Anthropic. Under Altman, OpenAI has dramatically increased its commercial activity and fundraising, marking a departure from its original focus on AI safety research. With the possibility of Altman returning to his leadership role, the public and stakeholders are demanding clear explanations from OpenAI’s board about the reasons behind these leadership changes given their far-reaching implications.

article_content: Disneyland has unveiled a first look at its reimagined Adventure Treehouse, inspired by Walt Disney’s Swiss Family Robinson. The updated attraction will open on November 10 in Disneyland Park, paying homage to the original treehouse that Walt Disney and his team created in 1962. Previously, the treehouse was themed after the 1999 animated film Tarzan. The new version features a water wheel powered by 'magical waters,' a cozy dining area for the family of five, a wood-carving station, an astronomy loft, a nature room, and the father’s art studio. According to Disney officials, “The video explores the mother’s music den, sons’ nature room and daughter’s astronomer’s loft nestled among the tree’s massive branches. It also shows the ground-level kitchen and dining room and the father’s art studio.” There are no height requirements for guests wishing to enjoy the attraction. Disney’s original Swiss Family Robinson film was released in 1960 and tells the story of a family shipwrecked on a deserted island. The movie stars John Mills, James MacArthur, and Dorothy McGuire.

La nova versió inclou una roda d’aigua moguda per 'aigües màgiques', un menjador acollidor per a la família de cinc, un espai de talla de fusta, un loft d’astronomia, una sala de natura i l’estudi d’art del pare. Segons els responsables de Disney, “El vídeo explora el saló musical de la mare, la sala de la natura dels fills i el loft d’astronomia de la filla, situats entre les grans branques de l’arbre. article_content: In a heartwarming case of mistaken identity in Shanghai, police took in a baby raccoon dog that was initially thought to be a bear cub. The animal was found by a local resident who contacted authorities, and Officer Li Wenyue brought the animal to the station, making a temporary home for it in a shoebox. The misunderstanding came to light when photos of the animal in a small police uniform were shared on the social media site Weibo, catching the attention of a forestry department expert who identified it correctly as a raccoon dog. The young animal is now under the care of the forestry department and will be released back into its natural habitat when it is old enough. Although raccoon dogs look like raccoons, they are more closely related to dogs and foxes. Unfortunately, these animals are commonly bred in large numbers for their fur in China—around 1.5 million are raised every year, according to a 2005 investigation. The nation’s fur trade has faced criticism over animal rights issues and the mislabeling of raccoon dog fur as fake. In 2006, major US fashion brands, including Rocawear, Sean John, and Macy’s, drew scrutiny for selling raccoon dog fur under false labels and consequently pulled those garments from their shelves.

article_content: A new front has emerged in Israel’s efforts to combat the funding of Iran-backed militant groups, such as Hamas and Hezbollah, through cryptocurrency. The focus is now on Tron, a fast-growing crypto network that offers quicker and cheaper transactions than Bitcoin. According to several financial crime experts and blockchain specialists, Tron is now the preferred platform for crypto transfers linked to organizations designated as terrorist groups by Israel, the US, and others. Reuters analyzed crypto seizures announced by Israeli security services since 2021, revealing a marked rise in Tron wallet seizures and a decline in those involving Bitcoin. Merkle Science CEO Mriganka Pattnaik stated that terrorist organizations increasingly favor Tron because of its fast transaction times, low fees, and stability. Merkle Science, which works with law enforcement in the US, UK, and Singapore, confirmed this shift. Israel’s National Bureau for Counter Terror Financing (NBCTF) froze 143 Tron wallets between July 2021 and October 2023, with most seizures taking place in 2023. Among these, 39 wallets were linked in June to Lebanon’s Hezbollah, and 26 in July to Palestinian Islamic Jihad, a group allied with Hamas. NBCTF also froze 56 Tron wallets it associated with Hamas, including 46 in March 2022 tied to Gaza-based exchange Dubai Co. For Exchange. After the October 7, 2023 attack by Hamas, Israel escalated its investigations into Hamas financing. In one of the largest operations to date, Israel froze around 600 crypto accounts believed to be connected to Dubai Co., though it did not specify the crypto types or networks involved. Some individuals whose funds were frozen told Reuters they used Tron for personal or business reasons and denied any ties to militant groups. Israel views Dubai Co. as a terrorist organization because of its financial support for Hamas. Dubai Co. did not respond to a request for comment. Hamas, Hezbollah, and Islamic Jihad have also not commented. The armed wing of Hamas stated in April 2023 that it would stop accepting Bitcoin donations due to increased monitoring, but did not mention Tron. Reuters could not independently confirm whether Hamas has used Tron. NBCTF declined to provide further details. A June 2023 Israeli statement said funds were seized for use by terrorist groups funded by Iran, which supports Hamas, Hezbollah, and Islamic Jihad as part of its 'Axis of Resistance'. However, NBCTF did not confirm whether Iran was the funding source in its reports. Iran’s foreign ministry did not reply to Reuters inquiries about Tron. Reuters previously reported that Iranian firms conducted $8 billion in Tron transactions between 2018 and 2022, partly to avoid US sanctions. Due to limited transparency, it is difficult to gauge exactly how much crypto reaches sanctioned groups. Most transactions on the Tron network involve Tether, a widely used stablecoin still pegged to the US dollar. Tether regularly assists law enforcement by tracking and freezing suspicious accounts. The Tron blockchain is the leading platform for Tether, hosting $48 billion in tokens in 2023. Tron’s average daily transactions rose by over 70% year-on-year as of June 2023. Tron was founded by Justin Sun in 2017, who faces a US SEC lawsuit over alleged market manipulation and unregistered securities sales, which he denies. Historically, Bitcoin was targeted for seizures more than Tron, but since 2021, this trend has reversed. Chainalysis reports that illicit crypto activity accounted for only 0.2% of overall crypto transactions in 2022, down from 2% in 2019. The Financial Action Task Force recently warned that the use of Tether on Tron helps terrorist groups to conceal donors’ identities. Experts attribute Tron's rise among suspicious transactions to its lower costs, fast transfers, and initially limited attention from blockchain monitoring. It is challenging to conclusively prove that seized wallets were truly used to fund militant groups, as blockchains are transparent but wallet owners’ identities are often unknown.

Una declaració israeliana de juny de 2023 diu que els fons es van confiscar per ser utilitzats pels grups terroristes finançats per l’Iran, que dona suport a Hamàs, Hezbol·lah i la Gihad Islàmica dins de l’anomenat ‘Eix de Resistència’. No obstant això, la NBCTF no va afirmar si l’Iran era la font de finançament. El Ministeri d’Afers Exteriors iranià no va respondre a Reuters sobre Tron. A causa de la transparència limitada, és difícil saber quants fons acaben en grups prohibits. La majoria de transaccions a la xarxa Tron impliquen Tether, un stablecoin àmpliament utilitzat vinculat al dòlar. Tether ajuda regularment a la policia rastrejant i congelant comptes sospitosos. La blockchain Tron és la principal plataforma per a Tether, amb 48.000 milions de dòlars en tokens el 2023. Les transaccions diàries a Tron van créixer més d’un 70% respecte a l’any anterior fins al juny de 2023. Tron va ser fundada per Justin Sun el 2017, que afronta una demanda de la SEC dels EUA per suposada manipulació del mercat i venda de valors sense registrar, acusacions que nega. Històricament, les confiscacions de Bitcoin eren més freqüents que les de Tron, però des del 2021 la tendència s’ha invertit. Chainalysis informa que l’activitat il·lícita amb criptos només fou el 0,2% del total el 2022, per sota del 2% el 2019. El Grup d’Acció Financera ha advertit recentment que l’ús de Tether a Tron facilita que grups terroristes ocultin la identitat dels donants. Els experts atribueixen el creixement de Tron entre transaccions sospitoses al seu baix cost, rapidesa i la manca d’atenció inicial de les empreses d’anàlisi blockchain. És difícil demostrar de manera concloent que les carteres confiscades es van fer servir realment per finançar grups militants, ja que la blockchain és transparent però sovint es desconeix la identitat dels propietaris de les carteres.

article_content:
Shares of logistics service provider Delhivery declined by approximately 3.75%, reaching a low of Rs 398.80 on Friday morning after 1.8 crore shares were traded in large block deals. Japanese IT conglomerate SoftBank, which held a 14.46% stake in Delhivery at the end of the September quarter via Svf Doorbell (Cayman), is believed to be the likely seller. The deal is reportedly valued at Rs 747 crore, or Rs 403 per share. Official confirmation is expected when the exchanges release their bulk and block deal data later in the day.

Reports indicate SoftBank has been considering the sale of around a 4% stake in Delhivery. In 2023 to date, Delhivery shares have delivered nearly 22% returns to investors. In March, SoftBank sold a 2.84% stake in Delhivery for Rs 954.2 crore through multiple block deals. Over the past two years, SoftBank has reduced its investments in startups globally, recently selling stakes in both Paytm (One97 Communications) and PB Fintech. In November last year, SoftBank sold a 4.5% stake in Paytm for $200 million.

For the September quarter (Q2 FY24), Delhivery reported an 8% year-on-year increase in revenue to Rs 1,942 crore, and its losses narrowed by 59% YoY to Rs 103 crore from Rs 254 crore in Q2 FY23. According to Emkay analyst Anshul Agarwal, Delhivery’s strategy of passing efficiency gains in the B2C segment, where customers are price-sensitive, should support further market share growth. Meanwhile, improving yields in the B2B segment, which values network speed and reliability, is expected to aid the company's path to profitability. The brokerage anticipates Delhivery will achieve adjusted EBITDA breakeven in FY24 and turn both PAT and FCF positive by FY26, driven by operating leverage and lower capital expenditure intensity.
