article_content: India is internationally renowned for its vibrant colours, seen in everything from Bollywood film sets to sparkling saris and lively curries. This vivid spirit was alive yesterday during the Lathmar Holi Festival, which marks the arrival of spring. Thousands of Hindus gathered in the small villages of Nandgaon and Barsana, in the northern state of Uttar Pradesh, to celebrate by throwing bright powders and coloured water at each other. Hindu men from Nandgaon are covered in coloured powder as they sit in prayer at the Ladali (Radha) temple. The Lathmar Holi tradition sees women from Barsana playfully strike men from Nandgaon with wooden sticks in response to their teasing, as the men depart the village. The roots of playing with colours during Holi come from the legend of Radha and Lord Krishna. According to the story, Lord Krishna, dark-skinned and jealous of Radha’s fair complexion, complained to his foster mother Yasodha, who jokingly suggested he could colour Radha’s skin with powders. Inspired by this, Krishna and his friends visited Radha's village to playfully douse her and her friends with colours. The women chased them away with sticks, called 'lathis.' During Lathmar Holi, men dress as 'gops' (Krishna's companions), while women are 'gopis' (Radha’s friends), recreating this legend through songs, coloured powders, and playful stick-beating. On the first day, men from Nandgaon visit Barsana to play Holi, while on the second day, men from Barsana travel to Nandgaon to continue the festivities. Women of both villages prepare for weeks in advance, often being pampered and well-fed to energize them for the celebrations. Participants enjoy the festival with exuberance, sipping thandai—sometimes laced with bhang (cannabis paste)—which is known to enhance the high spirits of the event. Lathmar Holi is more than just a show of colours; it symbolizes love, fun, and equality—a celebration so lively that, according to belief, even the gods come down to watch.

Aquest esperit viu es va manifestar ahir durant el Festival Lathmar Holi, que marca l’arribada de la primavera. Milers d’hindús es van reunir als petits pobles de Nandgaon i Barsana, a l’estat del nord d’Uttar Pradesh, per celebrar llençant pólvores de colors vius i aigua acolorida els uns als altres. Els homes hindús de Nandgaon es cobreixen de pols de colors mentre resen al temple Ladali (Radha). La tradició del Lathmar Holi vol que les dones de Barsana colpegin juganerament els homes de Nandgaon amb bastons de fusta com a resposta a les seves bromes, quan aquests marxen del poble. L’origen de jugar amb colors durant el Holi prové de la llegenda de Radha i el Senyor Krishna. Segons la història, Krishna, de pell fosca i gelós de la pell clara de Radha, es va queixar a la seva mare adoptiva Yasodha, que li va suggerir de broma que podia tenyir la pell de Radha amb pólvores de colors. Inspirat per això, Krishna i els seus amics van visitar el poble de Radha per ruixar-la a ella i a les seves amigues amb colors. Les dones els van fer fora amb bastons, anomenats ‘lathi’. Durant el Lathmar Holi, els homes es vesteixen de ‘gops’ (companys de Krishna), mentre que les dones són ‘gopis’ (amigues de Radha), recreant la llegenda amb cançons, pólvores de colors i bastonades juganeres. El primer dia, els homes de Nandgaon visiten Barsana per jugar a Holi, i el segon dia, els homes de Barsana viatgen a Nandgaon per continuar la festa. Les dones dels dos pobles es preparen setmanes abans, sovint sent mimades i ben alimentades per tenir energia per a la celebració. Els participants gaudeixen del festival amb alegria, prenent thandai (una beguda que a vegades conté bhang, una pasta de cànnabis) associada amb l’ambient festiu de l’esdeveniment. El Lathmar Holi és més que una explosió de colors: simbolitza amor, diversió i igualtat—una celebració tan viva que, segons es diu, fins i tot els déus baixen a observar-la.

Former Galatasaray manager Roberto Mancini has declined to confirm any interest in replacing Laurent Blanc as the manager of French champions Paris Saint-Germain (PSG). Recent reports have linked the former Manchester City boss to a possible move to the Parc des Princes, as Blanc faces scrutiny following PSG’s inconsistent start to the Ligue 1 season. However, Mancini insists he has not been contacted regarding the position and noted that PSG already have a very capable manager.

Mancini, who is currently a free agent after leaving Galatasaray in June following less than one season in charge, addressed the rumors while speaking at a forum in Qatar. He said, "I think there is a good coach there. [Blanc] runs PSG well and he won the French league last year. I know nothing more. Maybe I will coach in France – or somewhere else. Everything is possible in football."

The 49-year-old parted ways with Galatasaray just one season into a three-year contract. Meanwhile, PSG manager Laurent Blanc is under pressure as his team currently sits seven points behind the top of Ligue 1.

article_content: A South Korean court has sentenced 68-year-old Lee Yoon-seop to 14 months in jail for praising North Korea in a poem. According to reports in South Korean media, Lee advocated for Korean unification under Pyongyang’s socialist system in his poem, which was published in North Korean state media in 2016. He wrote that if the Koreas were united, citizens would receive free housing, healthcare, and education. Lee was convicted under South Korea’s National Security Act, which prohibits publicly praising or promoting North Korea. The poem, titled 'Means of Unification,' also argued that unification would result in fewer people taking their own lives or living in debt. Lee’s poem won a poetry contest in North Korea in November 2016. The Korea Herald noted that Lee had previously been jailed for 10 months for a similar offense. In its recent ruling, a Seoul court stated that Lee 'continued to generate and disseminate a considerable amount of propaganda that glorified and praised the North.' The Korea Herald also reported that he had posted online comments praising North Korea’s military in 2013 and later published anti-state content on South Korean blogs and websites.

Since SMEs account for the majority of the country’s businesses and employ most of the workforce, this lack of funding holds back economic growth and job creation. Historically, commercial banks dominated business lending, but these institutions often require extensive paperwork and high collateral, making it hard for smaller businesses to obtain timely loans. With these challenges in mind, many Nigerian entrepreneurs are now seeking out digital lending platforms like Shara. These fintech services have gained traction for offering quick, collateral-free loans through accessible online applications, allowing business owners to seek funding whenever they need it—even outside traditional banking hours. Beyond simple applications, digital lenders provide quick approvals, a range of loan products for different business needs, recurring access to credit, and online tools for managing repayments—enhancing transparency and user experience compared to traditional lenders. An additional advantage for micro and small businesses is that digital lenders often remove the need for collateral or personal guarantors, lowering common barriers to business finance. By addressing the shortcomings of conventional banks, digital lenders like Shara are broadening access to funding and helping Nigerian businesses sustain and expand. Borrowers are encouraged to review all loan conditions to ensure clear understanding of fees and repayment terms.

article_content: Wheat is a crucial staple food worldwide, sustaining the livelihoods of billions. Although the significance of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) in biological systems is well recognized, their specific roles in wheat grain development have not been fully understood. A recent study published in Seed Biology on September 4, 2023, has taken major steps to change this. The team assembled a comprehensive database of wheat lncRNAs to better understand how they function during the grain development process. They performed genome-wide, strand-specific RNA sequencing on wheat grain endosperm at 10 and 15 days after pollination—vital stages for seed development. Additionally, they combined information from 545 public transcriptome datasets, which covered various wheat tissues and developmental timepoints. This approach enabled them to discover 20,893 wheat lncRNAs. On average, these lncRNAs are about 900 base pairs long, mostly have only one exon, and overlap significantly with LTR retrotransposons. When compared to protein-coding genes (PCGs), wheat lncRNAs are shorter, possess fewer exons, display higher tissue-specific expression, and often show expression patterns that correspond with neighboring genes. Notably, 90.7% of them are exclusive to one of wheat’s three subgenomes (A, B, or D), suggesting a different evolutionary path than PCGs. To share these insights, the researchers established wLNCdb (http://wheat.cau.edu.cn/wLNCdb), a public online database that provides tools for analyzing wheat lncRNA expression, interactions, function, and genetic variation. Using this resource, they identified a particular lncRNA, TraesLNC1D26001.1, which delays wheat seed germination by increasing the level of the gene TaABI5. This same lncRNA shows coordinated expression with genes needed for starch and protein production in wheat grains, underlining its influence on grain characteristics and quality. Overall, this landmark study presents a detailed map of wheat lncRNAs and offers an accessible database to drive further research, with promising implications for boosting wheat crop yields and improving food quality in the future.

Un estudi recent publicat a Seed Biology el 4 de setembre de 2023 ha fet passes importants per canviar-ho. L’equip va construir una base de dades exhaustiva d’lncRNA de blat per comprendre millor com actuen durant el procés de formació del gra. Els investigadors van fer una seqüenciació genòmica d’ARN de cadena específica a l’endosperma del gra de blat als 10 i 15 dies després de la pol·linització, moments clau pel desenvolupament de la llavor. També van combinar dades de 545 transcriptomes públics cobrint diferents teixits del blat i etapes de desenvolupament. Aquesta estratègia va permetre descobrir 20.893 lncRNA de blat. De mitjana, aquests lncRNA mesuren aproximadament 900 parells de bases, solen tenir només un exó i se superposen sovint amb retrotransposons LTR. Comparats amb els gens codificadors de proteïna (PCG), els lncRNA de blat són més curts, tenen menys exons, s’expressen de forma més específica a teixits concrets i generalment mostren patrons d’expressió similars als gens del voltant. Destaca també que el 90,7% són exclusius d’un dels tres subgenomes del blat (A, B o D), deixant entreveure trajectòries evolutives diferents respecte als PCG. Per compartir aquestes descobertes, els investigadors han creat wLNCdb (http://wheat.cau.edu.cn/wLNCdb), una base de dades pública que ofereix eines per analitzar l’expressió, les xarxes d’interacció, la funció i la variació genètica dels lncRNA de blat. Amb aquest recurs, l’equip va identificar un lncRNA concret, TraesLNC1D26001.1, que retarda la germinació de la llavor incrementant l’expressió del gen TaABI5. Aquest mateix lncRNA presenta una coordinació d’expressió amb altres gens implicats en la formació de midó i proteïna al gra, subratllant la seva influència en el desenvolupament i la qualitat final del blat. En resum, aquest estudi pioner presenta un mapa detallat dels lncRNA de blat i una base de dades accessible per impulsar la recerca futura, amb implicacions prometedores per millorar la producció i la qualitat alimentària del blat.

article_content: Green Day stunned patrons with a surprise performance at The Marquis, a pub in central London, on Thursday. Bar manager Tommy McGuinness revealed he was approached earlier in the week by a record label seeking to book a 'big US band' for the venue. 'It was a whirlwind,' McGuinness told BBC London. 'Turns out Billie Joe loves the pub. It's the smallest place Green Day have ever played.' Initially, McGuinness hesitated because another band was already scheduled. 'I've always been a fan, so it was doubly special. It was bizarre, mental, but brilliant.' McGuinness explained the pub was chosen after Green Day's lead singer and guitarist, Billie Joe Armstrong, began following the venue on Instagram and watched its posted videos featuring unsigned artists. The event was intended to be secret, but news rapidly leaked, prompting crowds to gather outside. 'We reached capacity early,' McGuinness said. 'People were queuing up to Trafalgar Square. Even those who didn't get in seemed to enjoy it. The atmosphere was wonderful.' Approximately 80 people managed to see the gig inside, and McGuinness said, 'Everyone in the pub had the time of their life.' article_content:
After nearly a year apart, Rachael Neustadt, an American mother living in London, is expected to be reunited with her two sons following a significant legal victory. Her ex-husband, Ilya Neustadt, a former lecturer at London Metropolitan University, had refused to return their sons, Daniel (7) and Jonathan (5), from Russia, defying orders from an English judge after the couple’s separation.

Rachael Neustadt turned to Russian courts for help, using an international law—ratified by Russia just five months earlier—to request the intervention. The Moscow City Appeal Court has now recognized the English High Court’s order in a ruling celebrated by Ms. Neustadt and her legal team. Her solicitor, Caroline Korah, described the court’s decision as a ‘landmark’ and expressed hope for a swift reunion.

Ms. Neustadt, 36, expressed immense gratitude to the courts and said, “I can’t wait until the boys and I are all back home in London. We have a lot of hugs to catch up on, and I will not rest until they are in my arms.” She has also cared for her third son, one-year-old Meir, throughout the ordeal.

Mr. Neustadt, 37, had taken Daniel and Jonathan to Russia for a Christmas visit last year and did not return them, despite an English High Court order. Ms. Neustadt and her lawyers sought legal recognition in Russia following Russia’s ratification of the 1996 Hague Convention on Parental Responsibility and Child Protection in June. England adopted the Convention in November 2012. This case is the first to use the 1996 Hague Convention for cross-border child abduction between England and Russia.

After making an application to the Moscow City Court, Ms. Neustadt received a favorable ruling on September 11. Although Mr. Neustadt appealed, the Moscow City Appeal Court confirmed the decision to recognize and enforce the English High Court’s orders, paving the way for Daniel and Jonathan’s return.

Caroline Korah stated, ‘It is heart-wrenching for the child and the left-behind parent when a parent wrongfully retains a child whilst abroad. With the tragedy of child abduction on the rise, the rights and best interests of children must be the paramount consideration.’ She added, ‘We are thrilled at the ruling in Moscow and hope that Rachael and the boys are all reunited soon.’
translated_content:
Després de gairebé un any separada, Rachael Neustadt, una mare nord-americana que viu a Londres, està a punt de retrobar-se amb els seus dos fills després d’una important victòria legal. El seu exmarit, Ilya Neustadt, exprofessor de la London Metropolitan University, s’havia negat a retornar els seus fills Daniel (7) i Jonathan (5) des de Rússia, desobeint una ordre d’un jutge anglès després de la separació de la parella.

La Rachael va recórrer als tribunals russos, utilitzant una llei internacional ratificada per Rússia només cinc mesos abans, per demanar la seva intervenció. Ara, el Tribunal d’Apel·lació de la Ciutat de Moscou ha reconegut l’ordre del Tribunal Superior d’Anglaterra en una decisió celebrada per la Rachael i el seu equip legal. La seva advocada, Caroline Korah, va qualificar la decisió com un «punt d’inflexió» i va expressar el desig d’una reunió imminent.

Rachael, de 36 anys, va expressar una enorme gratitud als tribunals i va dir: «No puc esperar a estar tots junts a casa a Londres. Ens hem de posar al dia amb moltes abraçades i no descansaré fins que els tingui als braços.» També s’ha fet càrrec durant tot aquest temps del seu tercer fill, en Meir, d’un any.

Ilya Neustadt, de 37 anys, va portar Daniel i Jonathan a Rússia per Nadal l’any passat i no els va tornar, tot i l’ordre del Tribunal Superior anglès. Rachael i els seus advocats van buscar reconeixement legal a Rússia després que aquest país ratifiqués la Convenció de l’Haia de 1996 sobre Responsabilitat Parental i Protecció de Menors al juny. Anglaterra s’hi va adherir el novembre de 2012. Aquest és el primer cas en què s’utilitza la Convenció de l’Haia de 1996 per a un segrest de menors entre Anglaterra i Rússia.

Després de presentar una sol·licitud al Tribunal de la Ciutat de Moscou, Rachael va rebre una sentència favorable l’11 de setembre. Tot i que Ilya Neustadt va presentar recurs, el Tribunal d’Apel·lació de Moscou va confirmar la decisió de reconèixer i executar les ordres del Tribunal Superior anglès, obrint el camí per al retorn de Daniel i Jonathan.

article_content: After traveling 352 million miles over eight and a half months, NASA's Curiosity rover successfully landed on Mars at 5:32 GMT (1:32 EDT) this morning. The rover entered the Martian atmosphere at 13,000 mph and was gently lowered by a pioneering 'sky crane' system before arriving safely inside the Gale Crater. NASA's Pasadena mission control erupted in cheers as the landing was confirmed. Curiosity immediately sent back its first photos of the Martian surface, with scientists hugging and celebrating the achievement. Shortly after, the rover transmitted a high-resolution image showing one of its wheels on Mars, with color images expected soon. The Curiosity rover announced its arrival via Twitter: "I'm safely on the surface of Mars. GALE CRATER I AM IN YOU!!!" NASA Administrator Charles Bolden hailed the event as a major milestone toward eventual human exploration: "Today, the wheels of Curiosity have begun to blaze the trail for human footprints on Mars," he said. President Obama also praised the landing: "Tonight, on the planet Mars, the United States made history. The successful landing of Curiosity—the most sophisticated roving laboratory ever to land on another planet—marks an unprecedented feat of technology that will remain a point of national pride far into the future." The descent sequence, called the 'seven minutes of terror,' involved highly complex maneuvers as Curiosity navigated the atmosphere and reached the surface. The landing trajectory was so precise that last-minute adjustments were unnecessary. Gale Crater was selected as the landing site for its evidence of ancient water, including a three-mile-high mountain with mineral-rich foundations. Project manager John Grotzinger highlighted the scientific potential of the first images. Curiosity is powered by a nuclear generator and is about the size of a small car. Its equipment includes a robotic arm, a power drill, a chemical laboratory, various cameras, a weather station, a rock-zapping laser, and a radiation detector. The rover will assess whether areas of Mars might have been hospitable for microbial life, searching for essential elements like carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus, sulfur, and oxygen. Earlier NASA rovers Spirit and Opportunity landed with airbags in 2004. Curiosity's advanced landing used a heat shield, a supersonic parachute, and a rocket-powered 'sky crane', which lowered the rover by cable. Public interest was high, with crowds gathering—including in New York's Times Square—to watch live broadcasts. NASA's mission continues amid changes to its Mars exploration roadmap and budget challenges, having revised its international partnerships. Despite the risks and failures of more than half of Mars missions since the 1960s, NASA remains committed, while Opportunity keeps operating years beyond expectations. Curiosity's mission is not to search directly for living or fossilized life, but to gather data for future missions. NASA aims to eventually return Martian rock and soil samples to Earth for detailed analysis.

El centre de control de la NASA a Pasadena va esclatar en aplaudiments quan es va confirmar l'aterratge. El Curiosity va enviar immediatament les primeres fotos de la superfície de Mart, amb científics abraçant-se i celebrant l'èxit. El rover Curiosity va anunciar la seva arribada a través de Twitter: "Sóc segurament a la superfície de Mart. GALE CRATER, JA SÓC A TU!!!" L'administrador de la NASA, Charles Bolden, va qualificar l'esdeveniment de fita clau cap a l'exploració humana: "Avui, les rodes de Curiosity han començat a obrir el camí per a les petjades humanes a Mart", va dir. El president Obama també va elogiar l'aterratge: "Aquesta nit, al planeta Mart, els Estats Units han fet història. L'èxit de l'aterratge del Curiosity—el laboratori robòtic més sofisticat que mai ha aterrat en un altre planeta—és una fita tecnològica sense precedents que serà motiu d'orgull nacional durant molt de temps." La seqüència d'aterratge, coneguda com els 'set minuts de terror', va implicar maniobres molt complexes mentre el Curiosity travessava l'atmosfera abans d'arribar a la superfície. La trajectòria d'aterratge va ser tan precisa que no van caldre ajustos d'última hora. El cràter Gale va ser escollit per les seves evidències d'aigua antiga, incloent-hi una muntanya de cinc quilòmetres d'altura amb sòl ric en minerals. El cap de projecte John Grotzinger va ressaltar el potencial científic de les primeres imatges. El Curiosity funciona amb un generador nuclear i té aproximadament la mida d’un cotxe petit. El seu equipament inclou un braç robòtic, una broca, un laboratori químic, diferents càmeres, una estació meteorològica, un làser analitzador de roques i un detector de radiació. El vehicle estudiarà si algunes zones de Mart podrien haver estat habitables per a vida microbiana, cercant elements essencials com el carboni, el nitrogen, el fòsfor, el sofre i l'oxigen. Els anteriors vehicles de la NASA, Spirit i Opportunity, van aterrar amb coixins d’aire el 2004. L’aterratge avançat del Curiosity va utilitzar un escut tèrmic, un paracaigudes supersònic i una 'grua aèria' propulsada per coets, que va baixar el vehicle mitjançant cables. L'interès del públic va ser alt, amb multituds reunides —fins i tot a Times Square, Nova York— per veure la transmissió en directe. La missió de la NASA segueix endavant, tot i els canvis en el seu full de ruta d'exploració i els desafiaments pressupostaris, havent revisat algunes col·laboracions internacionals. Malgrat els riscos i els fracassos de més de la meitat de les missions a Mart des dels anys 60, la NASA hi aposta fort, i l'Opportunity segueix funcionant molt després del previst. La missió del Curiosity no inclou la recerca directa de vida, sinó obtenir dades clau per a futures missions. La NASA vol tornar mostres de roques i sòl marcians a la Terra per a una anàlisi detallada.

A bipartisan group assembled by the Constitution Project has released a report titled 'Irreversible Error,' recommending major reforms to the U.S. death penalty system. The experts advocate for replacing complex multi-drug protocols with a single-drug method for executions, following incidents where problematic procedures led to unnecessary suffering, such as the recent botched execution in Oklahoma.

The report urges both federal and state authorities to improve transparency in their execution processes by revealing details about the drugs used and involving the public in developing protocols. This call for openness comes as the Justice Department reviews execution practices nationwide.

Contributors to the report include former officials who have overseen executions and anti-death penalty activists. While the report does not argue for or against capital punishment itself, it emphasizes that current methods risk unfair, disproportionate, and possibly unconstitutional consequences.

Among the issues highlighted is the execution of individuals convicted under felony murder statutes—even when they had no intention to kill—which the report suggests may breach the Eighth Amendment protections against cruel and unusual punishment. The study also seeks better access to legal recourse for death row inmates, meaningful clemency procedures, and fairer standards for determining intellectual disability in defendants.

Ultimately, the report stresses that reforms are needed at every level of the system to ensure executions, if carried out, reflect principles of transparency, justice, and humane treatment.

L'informe demana a les autoritats federals i estatals més transparència en els processos d'execució, fent públiques les dades sobre els fàrmacs i promovent la participació ciutadana en l'elaboració dels protocols. article_content: A Stockholm court has acquitted Russian-Swedish businessman Sergei Skvortsov, who faced allegations of covertly transferring sensitive technology to Russian intelligence services. Judge Jakob Hedenmo stated that while the investigation focused on whether Skvortsov's actions amounted to espionage, the prosecution could not prove this intent. Prosecutors had sought a five-year prison sentence, arguing that Skvortsov used his import-export businesses to send electronic equipment, potentially usable in military applications, to Russia. Skvortsov, who moved to Sweden with his wife in the 1990s, was detained in November 2022, and his closed-door trial on charges of 'illegal intelligence activities' was held in September. The court ordered his release on October 9, citing a lack of justification for continued detention. During the trial, prosecutor Henrik Olin characterized Skvortsov as a 'procurement agent' for technology usually banned from transfer to the Russian military, with Swedish media reporting that such items might support nuclear weapons research. According to Olin, Skvortsov and his companies were embedded in a Russian intelligence-managed supply system, allegedly threatening the security interests of both Sweden and the US over about ten years. Olin stated the majority of the exported technology originated in the US, referencing previous American prosecutions in 2016 for similar activities supplying the Russian military. He suggested Skvortsov followed in their path. Skvortsov, however, claimed he acted within the law and sought official approval for his exports. Prosecutors claimed Skvortsov misled authorities by submitting false information about partners and end users to gain export authorization. Defense lawyer Ulrika Borg argued investigators did not conclusively establish any connection between Skvortsov and Russian intelligence, describing him as a businessman with diverse contacts, including in sectors such as agriculture and Russia's space agency, Roscosmos. Borg criticized the prosecution for associating people with espionage based on weak ties. Amid rising tensions over Sweden's NATO membership bid and its support for Ukraine, Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson recently stated that the national security situation is the most severe since World War II, explicitly naming Russia as a significant threat.

La fiscalia havia sol·licitat una pena de cinc anys de presó, argumentant que Skvortsov va utilitzar les seves empreses d’importació i exportació per enviar equips electrònics, potencialment utilitzables en aplicacions militars, a Rússia. Skvortsov, que es va traslladar a Suècia amb la seva esposa als anys noranta, va ser detingut el novembre de 2022, i el seu judici a porta tancada per ‘activitats d’intel·ligència il·legals’ es va celebrar al setembre. El tribunal va ordenar la seva llibertat el 9 d’octubre, adduint manca de justificació per a la seva detenció continuada. Olin va explicar que la major part de la tecnologia exportada provenia dels Estats Units, referint-se a casos judicials als EUA el 2016 per activitats similars de proveïment a l’exèrcit rus. Va suggerir que Skvortsov seguia una trajectòria semblant. Per contra, Skvortsov va defensar que actuava segons la llei i que sol·licitava l’aprovació oficial per a les seves exportacions. Borg va criticar la fiscalia per vincular l’espionatge a relacions circumstancials. En un context de tensions pel procés d’adhesió de Suècia a l’OTAN i el suport suec a Ucraïna, el primer ministre Ulf Kristersson va declarar recentment que la situació de seguretat nacional és la més greu des de la Segona Guerra Mundial, assenyalant Rússia com una amenaça principal.

After months of negotiation, Montenegro's Prime Minister Milojko Spajic has succeeded in forming a new coalition government, which was approved early Tuesday morning. Spajic, the 36-year-old leader of the pro-European, centrist party 'Europe Now!', leads a government formed with support from the anti-Western, pro-Russian alliance 'For the Future of Montenegro.'

'Europe Now!', established in 2022, ran on a platform promoting Montenegro's accession to the European Union, higher wages and pensions, and economic reform, securing 26% of votes in the June legislative election. Spajic was appointed prime minister in August after receiving support from 46 out of 81 parliamentary deputies, while 19 voted against, one abstained, and the rest were absent. However, he struggled to assemble a coalition until receiving backing from the 'For the Future of Montenegro' alliance, led by Andrija Mandic, who has previously criticized NATO membership and advocated closer ties with Russia. Mandic also opposed Montenegro’s separation from Serbia in the 2006 referendum.

A key condition for the alliance’s support was appointing Mandic as speaker of parliament, a role he assumed on Monday, drawing opposition criticism. That day, Spajic urged parliament to back his government’s proposals: “Our goal is to make Montenegro the Switzerland of the Balkans, the Singapore of Europe.” Opposition parties, especially the Democratic Party of Socialists led by Danijel Zivkovic, argued the government would not deliver on Spajic’s promises, with Zivkovic labeling it “anti-European, anti-Montenegrin and pro-Russian.”

Hundreds of opposition supporters demonstrated outside parliament in the capital on Monday. The coalition agreement stipulates that pro-Serbian groups are to join the government within a year, taking ministerial posts.

Despite warnings from some EU officials advising Spajic to avoid anti-NATO, anti-Western groups in government, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Tuesday encouraged Spajic to continue pursuing EU accession. “Montenegro has been for a long time the most advanced Western Balkan country on the EU accession path, and I am happy to see that you are determined to keep this position,” von der Leyen said after discussions with Montenegro’s President Jakov Milatovic. She further stressed the importance of remaining focused on the EU accession objectives.

Von der Leyen visited Spajic and other officials during a tour of Western Balkan countries seeking EU membership, with prior stops in North Macedonia and Kosovo and plans to travel to Serbia later on Tuesday.

Després de mesos de negociacions, el primer ministre de Montenegro, Milojko Spajic, ha aconseguit formar un nou govern de coalició, que es va aprovar a primera hora de dimarts. Spajic, líder de 36 anys del partit proeuropeu i centrista 'Europa Ara!', encapçala un govern amb el suport de l'aliança antioccidental i prorussa 'Pel Futur de Montenegro'.

'Europa Ara!', fundat el 2022, es va presentar amb un programa que defensava l’adhesió de Montenegro a la Unió Europea, augments de salaris i pensions i reformes econòmiques, assolint el 26% dels vots a les eleccions legislatives de juny. Spajic va ser nomenat primer ministre a l’agost després d’obtenir el suport de 46 dels 81 diputats del parlament, mentre que 19 hi van votar en contra, un es va abstenir i la resta eren absents. Tot i així, li va costar tancar una coalició fins aconseguir el suport de l’aliança 'Pel Futur de Montenegro', liderada per Andrija Mandic, que prèviament havia criticat la pertinença a l’OTAN i promogut una relació més estreta amb Rússia. Mandic també es va oposar a la separació de Montenegro de Sèrbia en el referèndum de 2006.

Una de les condicions per obtenir el suport de l’aliança va ser nomenar Mandic president del Parlament, càrrec que va assumir dilluns passat, fet que va aixecar crítiques de l’oposició. Aquell dia, Spajic va intentar convèncer el parlament perquè donés suport als seus programes de govern: “El nostre objectiu és fer de Montenegro la Suïssa dels Balcans, el Singapur d’Europa.” Els partits de l’oposició, especialment el Partit Democràtic dels Socialistes encapçalat per Danijel Zivkovic, van argumentar que el govern no compliria les promeses de Spajic, i Zivkovic el va qualificar d’“antieuropeu, antimontenegrí i prorús”.

Centenars de simpatitzants de l’oposició van protestar davant del parlament a la capital dilluns passat. L’acord de coalició estipula que els grups proserbis s’incorporaran al govern en el termini d’un any, ocupant ministeris.

Malgrat les advertències d’alguns representants de la UE de no incloure grups anti-OTAN i antioccidentals al govern, la presidenta de la Comissió Europea, Ursula von der Leyen, va animar dimarts Spajic a continuar avançant pel camí de l’adhesió a la UE. “Montenegro ha estat durant molt de temps el país dels Balcans Occidentals més avançat pel que fa al procés d’adhesió a la UE, i m’alegra veure que esteu decidits a mantenir aquesta posició”, va dir von der Leyen després de reunir-se amb el president montenegrí Jakov Milatovic. Va emfatitzar també la importància de seguir centrats en els objectius d’adhesió a la UE.

Von der Leyen va visitar Spajic i altres responsables en el marc d’una gira pels països balcànics que aspiren a unir-se a la UE. Prèviament havia estat a Macedònia del Nord i Kosovo, i preveu viatjar a Sèrbia més tard aquest dimarts.

article_content: David Walliams, best known as a comedian, has earned over £13 million from his five children’s books since he entered the genre four years ago. New figures show Walliams is now experiencing greater success as a children’s author, with his books being embraced by readers across the nation. Walliams has sold approximately 2.2 million books in the UK and an additional 200,000 worldwide. According to Nielsen Bookscan, total UK sales have just surpassed £13 million, currently standing at £13,198,871.97. Although he shares profits with his publisher, HarperCollins, Walliams receives a substantial portion. His first children’s book, Mr Stink, released in October 2009, has sold more than half a million copies in the UK. Billionaire Boy, published in June 2011, sold around 550,000 copies, followed by Ratburger in September 2012 with 300,000 copies sold. In 2013, Walliams added two more titles: Gangster Granny, released in February, sold over 520,000 copies, and The Boy in the Dress, published in July, sold around 350,000. Walliams’s sixth book, Demon Dentist, is scheduled for release later this month. Walliams’s book sales place him among celebrated children’s authors like JK Rowling and Roald Dahl. One publisher commented, 'He is a phenomenon; people who think of him only as a comedian are mistaken. He is arguably the most successful children’s author in recent years. He's the Roald Dahl of his generation.' This success marks a remarkable second career for Walliams, who rose to fame alongside Matt Lucas in Little Britain, widely regarded as a leading comedy show. Walliams has homes in London and Brighton. He is married to model Lara Stone, and they have a son named Alfred.

Aquesta fita representa una segona carrera extraordinària per a Walliams, que va saltar a la fama al costat de Matt Lucas a Little Britain, reconeguda com una de les sèries d’humor més populars. An undercover investigation has revealed that more than a dozen Muslim clerics in the UK agreed to perform marriage ceremonies for girls as young as 14. Four imams are under investigation after offering to arrange such ceremonies, which are illegal under UK law. Reporters, posing as the mother and brother of a 14-year-old girl, contacted 56 mosques across the country requesting an Islamic marriage ceremony (nika). Imams at 18 mosques agreed, including one who had previously worked with the police. The cleric was willing to conduct the ceremony despite knowing the bride would be forced to move in with a man against her wishes.

One of the clerics identified was Khan Misbahi, a preacher at Jamia Masjid Kanzul Imam Mosque near Leeds, who agreed to proceed with the marriage. The investigation highlights concerns about underage marriage in Britain. Campaigners estimate that thousands of girls are forced into such ceremonies each year, sometimes due to cultural sensitivities.

These marriages are not recognized by UK law, which requires both parties to be at least 16 years old to marry. Under Islamic law, girls may marry after reaching puberty. Mohammed Shahid Akhtar, an imam from Central Jamia Mosque Ghamkol Sharif in Birmingham, showed disregard for English marriage law, stating, ‘She’s 14. By sharia, grace of God, she’s legal to get married. Obviously, Islam has made it easy for us. There is nothing against that. We’re doing it because it’s OK through Islam.’

Akhtar’s mosque, which accommodates up to 6,000 people, has suspended him and denies conducting underage marriages. Another cleric, Shams-ul-Huda Khan Misbahi, preaching near Leeds, confirmed the marriage would be 'real' and justified making the girl move in with the man, saying 'everything is jaiz' (lawful). Misbahi, who has previously assisted West Yorkshire police on community issues, admitted a UK marriage certificate could not be provided, but said the marriage could be documented at the mosque.

The mosque has initiated an investigation into Misbahi’s comments. The Muslim Council of Britain condemned underage marriage, with Assistant Secretary-General Shaykh Ibrahim Mogra stating, 'In this country, it is illegal, it is forbidden and no imam should be allowed to conduct the marriage of an underage child.'

Two other imams from mosques in Manchester and Birmingham are also under investigation for agreeing to similar ceremonies. The charity Karma Nirvana, which helps victims of forced marriage, has supported girls as young as eight and receives over 600 calls monthly. Founder Jasvinder Sanghera noted that the issue is aggravated by cultural sensitivities masking illegality. Since 2008, courts in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland have had the power to prevent forced marriages through civil orders, with violations leading to potential two-year prison sentences for contempt of court.

Una investigació encoberta ha revelat que més d'una desena de clergues musulmans al Regne Unit van accedir a realitzar cerimònies de matrimoni per a noies de només 14 anys. Quatre imams estan sent investigats per haver ofert organitzar aquestes cerimònies, que són il·legals segons la llei britànica. Periodistes fent-se passar per la mare i el germà d'una noia de 14 anys van contactar amb 56 mesquites d'arreu del país per demanar una cerimònia islàmica (nika). Els imams de 18 mesquites hi van accedir, fins i tot un que havia col·laborat prèviament amb la policia. El clergue estava disposat a celebrar la cerimònia tot i saber que la núvia seria obligada a viure amb un home en contra de la seva voluntat.

Un dels clergues identificats és Khan Misbahi, predicador a la mesquita Jamia Masjid Kanzul Imam a prop de Leeds, qui va acceptar celebrar el matrimoni. La investigació posa en evidència les preocupacions sobre els matrimonis de menors al Regne Unit. Activistes calculen que milers de noies són forçades a aquestes cerimònies cada any, sovint per raons de sensibilitat cultural.

Aquests matrimonis no són reconeguts per la llei britànica, que requereix que ambdues parts tinguin almenys 16 anys per casar-se. Segons la llei islàmica, les noies poden casar-se quan arriben a la pubertat. Mohammed Shahid Akhtar, imam de la Central Jamia Mosque Ghamkol Sharif de Birmingham, va expressar menyspreu per la llei matrimonial britànica afirmant: «Té 14 anys. Per la sharia, i la gràcia de Déu, és legal casar-se. Òbviament, l'islam ens ho posa fàcil. No hi ha res en contra. Ho fem perquè està permès per l'islam.»

La mesquita d'Akhtar, amb capacitat per a 6.000 persones, l'ha suspès i nega haver fet matrimonis de menors. Un altre clergue, Shams-ul-Huda Khan Misbahi, que predica vora Leeds, va confirmar que el matrimoni seria 'real' i justificava que la noia hagués d'anar a viure amb l'home dient que 'tot és jaiz' (lícit). Misbahi, que havia assessorat la policia de West Yorkshire en temes comunitaris, va admetre que no podria expedir un certificat matrimonial oficial, però la unió es podria registrar a la mesquita.

La mesquita ha obert una investigació sobre les seves declaracions. El Consell Musulmà de Gran Bretanya ha condemnat la pràctica, i el Secretari General Adjunt, Shaykh Ibrahim Mogra, va afirmar: «En aquest país, és il·legal, està prohibit i cap imam hauria de poder celebrar el matrimoni d'un menor.»

Altres dos imams de mesquites a Manchester i Birmingham també són investigats per haver acceptat fer cerimònies similars. L'entitat Karma Nirvana, que ajuda víctimes de matrimonis forçats, ha ajudat noies de fins a vuit anys i rep més de 600 trucades mensuals. La fundadora, Jasvinder Sanghera, explica que el problema s'agreuja per les sensibilitats culturals que permeten ocultar la il·legalitat. Des de 2008, als tribunals d'Anglaterra, Gal·les i Irlanda del Nord se'ls permet impedir els matrimonis forçats a través d'ordres civils, amb penes de fins a dos anys de presó per incompliment.

article_content: A Florida jury is overseeing the mail and immigration fraud trial of Rogerio Scotton, a former professional race car driver originally from Brazil. Scotton, aged 43, is representing himself after disputes with six previous attorneys. As part of his defense, he has submitted intimate videos made with his wife as evidence to show that their marriage is genuine and not a sham for immigration benefits. Scotton's wife, who was born in Cuba and is now a U.S. citizen, is central to his defense. Scotton has been charged with 27 counts of mail fraud and two counts of lying to immigration authorities. Authorities allege that Scotton operated a multimillion-dollar mail-fraud scheme, setting up fake accounts to bill major retailers such as Target, Walmart, and Apple, and using these to ship electronics to customers in Brazil through companies like FedEx, UPS, and DHL. Presiding over the case, U.S. District Judge Robin Rosenbaum is considering whether the proposed video evidence is appropriate for the jury to view, balancing Scotton’s right to a fair trial with concerns for his wife’s privacy. Judge Rosenbaum has requested to review the material herself first and suggested exploring less intrusive ways to verify the authenticity of the marriage. Scotton has been in custody for more than 22 months and maintains his innocence. He previously lived in Boca Raton, Florida, and has a background in competitive racing including events like the Miami Grand Prix and NASCAR.

Com a part de la seva defensa, ha presentat vídeos íntims realitzats amb la seva esposa per demostrar que el seu matrimoni és genuí i no una ficció per obtenir beneficis d'immigració. L'esposa de Scotton, nascuda a Cuba i ara ciutadana nord-americana, és clau en la seva defensa. Scotton està acusat de 27 càrrecs de frau postal i dos de mentir a les autoritats d'immigració. Les autoritats afirmen que Scotton dirigia un esquema de frau postal multimilionari, obrint comptes falsos per facturar a grans minoristes com Target, Walmart i Apple, i utilitzant-los per enviar electrònica a clients del Brasil a través d'empreses com FedEx, UPS i DHL. La magistrada federal Robin Rosenbaum presideix el cas i està considerant si és apropiat que el jurat visualitzi els vídeos proposats, tot equilibrant el dret de Scotton a un judici just amb la privadesa de la seva esposa. La jutgessa Rosenbaum ha sol·licitat revisar el material prèviament i ha suggerit explorar alternatives menys invasives per verificar l'autenticitat del matrimoni. Scotton porta més de 22 mesos sota custòdia i manté la seva innocència. Havia viscut anteriorment a Boca Raton, Florida, i té experiència en curses competint en esdeveniments com el Miami Grand Prix i la NASCAR.

article_content: Guillaume Soro, the former Prime Minister of Ivory Coast who has been living in exile since 2019, has announced his intention to return to his homeland despite facing two criminal convictions. On Sunday, Soro stated that it was difficult "to live far from my ancestral land of Africa" and expressed his desire to help "contribute to the reconciliation" of the country. In 2021, an Ivorian court sentenced Soro in absentia to life in prison for undermining national security; in 2020, he received a 20-year sentence for embezzlement of public funds. Both convictions occurred after Soro entered self-imposed exile in December 2019. Soro has maintained his innocence, stating on the social media platform X (formerly Twitter) that he is "guilty of no crime". He also revealed that authorities attempted to detain him at an airport in Turkey on November 3, seeking to extradite him to Ivory Coast. Although he has not specified a date for his return, Soro had previously announced his intention to run in Ivory Coast's 2025 presidential election. His 2020 presidential bid was blocked by a Constitutional Court decision. Soro, a former leader of a rebel group active in northern Ivory Coast in the early 2000s, was once a close ally of the current President, Alassane Ouattara. He played a significant role in supporting Ouattara during the 2010 post-election crisis against then-President Laurent Gbagbo—a conflict that resulted in nearly 3,000 deaths and ended with Gbagbo's capture in April 2011. Following the crisis, Soro served as Prime Minister and Speaker of the National Assembly under President Ouattara. However, their relationship deteriorated in 2019 after Ouattara accused Soro of instigating a "civilian and military insurrection," leading to Soro's exile.
translated_content: Guillaume Soro, l'ex-primer ministre de Costa d'Ivori que viu a l'exili des de 2019, ha anunciat la seva intenció de tornar al seu país natal tot i enfrontar-se a dues condemnes penals. Diumenge, Soro va dir que era difícil «viure lluny de la meva terra ancestral d'Àfrica» i va expressar el seu desig d'«ajudar a la reconciliació» del país. El 2021, un tribunal ivorià va condemnar Soro en absència a cadena perpètua per atemptar contra la seguretat nacional; el 2020 va rebre una condemna de 20 anys per malversació de fons públics. Ambdues condemnes es van produir després que Soro entrés en exili autoimposat el desembre del 2019. Soro ha mantingut la seva innocència, afirmant a la xarxa social X (antic Twitter) que és «culpable de cap delicte». També ha revelat que les autoritats van intentar detenir-lo a un aeroport de Turquia el 3 de novembre per intentar extraditar-lo a Costa d'Ivori. Tot i que no ha especificat la data de tornada, Soro ja havia anunciat anteriorment la seva intenció de presentar-se a les eleccions presidencials ivorianes del 2025. El seu intent de candidatura a les eleccions del 2020 va ser bloquejat per una decisió del Tribunal Constitucional. Soro, exlíder d’un grup rebel actiu al nord de Costa d'Ivori a principis dels 2000, va ser un estret aliat de l'actual president, Alassane Ouattara. Va tenir un paper clau en donar suport militar a Ouattara durant la crisi postelectoral del 2010 contra l'ex-president Laurent Gbagbo —un conflicte que va causar prop de 3.000 morts i que va acabar amb la captura de Gbagbo l’abril del 2011. Després de la crisi, Soro va ser primer ministre i president de l'Assemblea Nacional sota Ouattara. No obstant això, la seva relació es va deteriorar el 2019 després que Ouattara acusés Soro d’instigar una «insurrecció civil i militar», fet que va portar Soro a l’exili.

HARARE, Zimbabwe (CNN) -- Zimbabwe's main opposition party said Sunday it will not join a government with President Robert Mugabe unless given real power to deliver change, food, and jobs. Mugabe told supporters on Saturday he would not step down, despite mounting calls.

Nelson Chamisa, spokesperson for the Movement for Democratic Change (MDC), outlined this position after the party's national executive meeting, ahead of unity government talks scheduled for Monday.

In September, Mugabe and MDC leader Morgan Tsvangirai signed a power-sharing agreement brokered by former South African President Thabo Mbeki under the Southern African Development Community (SADC), but a government of national unity has not yet been formed. The process stalled when Tsvangirai accused Mugabe of taking control of key ministries such as defense, information, foreign affairs, finance, and home affairs.

South African President Kgalema Motlanthe, the current SADC chairman, will arrive in Zimbabwe Monday with Mbeki and Mozambican leader Armando Guebuza to help mediate further. In an interview with CNN, Chamisa stressed that the MDC cannot accept positions without actual power, stating, "We can't enter positions of authority without real power to bring about change, food, and jobs. Joining a powerless government would be political suicide. We insist on settling issues like fair allocation of ministries and the recognition of governors according to the March 29 election. We hope President Mugabe and ZANU-PF understand the importance of our position."

Chamisa called Monday's meeting a "watershed moment" and voiced the MDC's wish to bring prolonged talks to an end. Mugabe told state media Monday's meeting would be the last and threatened to form a government alone if there is no deal. Chamisa responded: "If they end talks out of arrogance, so be it. We won't let Mugabe dictate the terms. We are the winners and want to decide which issues to address. There's no time for delays—people in Zimbabwe are suffering."

According to the deal, Mugabe would remain president and Tsvangirai would become prime minister, following last June's hotly contested runoff, which saw violence and more than 200 deaths, mostly among opposition supporters. Tsvangirai won the March first round but did not meet the threshold to avoid a runoff. Many see power-sharing as key to resolving Zimbabwe’s crises: economic collapse, food shortages, and record inflation. The United Nations says more than five million people face starvation. A cholera outbreak has killed over 2,200 people, worsened by a shortage of chemicals for treating water, and an ongoing doctors’ and nurses’ strike for higher pay and better equipment continues.

Tsvangirai, upon returning to Zimbabwe on Saturday, reaffirmed his commitment to the deal with Mugabe, but insisted he would not be rushed into forming a unity government.

HARARE, Zimbabwe (CNN) -- El principal partit de l'oposició de Zimbabwe va afirmar diumenge que no s’unirà a un govern amb el president Robert Mugabe si no se li dona un poder real per impulsar canvis, aliments i llocs de treball. Mugabe va dir dissabte als seus seguidors que no dimitirà malgrat les creixents demandes.

Nelson Chamisa, portaveu del Moviment pel Canvi Democràtic (MDC), va explicar aquesta postura després de la reunió executiva nacional del partit, abans de les converses previstes per dilluns sobre un govern d’unitat nacional.

Al setembre, Mugabe i el líder de l’MDC, Morgan Tsvangirai, van signar un acord per compartir el poder, mediat per l’expresident sud-africà Thabo Mbeki dins del marc de la Comunitat per al Desenvolupament de l’Àfrica Meridional (SADC), però encara no s’ha format cap govern d’unitat nacional. El procés es va estancar quan Tsvangirai va acusar Mugabe d’acaparar ministeris clau com defensa, informació, afers exteriors, finances i interior.

El president sud-africà Kgalema Motlanthe, actual president de la SADC, arribarà dilluns a Zimbabwe amb Mbeki i el líder moçambiquès Armando Guebuza per ajudar a mediar. En una entrevista amb CNN, Chamisa va insistir que l’MDC no pot acceptar càrrecs sense poder real i va dir: “No podem entrar en posicions d’autoritat sense el poder real per avançar en canvis, aliments i llocs de treball. Entrar en un govern sense poder real seria suïcidi polític. Volem resoldre qüestions com la distribució justa dels ministeris i el reconeixement dels governadors segons les eleccions del 29 de març. Esperem que el president Mugabe i ZANU-PF entenguin la importància de la nostra postura.”

Chamisa va definir la reunió de dilluns com un "moment decisiu", i va expressar la voluntat de l’MDC d’acabar amb aquestes llargues negociacions. Mugabe va dir als mitjans estatals que la reunió de dilluns seria la definitiva i que, si no s’arribava a cap acord, formaria govern ell sol. Chamisa va respondre: “Si trenquen les negociacions per arrogància, així sigui. No deixarem que Mugabe imposi el ritme. Som els guanyadors i volem decidir els temes a tractar. El poble de Zimbabwe està patint i no queda temps.”

Segons l’acord, Mugabe seguiria com a president i Tsvangirai seria primer ministre, després d’una segona volta electoral molt disputada al juny, que va provocar més de 200 morts, la majoria entre opositors. Tsvangirai va guanyar la primera volta al març però no va superar el llindar necessari. Per a molts, el repartiment de poder és clau per solucionar les greus crisis de Zimbabwe: col·lapse econòmic, falta d’aliments i una inflació rècord. Les Nacions Unides afirmen que més de cinc milions de persones afronten la fam. Un brot de còlera ha causat més de 2.200 morts, agreujat per la manca de productes químics per tractar l’aigua, i continua la vaga de metges i infermeres reclamant millores salarials i d’equipament.

En tornar dissabte a Zimbabwe, Tsvangirai va reafirmar el seu compromís amb l’acord amb Mugabe, però va insistir que no té pressa per formar un govern d’unitat.

article_content: The Court of Appeal, Abuja Division, has removed Abubakar Suleiman as Speaker of the Bauchi State House of Assembly and as member representing Ningi Central Constituency in Bauchi State. On Friday, the appellate court ordered a rerun election in ten polling units within the constituency. Abubakar Suleiman, a member of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) and former Chairman of the Conference of Speakers of State Legislatures of Nigeria, was initially declared the winner of the March 18 election by INEC's Returning Officer, Professor Shuaibu Muhammad. He received 16,866 votes, defeating Khalid Abdulmalik-Ningi of the All Progressives Congress (APC), who had 15,065 votes, and Danlami Bara’u of the New Nigeria People’s Party (NNPP), who got 4,886 votes. Unsatisfied with the results, Abdulmalik-Ningi challenged the outcome at the State Election Petition Tribunal. The tribunal dismissed his petition and upheld Suleiman's election for a second term. However, Abdulmalik-Ningi then took the case to the Court of Appeal, which overturned the tribunal’s judgment and ordered the rerun. In response, Suleiman, through his spokesperson Abdul Burra, described the decision as a minor political setback and urged his supporters and all constituents to remain calm. He expressed confidence in winning the rerun, mentioning strong support in the affected polling units and ongoing infrastructural development in Ningi under Governor Bala Abdulkadir Muhammad. Suleiman stated that the PDP remains the leading party in the constituency.
translated_content: El Tribunal d'Apel·lació, Divisió d'Abuja, ha destituït Abubakar Suleiman com a president de l'Assemblea Estatal de Bauchi i com a membre que representa la circumscripció de Ningi Central a l'estat de Bauchi. Aquest divendres, el tribunal d'apel·lació ha ordenat repetir les eleccions a deu col·legis electorals dins la circumscripció. Abubakar Suleiman, membre del Partit Democràtic Popular (PDP) i ex-president de la Conferència de Presidents de les Assemblees Legislatives dels estats de Nigèria, havia estat declarat inicialment guanyador de les eleccions del 18 de març pel responsable electoral de l'INEC, el professor Shuaibu Muhammad. Va obtenir 16.866 vots, per davant de Khalid Abdulmalik-Ningi, del Congrés de Tots els Progressistes (APC), que en va obtenir 15.065, i Danlami Bara’u, del Partit del Poble de la Nova Nigèria (NNPP), que en va aconseguir 4.886. No satisfet amb els resultats, Abdulmalik-Ningi va impugnar el resultat davant el Tribunal de Recursos Electorals de l'Estat. El tribunal va desestimar la seva petició i va confirmar Suleiman com a escollit per a un segon mandat. Tot i això, Abdulmalik-Ningi va portar el cas al Tribunal d'Apel·lació, que va anul·lar la sentència del tribunal i va ordenar la repetició de les eleccions. En resposta, Suleiman, a través del seu portaveu Abdul Burra, va descriure la decisió com un petit revés polític i va demanar als seus seguidors i a tota la circumscripció que mantinguin la calma. Va expressar confiança en guanyar la repetició de les eleccions, destacant el seu fort suport als col·legis afectats i el desenvolupament d'infraestructures en curs a Ningi sota el governador Bala Abdulkadir Muhammad. Suleiman va afirmar que el PDP continua sent el partit principal a la circumscripció.

article_content: Despite some concerns over the impact of the global economic slowdown on placements this year, IIT-Bombay is expected to see a strong number of job offers exceeding the one-crore rupee mark. The overall number of companies recruiting at IITs has slightly decreased from last year, but students say this drop is marginal and they remain optimistic about their job prospects. Companies such as Da Vinci Derivatives, Hudson River Trading, Glean Technologies, and Barclays are lined up to offer high-value positions at IIT-Bombay. According to a final-year student, Da Vinci Derivatives is offering a domestic role with a salary package of Rs 1.3 crore, while Hudson River Trading proposes a Singapore-based role worth around 200,000 Singapore Dollars (approximately Rs 1.24 crore). Glean Technologies will be recruiting for an international role offering a package of $125,000. Hudson River Trading, a quantitative trading company, is visiting IIT-B and other IITs for campus hiring for the first time, offering roles based in Singapore. However, these offers depend on student selection in placement interviews beginning December 1. Jane Street Capital, a trading firm from New York, which last year offered the highest package of Rs 3.67 crore at some IITs, has again made a pre-placement offer at IIT-Bombay. The details of this year's package have not yet been disclosed. Jane Street typically recruits through internships. Barclays is hiring for a Hong Kong-based role with a compensation package of 11 lakh Hong Kong dollars, while Edge Focus is offering a remote position. Domestic opportunities are also available from firms like Graviton Research Capital, Quadeye, and NK Securities, mainly in roles such as trading, quantitative research, or development. Major technology companies including Microsoft and Apple are set to visit the campus as well, though so far, they are only accepting applications for domestic positions. The usual group of companies that have visited IIT-B’s Powai campus year after year are all returning, in addition to some new and unique organizations recruiting exclusively from IIT-Bombay this year. In the previous year, a total of 384 companies participated in placements at IIT-B, resulting in jobs for 1,516 students through the placement cell. The highest domestic salary offered was Rs 1.68 crore, with the top international offer standing at Rs 3.67 crore. Out of all the offers, 16 exceeded the crore mark, and 65 were international roles, with the average salary coming to Rs 21.82 lakh.
translated_content: Tot i les preocupacions sobre l’impacte de la desacceleració econòmica global en les col·locacions d’aquest any, s’espera que l’IIT-Bombay rebi nombroses ofertes de feina que superin la marca d’un crore de rupies. El total d’empreses que contracten als IIT ha disminuït lleugerament respecte a l’any passat, però els estudiants diuen que el descens és mínim i continuen sent optimistes quant a les seves oportunitats laborals. Empreses com Da Vinci Derivatives, Hudson River Trading, Glean Technologies i Barclays tenen la intenció d’oferir llocs de treball molt ben remunerats a l’IIT-Bombay. Segons un estudiant de darrer curs, Da Vinci Derivatives proposa una posició interna amb un salari de 1,3 crore de rupies, mentre Hudson River Trading ofereix un lloc a Singapur valorat en 200.000 dòlars de Singapur (aproximadament 1,24 crore de rupies). Glean Technologies reclutarà per a un càrrec internacional amb una remuneració de 125.000 dòlars. Hudson River Trading, una empresa de trading quantitatiu, visita l’IIT-B i altres IIT per primer cop per contractar directament al campus, oferint llocs a Singapur. Tanmateix, aquestes ofertes depenen que els estudiants siguin seleccionats en entrevistes de col·locació que comencen l’1 de desembre. Jane Street Capital, una empresa de trading de Nova York que l’any passat va oferir el paquet més alt (3,67 crore de rupies) en alguns IIT, ha fet una nova oferta prèvia a l’IIT-Bombay. Els detalls d’aquest any encara no s’han fet públics. Normalment, Jane Street recluta mitjançant pràctiques. Barclays busca cobrir una posició a Hong Kong amb un paquet retributiu d’11 lakh de dòlars de Hong Kong, mentre que Edge Focus ofereix una posició remota. També hi ha oportunitats internes amb firmes com Graviton Research Capital, Quadeye i NK Securities, principalment en rols de trading, recerca quantitativa o desenvolupament. Les grans tecnològiques Microsoft i Apple també visitaran el campus; de moment, només accepten sol·licituds per a rols interns. El grup habitual d’empreses que solen visitar el campus Powai de l’IIT-Btorna aquest any, junt amb algunes empreses noves i úniques que recluten exclusivament a l’IIT-Bombay. L’any passat, 384 empreses van participar en les col·locacions de l’IIT-B, col·locant 1.516 estudiants a través de la placement cell. El salari domèstic més alt va ser de 1,68 crore de rupies, i l’oferta internacional més elevada, de 3,67 crore. Hi va haver 16 ofertes superiors a un crore i 65 internacionals, amb una mitjana salarial de 21,82 lakh de rupies.

article_content: My name is Evan Moss, and I'm a 9-year-old boy who loves Pokemon! When I was just a month old, I started having seizures, and at age four, Dr. Weiner performed brain surgery to help stop them. The surgery stopped my seizures for two years, but unfortunately, they returned, and now my seizures are longer. When I was younger, I had about 15 short seizures a day. Now, I have one that lasts about 10 minutes every two weeks or so. I have two dogs: Dinky and Mindy. Dinky is our family dog and mainly belongs to my sister, Aria. Mindy is my seizure dog. It took a lot of fundraising and almost a year of waiting before we could drive from Virginia to Ohio to bring Mindy home. It was challenging at first because she didn't always listen, but now Mindy follows lots of commands, and I've even taught her a few new tricks, like climbing into my swing set fort. The best part about having Mindy is playing and racing with her – even though she stays by my side on her leash, I know she's really fast! Living with epilepsy can be tough, and sometimes I worry about the really dangerous kinds of seizures, but having Mindy helps me feel safer. Mindy barks when I have a seizure to alert my parents, who then give me medicine to help stop it. People often ask me what a seizure feels like, but it's hard to describe, and sometimes I don't remember them. If I met someone newly diagnosed with epilepsy, I would tell them, 'Don't worry, you're not in this alone!'
translated_content: Em dic Evan Moss i sóc un nen de 9 anys que adora Pokémon! Quan tenia tot just un mes, vaig començar a tenir convulsions, i als quatre anys el Dr. Weiner em va operar el cervell per intentar aturar-les. L'operació va aturar les convulsions durant dos anys, però malauradament van tornar i ara duren més temps. Quan era petit, tenia unes 15 crisis curtes cada dia. Ara, en tinc una que dura uns 10 minuts cada dues setmanes aproximadament. Tinc dos gossos: en Dinky i la Mindy. En Dinky és el gos de la família i principalment és de la meva germana, l’Aria. La Mindy és la meva gossa detectora de convulsions. Vam haver de recaptar molts diners i esperar gairebé un any abans de poder anar de Virgínia a Ohio per portar la Mindy a casa. Al principi va ser difícil perquè no sempre m’obeïa, però ara segueix moltes ordres i fins i tot li he ensenyat alguns trucs nous, com pujar a la fortalesa del meu gronxador. El millor d’estar amb la Mindy és jugar i fer curses amb ella – encara que va lligada a la corretja al meu costat, sé que pot córrer molt ràpid! Viure amb epilèpsia pot ser dur, i a vegades em preocupa la possibilitat de convulsions que poden ser perilloses, però tenir la Mindy em fa sentir més segur. La Mindy borda quan tinc una convulsió per avisar els meus pares, que després em donen medicament per ajudar a aturar-la. La gent sovint em pregunta com se sent una convulsió, però és difícil d’explicar i, de vegades, ni me’n recordo. Si conegués algú acabat de diagnosticar amb epilèpsia, li diria: 'No t’amoïnis, no estàs sol en això!'

article_content: President Bola Tinubu has overturned a federal policy that would have deducted 40% of internally generated revenue (IGR) from Nigerian federal universities. The announcement, delivered by Education Minister Tahir Mamman at the University of Ibadan’s 75th Founder’s Day, cited the policy as ill-timed given universities' current financial struggles. The now-cancelled policy had been announced in an October 2023 letter from the Accountant-General, slated to start in November. The justification referenced an earlier finance circular from December 2021. University administrators and the Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU) criticized the proposal, highlighting that the Finance Act 2020 requires only surplus—not core IGR—be remitted to the federal government. They warned that deductions under current conditions could harm university operations and possibly result in higher costs for students and their families. Confirming the cancellation, President Tinubu emphasized his commitment to improving the education sector as a cornerstone of national development.

La política, ara cancel·lada, s’havia comunicat en una carta de l’octubre de 2023 de l’Accountant-General i havia de començar al novembre. La justificació es basava en una circular financera anterior del desembre de 2021. Els responsables universitaris i el Sindicat del Personal Acadèmic de les Universitats (ASUU) van criticar la proposta, subratllant que la Llei Financera del 2020 exigix només que els excedents, i no el nucli dels IGR, es remetin al govern federal. Van advertir que aplicar la deducció en l’actual context podria perjudicar el funcionament de les universitats i provocar un augment dels costos per a estudiants i famílies. Confirmant la cancel·lació, el president Tinubu va reiterar el seu compromís amb la millora del sector educatiu com a pilar fonamental per al desenvolupament nacional.

article_content: Each time Congress takes a break and heads home, the same story unfolds: progress on important issues like medical innovation remains stalled. While lawmakers meet with voters or host online discussions, thousands of Americans are diagnosed with serious diseases such as cancer, Alzheimer's, or heart conditions. All the while, researchers push forward in search of critical medical breakthroughs, yet their efforts are held back by persistent gridlock in Washington. Political disputes have prevented necessary funding for institutions like the National Institutes of Health and the Centers for Disease Control. Since the implementation of across-the-board budget cuts called sequestration, research labs nationwide have been forced to close or downsize and hiring freezes have become commonplace. Young scientists are reconsidering their career paths, with many opting to pursue opportunities in countries investing more in research. So far, the 113th Congress has passed fewer than thirty-six laws, making it one of the least productive in recent times. Decision-making tends to happen under the pressure of looming crises, such as potential government shutdowns. In the private sector, this pattern would likely lead to a leadership change—voters could demand the same accountability from elected officials. This is the moment for anyone concerned about medical and health research to get involved. Congressional recess is a chance to make sure representatives get the message: Americans expect real solutions—not empty debate—including reforms that manage healthcare costs and protect crucial research funding. Recognizing the value of research, the U.S. now treats medical R&D as an investment, reinforcing its importance for future economic and health outcomes. Polling by Research!America shows many Americans would even accept higher taxes if they knew the money would boost medical research. Investing in science isn’t about quick payoffs; it’s about securing better lives for future generations. The country’s ability to conquer diseases depends on moving beyond partisan clashes and embracing long-term commitments to research.
translated_content: Cada vegada que el Congrés fa una pausa i torna a casa, la mateixa història es repeteix: el progrés en temes claus com la innovació mèdica segueix aturat. Mentre els legisladors es reuneixen amb ciutadans o organitzen xerrades en línia, milers d’americans són diagnosticats amb malalties greus com càncer, Alzheimer o problemes cardíacs. Alhora, investigadors treballen per assolir descobriments mèdics crucials, però els seus esforços es veuen limitats pel bloqueig polític a Washington. Les disputes polítiques han impedit el finançament necessari per institucions com els Instituts Nacionals de Salut (NIH) i els Centres pel Control i la Prevenció de Malalties (CDC). Amb la implantació de retallades pressupostàries generalitzades («sequestration»), molts laboratoris han hagut de tancar o reduir equips i la congelació de contractacions s’ha convertit en norma. Molts joves científics es plantegen el seu futur i alguns marxen a països amb més inversió en recerca. El 113è Congrés ha aprovat, fins ara, menys de trenta-sis lleis, situant-lo entre els menys productius de la història recent. Les decisions importants s’acostumen a prendre davant de crisis imminents, com possibles tancaments del govern federal. Si això passés a una gran empresa, segurament es canviaria la direcció—els votants podrien demanar la mateixa responsabilitat als seus representants. Ara és el moment perquè qui valora la recerca mèdica i sanitària faci sentir la seva veu. El període de recés és una oportunitat per recordar als legisladors que els ciutadans volen solucions reals—i no només discussions retòriques—, incloent-hi reformes que controlin la despesa sanitària i protegeixin el finançament fonamental de recerca. Els Estats Units ara reconeixen oficialment la R+D mèdica com una inversió, donant importància clau al seu impacte econòmic i sanitari futur. Segons sondatges encarregats per Research!America, molts nord-americans acceptarien pagar més impostos si aquests diners anessin destinats a la recerca mèdica. Invertir en ciència va més enllà de guanyar diners ràpid; és garantir un futur millor a les pròximes generacions. Avançar en la lluita contra malalties dependrà de superar l’enfrontament polític i apostar per compromisos ferms i duradors amb la recerca.
