A grieving mother has criticized a hospital consultant following the tragic death of her daughter, Jayne Hughes, after a misdiagnosis at the Accident & Emergency department in Lydney, Gloucestershire. Jayne Hughes, 44, died at home after doctors failed to detect a blood clot in her lungs, known as a pulmonary embolism, when she was brought into hospital following a fall down the stairs. At the inquest held at Gloucester Coroner’s Court, it was revealed that Ms. Hughes presented with symptoms such as breathlessness, high blood pressure, an elevated heart rate, and low oxygen saturation—all indicators of a possible blood clot. Despite these warning signs, she was discharged with painkillers when the attending consultant, Dr. Delia Parnham-Cope, concentrated on injuries related to her fall.

Carol Woodward, Jayne’s mother, voiced her deep frustration after receiving a handwritten apology from Dr. Parnham-Cope, who cited her busy workload as a factor in the misdiagnosis. Mrs. Woodward described the note as an insult, further compounded by Dr. Parnham-Cope’s admission at the inquest that she should have carried out a more thorough investigation. The consultant stated that she had spent the previous nine months reviewing her clinical practice and undergoing additional training.

Jayne Hughes was discharged from Gloucestershire Royal Hospital after tests showed no fractures or cardiac issues. Subsequently, her condition deteriorated and she visited her local surgery, where locum GP Dr. Meenakshi Raina attributed her symptoms to anxiety and asthma, also sending her home. She was found dead in bed the following morning. A hospital investigation later confirmed that Miss Hughes' symptoms had been overlooked and she did not receive appropriate treatment. The pathologist, Dr. Chamia de Cates, concluded the cause of death was bilateral pulmonary embolism originating from a blood clot in the left calf.

Coroner Katie Skerrett gave a narrative verdict, stating that the fatal embolism went undiagnosed and Ms. Hughes’ condition worsened without recognition. Carol Woodward remains angry over the lack of consequences for Dr. Parnham-Cope, who continues to work. The consultant maintains that she has learned from the incident and is committed to improving her practice.

Jayne Hughes, de 44 anys, va morir a casa seva després que els metges no detectessin un coàgul de sang als pulmons, conegut com embòlia pulmonar, quan va ser portada a l’hospital després de caure per les escales. Durant la investigació al Tribunal del Coroner de Gloucester, es va posar de manifest que la senyora Hughes presentava dificultat per respirar, pressió arterial alta, ritme cardíac elevat i baixa saturació d’oxigen, tots ells indicadors d’un possible coàgul sanguini. Malgrat aquestes senyals d’alerta, va ser donada d’alta amb analgèsics quan la doctora de guàrdia, Delia Parnham-Cope, es va centrar en les lesions provocades per la caiguda.

Carol Woodward, la mare de Jayne, va expressar la seva profunda frustració després de rebre una disculpa manuscrita de la doctora Parnham-Cope, que atribuïa l’error de diagnòstic a la càrrega de feina. Després, va empitjorar i va anar al seu centre de salut local, on la metgessa suplent, Meenakshi Raina, va atribuir els símptomes a ansietat i asma, i també la va enviar a casa. La consultora assegura que ha après de la situació i vol millorar la seva pràctica.

article_content: A young boy in Essex, Tayler Gunn, became fearful of gaining weight after his school sent a letter stating he was close to being clinically obese. Since receiving the letter, the six-year-old has started to avoid foods like cheese, ham, and spaghetti, and has become increasingly anxious about his body image. Tayler’s mother, Leanne Kane, expressed deep frustration, believing that official actions have harmed her son’s self-confidence. She criticized the school’s message, feeling it unfairly labeled Tayler as unhealthy. In response to concerns about body image, the All Party Parliamentary Group on body image reported that over half of the public holds negative views about their appearance, affecting even very young children. As a result, MPs have recommended mandatory lessons to support students’ self-esteem and body image in schools. The report also cited a 20% increase in cosmetic surgeries since 2008, attributing it partly to media promotion of unrealistic body ideals. It suggested that the Equality Act be reviewed to protect against appearance-related discrimination in the same way as race or gender discrimination. Leanne supports initiatives to help children, yet believes government involvement has contributed to Tayler’s self-consciousness. Lisa-Marie Jobson, the principal of a stage school in Essex, sees value in educating children about health and body diversity. She notes that TV advertising is increasingly featuring children of varying backgrounds, though magazines still often favor idealized images, which can place added pressure on children. Jobson points out that many children, especially those in dance, are highly aware of their bodies, but says this should be approached in a fun and healthy context. She emphasizes the importance of recognizing that every child is different, with their own strengths. Clinical psychologist Zach de Beer warns that problems with body image can have serious, lasting effects due to cultural pressures and bullying. He highlights that all forms of verbal abuse are unacceptable and can deeply affect vulnerable youth.

article_content: Bill Gates has released his annual list of suggested winter reads and listens, upholding his decade-long holiday tradition. This year, on his GatesNotes blog, Gates departs from his usual five-book list, instead highlighting three nonfiction books, an online economics course, and his personal Spotify holiday playlist. The 2023 selections delve into climate change, technological innovation, and biological evolution. Gates explains these works resonated with him, describing them as deeply informative and well-written. All of his picks this year are nonfiction. To balance weightier topics, Gates offers a holiday playlist featuring classic and modern songs from artists like Donny Hathaway, Nat King Cole, Dolly Parton, Paul McCartney, John Lennon, and Pentatonix. Here are Gates' 2023 recommendations: 1. 'The Song of the Cell' by Siddhartha Mukherjee – Gates suggests he would have enjoyed biology more if he had this book as a student. Mukherjee explores the story of human evolution through cells and explains the foundations of life and disease in clear, accessible language. 2. 'Not the End of the World: How We Can Be The First Generation To Build A Sustainable Planet' by Hannah Ritchie – Gates values Ritchie's optimistic, solutions-focused take on sustainability and climate change. Ritchie argues that sustainability has always been a challenge and addresses practical steps to make a positive impact. 3. 'Invention and Innovation: A Brief History of Hype and Failure' by Vaclav Smil – A regular in Gates' reviews, Smil brings a critical eye to current technological advancement, prompting Gates to reflect on innovation and progress. 4. 'Unexpected Economics,' an online course by Stanford Professor Timothy Taylor – Gates recommends this course for its clarity and relevance, praising Taylor’s ability to make economics engaging and accessible. 5. 'Holiday Playlist 2023' – Gates’ Spotify playlist features a mix of holiday music, from American standards to international hits. He describes holiday music as a long-standing family tradition.

Nearly one-third of the world's mine tailings are stored within or close to protected conservation areas, according to new research by the University of Queensland. The study, led by Bora Aska from UQ's Sustainable Minerals Institute and School of the Environment, warns that these waste storage facilities pose significant risks to some of Earth's most valuable species and landscapes. The findings were published in the journal Nature Sustainability.

"Mine tailings are the waste left over after mineral processing, and the structures that store them rank among the world’s largest engineered constructions," said Aska. "We identified that, out of 1,721 disclosed tailings facilities, nine percent are located within declared protected areas, while 20 percent are situated within five kilometers of such zones. Our research suggests that mine waste jeopardizes biodiversity in protected regions globally, including eight active tailings dams within Australian protected areas recognized by the International Union for Conservation of Nature."

Historical incidents illustrate these concerns. In 2015, the Samarco dam failure in Brazil resulted in 19 fatalities as a massive flood of mining waste engulfed villages, farmland, and waterways. Another collapse near Brumadinho, Brazil, in 2019 killed 270 people and devastated 133 hectares of Atlantic Forest and 70 hectares of protected areas downstream.

"Given the sheer scale of tailings facilities, we are deeply concerned about their potential risks to regions crucial for biodiversity and species conservation," said Aska. "We assessed risk by analyzing a global database of tailings facilities and comparing it with spatial data on protected areas."

Data for the study were sourced from public disclosures mandated by the Mining and Tailings Safety Initiative, launched after the Brumadinho disaster. Associate Professor Laura Sonter from UQ noted that managing mine waste will become an increasingly complex sustainability challenge as demand for energy-transition metals rises and ore grades decline over the next 30 years.

"With the current distribution of tailings facilities and historical failure rates, the consequences for biodiversity could be devastating," Sonter explained. "Fortunately, improved data collection now allows us to integrate this knowledge into the planning and management of new and existing storage sites. Moving forward, it is essential to act quickly to eliminate the negative impacts of mining waste on both people and the environment."

L’estudi, liderat per Bora Aska de l'Sustainable Minerals Institute i la School of the Environment de la UQ, adverteix que aquestes instal·lacions de residus representen riscos significatius per a algunes de les espècies i paisatges més valuosos del planeta. Els resultats han estat publicats a la revista Nature Sustainability.

«Els residus miners són els materials sobrants després del processament dels minerals, i les estructures on s’emmagatzemen es troben entre les construccions d’enginyeria més grans del món», explica Aska. «Hem identificat que, de 1.721 instal·lacions de residus declarades, un 9% es troben dins d’àrees protegides reconegudes i un 20% es situen a menys de cinc quilòmetres d’aquestes zones. La nostra recerca suggereix que els residus miners posen en perill la biodiversitat a escala mundial, inclosos vuit dipòsits actius dins d’àrees protegides a Austràlia, reconegudes per la Unió Internacional per a la Conservació de la Natura.»

Incidents històrics posen de manifest aquestes preocupacions. El 2015, el col·lapse de la presa Samarco al Brasil va causar 19 morts i va arrasar pobles, camps i rius amb residus miners. Un altre col·lapse a Brumadinho, el 2019, va provocar la mort de 270 persones i la destrucció de 133 hectàrees de bosc atlàntic i 70 hectàrees d’àrees protegides aigües avall.

«Donada la grandària d’aquestes instal·lacions, estem profundament preocupats pels riscos potencials per a zones vitals per a la biodiversitat i la conservació de les espècies», afegeix Aska. «Hem avaluat el risc analitzant una base de dades global de dipòsits de residus miners i comparant-la amb dades espacials d’àrees protegides.»

Les dades per a l’estudi provenen de les declaracions públiques requerides per la Mining and Tailings Safety Initiative, creada després del desastre de Brumadinho. L’associada Laura Sonter, de la UQ, apunta que la gestió dels residus miners serà cada vegada més complexa a mesura que augmenti la demanda de metalls per a la transició energètica i disminueixi la qualitat dels minerals durant els pròxims 30 anys.

«Amb la distribució actual de les instal·lacions i la taxa de fallades històrica, les conseqüències per a la biodiversitat podrien ser devastadores», explica Sonter. «Per sort, la millora en la recollida de dades ja permet integrar aquest coneixement en la planificació i la gestió de les instal·lacions noves i existents. Cal actuar amb rapidesa per eliminar els impactes negatius dels residus miners sobre les persones i el medi ambient.»

article_content: Amy Adams, celebrated for her roles in 'Catch Me If You Can' and 'Junebug,' reveals her passion for beauty routines and candidly shares personal beauty stories. The Colorado-born actress, who stars in 'Enchanted' and the upcoming 'Charlie Wilson's War,' jokes about her childhood mischief: 'I used to steal my older sister's pink-and-green Maybelline mascara,' she recalls. Now 33, Adams explains, 'I try to be optimistic, and sometimes that gets mistaken for innocence or naivety.' Though she laughs about outgrowing petty theft, Adams says her love for mascara—and beauty products in general—remains strong. 'If I outgrow something, I share it with friends,' she says. 'It's good to be my friend when I clean out my makeup bag!' Adams admits she's still learning makeup application, preferring to leave it to experts for important occasions. She recalls, 'When I first moved to L.A., a producer mentioned I needed more makeup for an audition. My agent had to help me apply it because I simply didn't know how.' Her makeup style stays simple, but she enjoys getting dressed up with friends. 'There's nothing like a new lip gloss to give you a lift,' she says, revealing she often carries as many as 10 glosses in her purse and has a fondness for perfumes, particularly Jo Malone scents. She doesn't stick to one signature perfume, changing it up with her moods. Skincare is a priority for Adams, who diligently reapplies sunscreen and schedules regular facials. 'My skin is very sensitive to the sun. I even got a rash after being outside with a low-SPF sunscreen,' she confides. She started seeing Marion Simms at Skin Sense in Los Angeles after experiencing skin dryness filming 'Catch Me If You Can.' To maintain her hair's richness, Adams uses Bumble and Bumble True Reds shampoo and is open to try new styles, even considering a bold switch to platinum blonde. 'There was a big change in my life when I went from blonde to red hair. People view you differently,' she notes. Her favorite beauty tool is the classic Conair hot rollers. Adams says, 'They're making a comeback! I use them while I do my makeup and then shake out the curls.' Though she once dreamed of being taller—Adams stands at 5 feet 5 inches—she has embraced her height and maintains confidence. 'I was a dancer and admired that willowy look, but now I just walk tall and wear wedges.' To create Adams's signature smoky eye makeup, Molly R. Stern used Shu Uemura in AI on her eyelids, blended with taupe shadow, green liner, beige lip pencil, and Cover Girl Wetslicks Fruit Spritzers in Guava Splash. For bouncy waves, hairstylist Andy LeCompte set Adams's hair in pin curls and finished with mousse and Klorane dry shampoo for texture.

Ara amb 33 anys, Adams explica: 'Intento ser optimista, i de vegades això es confon amb innocència o ingenuïtat.' Tot i que es pren amb humor haver superat els petits furts, Adams diu que la seva passió per la màscara de pestanyes —i per la bellesa en general— segueix intacta. 'Si ja no faig servir algun producte, el comparteixo amb les amigues', diu. 'És bo ser la meva amiga quan buido la bossa de maquillatge!' Adams reconeix que encara està aprenent a maquillar-se i prefereix que els experts s'encarreguin en esdeveniments importants. Recorda: 'Quan vaig arribar a L.A., un productor va dir que havia de portar més maquillatge per a una audició. La meva agent va haver d'ajudar-me perquè realment no en sabia.' La seva rutina de maquillatge és senzilla, però gaudeix arreglant-se per sortir amb amistats. 'No hi ha res com un nou gloss de llavis per animar-te,' explica, revelant que pot portar fins a 10 glossos a la bossa i que li encanten els perfums, especialment els de Jo Malone. No es queda amb una sola fragància, sinó que canvia segons l'estat d'ànim. La cura de la pell és una prioritat per Adams, que es torna a posar protector solar sovint i agenda facials regulars. 'La meva pell és molt sensible al sol. Fins i tot vaig tenir una erupció després d'estar fora amb un protector solar de baix SPF,' confessa. Va començar a visitar Marion Simms de Skin Sense a Los Angeles després de tenir la pell seca gravant 'Catch Me If You Can.' Per mantenir la riquesa del seu cabell, Adams utilitza el xampú Bumble and Bumble True Reds i està oberta a provar nous estils, fins i tot considera un canvi radical a ros platí. 'Va haver-hi un gran canvi quan vaig passar de rossa a pèl vermell. La gent et veu diferent,' comenta. La seva eina de bellesa preferida són els tradicionals risadors calents Conair. Adams diu: 'Estan tornant! Els faig servir mentre em maquillo i després només sacsejo els rínxols.' Tot i que de petita somiava ser més alta—Adams fa 1,65 metres—, ara accepta la seva alçada amb confiança. 'Era ballarina i admirava aquesta figura esvelta, però ara simplement camino amb el cap ben alt i porto calces altes.' Per aconseguir els ulls fumats d'Adams, Molly R. Stern va emprar Shu Uemura en AI a les parpelles, difuminat amb una ombra de tons talp, delineador verd, llapis de llavis beix i una passada de Cover Girl Wetslicks Fruit Spritzers de sabor Guava Splash. Per a ones amb volum, el perruquer Andy LeCompte va posar els cabells d'Adams en bucles amb agulles i va acabar amb escuma i xampú sec Klorane perquè tinguessin textura.

article_content: Blackpool chairman Karl Oyston has criticized Dundee United for publicly revealing the club's approach for manager Jackie McNamara. After opting not to appoint caretaker manager Barry Ferguson permanently, Blackpool made an official approach to Dundee United, who are preparing for the Scottish Cup final. Dundee United responded with a statement on their official website, rejecting the approach and confirming that McNamara would stay. Oyston, under fan pressure to secure the right appointment after narrowly avoiding relegation, told Sportsmail that he is no longer interested in pursuing McNamara. 'I'm always disappointed when clubs make public something that should remain private,' Oyston said. 'The only way to find out if another club's manager is interested is by talking to their club, which is not the same as a job offer. If I can't have a private conversation without it becoming public, I lose interest.' Meanwhile, McNamara is focusing on his team's upcoming match at Celtic Park before preparing for the Scottish Cup final against St Johnstone. He stated that nothing would distract the team from their preparations and that plans are underway to strengthen the squad for next season. 'You have to be ready for different scenarios, with players joining or leaving. We lost key players last year but added good replacements, and that's how football works,' McNamara said. Dundee United winger Gary Mackay-Steven expressed that McNamara's decision to stay is a major boost ahead of the final. Mackay-Steven praised McNamara’s impact and predicted he will have opportunities at bigger clubs in the future, emphasizing that both manager and players are content at the club.

article_content: The U.S. Air Force has withdrawn a brochure previously distributed at Shaw Air Force Base in South Carolina after a lawmaker objected to its guidance for sexual assault victims, such as advising them to consider submitting to an attack instead of resisting. The brochure contained advice that Congresswoman Louise Slaughter called victim-blaming and inappropriate, especially as the military continues to address ongoing sexual assault issues. One section read, 'If you are attacked, it may be advisable to submit rather than to resist. You have to make this decision based on circumstances. Be especially careful if the attacker has a weapon.' Some portions of the brochure also included common personal safety tips, such as checking around a car before entering and using dead-bolt locks and peepholes when home alone. The Department of Defense estimates there are 26,000 sexual assaults each year in the military. The brochure advised that if someone is accosted in a parking lot, they could 'consider rolling underneath a nearby car and screaming loudly,' noting that 'it is difficult to force someone out from under a car.' Representative Louise Slaughter, a Democrat from New York, who raised concerns about the brochure in May, released a letter she received from the Pentagon detailing the Air Force's decision and the military's ongoing efforts to address sexual assault, including a review of its prevention materials. Jessica Wright, acting undersecretary of defense, wrote to Slaughter, 'We share your concerns over some of the materials presented, and the Air Force has withdrawn the brochure from circulation.' The letter, dated June 20, was received by Slaughter's office during the previous week's congressional recess and released on Tuesday. The Pentagon's recent report estimated that up to 26,000 service members may have experienced sexual assault last year, based on an anonymous survey. Reports of sexual assaults by military personnel rose 6 percent to 3,374 in 2012, but many victims still chose not to come forward, despite enhanced oversight and assistance programs. Tia Christopher and Claire Russo, both survivors of military sexual assault, have spoken publicly about their experiences. Slaughter stated, 'No service member wearing the uniform of the United States military should ever be told it may be advisable to submit rather than to resist in the case of a sexual assault. I am cautiously optimistic about the Pentagon's agreement to review all sexual assault prevention materials. We have to change the military culture if we want to stop this epidemic of sexual assault, and this response is a step in the right direction and a small victory for victims.'

El fulletó contenia consells que la congressista Louise Slaughter va qualificar de culpabilitzadors de la víctima i inapropiats, especialment mentre les forces armades continuen lluitant contra els casos d’agressió sexual. Una secció deia: 'Si t’ataquen, podria ser millor sotmetre’t que resistir-te. Aquesta decisió s’ha de prendre segons les circumstàncies. Tingues especial cura si l’agressor porta una arma.' Excitement is mounting in Ahmedabad as the undefeated host nation, India, prepares to face Australia in the ICC Cricket World Cup final. All forms of transport—from trains and flights to chartered buses—are bringing fans to the city. On Saturday morning, the train from Mumbai was packed with cricket enthusiasts, many discussing soaring ticket resale prices. Black market rates have pushed presidential gallery tickets as high as Rs 467,000 ($5,600), far exceeding India’s median annual income, while standard tickets are being resold for 20–30 times their face value.

Even those who managed to get tickets expressed frustration over the chaotic distribution, attributed to the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), led by Jay Shah, the son of Home Minister Amit Shah. The BCCI has not disclosed how many tickets were available to the public. Some fans acquired tickets through personal connections, circumventing lengthy and often unsuccessful online queues. Meanwhile, hotel prices have surged to Rs 200,000 ($2,400) per night, and up to 200 charter flights are expected. With regular flights and trains to Mumbai sold out, many are now seeking expensive charters for return journeys.

The influx has benefited local businesses. Taxi driver Vijay Dave reported serving visitors from places including London, Goa, Pune, and Mumbai. Cinemas screening the match are sold out, and crowds have jammed the road outside the Indian team’s hotel. The team’s perfect run has further intensified excitement, with fans gathering outside stadiums and street vendors selling replica blue jerseys. Indian captain Rohit Sharma acknowledged the symbolic importance of this final, stressing the team’s focus and calm approach amid mounting expectations.

Australian captain Pat Cummins said his team aims to embrace the challenge and hopes to quiet the home crowd. The relatively small number of international fans is partly due to late schedule announcements and ongoing ticketing issues. Australian supporters have toured local landmarks, but they remain few compared to the Indian contingent.

The event promises a vibrant spectacle, featuring a drone show, a nine-aircraft display by the Indian Air Force, and a halftime concert expected to include patriotic music. The stadium anthem “Maa Tujhe Salam” (“I Salute You, Mother India”) is anticipated during a light and laser show. Australian player Glenn Maxwell previously criticized the decision to darken the stadium mid-game, stating it disrupted players’ adjustment.

Attending dignitaries include Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Australian Deputy Prime Minister Richard Marles. Modi last attended a match in Ahmedabad in March, also against Australia. While his previous appearance included a ceremonial lap, this time he is expected to present the trophy to the winners, though the outcome is undecided. Many fans believe Indian victory is likely after weeks of strong performances, with anticipation replacing the usual nerves. “This is a special team and we know that,” one supporter commented.

article_content: Australian authorities are pursuing legal action against Islamic preacher Junaid Thorne after allegations emerged that he traveled between Sydney and Perth using false identities. Thorne, a self-described sheik, was issued a notice to appear before a Perth court, an Australian Federal Police (AFP) spokesperson confirmed. Officers executed a search warrant at a residence in Bass Hill, southwest Sydney, resulting in the notice being served to 25-year-old Thorne. He is charged with allegedly using a carriage service to book a ticket under a false name and with traveling interstate using that ticket, according to The West Australian. Police have released limited information about the Sydney raid, but further charges may be possible. Reports indicate that Thorne recently relocated from Perth to Sydney. The legal proceedings follow controversy over Thorne's social media posts in the aftermath of the attacks on the satirical newspaper Charlie Hebdo in Paris. Thorne stated that insults against the Prophet Muhammad were unacceptable and likely to provoke a response. His remarks followed the attack in Paris, which resulted in 12 deaths. Thorne also referenced the magazine’s previous firebombing in 2011, suggesting that insulting the Prophet could provoke reactions in any context or religion. He commented that those who seek unlimited freedom of speech should expect others to exercise their 'freedom of action.' When contacted for comment, Thorne declined to answer questions about his statements. Australian politician Jacqui Lambie has called for Thorne to be tried for treason, criticizing previous governments for not adequately addressing extremism. Lambie stated that people who express sympathy or support for extremist acts should face consequences and urged that Thorne and other extremists be tried for treason. Thorne, who spent 14 years in Saudi Arabia, previously appeared at a court proceeding for terror suspect Sulayman Khalid. In an interview with ABC, Thorne clarified that he does not describe himself as a supporter of Islamic State, but said he agrees with the group on some issues and disagrees on others. Khalid, whom Thorne accompanied to court, was charged with terrorism-related offenses, including an alleged plot in the Blue Mountains. He gained media attention for wearing an Islamic State symbol on a television program. Thorne has previously criticized Australian authorities, referring to them as ‘the real terrorists’ after anti-terror raids last September. He also commented on the case of Numan Haider, an 18-year-old shot by police, claiming Haider was ‘murdered by authorities.’ Thorne confirmed that Haider had attended some of his lectures. Thorne’s views have drawn public scrutiny over the past year. In interviews, he remarked that fully supporting Islamic State would cause problems for him, but that claiming he did not agree with them at all would be untruthful. These events have reignited debates about extremism, freedom of speech, and national security.

Lambie va dir que les persones que expressen simpatia o suport a actes extremistes han d’assumir conseqüències, i va demanar que Thorne i altres siguin jutjats per traïció. London, England (CNN) -- British Prime Minister Gordon Brown’s offer to resign as part of a strategy to form a coalition government with the Liberal Democrats, rather than seeing David Cameron’s Conservatives take power, received mixed reactions from the UK press on Tuesday. In a statement outside Downing Street on Monday, Brown said he would stand down as Labour leader in the autumn, opening up the leadership contest.

The Times observed that Brown took decisive action as Tony Blair once predicted, pausing the Conservative advance toward Downing Street. The paper emphasized the timing of Brown’s announcement, coming after four days of negotiations between David Cameron and Nick Clegg. It further noted that Brown recognized his continued leadership could block Labour’s hopes of staying in power, with even his closest allies admitting over the weekend that his time as leader was nearly over.

The Sun, a major tabloid owned by News Corp, described the situation as chaotic, claiming Brown’s decision had placed the UK in political uncertainty, with the formation of a new government delayed.

The Daily Mail, known for its right-leaning perspective, called Brown’s offer "a squalid day for democracy," citing criticism from senior Labour figures who opposed a deal with the Liberal Democrats that could deny David Cameron the role of Prime Minister. Former Home Secretary David Blunkett warned that the public might feel their voices were being ignored by such arrangements.

The Times also reported that Labour strategists Peter Mandelson and Alastair Campbell were central to the party’s plan and that Nick Clegg and the Liberal Democrats were accused of holding discussions with Labour while still formally negotiating with the Conservatives.

The Telegraph described Brown’s move as a "Labour coup," suggesting that Labour was trying to take advantage of the Conservatives’ hesitance to offer the Liberal Democrats significant electoral reform. Labour proposed a referendum on a proportional representation voting system, a major issue for the Liberal Democrats.

The Guardian, a left-leaning paper, said Brown’s move forced the Conservatives to make an "extraordinary" counter-offer: a referendum on the alternative vote electoral system and potential cabinet positions for the Liberal Democrats. Shocked Conservative MPs reportedly quickly accepted this new position.

The Mirror, which supports Labour, praised Brown’s decision as selfless, stating that he stepped aside for the good of the country.

En una declaració davant de Downing Street, dilluns, Brown va anunciar que deixaria el càrrec de líder laborista a la tardor, obrint el procés de successió.

The Times va fer notar que Brown va actuar amb decisió, com Tony Blair havia predit, aturant l’avenç dels conservadors cap a Downing Street. El diari va destacar el moment de l’anunci de Brown, després de quatre dies de negociacions entre David Cameron i Nick Clegg. També va assenyalar que Brown era conscient que mantenir-se al capdavant podria impedir que els laboristes seguissin al govern, i que fins i tot els seus aliats més propers admetien el cap de setmana que el seu temps com a líder s’acabava.

The Sun, un tabloide important propietat de News Corp, va qualificar la situació de caòtica, afirmant que la decisió de Brown havia sembrat una incertesa política al Regne Unit i havia endarrerit la formació d’un nou govern.

The Daily Mail, conegut pel seu perfil conservador, va descriure l’oferta de Brown com "un dia miserable per la democràcia", recollint crítiques de figures laboristes veteteranes que amenaçaven un acord amb els Liberal Demòcrates que podia impedir que David Cameron fos primer ministre. L’exministre de l’Interior David Blunkett va dir que la ciutadania podria sentir-se ignorada amb aquest acord.

The Times també va informar que els estrategues laboristes Peter Mandelson i Alastair Campbell eren fonamentals en el pla, i que Nick Clegg i els Liberal Demòcrates van ser acusats de negociar amb els laboristes mentre encara parlaven oficialment amb els conservadors.

The Telegraph va descriure el moviment de Brown com "un cop laborista", suggerint que el partit intentava aprofitar la reticència dels conservadors a oferir una reforma electoral substancial als Liberal Demòcrates. Els laboristes van proposar un referèndum sobre el sistema de representació proporcional, un dels temes centrals pels Liberal Demòcrates.

The Guardian, un diari d’esquerres, va dir que la decisió de Brown va portar els conservadors a fer una "contraoferta extraordinària": un referèndum sobre el sistema de vot alternatiu i la possibilitat que els Liberal Demòcrates tinguessin llocs al gabinet. Segons The Guardian, els diputats conservadors van acceptar de pressa la nova proposta.

The Mirror, que dona suport als laboristes, va lloar la decisió de Brown considerant-la altruista i assegurant que va posar els interessos del país per davant dels seus.

article_content: On Monday, pharmacy staff at dozens of Walgreens locations walked off the job, demanding higher staffing levels and enhanced safety measures. The collective action appeared to be organized organically, largely through Reddit and other social media networks, where participants described persistent issues with overwhelming workloads and insufficient support from Walgreens management. 'We need a bigger budget, more staff, and proper safety regulations to serve our customers,' one Reddit post stated. The walkout participants include pharmacists, technicians, and support staff. In a statement to Insider, a Walgreens spokesperson acknowledged the significant efforts made by team members over the past few years, noting the challenges they have faced. Walgreens emphasized it is 'engaged and listening' to worker concerns, committed to offering resources and support, and making 'significant investments' in employee wages and hiring bonuses to increase staffing. Walgreens operates around 9,000 locations across the U.S., but as of Monday morning, a comprehensive list of affected stores was unavailable. Work stoppages are expected to continue into Tuesday and Wednesday, according to media reports. The theme of unsafe and unhealthy working conditions due to inadequate staffing and rising demands was prevalent in the most recent quarterly survey conducted by the American Pharmacists Association (APhA). Most respondents reported working off the clock, taking extra shifts, and skipping breaks to care for patients and maintain their jobs. According to the APhA report, this period was marked by pharmacists being pressured to perform illegal actions, minimize concerns about unsafe conditions, and tolerate abusive or hostile behavior from customers and managers. Respondents also reported handling high-risk workloads with untrained or undertrained coworkers, under inexperienced management. Similar issues led pharmacy workers at CVS locations in Kansas City to stage a walkout in September. 'They keep stretching us thinner and thinner,' a pharmacist told the Kansas City Star, explaining they regularly worked 10-hour days with no time for bathroom or lunch breaks. The newspaper granted the source anonymity, noting that CVS has a policy of terminating employees who speak to the media. 'When you're expected to work under those conditions, mistakes are inevitable,' the pharmacist added. 'Eventually, a pharmacist could lose their license, face a lawsuit, or a patient could be harmed because drug allergies or interactions weren’t checked—directly resulting from these policies.' In a blog post last week, APhA CEO Michael Hogue described the pharmacy industry as 'facing an inflection point.' He wrote, 'The exhaustion, worry, and frustration many of you are experiencing is real. Pharmacists have been asked to fulfill their roles in healthcare without enough staff support for far too long. Corporations and health systems need to do more—and urgently.' Hogue also expressed support for workers who have withdrawn from unsafe work conditions, such as harassment and understaffing. 'I'm not going to ask for patience; we've all been patient long enough,' he concluded.

'Quan t'exigeixen treballar en aquestes condicions, els errors són inevitables,' va afegir el farmacèutic. 'Arribarà un moment que un farmacèutic perdrà la llicència, tindrà una denúncia, o algun pacient patirà danys perquè no s'han comprovat al·lèrgies o interaccions, i serà per culpa d'aquestes polítiques.' article_content: 1. Hamburger – Louis' Lunch, New Haven, Connecticut: Multiple sources claim to have invented the hamburger, but both Louis' Lunch and the Library of Congress credit this New Haven restaurant. In 1900, owner Louis Lassen created a quick meal for a customer by placing a beef patty between two pieces of bread. This simple invention paved the way for what’s now a classic sandwich. The restaurant is still family owned, still cooks burgers on old gas stoves, and ketchup is still not permitted. 2. Fried Twinkie – The ChipShop, Brooklyn, New York: The idea of deep-frying a Twinkie was popularized by Christopher Sell, owner of the ChipShop. Drawing inspiration from his experience frying sweets in England, Sell froze Twinkies, dipped them in batter, and deep-fried them, creating a crispy and soft dessert that won high praise from food critics. 3. Root Beer Float – Myers Avenue Red Soda Co., Cripple Creek, Colorado: In 1893, Frank J. Wisner, while looking at a moonlit, snow-covered mountain, thought to float vanilla ice cream in his root beer, creating the 'black cow,' now known as the root beer float. The drink quickly became a favorite. 4. Corn Dogs – Cozy Dog Drive In, Springfield, Illinois: Ed Waldmire, Jr. introduced the world to the Cozy Dog, the first corn dog served on a stick, in 1946. Initially called 'Crusty Cur,' the sandwich was renamed by Waldmire’s wife to 'Cozy Dog.' The drive-in has served them along Route 66 since then. 5. Pizzeria – Lombardi's, New York City, New York: Lombardi's, opened by Gennaro Lombardi in 1905, holds the distinction of America’s first licensed pizzeria. Anthony 'Totonno' Pero began selling pizzas from the store, leading to its exclusive focus on pizza. After closing in 1984, Lombardi's reopened nearby and celebrated its 100th year by offering pies for five cents each, the original 1905 price. 6. Fat Darrell – R.U. Hungry, New Brunswick, New Jersey: In 1997, student Darrell W. Butler at Rutgers University requested a sandwich combining chicken fingers, mozzarella sticks, French fries, and marinara sauce at the university's 'Grease Trucks.' The Fat Darrell quickly became a hit, even gaining national attention. 7. Philly Cheesesteak – Pat's King of Steaks, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania: Pat and Harry Olivieri created the first steak and onion sandwich in 1932 at their stand, which evolved into Pat’s King of Steaks. The origin of adding cheese is disputed between Pat’s and rival Geno’s Steaks, but the cheesesteak is now an iconic Philadelphia dish. 8. Onion Rings – Pig Stand, Dallas, Texas: The invention of the onion ring is credited to a cook at Pig Stand in Dallas, who accidentally fried a battered onion. The chain also claims innovation with the first drive-in, Texas toast, and neon sign promotion. 9. Derby Pie – Melrose Inn, Prospect, Kentucky: The Kern family created Derby pie, a chocolate-pecan tart, at the Melrose Inn during the 1950s. The pie’s recipe remains a secret, and authentic Derby-Pie® is made exclusively by Kern’s Kitchen, Inc.

El 1900, el propietari Louis Lassen va crear un àpat ràpid posant una hamburguesa de vedella entre dues llesques de pa per a un client amb pressa. Anelles de ceba – Pig Stand, Dallas, Texas: Es diu que una cuinera de Pig Stand, a Dallas, va inventar les anelles de ceba quan va fregir per error una rodanxa arrebossada. La cadena també reivindica la creació del primer drive-in, la Texas toast i la promoció amb rètols de neó. 9. Derby Pie – Melrose Inn, Prospect, Kentucky: La família Kern va crear el Derby Pie, una tarta de xocolata i nous pecanes, al Melrose Inn a la dècada dels 50. article_content: A US military Osprey aircraft crashed in waters off Japan's Yakushima Island, leaving at least one person dead. Japan's Coast Guard confirmed that six people were on the aircraft, updating earlier reports of eight. Currently, no details are available about the remaining passengers or the reason for the crash. Authorities received the alert around 2:47 p.m. local time and immediately sent rescue teams to the area. The Yakushima Airport Management Office later received an emergency landing request from the US military, though it's unclear if it involved the Marines or Air Force. This incident adds to a series of Osprey crashes over the years. The Osprey, praised for its ability to take off like a helicopter but cruise like a plane, has struggled with mechanical and operational problems since the 1980s. CNN's military analyst and retired Air Force Colonel Cedric Leighton noted its versatility but ongoing safety concerns. Earlier crashes have resulted in fatalities, including in Australia (2023), as well as California and Norway (2022). Although generally regarded as safe, repeated issues continue to raise questions. Authorities are investigating this latest accident to determine its cause.

Ofqual, the UK's exams regulator, suggests that A-level exams in modern languages may be too demanding, with significantly fewer students achieving the top A* grade compared to subjects like maths. Recent data shows that only around 7% of students taking French, Spanish, or German A-levels attained an A*, while the figure is approximately 17% for maths and nearly 29% for further maths. As a result, Ofqual is considering changes to language exams to make it easier for students to earn the highest marks, although no immediate reforms are planned.

This idea contrasts with the government's current direction, as Education Secretary Michael Gove has advocated for tougher exams and measures to combat grade inflation, such as prioritizing final exams over modular testing and restricting opportunities for repeat attempts.

Ofqual's recent report highlights two issues: the smaller proportion of top grades in languages and inconsistencies in A and A* grade distribution across subjects and years. The aim is to make grading standards more consistent and fair.

Education experts note that language exams often require interpretation and a high level of fluency, making top grades harder to achieve, whereas maths exams tend to allow for straightforward answers and objective scoring.

Les dades recents mostren que només prop del 7% dels alumnes de francès, espanyol o alemany obtenen un A*, mentre que la xifra puja fins al 17% en matemàtiques i gairebé al 29% en matemàtiques avançades. Per això, Ofqual està valorant canvis als exàmens d'idiomes perquè sigui més accessible assolir les notes més altes, encara que no hi ha reformes immediates previstes.

article_content: Most three-year-olds look forward to summer so they can play outside for hours, but for Eddison Miller, sunlight can cause his skin to blister and burn severely. Eddison is one of the youngest people diagnosed with xeroderma pigmentosum (XP), a rare and incurable genetic disorder that makes him extremely sensitive to all UV rays. Eddison's parents, Nicola and Andrew Miller, strive to keep his life as normal as possible. However, every part of his body must be covered by UV-protective clothing whenever he goes outdoors. This includes gloves, a hat with a special visor covering his face, neck, and shoulders, and clothing that blocks UV rays. Diagnosed with XP at just three months old, Eddison is at greatly increased risk of developing skin cancer from sunlight exposure. XP affects fewer than 100 people in the UK and about 2,000 worldwide. To protect Eddison, his skin must be covered in SPF 50+ sunblock every three hours, and he plays in a specially-designed indoor garden when outside is too bright. XP is a life-altering hereditary condition characterized by extreme sensitivity to ultraviolet light, found in both sunlight and many artificial sources. If not fully protected, those with XP can suffer severe skin and eye damage, which can lead to cancer. About 30% of XP patients also develop neurological issues, such as hearing loss and loss of mobility. Although there is no cure, measures like avoiding daylight, wearing specialized clothing, and using sunscreens can help manage the condition. Regular skin, eye, and neurological exams, along with prompt treatment of cancerous tissue, are also necessary. Eddison's mother, Nicola, explained how their lives changed after his diagnosis. They must prevent him from exposure to UV rays even inside their home, with an air conditioning system installed because windows cannot be opened safely. Despite these challenges, Eddison enjoys playing in his sandpit, riding his bike, and spending time with his little brother, Raife. His parents’ main goal is to help him live as normal a life as possible. Eddison's family also works to inform others about XP through the Teddington Trust, founded by Eddison’s aunt Rebecca Stewart. The Trust supports affected families and has launched teddy bears and children's books, called ‘Little Ted’, that help educate children about XP. The family aims to provide these resources free to all children worldwide affected by the condition. Book illustrator Michael Howdon and printing company Parkers Design & Print have joined the initiative, expressing their pride in supporting XP families with these materials. Donations can be made via the Teddington Trust website. Eddison’s mother noted that last summer, they spent less than 24 hours outdoors in six weeks due to the risk. Eddison is able to play outside at night, when it is safe from UV exposure.

L'Eddison és una de les persones més joves diagnosticades amb xerodèrmia pigmentosa (XP), un trastorn genètic rar i incurable que el fa extremadament sensible a tots els raigs UV. Els pares de l'Eddison, la Nicola i l'Andrew Miller, intenten que la seva vida sigui el més normal possible. Tot i que no hi ha cura, mesures com evitar la llum del dia, portar roba especialitzada i utilitzar protectors solars poden ajudar a gestionar la condició. Són necessaris exàmens regulars de pell, ulls i neurologia, així com l'eliminació ràpida de teixit cancerigen. L'objectiu principal dels seus pares és que pugui viure una vida tan normal com sigui possible. La família també treballa per informar altres persones sobre el XP a través de la Teddington Trust, fundada per la tieta de l'Eddison, la Rebecca Stewart. La Fundació dóna suport a famílies afectades i ha creat peluixos i llibres infantils, anomenats 'Little Ted', que ajuden a educar infants sobre el XP. La família vol oferir aquests recursos gratuïtament a tots els infants d'arreu del món que pateixen aquesta condició. L'il·lustrador del llibre, en Michael Howdon, i l'empresa d'impremta Parkers Design & Print s'han unit a la iniciativa i han expressat el seu orgull de donar suport a les famílies amb XP. Es poden fer donacions al web de la Teddington Trust. La mare de l'Eddison va comentar que l'estiu passat només van passar 24 hores a l'exterior en sis setmanes a causa del risc. L'Eddison pot jugar a l'aire lliure a la nit, quan és segur pel que fa als raigs UV.

article_content: Drinking between two and four cups of coffee daily may reduce the risk of suicide in men and women by 50%, according to new research. Researchers at the Harvard School of Public Health analyzed data from three prior US studies and found that adults who consumed several cups of caffeinated coffee each day had about half the risk of suicide compared to those who drank decaffeinated coffee, little coffee, or none at all. The study involved 200,000 men and women. It examined their caffeine consumption from both coffee and other sources, such as tea, caffeinated soft drinks, and chocolate. For most participants, coffee was their main source of caffeine. Over an average 6.5-year follow-up period, there were 277 reported deaths by suicide. Lead researcher Michel Lucas, a research fellow in the Department of Nutrition at HSPH, explained that this study, unlike previous ones, was able to compare the effects of caffeinated versus non-caffeinated beverages and identified caffeine as the likely protective factor in coffee. Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system and may act as a mild antidepressant by increasing production of neurotransmitters associated with positive mood, such as serotonin, dopamine, and noradrenaline. The researchers noted that this could explain why other studies have also found lower depression rates among coffee drinkers. Despite these findings, the authors caution against using caffeine or coffee to self-medicate depression, as high intakes could lead to adverse effects. Previous research has even found that people drinking more than eight cups of coffee per day had an increased suicide risk. Overall, the authors suggest that consuming more than two to three cups of coffee (or over 400 mg of caffeine) daily provides little additional benefit. They did not observe a significant difference in risk between those drinking two to three cups and those drinking four or more cups per day, likely due to the small number of suicide cases in these groups. A previous Finnish study found that people drinking eight or nine cups of coffee per day had a higher risk of suicide. However, very few participants in the Harvard studies consumed such high amounts, so the effects of drinking six or more cups daily were not addressed.

Investigadors de l'Escola de Salut Pública de Harvard van analitzar dades de tres estudis nord-americans previs i van descobrir que els adults que consumien diverses tasses de cafè amb cafeïna al dia tenien aproximadament la meitat de risc de suïcidi que aquells que prenien cafè descafeïnat, poc cafè o gens. L'estudi va incloure 200.000 homes i dones. Es va analitzar el seu consum de cafeïna tant procedent del cafè com d'altres fonts, com ara el te, refrescos amb cafeïna i xocolata. Per a la majoria de participants, el cafè era la font principal de cafeïna. Durant una mitjana de seguiment de 6,5 anys, es van registrar 277 morts per suïcidi. Segons el principal investigador Michel Lucas, col·laborador del Departament de Nutrició a l'HSPH, aquest estudi, a diferència d'anteriors, va poder comparar els efectes de les begudes amb i sense cafeïna i va identificar la cafeïna com el factor protector probable del cafè. La cafeïna estimula el sistema nerviós central i pot actuar com un antidepressiu suau augmentant la producció de neurotransmissors associats amb l'estat d'ànim positiu, com la serotonina, la dopamina i la noradrenalina. Els investigadors van assenyalar que això podria explicar perquè altres estudis també han detectat menors taxes de depressió entre els bevedors de cafè. Tot i aquests resultats, els autors recomanen no utilitzar el cafè o la cafeïna per automedicar-se contra la depressió, ja que un consum elevat pot tenir efectes adversos. De fet, recerques prèvies han trobat que consumir més de vuit tasses de cafè diàries augmenta el risc de suïcidi. En general, els autors suggereixen que prendre més de dues o tres tasses de cafè diàries (o més de 400 mg de cafeïna) aporta poc benefici addicional. No van observar una diferència significativa de risc entre aquells que prenien dues o tres tasses i els que en prenien quatre o més, probablement degut al baix nombre de casos de suïcidi en aquests grups. Un estudi finlandès anterior va mostrar que les persones que prenien vuit o nou tasses de cafè al dia presentaven un major risc de suïcidi. Tanmateix, molt pocs participants dels estudis de Harvard consumien quantitats tan elevades, de manera que els efectes de beure sis o més tasses diàries no es van abordar.

article_content:
Fast fashion—a global, multibillion-dollar industry—allows consumers to quickly and affordably update their wardrobes with the latest trends. Prominent brands like Shein, Fashion Nova, Temu, Zara, and H&M drive this sector, which is estimated to be worth around $100 billion worldwide.

Nevertheless, fast fashion brings significant challenges. The rapid production cycle results in substantial environmental consequences, with about 100 billion new garments produced annually and roughly 50 billion discarded within a year. In the United States, 85% of discarded textiles end up in landfills or are incinerated. According to the World Health Organization, the fashion industry accounts for about 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions and 20% of water pollution from textile dyeing.

Tariff avoidance is also a notable concern. Companies frequently ship products directly to consumers in small packages, often benefiting from import duty exemptions—such as the U.S. rule waiving duties for shipments valued under $800. Similar concerns about proper tariff collection have emerged in South Africa and Brazil.

To address these issues, some countries are considering or have implemented tax measures. The UK has discussed garment levies and VAT reductions for clothing repair services. Australia introduced a voluntary 4-cent-per-item garment levy, though manufacturer participation has been limited. The European Union encourages member states to develop tax policies that support sustainable textiles. Sweden has considered a chemical tax on clothing and footwear, while Brazil is exploring digital taxes for low-value imports.

Despite these policy initiatives, the effectiveness of tax solutions remains debated. While small levies may not deter most consumers from purchasing inexpensive fast fashion, they could help fund recycling programs or environmental initiatives. As governments aim to meet environmental commitments, taxes are increasingly considered as potential tools to mitigate the adverse effects of fast fashion.

La moda ràpida —una indústria global multimilionària— permet als consumidors renovar el vestuari de manera ràpida i assequible seguint les últimes tendències. Marques capdavanteres com Shein, Fashion Nova, Temu, Zara i H&M dominen un sector valorat en uns 100.000 milions de dòlars arreu del món.

Tot i així, la moda ràpida comporta desafiaments importants. Els seus cicles de producció accelerats provoquen un gran impacte ambiental: es produeixen uns 100.000 milions de peces anualment i prop de 50.000 milions es descarten en només un any. Als Estats Units, el 85% d’aquestes peces descartades van a parar a abocadors o s’incineren. Segons l’Organització Mundial de la Salut, la indústria tèxtil representa aproximadament el 10% de les emissions globals de gasos d’efecte hivernacle i el 20% de la contaminació de l’aigua pel tenyit tèxtil.

L’evasió de tarifes és també un dilema rellevant. Les empreses envien productes directament als consumidors en paquets petits, aprofitant exempcions d’impostos d’importació (com la normativa dels EUA que eximeix d’aranzels les expedicions per sota de 800 dòlars). Preocupacions semblants han sorgit a Sud-àfrica i Brasil sobre la recaptació correcta de tarifes.

Per abordar aquests problemes, alguns països han proposat o aplicat mesures fiscals. El Regne Unit ha estudiat la imposició de gravàmens sobre la roba i reduccions de l’IVA per serveis de reparació tèxtil. Austràlia ha introduït un impost voluntari de 4 cèntims per peça, tot i que la participació dels fabricants és baixa. La Unió Europea anima els estats membres a dissenyar polítiques fiscals que promoguin els tèxtils sostenibles. Suècia ha considerat un impost químic per a la roba i el calçat, mentre que el Brasil estudia impostos digitals per a importacions de baix valor.

Tot i aquestes iniciatives, hi ha debat sobre l’eficàcia real de les solucions fiscals. Malgrat que petits gravàmens difícilment desanimen els consumidors a comprar moda ràpida, podrien finançar programes de reciclatge o projectes mediambientals. Els governs, en la seva missió de complir compromisos ecològics, veuen cada cop més la fiscalitat com a eina per mitigar els efectes negatius de la moda ràpida.

article_content: The first onesies were often dismissed as little more than adult romper suits. Made from cotton or polyester, these affordable fleecy outfits provided warmth and convenience, particularly for those unbothered by their resemblance to oversized toddler wear. Nevertheless, the onesie quickly transitioned from at-home loungewear to a noticeable high street trend, serving both as a quirky fashion statement and as popular fancy dress. Now, in time for Christmas, Marks & Spencer has introduced a luxury version made from pure cashmere wool, available in black or grey for £199. M&S describes this cashmere onesie as 'the epitome of luxury,' promising that 'this sumptuous cashmere onesie will keep you snug and stylish from head to toe.' The word 'onesie' originated with American baby goods manufacturer Gerber, which used it as a brand name for an all-in-one suit for toddlers. A recent M&S ad campaign, photographed by Annie Leibovitz and starring David Gandy and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, has received mixed reactions from the public and press, but has not led to an increase in clothing sales. In fact, sales are reportedly down. Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, who also launched her 'Rosie for Autograph' lingerie collection with Marks & Spencer, has seen strong success with that line, making it the store’s most successful underwear range. Originally marketed as thermal sleepwear for adults, onesies have become a fashion phenomenon over the last six years, propelled by celebrity endorsements. Well-known figures such as Brad Pitt, Holly Willoughby, Amanda Holden, members of One Direction, and Olympian Tom Daley have all been seen wearing them in public. Just as the shell suit was a defining trend in the 1980s, the onesie has become emblematic of current generational fashion tastes. While shell suits eventually fell out of favor after being linked with certain social groups, M&S is hoping the onesie trend will last—at least through Christmas. The company is set to release its latest sales figures on Tuesday, amidst speculation that their women’s fashion sales have not rebounded as expected. This would be disappointing for the retailer, which recently invested £5 million in a star-studded advertising campaign, featuring Dame Helen Mirren and Tracey Emin, in support of its well-received autumn collection.

Tot i així, l'onesie va passar ràpidament de ser roba per estar per casa a una tendència visible als carrers, convertint-se tant en una declaració de moda original com en una disfressa divertida. Ara, per Nadal, Marks & Spencer ha presentat una versió de luxe feta de llana de caixmir pura, disponible en negre o gris per £199. Inicialment comercialitzats com a pijames tèrmics per adults, els onesies s'han convertit en un fenomen de moda durant els darrers sis anys, impulsats pel suport de celebritats. Persones famoses com Brad Pitt, Holly Willoughby, Amanda Holden, membres de One Direction i l'olímpic Tom Daley han estat vistos portant-los en públic. Igual que el 'shell suit' va ser una tendència emblemàtica dels anys vuitanta, l'onesie s'ha convertit en símbol de l'estil de la generació actual. Això seria decebedor per a l'empresa, que recentment ha invertit cinc milions de lliures en una campanya publicitària plena d'estrelles, amb Dame Helen Mirren i Tracey Emin, per promocionar la seva col·lecció de tardor, ben rebuda pel públic.

Social media quickly filled with humorous and creative reactions, including viral memes and parodies using scenes from popular movies such as 'Spider-Man', 'The Simpsons', 'Terminator', and India's 'Baahubali'. One widely shared deepfake video showed Altman inserted as Norman Osborn experiencing a corporate ousting. While rumors swirled online, OpenAI hasn’t given an official explanation for Altman’s departure. 

In a public statement, OpenAI emphasized its commitment to developing AI for the benefit of everyone and asserted that new leadership is required for its next phase. Sam Altman addressed the situation positively on social media, expressing appreciation for his time at OpenAI and hinting at future plans. CTO Mira Murati has been named interim CEO. Microsoft, a major investor in OpenAI, reiterated its support, with CEO Satya Nadella expressing ongoing confidence in their partnership and its global impact.

article_content: Hurricane Otis, a Category 5 storm, made landfall near the Pacific resort city of Acapulco, Mexico, early Wednesday. According to the US National Hurricane Center (NHC), Otis arrived with maximum sustained winds of 165 miles (265 kilometers) per hour after rapidly intensifying to the top tier on the Saffir-Simpson scale. The NHC issued warnings of potentially 'catastrophic' damage, especially in areas directly impacted by the hurricane's core. President Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador used social media to urge residents to relocate to emergency shelters and stay clear of rivers, streams, and ravines. Ahead of landfall, soldiers patrolled Acapulco’s beaches as locals and tourists enjoyed the calm before the storm. 'We won't be running any tours today,' said boat operator Carolina Torres, expressing hope that the storm would weaken before hitting. 'If it hits us, that's very serious for us,' she added. The NHC forecasted rainfall totals of up to 20 inches (51 centimeters) across Guerrero and parts of neighboring Oaxaca state, warning of the high potential for flash floods, urban flooding, and mudslides in mountainous areas. The US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration released satellite imagery of Hurricane Otis approaching Mexico’s southern Pacific coast. NHC advisories also cautioned of a 'potentially catastrophic storm surge' likely to cause life-threatening coastal flooding. Mexico is frequently struck by hurricanes along both its Pacific and Atlantic coasts between May and November, but Category 5 landfalls are rare. In October 1997, Category 4 Hurricane Pauline killed over 200 people, many in Acapulco, making it one of the deadliest storms in Mexican history. Category 5 Hurricane Patricia in October 2015 brought winds of 200 mph but caused only material damage and no deaths as it made landfall in a sparsely populated region. More recently, Tropical Storm Norma claimed three lives—including a child—after making landfall twice in Sinaloa, and earlier this month, Hurricane Lidia resulted in two deaths after striking Jalisco and Nayarit as a Category 4 storm. In August, Hurricane Hilary, briefly a Category 4, caused one death and infrastructure damage in Baja California. Scientists warn that hurricanes are growing stronger due to global warming.

El NHC va emetre advertiments sobre danys potencialment “catastròfics”, especialment a les zones directament impactades pel nucli de l’huracà. article_content: In February, during Black History Month, networks and major brands typically honor the achievements of African-Americans in the arts, politics, technology, and commerce through annual ad campaigns. This year, the Republican National Committee (RNC) has joined in, sponsoring its first-ever Black History Month ads. These advertisements, broadcast on Black radio and television stations in selected markets, highlight Black Republicans like Louis Sullivan, the former Secretary of Health and Human Services under President George H.W. Bush. This initiative represents the RNC's first ad buy for Black History Month and is part of a larger strategy to reach minority voters. After President Barack Obama received strong support from Black, Latino, and Asian-American voters in the 2012 presidential election—93% among Black voters—the RNC stepped up efforts to engage minority communities. The current ad campaign is part of this broader outreach. However, uplifting advertisements alone are unlikely to persuade Black Democrats to change their party affiliation. While promoting leaders like Senator Tim Scott, the party continues to grapple with controversies caused by insensitive racial comments from some officials. For example, the Iowa Republican Party recently let go of the creator of a Facebook flowchart that flippantly claimed racists are 'white people you don't like.' The RNC’s effort to build a 'new generation of Black Republicans' brings up questions about why Black voters do not hold Democrats and liberals equally accountable for racial missteps. The article notes cases such as criticism of MSNBC for remarks about the Romney family's adoption and Fox News host Bill O’Reilly’s interview with President Obama. These dynamics are shaped by a long history of race and party politics, as well as psychological perspectives that the GOP may be overlooking. Some Republicans point out southern Democrats’ resistance to civil rights laws in the past but often do not acknowledge that many white Southern Democrats eventually switched to the Republican Party after the civil rights movement. The GOP has also admitted using racially coded language to appeal to some voters. While Black political attitudes have moderated somewhat in recent generations, many in the community continue to favor a strong federal government, which they see as better at protecting civil rights than state or local governments. Group identity and shared interests significantly shape the political choices of Black and Latino Americans. For example, a financially secure Black individual might support higher taxes to maintain social programs like food assistance, which disproportionately helps minority groups. Overall, the article calls the GOP’s increased engagement with Black voters a good development, but stresses that well-produced ad campaigns are not enough. To truly resonate with Black communities, Republicans must address group identity and frame their principles to align with group interests. The commentary reflects the personal views of Andra Gillespie.

Enguany, el Comitè Nacional Republicà (RNC) s’hi ha sumat per primera vegada amb anuncis pel Mes de la Història Negra. Aquests anuncis, que s’emeten a emissores de ràdio i televisió destinades a públic afroamericà en alguns mercats seleccionats, posen en valor republicans negres com Louis Sullivan, exsecretari de Salut i Serveis Humans sota el president George H.W. Després que el president Barack Obama obtingués un gran suport dels votants negres, llatins i asiàtics a les eleccions presidencials del 2012—el 93% entre els votants negres—el RNC va intensificar els esforços per connectar amb les comunitats minoritàries. L’actual campanya d’anuncis s’emmarca dins d’aquest objectiu més ampli. Tanmateix, només amb anuncis motivadors difícilment es convenceran els demòcrates negres perquè canviïn d’afiliació política. Tot i promocionar figures com el senador Tim Scott, el partit s’enfronta a controvèrsies provocades per comentaris racials insensibles d’alguns membres. Per exemple, el Partit Republicà d’Iowa va acomiadar recentment l’autor d’un diagrama publicat a Facebook que trivialitzava el concepte de racisme, dient que els racistes són ‘persones blanques que no t’agraden’. L’intent del RNC d’impulsar una ‘nova generació de republicans negres’ planteja qüestions sobre per què els votants negres no exigeixen la mateixa responsabilitat a demòcrates i liberals pels seus errors racials. L’article cita casos com la polèmica generada per comentaris de MSNBC sobre l’adopció de la família Romney i la crítica al presentador de Fox News Bill O’Reilly per la seva entrevista amb Obama. Aquests fenòmens responen a una llarga història de política racial i afiliació de partit, així com a factors psicològics que potser el Partit Republicà no té prou en compte. Alguns republicans remarquen l’oposició dels demòcrates del sud als drets civils en el passat, però solen oblidar que molts d’aquests demòcrates blancs van passar al Partit Republicà després del moviment pels drets civils. El propi partit ha reconegut l’ús de llenguatge codificat amb connotacions racials per atraure certs sectors. Tot i que les actituds polítiques dels negres s’han moderat en les darreres generacions, molts continuen defensant un govern federal fort, que perceben com a més eficaç a protegir els drets civils que les administracions estatals o locals. La identitat de grup i els interessos compartits influeixen notablement en les decisions polítiques dels afroamericans i llatins. Per exemple, una persona negra amb una bona posició econòmica pot avalar impostos més elevats per mantenir programes socials com les ajudes alimentàries, que beneficien de manera desproporcionada les minories. En definitiva, l’article veu positivament que el GOP augmenti l’atenció vers els votants negres, però destaca que campanyes d’anuncis ben produïdes no són suficients. Per connectar realment amb la comunitat negra, els republicans han de considerar la identitat de grup i adaptar els seus missatges a aquests interessos col·lectius. Aquest és un comentari de l’Andra Gillespie i reflecteix opinions personals.

article_content: Phil has worked in corporate finance for 37 years and is the CEO of Global Financial Services, Global Financial Training Program, and Global Church Financing. The Covid-19 pandemic brought the global economy to a halt, affecting every industry—including real estate. With businesses shuttered and employees moving to remote work, the commercial real estate (CRE) sector experienced significant shifts. Now, more than two years later, we can properly examine the challenges CRE faced and analyze how these changes affect us today. Before the pandemic, commercial real estate showed continuous growth. Office spaces were in high demand, retail properties were filled, and the hospitality sector was thriving. Investors and developers were eager to expand, and loans were easily accessible with favorable terms. The pandemic was a game-changer for CRE. Office buildings sat empty, malls and hotels saw severe demand reductions, and many businesses had to quickly adapt. Remote work became standard, with companies like Twitter and Square allowing permanent work-from-home. Office occupancy and rents dropped; some businesses downsized or exited the office market entirely. Retailers faced challenges as foot traffic dwindled due to lockdowns and e-commerce growth. Chains such as JCPenney and Neiman Marcus filed for bankruptcy, prompting malls to focus on experiences and services instead of traditional retail. Many small businesses found it unsustainable to keep physical storefronts. Hotels experienced some of the harshest impacts, with occupancy rates reaching record lows. Major hotel chains like Marriott and Hilton faced major losses; many hotels pivoted to offer long-term rentals or temporary housing for healthcare workers and Covid-19 patients. Restaurants were also significantly affected. Some shifted to take-out only, while others closed due to unsustainable expenses, leaving many buildings vacant. Despite the major disruptions and uncertainty, the pandemic tested the CRE industry’s resilience and adaptability. While many businesses closed, others emerged stronger, implementing new strategies. After the steep drop in occupancy, CRE investors sought ways to adapt and continue generating returns. Loans played a critical role in supporting commercial real estate through this period. US government programs like the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) and Economic Injury Disaster Loans (EIDL) gave property owners vital support to meet expenses and retain staff. Lenders offered relief by deferring loan payments, which helped prevent many foreclosures and evictions. Programs like the CARES Act and loan forbearance allowed many tenants to continue making payments, helping businesses survive and keeping CRE properties afloat. During 2020, interest rates hit historic lows, letting owners and investors refinance at better rates. The Small Business Administration (SBA), through its 7(a) and 504 programs, offered generous loans with flexible terms for small and new businesses. In 2023, the CRE industry continues to show adaptability amid ongoing trends and challenges. Multiple loan options are available to suit different needs. Traditional mortgages, both fixed and adjustable, remain common for property purchases and refinancing. SBA loans are still useful for small businesses acquiring or expanding properties. Construction loans provide funding at various project stages to keep development on track. Bridge loans fill short-term gaps, allowing for acquisition or renovation before longer-term financing is secured. CRE finds itself at an inflection point. As we enter 2024, interest rates are higher than they were in recent years. Nearly every CRE sector except for office spaces has recovered since Covid. High rates currently deter some investors, but as rates decrease, the CRE market could strengthen. Commercial real estate has changed significantly due to the pandemic. Initial disruptions led to challenges and uncertainty, but the sector demonstrated resilience and innovation. Loans, government support, and creative solutions have been essential to this transformation. Though the future remains uncertain, it’s clear that commercial real estate continues to evolve rather than stand still.

La pandèmia de la Covid-19 va paralitzar l’economia mundial, afectant totes les indústries, inclòs el sector immobiliari. Abans de la pandèmia, el sector immobiliari comercial mostrava un creixement continu. Les oficines tenien una alta demanda, els locals comercials estaven plens i el sector de l’hostaleria prosperava. Els inversors i promotors estaven disposats a expandir-se i els préstecs eren fàcilment accessibles amb condicions favorables. La pandèmia va suposar un canvi radical pel CRE. Les oficines van quedar buides, centres comercials i hotels van patir una forta reducció de la demanda, i moltes empreses es van veure obligades a adaptar-se ràpidament. El teletreball es va convertir en norma, amb empreses com Twitter i Square permetent treballar des de casa de manera permanent. La ocupació i els lloguers d’oficines van caure; algunes empreses van reduir espais o van abandonar el mercat d’oficines. El comerç minorista va afrontar reptes a mesura que el trànsit de clients disminuïa per les restriccions i el creixement del comerç electrònic. Cadenes com JCPenney i Neiman Marcus van declarar fallida, i això va portar els centres comercials a enfocar-se més en experiències i serveis. Moltes petites empreses ja no podien mantenir locals físics. Els hotels van ser dels més afectats, amb taxes d’ocupació en mínims històrics. Grans cadenes com Marriott i Hilton van patir pèrdues importants; molts hotels es van adaptar oferint lloguers de llarga estada o es van convertir en allotjament temporal per a sanitaris i pacients de la Covid-19. Els restaurants també van patir greument. Alguns van passar només a ‘take-away’, mentre altres van tancar degut a despeses insostenibles, deixant molts locals buits. Tot i les grans disrupcions i la incertesa, la pandèmia va posar a prova la resiliència i capacitat d’adaptació del sector CRE. Encara que molts negocis van tancar, altres van emergir més forts mitjançant nous enfocaments. Després de la caiguda d’ocupació, els inversors del CRE van buscar maneres d’adaptar-se per continuar generant rendiments. Els préstecs van ser claus per donar suport al sector immobiliari comercial durant aquest període. Programes governamentals dels EUA com el Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) i Economic Injury Disaster Loans (EIDL) van oferir suport essencial als propietaris per afrontar despeses i mantenir llocs de treball. Els prestadors també van oferir ajornaments de pagament, evitant moltes execucions i desnonaments. Programes com el CARES Act i la moratòria de préstecs van permetre que molts llogaters continuessin pagant, ajudant comerciants a sobreviure i mantenint el CRE a flotació. A l’any 2020, els tipus d’interès van assolir mínims històrics i van permetre refinançar propietats a millors condicions. L’Administració de Petites Empreses (SBA), mitjançant els programes 7(a) i 504, va oferir préstecs amb condicions flexibles per a petites i noves empreses. El 2023, el sector CRE continua demostrant capacitat d’adaptació davant tendències i reptes. Existeixen moltes opcions de finançament segons les necessitats: hipoteques tradicionals (a tipus fix o variable), préstecs SBA per petites empreses, préstecs de construcció per a projectes en diferents fases, i préstecs pont per cobrir necessitats a curt termini mentre s’espera finançament a llarg termini. El CRE es troba en un punt d’inflexió. Entrant al 2024, els tipus d’interès són més alts que en anys anteriors. Gairebé tots els sectors del CRE, excepte el d’oficines, s’han recuperat des de la Covid. Els tipus alts fan recelar alguns inversors, però si baixen, el sector es podria reforçar. El sector immobiliari comercial ha canviat molt arran de la pandèmia. Les disrupcions inicials van portar reptes, però el sector ha demostrat resiliència i innovació. Els préstecs, el suport governamental i les solucions creatives han estat essencials en aquesta transformació. Tot i la incertesa del futur, el que és clar és que el sector immobiliari comercial no està quiet i segueix evolucionant.
