En la votació de dissabte, el partit populista Smer-SD, liderat per l'exprimer ministre Robert Fico, va obtenir el 23 per cent dels vots, per davant d'Eslovàquia Progressista, amb el 18 per cent. En un comunicat, el ministeri d'Afers Estrangers d'Eslovàquia va condemnar el que va qualificar de 'desinformació deliberadament difosa' per Rússia, considerant-ho una interferència inacceptable en el procés electoral eslovac. El ministeri va exigir a Moscou que deixi d'emprendre activitats de desinformació dirigides a Eslovàquia i va presentar una protesta enèrgica contra les declaracions del cap d'intel·ligència rus, subratllant que posen en dubte la integritat d'eleccions lliures i democràtiques al país. En resposta, Moscou va negar les acusacions. Segons va citar l'agència de notícies russa, l'ambaixada russa a Bratislava va declarar: 'A diferència d'alguns dels actuals aliats d'Eslovàquia, nosaltres no intervenim en els afers interns d'altres països ni promovem canvis de règim.'

article_content: Home Depot (NYSE: HD) is preparing to report its third-quarter earnings for fiscal 2023 on November 14. This follows a year-to-date stock decline of 8%, influenced by falling lumber prices and a consumer shift toward services, which has weakened demand for goods, particularly in larger, non-essential categories. The company anticipates that overall sales and comparable sales for 2023 will decrease by 2% to 5% compared to 2022. Operating margin is forecast between 14.0% and 14.3%, consistent with previous guidance. Analysts expect diluted earnings per share to drop by 7% to 13% year-over-year. Projections indicate Home Depot will achieve approximately $36.1 billion in Q3 revenue, slightly ahead of consensus estimates. In Q2, revenue decreased 2% year-over-year to $42.9 billion, and comparable-store sales fell by 2%. These outcomes are attributed to ongoing macroeconomic factors like high inflation—a pattern mirrored by Lowe's, whose comparable sales also declined in Q2. During Q2 2023, Home Depot’s average transaction size edged up to $90.07, while the number of transactions decreased by 1.8% to 459.1 million. Sales per retail square foot also dropped 2.3%, landing at $684.65. For the full year, Trefis predicts Home Depot’s revenue will total $152.7 billion, about 3% below last year’s figure. Expected Q3 earnings per share are $3.60, slightly beating consensus. Q2 saw operating income fall 8.6% to $6.59 billion, with net earnings down 9.9% to $4.66 billion. Inventory at quarter-end was $23.27 billion, compared to $26.09 billion a year earlier. Significantly, Home Depot continues to generate more revenue from professional contractors than main competitor Lowe’s, which could bolster its long-term performance. Trefis values Home Depot shares at $317, roughly 9% above their current market price. Additional peer and portfolio comparisons provide further context.

article_content: Once among the world’s most photographed women and central to a major political scandal, Christine Keeler now lives a humble life in South London. Appearing publicly for the first time in seven years at the age of 71, Keeler is far removed from her past as a model and showgirl involved in the Profumo affair of 1963. Keeler’s relationships in the early 1960s—with John Profumo, the British Minister for War, and Yevgeny Ivanov, a naval attaché at the Russian Embassy in London—were at the center of a scandal that shook British politics during the Cold War. Profumo, married to actress Valerie Hobson, met Keeler through their mutual friend Stephen Ward at a Cliveden estate party in 1961. Profumo was unaware that Keeler was also seeing Ivanov. In 1963, Profumo denied the affair in the House of Commons, but resigned three months later after admitting he had lied. Stephen Ward was prosecuted for living off immoral earnings, but died of an overdose the day before his trial ended, on August 3, 1963. Keeler was also convicted of unrelated perjury charges and served nine months in prison. Although she once embraced her fame and sold her story worldwide, Keeler now lives in sheltered accommodation and is reportedly estranged from her two sons. In a recent interview to promote her latest book, she discussed her strained relationship with her family. Interest in the affair continues. Andrew Lloyd Webber’s musical centered on Stephen Ward is set to debut soon, though Keeler did not participate in the project.

Les relacions de Keeler a principis dels anys seixanta —amb John Profumo, ministre de Guerra britànic, i Yevgeny Ivanov, agregat naval de l’ambaixada russa a Londres— van ser al centre d’un escàndol que va sacsejar la política britànica durant la Guerra Freda. Profumo, casat amb l’actriu Valerie Hobson, va conèixer Keeler gràcies al seu amic comú Stephen Ward en una festa a la finca Cliveden l’any 1961. Profumo no sabia que Keeler també veia Ivanov. El 1963, Profumo va negar la relació a la Cambra dels Comuns, però va dimitir tres mesos després quan va admetre que havia mentit. Stephen Ward fou processat per viure de guanys il·lícits, però va morir d’una sobredosi el dia abans que acabés el seu judici, el 3 d’agost de 1963. Encara que en el passat havia abraçat la seva fama i venut la seva història arreu del món, Keeler ara viu en un habitatge protegit i, segons sembla, està distanciada dels seus dos fills. En una entrevista recent per promocionar el seu darrer llibre, va parlar de la seva difícil relació familiar. L’interès per aquell afer persisteix. El musical d’Andrew Lloyd Webber centrat en Stephen Ward està a punt d’estrenar-se, tot i que Keeler no va participar en el projecte.

article_content:
The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences recently honored promising filmmakers at the 50th annual Student Academy Awards. The ceremony, held in person at the Samuel Goldwyn Theater in Beverly Hills, celebrated students from universities worldwide. Gold, Silver, and Bronze medals were presented in the alternative/experimental, animation, documentary, and narrative categories.

Among the recipients, Leo Behrens from the American Film Institute claimed Gold in alternative/experimental. For animation, the Gold went to Gabriel Augerai, Romain Augier, and Yannick Jacquin from École des Nouvelles Images in France, marking a first-time win for the institution. Additional prizes went to students at MoPA 3D Animation School (France), National Film and Television School (UK), New York University, Columbia University, Filmakademie Wien (Austria), Den Norske Filmskolen (Norway), and Hamburg Media School (Germany).

With their wins, all the awarded films are now eligible to vie for the 2023 Oscars in various short film categories. Since its inception in 1972, the Student Academy Awards have provided a platform to recognize and support new talent in international filmmaking.

article_content: Andy Davies, a 33-year-old dentist from Birmingham with a passion for sports, endured a near-fatal stroke following a demanding tooth extraction in November 2011. Feeling unwell, Andy managed to reach the hospital, where doctors determined he had experienced a torn artery in his neck, resulting in bleeding in his brain stem. This major stroke led to 'locked-in' syndrome—Andy was left unable to move, speak, or breathe unaided, communicating solely through blinking. Placed in an induced coma for recovery, he spent about ten weeks without movement before gradually regaining some motor function. Currently, Andy is stable and receiving rehabilitation at Moseley Hall in Birmingham. He is steadily relearning essential abilities such as sitting, standing, walking, and talking, and his family hopes he will soon regain enough strength to feed himself. Andy's wife, Emma, and his mother, Barbara, have spoken about their pride in his resilience and express belief in his ongoing recovery, crediting medical care, community support, and their Christian faith. Emma, a teacher, recalls that doctors initially predicted complete dependence, but the family remains hopeful for further progress. Prior to his stroke, Andy enjoyed climbing and skiing. He graduated from Birmingham University in 2002 as the UK's first dyslexic dentist and worked in the NHS, supporting many people in need. Andy has returned home to Bournville on several occasions and recently attended a friend's wedding—important steps in his recovery. He married Emma in 2008, and thousands now follow his story online, joining in support and prayer. There are ongoing concerns about the approaching end of Andy’s rehabilitation funding, creating uncertainty for his future care. The family is grateful for the expertise and kindness of hospital staff and for the outpouring of encouragement from near and far as Andy continues his path to independence. Keep up with Andy’s journey via his blog: http://andydaviesupdate.blogspot.co.uk/

article_content: Tripp Halstead, a two-year-old from Georgia, has been fighting for his life after a large tree limb fell on his head during Hurricane Sandy. The incident happened on October 29 while Tripp was outside with his classmates at the Cribs to Crayons daycare center. He was quickly taken to Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta, where doctors performed emergency surgery to relieve swelling on his brain. Since then, Tripp has remained hospitalized in a medically induced coma. More recently, he developed bacterial meningitis, a serious infection, requiring another emergency operation to remove a shunt and pump. His family has described this experience as ‘heartbreaking’ and has been sharing updates on Facebook, where they ask for prayers and donations toward his recovery. Doctors say Tripp’s prognosis remains uncertain, as his brain injury spans both sides of his brain, making recovery more complex. Despite some hopeful signs, he has faced repeated setbacks, including breathing difficulties. Tripp's parents, Bill and Stacy Halstead, refer to him as their ‘miracle baby’—the child they long hoped for after years of trying. The family has expressed gratitude for the overwhelming support they’ve received from thousands of people, many of whom are strangers touched by Tripp’s story. They continue to share their journey on social media, expressing thanks for all the prayers and support, and asking for continued strength, whatever comes next.

article_content: Mastering Productivity: 5 ChatGPT Prompts to Transform Your To-Do List  The key to maximizing your productivity is focusing on what only you can do—your unique strengths and expertise. Delegate or automate routine tasks whenever possible, freeing time for work that truly matters to you. ChatGPT can be a powerful partner in helping you prioritize, delegate, and manage your workload more efficiently.  Here are five ChatGPT prompts to help you boost productivity:  1. Prioritize What Matters If everything on your list feels urgent, it’s easy to scramble without achieving anything meaningful. ChatGPT can help you assess your workload by considering deadlines, impact, effort, and updates, so you focus on tasks that make the biggest difference. Use this prompt: "Assess my list of tasks in the attached document/spreadsheet. Consider factors such as deadlines, project impact, required effort, and any recent updates. Prioritize these tasks based on urgency and impact, and provide reasoning for each recommendation."  2. Delegate Effectively When you delegate tasks to team members based on their strengths, you improve both efficiency and job satisfaction. With ChatGPT, you can match the right tasks to the right people, ensuring everyone’s time is well spent. Try: "Analyze the provided list of roles, tasks, and skills for my team members. Suggest the most effective delegation of these tasks, ensuring each task is matched to the appropriate team member based on skills and expertise. Update the plan as new tasks or changes occur."  3. Eliminate Low-Priority Tasks Don’t get bogged down with tasks that don’t add value. Use ChatGPT to help you identify low-priority or unnecessary commitments, clearing space for strategic work. Review your schedule regularly to maintain focus. Prompt: "Review my upcoming schedule. Identify any meetings or tasks that are low-priority or could be rescheduled or delegated. Suggest changes to protect time for high-value work and flag any commitments that may no longer be necessary."  4. Track Progress Stay on top of project status with ChatGPT’s help. By regularly updating your data, you can get progress reports that highlight milestones and areas needing attention. This helps you identify trends and prioritize improvements. "Generate a progress report for my ongoing projects based on the daily updates I provide. Include milestones, tasks completed, pending actions, and any issues. Compare with previous data to highlight progress and areas needing attention."  5. Break Down Long-term Goals Achieve your bigger objectives by letting ChatGPT help you create detailed, strategic plans broken into actionable steps and milestones. Update your plan as circumstances evolve so it remains relevant. "Create a strategic plan for achieving [goal] within [timeframe]. Break the goal into steps, milestones, and timelines. Consider resources, challenges, and market conditions. Update the plan as new data or changes arise."  With these five ChatGPT prompts, you can organize your time, streamline your team’s tasks, eliminate distractions, track progress, and create adaptable, actionable plans for growth. Put technology to work for you—and get more done with less stress.
translated_content: Domina la productivitat: 5 instruccions de ChatGPT per transformar la teva llista de tasques  La clau per maximitzar la teva productivitat és centrar-te en allò que només tu pots fer—les teves fortaleses i experiència úniques. Delega o automatitza les tasques rutinàries sempre que puguis, alliberant temps per al que realment importa. ChatGPT pot ser un aliat potent per ajudar-te a prioritzar, delegar i gestionar la teva càrrega de treball de manera eficient.  Aquí tens cinc instruccions de ChatGPT per ajudar-te a augmentar la productivitat:  1. Prioritza el que és important Si tot a la teva llista sembla urgent, és fàcil sentir-se aclaparat i no aconseguir res significatiu. ChatGPT t’ajuda a avaluar la teva càrrega de treball considerant terminis, impacte, esforç i canvis recents, perquè puguis enfocar-te en les tasques més rellevants. Utilitza aquesta instrucció: "Avalua la meva llista de tasques al document o full de càlcul adjunt. Considera terminis, impacte del projecte, esforç requerit i qualsevol actualització recent. Prioritza aquestes tasques segons la urgència i l’impacte, i dóna la teva justificació per cada recomanació."  2. Delega de manera efectiva Delegant tasques segons les fortaleses del teu equip, millores l’eficiència i la satisfacció laboral. Amb ChatGPT pots assignar les tasques adequades a les persones adequades. Prova-ho: "Analitza la llista de rols, tasques i habilitats dels membres del meu equip. Suggereix la delegació més efectiva, assignant cada tasca al membre més adequat segons la seva experiència i habilitats. Actualitza el pla a mesura que apareguin noves tasques o canvis."  3. Elimina tasques de baixa prioritat No et perdis amb tasques que no aporten valor. ChatGPT t’ajuda a identificar compromisos innecessaris, alliberant temps per al treball estratègic. Revisa la teva agenda regularment per mantenir el focus. Instrucció: "Revisa la meva agenda propera. Identifica reunions o tasques que siguin de baixa prioritat o que puguin ser reprogramades o delegades. Suggereix canvis per protegir temps per a tasques de valor i indica qualsevol compromís que ja no sigui necessari."  4. Fes seguiment del progrés Mantingues-te al dia de l’estat dels projectes amb l'ajuda de ChatGPT. Si actualitzes les dades regularment, obtindràs informes de progrés que destaquen fites i àrees a millorar. "Genera un informe de progrés dels meus projectes en curs amb les actualitzacions diàries que et faciliti. Inclou fites assolides, tasques completades, accions pendents i qualsevol incidència. article_content: England Under-21s extended their winning run to eight consecutive matches under coach Gareth Southgate with a 3-0 victory over Moldova. Before the trip to Lithuania and Moldova, Southgate praised Saido Berahino's renewed focus after a dip in form last season. Berahino delivered on his coach's confidence, scoring two goals. Harry Kane added the third, securing the win and boosting England's momentum ahead of Friday's Euro 2015 play-off draw. West Brom striker Berahino was named man of the match in Moldova, netting two goals. Nathan Redmond of Norwich assisted the opening goal. The England team featured Tom Carroll as captain (from Swansea), along with Jake Forster-Caskey, Will Hughes, and Nathan Redmond. Moldova fielded goalkeeper Koselev, Focsa, Gheorghiu, Jardan, and others. Moldova had previously kept four consecutive home clean sheets in qualification, but England broke that record in the 16th minute when Berahino scored. The squad’s trip to the match involved an unusual bus journey to Transnistria, crossing a guarded border and passing roaming livestock, but England’s performance was unaffected. Southgate made five changes to the starting line-up, yet the team maintained his passing philosophy. England pressed early and created several chances before Berahino converted Redmond's cross. Moldova had brief threats on goal, but England dominated overall. In the second half, Kane provided an assist for Berahino's second goal, and later scored himself in the 85th minute. England sealed a 3-0 win. Southgate emphasized that more challenges await in the play-offs, with the team needing to maintain and elevate their performance to qualify for the Czech Republic finals next summer. Attendance was 1,000. Mete Kalkavan from Turkey officiated the match.

article_content: A comparison of Mitt Romney's September economic plan and his Detroit speech highlights significant differences in their approach and content. The September plan, released as an e-book and introduced by Columbia Business School Dean Glenn Hubbard, was the result of extensive research and careful analysis. This plan avoided proposing new early tax cuts for high-income individuals, instead advocating for a tax system that is simple, fair, and minimally disruptive to economic activity. Romney supported maintaining the lower Bush-era tax rates to promote economic growth and assist Americans facing financial challenges, stating that allowing these rates to expire would be the wrong move. By contrast, Romney's Detroit speech seemed quickly assembled and aimed mainly at energizing Republican primary voters. In this speech, Romney proposed a 20% across-the-board cut in marginal individual income tax rates, asserting that this would promote hard work, risk-taking, and economic growth. He highlighted that businesses taxed through the individual system account for more than half of all private sector jobs, suggesting these cuts would boost employment and wages. However, the speech did not provide supporting evidence for these claims. There are ongoing questions about the impact of these tax cuts on the federal deficit, especially since Romney also pledged to extend the Bush tax cuts, abolish the Alternative Minimum Tax, and eliminate the estate tax. He reassured seniors that there would be no reductions affecting current or near-retirement Medicare recipients and ruled out tax increases, with entitlement reforms not starting until 2022. Critics challenge how the budget gap would be closed, as the plan points to cuts in programs for the poor, such as food stamps, housing assistance, and job training. The commentary emphasizes the potential social costs of such reductions, particularly since the economy has not fully recovered from the 2008-2009 downturn, and expresses skepticism about resolving the deficit solely through economic growth. Additionally, the article suggests that while not an explicit policy reversal, Romney's Detroit speech demonstrates a trend of accommodating party demands, which may weaken his image as an independent leader. The commentary contrasts this with past candidates who separated themselves from party orthodoxy. The analysis portrays Romney's platform as favoring wealthier and older Americans, with lower-income and younger groups bearing fiscal adjustment. This is seen as diverging from previous Republican efforts to reach younger voters. If elected, Romney could find his agenda dominated by congressional priorities like tax cuts and the Paul Ryan budget, potentially sidelining other reforms. Furthermore, the commentary warns that without changes to defense, Medicare, and Social Security, and with substantial tax cuts, avoiding increased deficits would require exceptionally high economic growth. If such growth does not occur, the deficits could become entrenched. In conclusion, while Romney is regarded as capable, he has removed major policy distinctions from the most conservative party members. Should he secure the Republican nomination, moderates and independents will need to consider the true nature of his leadership. The views presented are those of commentator David Frum.
translated_content: Una comparació entre el pla econòmic de Mitt Romney del setembre i el seu discurs a Detroit posa de manifest diferències rellevants en l'enfocament i el contingut. El pla de setembre, publicat en format e-book i presentat pel degà de la Columbia Business School, Glenn Hubbard, va ser fruit d'una recerca exhaustiva i una anàlisi acurada. Aquest pla evitava proposar noves baixades d'impostos primerenques per a persones amb ingressos alts i defensava un sistema fiscal senzill, just i poc disruptiu per l'activitat econòmica. Romney apostava per mantenir els tipus impositius baixos de l'era Bush per afavorir el creixement econòmic i ajudar els nord-americans amb dificultats, afirmant que deixar que aquests tipus caduquessin seria un error. En canvi, el discurs de Detroit de Romney semblava fet amb presses i estava dirigit principalment a estimular els votants de les primàries republicanes. En aquest discurs, Romney va proposar una reducció general del 20% en els tipus impositius marginals de la renda individual, argumentant que això afavoriria el treball, la presa de riscos i el creixement econòmic. Va destacar que les empreses que tributen a través del sistema d’impost sobre la renda individual representen més de la meitat dels llocs de treball del sector privat, i va suggerir que aquestes retallades podrien afavorir la creació d’ocupació i l’augment dels salaris. Tot i això, no es van presentar proves que avalessin aquestes afirmacions. Continuen sorgint dubtes sobre l’impacte d’aquestes rebaixes fiscals en el dèficit federal, especialment perquè Romney també es va comprometre a renovar les rebaixes fiscals de Bush, abolir l’impost mínim alternatiu i eliminar l’impost de successions. Va voler tranquil·litzar la gent gran assegurant que no hi hauria canvis perjudicials per als beneficiaris actuals o propers de Medicare i va descartar pujades d'impostos, ajornant les reformes dels programes públics fins al 2022. Els crítics es pregunten com es cobriria el dèficit pressupostari, ja que el pla preveu retallades en programes per a persones amb menys recursos, com cupons d’aliments, ajudes a l’habitatge i formació laboral. El comentari remarca els possibles costos socials d’aquests ajustaments, sobretot tenint en compte que l’economia encara no s’ha recuperat totalment de la recessió del 2008-2009, i expressa escepticisme davant del fet de confiar només en el creixement econòmic per solucionar el dèficit. A més, l’article suggereix que, tot i no ser una reversió clara de polítiques, el discurs de Detroit mostra la tendència de Romney a cedir a les demandes del partit, cosa que podria debilitar la seva imatge de líder independent. El comentari compara això amb antics candidats que van prendre distància amb l’ortodòxia del partit. L’anàlisi mostra que la plataforma de Romney afavoreix les persones amb més recursos i d’edat avançada, mentre que els grups joves i amb menys ingressos assumirien la càrrega fiscal. Això s’allunya dels intents republicans previs de connectar amb els joves. Si fos elegit, Romney podria veure la seva agenda condicionada per les prioritats del Congrés, com ara les rebaixes fiscals i els pressupostos de Paul Ryan, marginant altres reformes. D’altra banda, el comentari adverteix que, sense retallades en defensa, Medicare i Seguretat Social però amb retallades d’impostos importants, evitar l’augment del dèficit requeriria un creixement econòmic excepcionalment alt. Si aquest creixement no arriba, el dèficit podria perpetuar-se. En resum, tot i considerar-se que Romney és capaç, ha suprimit diferències de política clares respecte als membres més conservadors del partit. Si aconsegueix la nominació republicana, els moderats i independents hauran de plantejar-se quin tipus de lideratge representa realment. Les opinions expressades són les del comentarista David Frum.

article_content: A new butter knife called SpreadTHAT! has been introduced to tackle the challenge of spreading hard butter straight from the fridge. The knife uses a specially designed thermal conduction system where heat from your hand is transferred through a copper alloy tube to the blade, gradually softening the butter as you spread. This system needs no batteries, external power, or pre-heating. Weighing just 3 ounces (85 grams), SpreadTHAT! is also built with safety in mind, featuring rounded edges to make it suitable even for children to use. With no electrical parts involved, it's simple and safe. Developed by a team in Seattle, the SpreadTHAT! project launched on Kickstarter, where it quickly surpassed its initial $20,000 (£12,400) fundraising goal and has raised $33,500 so far, with 18 days remaining in the campaign. The creators say they were motivated by the inadequacies of existing butter spreaders, and wanted an effective, power-free alternative. Expected to sell for around £15, the knife makes use of copper alloys similar to those found in computer processor cooling systems, ensuring efficient heat transfer. It’s based on the principle that heat always moves toward cooler areas, helping users soften and spread cold butter easily. After months of development and testing, the team plans to begin mass production of SpreadTHAT! in time for the holiday season. Another recently launched butter knife, ButterUp, approaches the same problem with a grating method to help users spread cold butter.

Aquest sistema no requereix bateries, font d'alimentació externa ni preescalfament. article_content: For those who find themselves repeatedly pressing the snooze button every morning, a new app called Wakie might bring some excitement to the daily routine. Instead of waking up to a standard alarm sound, Wakie offers a unique feature: it connects users with strangers worldwide, who call to wake each other up at designated times. Developed by Armenian programmer Hrachik Adjamian, Wakie supports both Android and Windows Phone, with plans for an iOS version. The app allows members to set an alarm, and instead of a ringtone, a random user from anywhere in the world gives the wake-up call. Each call runs for 60 seconds, with a brief warning at the 50-second mark before ending automatically, minimizing any awkwardness. Users also have the option to be the waking caller for others. Importantly, no phone numbers are exchanged, maintaining user privacy. All calls are placed over the internet, so with Wi-Fi or a data connection, there are no direct charges, though using mobile data may count toward a user's limit and could incur fees if the limit is exceeded. Currently, only users in the US, UK, Canada, Singapore, and Hong Kong can fully use the alarm and wake-up call features. In other countries, users may still call to wake others but cannot set their own alarms through the app just yet. Wakie's creators describe it as a friendly, global community meant to make mornings happier and help people start the day with a smile, offering a gentle alternative to the loud jolt of a typical alarm clock.

Desenvolupada pel programador armeni Hrachik Adjamian, Wakie està disponible per a Android i Windows Phone, amb plans per arribar aviat a iOS. L'aplicació permet als membres programar una alarma i, enlloc d'un to tradicional, un usuari aleatori de qualsevol lloc del món fa la trucada de despertador. Cada trucada dura 60 segons, amb un avís als 50 segons abans que finalitzi automàticament per evitar moments incòmodes. Els usuaris també poden triar despertar altres persones. És important destacar que no s'intercanvien números de telèfon, preservant així la privadesa. Actualment, només els usuaris dels EUA, Regne Unit, Canadà, Singapur i Hong Kong poden utilitzar totes les funcions d'alarma i trucada. Als altres països, els usuaris poden trucar per despertar d'altres però encara no poden programar alarmes pròpies des de l'aplicació. Els creadors de Wakie el presenten com una comunitat amiga i global que vol fer els matins més agradables i ajudar a començar el dia amb un somriure, oferint una alternativa suau al soroll molest d'un despertador tradicional.

article_content: New FBI statistics for 2011 highlight Flint, Michigan as the U.S. city with the highest rate of violent crime among cities with populations over 100,000. Detroit, St. Louis, Oakland, and Memphis follow closely behind. These cities are contending with high unemployment and strained city budgets that have necessitated major police layoffs. In Flint, for instance, 20 officers were cut as gun violence surged, resulting in 52 murders. Detroit struggles with almost 20% unemployment and severe poverty, reporting 344 murders in 2011 and a violent crime rate just below Flint's. Planned 18% budget cuts for Detroit's police mean hundreds of job losses, reduced station hours, and a move for residents to report non-urgent crimes by phone. St. Louis had 18.6 violent crimes per 1,000 people and saw 113 murders in 2011, a slight drop from the previous year, but city budget issues may force a further reduction of 100 police officers. Oakland recorded 16.8 violent crimes per 1,000, with 104 murders in 2011—14 more than in 2010. The city is pushing for more police funding to address ongoing crime. Memphis experienced a rise in violent crime from 15.4 to 15.8 per 1,000, with murders increasing from 89 to 117. A large budget deficit raises prospects of further police layoffs. Despite a national decrease in violent crime rates by 4% last year, these five cities stand out as exceptions. City leaders link elevated violence to factors including unemployment, reduced police forces, and the prevalence of guns.

St. Louis va registrar 18,6 delictes violents per cada 1.000 habitants i 113 assassinats el 2011, lleugerament menys que el curs anterior, però els problemes pressupostaris podrien provocar la pèrdua de 100 policies més. Tot i que la taxa nacional de delictes violents va caure un 4% el 2011, aquestes cinc ciutats es mantenen com a excepcions. Els líders locals atribueixen la violència elevada a l'atur, la reducció de policies i la presència d'armes de foc.

article_content: A recent study led by Philip John Tyson, Associate Professor of Psychology at the University of South Wales, explored why about five percent of Americans experience a fear of clowns, known as coulrophobia. Working with colleagues Shakiela Davies, Sophie Scorey, and William James Greville, Tyson aimed to uncover the origins of this intriguing phobia. Their research, published in Frontiers of Psychology under the title "Fear of clowns: An investigation into the aetiology of coulrophobia," involved surveying over 500 individuals who reported being afraid of clowns. Participants answered detailed questions about what triggers their fear. One of the key discoveries, as summarized by the Washington Post, was that most participants did not link their fear to any direct negative encounters with clowns. Instead, many reported being unsettled by clowns because they felt it was impossible to discern the true emotions behind their painted-on expressions. Tyson noted that this inability to read a clown's intentions, combined with the possibility that something dangerous or malicious might be concealed by their makeup, was a significant source of unease. Additionally, respondents found clowns' behavior unpredictable and startling, echoing fears some people have of spiders—that something might suddenly happen. The exaggerated features of clowns, such as oversized red noses and brightly colored hair, contributed to their discomfort, similar to the unease created by human-like dolls or robots. The media also plays a major role: Many said movies featuring sinister clowns, like Joaquin Phoenix in 'Joker' or Pennywise in Stephen King's 'It,' had intensified their phobia. The researchers piloted a new tool, the Origin of Fear of Clowns Questionnaire (OFCQ), in their analysis. Their results indicate that factors such as uncertain intent, unsettling appearance, unpredictable actions, and media representation are central to clown-related fears—not personal negative experiences. The study concludes that coulrophobia results from a complex blend of these influences, suggesting that fears are primarily rooted in the clowns' facial appearance, behavior, and depiction in media. Researchers plan to further investigate how each factor relates to individual levels of fear.

Treballant amb els seus col·legues Shakiela Davies, Sophie Scorey i William James Greville, Tyson pretenia descobrir l’origen d’aquesta intrigant fòbia. La seva investigació, publicada a Frontiers of Psychology amb el títol "Fear of clowns: An investigation into the aetiology of coulrophobia", va consistir a enquestar més de 500 persones que van afirmar tenir por dels pallassos. Una de les troballes clau, resumida pel Washington Post, va ser que la majoria de participants no associaven la seva por amb cap experiència negativa directa amb un pallasso. En canvi, molts admetien sentir-se inquiets perquè els resultava impossible entendre les veritables emocions rere les expressions pintades dels pallassos. A més, els enquestats trobaven el comportament dels pallassos imprevisible i sorprenent, de manera semblant a la por a les aranyes: la por que passin coses de sobte. Les característiques exagerades dels pallassos, com els nassos vermells grans i els cabells de colors vius, augmentaven la incomoditat, igual que passa amb nines o robots amb trets humans. Els mitjans també hi tenen un paper important: molts van afirmar que pel·lícules amb pallassos sinistres, com el ‘Joker’ de Joaquin Phoenix o en Pennywise d’‘It’ de Stephen King, havien augmentat la seva fòbia. Els investigadors van provar una nova eina, el qüestionari Origin of Fear of Clowns Questionnaire (OFCQ), per a l'anàlisi. L’estudi conclou que la coulrofòbia resulta d’una combinació complexa d’aquests factors, suggerint que la por s’arrela principalment en l’aspecte facial, el comportament i la representació mediàtica dels pallassos. Els investigadors continuaran analitzant com afecta cada factor al nivell de por de les persones.

article_content: Hong Kong, China (CNN) — Hong Kong urged its residents on Tuesday to reconsider, shorten, or cancel planned trips to the Philippines following a tragic incident in Manila where eight tourists from Hong Kong were killed during a bus hostage crisis. The Hong Kong government raised its travel warning to the highest level, advising residents to avoid traveling to the Philippines. "Those already in the Philippines should prioritize their personal safety and remain alert," the advisory stated. Tour groups were told to return promptly, and those yet to depart were encouraged to cancel travel plans. Manila police reported that Rolando Mendoza, a former police officer dismissed from service, hijacked a tour bus carrying Hong Kong tourists on Monday. After a ten-hour standoff, Mendoza killed eight hostages before being shot dead by police. One passenger was critically injured, and six others were hospitalized with less severe wounds, according to Donald Tsang, chief executive of Hong Kong’s government. In Beijing, the Chinese government strongly condemned Mendoza's actions, extended condolences to the victims' families, and sent teams to assist. China’s Foreign Affairs Ministry stated it would coordinate with both the Philippine and Hong Kong governments to support ongoing rescue efforts and called on the Philippines to ensure the safety of Chinese citizens. The incident began at 10 a.m. Monday when Mendoza, dressed in uniform and armed, boarded the tourist bus under the pretext of seeking a ride, according to police spokesman Erwin Margarejo. Susanna Lau, General Manager of Hong Thai Travel, said a tour guide attempted to stop Mendoza, but he eventually boarded and instructed the driver to lock the doors. There were 25 people onboard, including 22 foreign nationals. Mendoza displayed demands for reinstatement in the bus window. Police cordoned off the area and attempted to negotiate, delivering food and involving Mendoza’s family in talks. Several hostages, including children and those with medical issues, were released during the day. At around 2 p.m., signs indicated escalating threats, but there was little change until Mendoza opened fire. Police stormed the bus at 8 p.m., ending the siege. Authorities have launched an official investigation. Philippine President Benigno Aquino III stated that conclusions would await the inquiry's results, emphasizing transparency. Some officials suggested media coverage may have aggravated the situation but asserted freedom of information was maintained. Manila Vice Mayor Isko Moreno mentioned that Mendoza's brother was arrested and accused of conspiring in the incident. CNN’s Sarita Harilela, Constance Cheng, Maria Ressa, and Arlene Samson-Espiritu contributed to this report.

El govern de Hong Kong va elevar l’avís de viatge al màxim nivell, recomanant evitar viatjar a Filipines. «Els que ja són a Filipines haurien de prioritzar la seva seguretat personal i romandre atents», deia l’avís. Susanna Lau, directora general de Hong Thai Travel, va dir que un guia turístic va intentar impedir-li l’entrada, però finalment Mendoza va pujar i va ordenar tancar les portes. President Paul Kagame of Rwanda has announced the removal of all visa barriers for African nationals visiting the country. This decision aims to advance Africa as a unified tourism destination, making travel to Rwanda more accessible for people across the continent. Kagame highlighted Africa’s rising middle class and its significance for the future of global tourism.

The African Union has welcomed Rwanda’s step, viewing it as a boost to intra-African trade and cooperation. AU Commission Chairman Moussa Faki Mahamat called on other African countries to adopt similar measures to promote the free movement of people. According to the AU, intra-continental trade stands at just 16 percent, a stark contrast to 70 percent within the European Union.

In addition, several African nations continue to forge bilateral visa-free travel agreements—recent examples include Ghana with South Africa, and Uganda with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Rwanda has also been working to attract tourists by partnering with major European football clubs such as Arsenal and Bayern Munich.

Kagame ha remarcat el creixement de la classe mitjana africana i la seva rellevància pel futur del turisme global.

La Unió Africana ha celebrat aquesta mesura de Rwanda, considerant-la clau per enfortir el comerç i la cooperació dins del continent. El president de la Comissió de la UA, Moussa Faki Mahamat, ha animat altres països africans a implementar polítiques similars per promoure la lliure circulació de persones. Segons la UA, el comerç intraafricà suposa només el 16%, mentre que a la Unió Europea arriba al 70%.

A banda, uns quants països africans segueixen tancant acords bilaterals per garantir viatges sense visat—com s’ha vist recentment entre Ghana i Sud-àfrica, o Uganda i la República Democràtica del Congo. Rwanda també aposta fort pel turisme amb col·laboracions amb grans clubs de futbol europeus, com l’Arsenal i el Bayern de Munic.

article_content: Julian Moran (30) and Angela Moran (31), an Australian couple, left their comfortable lifestyle and jobs in engineering and mining in Perth to run the Refugio Altiplano Healing Centre in the Amazon jungle of Peru, near Iquitos. Their journey into spiritual healing began when they encountered ayahuasca, an ancient psychedelic plant medicine used for its potential therapeutic effects on mental, emotional, and physical health. The centre covers 490 hectares of rainforest and offers tourists a natural setting to participate in ayahuasca ceremonies and natural medicine practices led by qualified shamans. Life in the jungle involves limited facilities, including power supplied by a petrol generator for about five hours a night, patchy phone reception, and no hot water. The Morans chose to continue running the retreat after the previous owner passed away. Mr Moran says many guests come from high-stress professions, including mining and resources, hoping to relieve work-related stress and burnout. Ayahuasca tea contains DMT (dimethyltryptamine), a hallucinogenic compound. DMT is illegal in most countries but permitted in Peru for traditional use. The Morans stress their focus on safety, authenticity, and qualified supervision. Ceremonies are reported to help participants process trauma and address conditions such as depression, PTSD, anxiety, addiction, and certain physical ailments. Purging—both physical (vomiting, diarrhea) and emotional—is considered part of the cleansing experience. Guests are accommodated in two-storey jungle-style houses, served healthy meals, and can join activities like river swimming, tours of local villages, and sessions in a traditional sauna. The centre accommodates up to four people. Retreats range from several nights to a month, with prices starting at $160 USD per night. A 12-day retreat is priced at $1,500 USD. Although ayahuasca use is controversial due to legal restrictions and health risks, the Morans state that their centre prioritizes safety, professional oversight, and the wellbeing of their guests. They encourage individuals, especially Australians, to learn more about ayahuasca and its legal status.

El seu viatge cap a la sanació espiritual va començar quan van conèixer l'ayahuasca, una medicina vegetal psicodèlica ancestral utilitzada pels seus possibles efectes terapèutics sobre la salut mental, emocional i física. El centre ocupa 490 hectàrees de selva i ofereix als visitants un entorn natural per participar en cerimònies d'ayahuasca i pràctiques de medicina natural guiades per xamans qualificats. La vida a la selva comporta instal·lacions limitades, com llum amb generador de benzina unes cinc hores per nit, cobertura de mòbil irregular i sense aigua calenta. Els Moran van decidir mantenir el refugi després de la mort del propietari anterior. Segons Mr Moran, molts hostes venen de professions d'alt estrès, com la mineria i els recursos, i busquen alleugerir l'estrès laboral i el desgast emocional. El te d'ayahuasca conté DMT (dimetiltriptamina), un compost al·lucinogen. El DMT és il·legal en la majoria de països, però es permet a Perú per ús tradicional. Els Moran fan èmfasi en la seguretat, l'autenticitat i la supervisió qualificada. S'indica que les cerimònies poden ajudar a processar traumes i tractar problemes com la depressió, el TEP, l'ansietat, l'addicció i certes malalties físiques. La purga, tant física (vòmits, diarrea) com emocional, es considera part del procés depuratiu. Els hostes s'allotgen en cases de dos pisos d'estil selva, reben àpats saludables i poden participar en activitats com banyar-se al riu, visitar pobles locals i gaudir de sessions en un sauna tradicional. El centre admet fins a quatre persones. Els retirades van de diverses nits fins a un mes, amb preus des de 160 dòlars per nit. Un retir de 12 dies té un cost de 1.500 dòlars. Tot i la controvèrsia per l'estat legal i els riscos potencials de l'ayahuasca, els Moran afirmen que el seu centre posa la seguretat, la supervisió professional i el benestar dels hostes al davant. Animem especialment els australians a informar-se sobre l'ayahuasca i el seu estat legal.

JetSynthesys, an Indian digital entertainment and technology company, has entered a strategic partnership with Japan-based, publicly listed Digital Hearts Holdings (DHH). This collaboration forms a 50:50 joint venture in India, combining the strengths of both organizations. As part of the alliance, DHH will invest in JetSynthesys Japan. In return, JetSynthesys Japan will benefit from DHH's expertise in market entry strategies and customer support in the Japanese market.

The joint venture’s primary goal is to expand debugging and gaming support services both in India and worldwide, leveraging the combined resources and capabilities of JetSynthesys and DHH. DHH brings a portfolio of services to the table, including debugging, game translation, Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA), game development support, marketing, and customer support for global gaming companies.

“Japan is the third-largest gaming market in the world and holds the highest Average Revenue Per User (ARPU),” said Rajan Navani, CEO and founder of JetSynthesys. “Our partnership with Digital Hearts is a key milestone in strengthening JetSynthesys' international presence. We plan to utilize our shared knowledge of the video games industry and audience trends to create cutting-edge global game titles.”

Specific investment details regarding the joint venture have not been disclosed.

JetSynthesys Japan aims to support DHH's business development in Western countries, while DHH will boost JetSynthesys Japan’s business expansion in Japan and other major East Asian markets. Additionally, DHH and its group companies will provide resources for development and support functions in co-developed projects with JetSynthesys Japan.

“Our collective sectoral expertise, individual skills, local knowledge, and broad networks in our respective regions will open new opportunities for both organizations. We look forward to collaborating in game development, operations, talent management, and business growth,” said Ryo Shima, head of JetSynthesys Japan.

Aquesta col·laboració suposa la creació d’una ‘joint venture’ al 50% a l’Índia, combinant les fortaleses de totes dues organitzacions. Com a part de l’aliança, DHH invertirà en JetSynthesys Japan. A canvi, JetSynthesys Japan es beneficiarà de l'experiència de DHH en estratègies d’entrada al mercat i suport al client dins del mercat japonès.

L’objectiu principal de la joint venture és expandir els serveis de debug i suport en el sector del joc a l’Índia i a escala global, aprofitant els recursos i les capacitats conjuntes de JetSynthesys i DHH. DHH aporta un ampli ventall de serveis: debug, traducció de videojocs, Garantia de Qualitat Lingüística (LQA), suport al desenvolupament de jocs, màrqueting i atenció al client per a empreses de videojocs globals.

«El Japó és el tercer mercat més gran de videojocs del món i té l’ARPU (ingrés mitjà per usuari) més alt», afirma Rajan Navani, CEO i fundador de JetSynthesys. «La nostra associació amb Digital Hearts representa un punt clau per reforçar la presència internacional de JetSynthesys. Volem aprofitar el nostre coneixement conjunt de la indústria del videojoc i de les tendències del públic per crear títols globals d’avantguarda.»

Els detalls específics de la inversió d’aquesta joint venture no han estat revelats.

JetSynthesys Japan pretén donar suport al desenvolupament de negoci de DHH a Occident, mentre que DHH impulsarà l’expansió de JetSynthesys Japan al Japó i altres mercats clau de l’Àsia oriental. Així mateix, DHH i les seves empreses del grup proporcionaran recursos per al desenvolupament i les funcions de suport en projectes co-desenvolupats amb JetSynthesys Japan.

«La nostra expertesa sectorial, habilitats individuals, coneixement local i àmplies xarxes en les respectives regions obriran noves oportunitats a ambdues organitzacions. Volem col·laborar en desenvolupament de jocs, operacions, gestió de talent i creixement empresarial», declara Ryo Shima, cap de JetSynthesys Japan.

article_content: If there's a prize for the world's cutest animal, the Siberian flying squirrel would certainly be a strong contender. With their large, expressive eyes and soft features, these tree-dwelling mammals look as if they've stepped out of a Disney film. Photographer Masatsugu Ohashi captured particularly endearing images of these elusive squirrels on the Japanese island of Hokkaido. In his photos, two squirrels seem to strike photogenic poses, with one especially charming shot showing a squirrel peering out from its nest hole. Also known as the Russian flying squirrel, this species is incredibly shy and nocturnal. In winter, they may spend several days sleeping, making daytime sightings especially rare. The squirrels often nest in holes created by woodpeckers and favor tall pine, cedar, or spruce trees. Ohashi notes that the squirrels return to the same tree every winter, with up to five individuals sharing a nest during the cold season. These small creatures typically weigh around 150 grams and can reach up to 34 centimeters in length, including their tails. Despite their reclusive nature, the squirrels occasionally emerge to nibble on flowers or explore near their nests, giving rare opportunities for photography. They become active in the early morning and evening, making them even more challenging to observe in daylight. The Siberian flying squirrel is named for its remarkable ability to glide from tree to tree. By spreading a thin flap of skin between their limbs, they can escape predators and move effortlessly through the forest canopy.
translated_content: Si hi hagués un premi per a l’animal més adorable del món, l’esquirol volador siberià seria, sens dubte, un fort candidat. Amb els seus ulls grans i expressius i les seves faccions suaus, aquests mamífers arborícoles semblen sortits d’una pel·lícula de Disney. El fotògraf Masatsugu Ohashi ha capturat imatges especialment entranyables d’aquests esquirols esquius a l’illa japonesa de Hokkaido. En les seves fotos, dos esquirols semblen adoptar postures fotogèniques, amb una escena especialment encantadora d’un esquirol que treu el cap des de l’entrada del seu niu. També coneguda com l’esquirol volador rus, aquesta espècie és molt tímida i nocturna. A l’hivern, poden passar diversos dies dormint, fet que fa que les observacions diürnes siguin especialment estranyes. Els esquirols sovint fan nius en forats creats per pícids i prefereixen arbres alts com pins, cedres o avets. Ohashi comenta que els esquirols tornen al mateix arbre cada hivern, amb fins a cinc individus compartint niu durant la temporada freda. Aquestes petites criatures solen pesar uns 150 grams i arribar fins als 34 centímetres de llarg, incloent-hi la cua. Tot i la seva naturalesa esquiva, de tant en tant surten per cruspir-se alguna flor o explorar prop del niu, oferint rares oportunitats per a la fotografia. S’activen al matí d’hora i al vespre, cosa que fa encara més difícil veure’ls de dia. L’esquirol volador siberià rep el seu nom per la seva habilitat extraordinària de planar d’arbre en arbre. En desplegar una fina membrana entre les extremitats, poden escapar dels depredadors i moure’s àgilment per la capçada del bosc.

article_content: The Sundowner Motel in Albuquerque, New Mexico, once home to tech pioneers Bill Gates and Paul Allen in Microsoft’s early days, has been given a new lease on life as affordable housing. Gates and Allen stayed at the Sundowner in 1975, the year they launched Microsoft. At the time, the motel—an iconic stop along Route 66—was already past its prime. The motel closed five years ago after falling into disrepair, having become a haven for squatters and illicit activity. Recently, a company purchased and renovated the property, transforming it into affordable apartments for people including the mentally ill, students, and working families. Originally opened in 1960, the Sundowner was known for its pool, casino, nightclub, and restaurant, drawing both locals and travelers. Traffic on Route 66 declined after Interstate 40 opened in 1970, which contributed to the Sundowner's deterioration. John Bloomfield, executive director of New Life Homes, visited the property in 2009 and was moved by its condition. He decided to buy and restore it as low-income housing. Redesigned by Garret Smith Ltd, construction began in April 2013, resulting in 71 units from studios to three-bedroom apartments. The updated property offers amenities such as a sand volleyball court, garden, gazebo, and a display case highlighting its Microsoft roots. Tenants began moving in last October, and the complex is now fully occupied.

El motel va tancar fa cinc anys després de caure en decadència, convertint-se en refugi de persones sense llar i activitats il·legals. Recentment, una empresa va comprar i renovar la propietat, transformant-la en apartaments assequibles per a persones amb malalties mentals, estudiants i famílies treballadores. El trànsit a la Ruta 66 va disminuir després de la inauguració de la Interestatal 40 el 1970, fet que va contribuir a la degradació del Sundowner. John Bloomfield, director executiu de New Life Homes, va visitar la propietat el 2009 i es va sentir commogut pel seu estat. Va decidir comprar-la i rehabilitar-la com a habitatge social. Redissenyat per Garret Smith Ltd, les obres van començar a l’abril de 2013, donant lloc a 71 unitats d’habitatge, des d’estudis fins a pisos de tres habitacions. La propietat reformada compta amb una pista de vòlei de sorra, jardí, glorieta i una vitrina que destaca el seu passat vinculat a Microsoft. Els primers veïns s’hi van traslladar l’octubre passat i, ara mateix, el complex està completament ple.

article_content: Although Borad and Popsy, our farm dogs near Mumbai, were technically my first pets, the first animal I truly bonded with and cared for was a baby rat named Quasi Mouse. I never knew if Quasi Mouse was male or female, but this little rat became the dorm pet during my sixth-grade year at Rishi Valley boarding school in the 1980s. Our teachers supported our unusual choice of pet, which was special—it must have been quite an experience for them to see a bunch of boys want to take in a rat. The name Quasi Mouse was suggested by one of the boys, probably because we were all into The Hunchback of Notre Dame and had been talking about Quasimodo. As kids, naming just happens without much thought. Quasi Mouse lived in a shoebox — most likely a Bata box — in the upper dorm’s corner. Each of us gave something to make the box comfortable. I added a hand towel so Quasi Mouse would have a soft place to sleep. We cut air holes in the box, and feeding time became a shared task: we used a dropper to give milk from the school kitchen. Having Quasi Mouse brought us together. The usual division between younger and older students faded when we all focused on caring for our pet. During the three or four days Quasi Mouse was with us, there was a special spirit in the dorm. We’d rush back after class, and suddenly our dorm was the cool place, with others stopping by to meet our new friend. Quasi Mouse was delicate, quiet, and not in great health; despite our efforts, we couldn't save it. Someone was always keeping an eye on it, so we all noticed immediately when it stopped moving. That’s how we learned, quite starkly, what happens when someone passes—stillness and silence. We gave Quasi Mouse a small funeral in the school garden. We were heartbroken, and I cried for days. What stood out was how kids from other dorms came to comfort us—it really showed the kindness and unity in our community. Pets are all about unconditional love, and caring for them teaches us empathy. They have a way of making us better. I’ve always felt attached to animals, though I’ve never kept a pet permanently in my own home. Whenever friends come by with their dogs, it brings me real happiness—a kind of joy borrowed from their experience. Looking back, the time with Quasi Mouse was strange but truly wonderful. — Quasar Padamsee, stage actor and theatre director
translated_content: Tot i que Borad i Popsy, els nostres gossos de la granja prop de Mumbai, van ser tècnicament les meves primeres mascotes, el primer animal amb qui realment vaig connectar i cuidar va ser una rata petita anomenada Quasi Mouse. Mai vaig saber si era mascle o femella, però aquesta rateta va esdevenir la mascota del dormitori en el meu sisè curs a l'internat de Rishi Valley als anys 80. Els professors van donar suport a la nostra curiosa tria de mascota, cosa especial—devia ser tota una experiència per a ells veure uns nois voler acollir una rata. El nom Quasi Mouse el va proposar un dels nois, segurament perquè tots érem fans de «El geperut de Notre Dame» i n’havíem parlat molt. De petits, improvisem molt amb els noms. La Quasi Mouse vivia en una capsa de sabates—probablement de Bata—a un racó de l’habitació de dalt. Cadascun hi va aportar alguna cosa per fer-la més còmoda. Jo hi vaig posar una tovallola de mà perquè tingués un llit tou. Vam fer forats d’aire a la capsa i, per donar-li menjar, usàvem una pipeta amb llet de la cuina de l’escola. Cuidar la Quasi Mouse ens va unir d’una manera especial. Les divisions entre estudiants petits i grans es van diluir quan tothom es dedicava a la mascota. Aquells tres o quatre dies que va viure la Quasi Mouse van portar una energia diferent al dormitori. Tothom tenia ganes de tornar després de classe, i de cop, el nostre dorm era el lloc de moda; companys d’altres habitacions venien a veure l’animaló. La Quasi Mouse era fràgil, tranquil·la i estava malalta; malgrat tot, no la vam poder salvar. Algú la vigilava tota l’estona i, quan va deixar de moure’s, tothom se’n va adonar. Així vam aprendre, d’una manera colpidora, què passa quan algú mor—tot es queda en silenci. Vam fer un petit funeral al jardí de l’escola. Vam estar molt tristos, i jo vaig plorar durant dies. Em va impressionar com altres dormitoris es van apropar per donar-nos suport—es va notar la calidesa i complicitat de la nostra comunitat. Les mascotes ens donen amor incondicional i tenir-ne cura ens ensenya empatia. Ens fan millors persones. Sempre he estimat els animals, tot i que mai no n’he tingut un de fix a casa. Cada cop que amics venen amb els seus gossos, m’omple d’alegria—una alegria prestada de les seves vivències. Amb el temps, l’experiència amb la Quasi Mouse pot semblar estranya, però la recordo com una vivència molt bonica. — Quasar Padamsee, actor i director teatral

article_content: Sheikh Mohammed has acquired a majority stake in Belardo, the colt who recently triumphed in the esteemed Dewhurst Stakes. While Belardo is set to compete under the blue silks of the Godolphin team, Roger Varian will continue as his trainer from Newmarket. The horse’s original owner, Prince Faisal, will keep a share in Belardo during his racing career. Belardo made headlines with his impressive win at the Dubai Dewhurst Stakes at Newmarket on October 17. John Ferguson, bloodstock advisor to Sheikh Mohammed, praised Belardo’s quality and shared excitement about working alongside Prince Faisal. Ferguson noted that Belardo has a promising future, both on the racetrack and as a potential stallion. Ted Voute, who acts on behalf of Prince Faisal and was responsible for buying Belardo as a yearling, emphasized the strong, long-term relationship between Prince Faisal and Sheikh Mohammed. Voute explained that Prince Faisal was pleased with the deal, especially since he will remain actively involved with Belardo, who is expected to retire to the Darley stud eventually. To date, Belardo has claimed three wins out of five starts, including a two-length victory over Kodi Bear in the Dewhurst on Future Champions Day.

El propietari original del cavall, el príncep Faisal, mantindrà una part de Belardo durant tota la seva carrera de curses. Belardo va captar l’atenció amb la seva impressionant victòria a la Dubai Dewhurst Stakes a Newmarket el 17 d’octubre. Ted Voute, representant del príncep Faisal i responsable de la compra de Belardo quan era anyell, va remarcar la sòlida i llarga relació entre el príncep Faisal i el xeic Mohammed. Voute va explicar que el príncep Faisal està satisfet amb l’acord, especialment perquè seguirà molt implicat amb Belardo, que s’espera que acabi la seva carrera a la ramaderia Darley. Fins ara, Belardo ha aconseguit tres victòries en cinc curses, incloent-hi una victòria de dos cossos sobre Kodi Bear a la Dewhurst el Future Champions Day.

article_content: Royal Ascot’s newly implemented strict dress code has drawn both attention and criticism during this year's race meet. While the exclusive royal enclosure is meant to enforce the highest standards of attire, some attendees managed to bend, or even break, the rules. Zoe Neilson, a 23-year-old arts graduate from Wandsworth, south London, wore a backless, thigh-skimming dress revealing her black lace bra, breaching two of the enclosure’s guidelines: no visible underwear and a requirement for modest dress length. Despite these infractions, Neilson, who also sported prominent tattoos and a nose ring, described the rules as 'pretentious' and expressed little concern over the stewards monitoring the entrance. Neilson stated, 'I knew my dress was too short, so I tugged it down before I went through the gates. I saw the stewards but decided to just enjoy myself. I feel a bit bad about showing my bra at the back, but not really, because you can’t please everyone. I like that everyone dresses up for Ascot, but I still think the rules are a bit much. Then again, you don’t want everyone in mini-skirts and crop tops.' Asked about her tattoos, which include roses, ivy, and a pocket watch, Neilson remarked, 'I didn’t even think twice about my tattoos. I don’t think it’s an issue these days—I think they’re nice.' Joanna Southgate, a 34-year-old office worker from Brixton, also embraced body art, displaying tattooed arms while wearing a red dress and cherry-shaped headpiece. Her tattoos feature two naked women and an octopus, which she described as tasteful and in the art nouveau style. Southgate said, 'I had a really good day at Ascot and no one made any negative comments about my tattoos. I think mine are very artistic—if they weren’t, or if they were offensive, I’d cover them up for the races.' Despite some fashion defiance, many were immaculately dressed, following the example set by the Duchess of Cambridge and other royals, with knee-length shift dresses and nude heels being especially popular. Nurse Fiona Webb, 29, from Wokingham, Berkshire, noted that while she didn’t intentionally choose nude heels because of Kate Middleton, royal fashion clearly influences styles. The Queen herself set a tone of classic sophistication in a powder pink hat and matching ensemble. Radiotherapist Lauren Evans, 23, of Kensington, placed a bet on the color of the Queen’s hat for each day of Ascot, winning on the previous day's blue and being surprised by Thursday’s pink. As usual, high-profile personalities attended the event, from Prince Harry’s former partner Florence Brudenell Bruce to Formula One driver Jenson Button and TV personalities Lisa Scott-Lee and Faye Tozer. The event also featured music from The Tootsie Rollers, a retro girl band. Fashion officers patrolled the gates, handing out pashminas, ties, and fascinators to ensure compliance. Those needing a proper hat were required to leave a £50 cash deposit to encourage returns. Some women promoting a local strip club were asked to leave due to revealing attire, while other guests enjoyed the day’s festivities, some even relaxing enough to doze off in the sun.

Tot i que l’exclusiu recinte reial està pensat per fer complir els estàndards més alts d’indumentària, alguns assistents han aconseguit desafiar o fins i tot incomplir les normes. Zoe Neilson, una llicenciada en arts de 23 anys de Wandsworth, al sud de Londres, va portar un vestit curt, obert a l'esquena, que deixava veure el seu sostenidor de punta negra, incomplint dues de les directrius del recinte: no es permet mostrar la roba interior i es requereix una llargada de vestit modesta. Malgrat alguns desafiaments en la moda, molts assistents anaven impecablement vestits, seguint l’exemple de la Duquessa de Cambridge i altres membres de la reialesa, amb vestits tipus tub a l’alçada del genoll i sabates de taló de color carn especialment populars. La infermera Fiona Webb, de 29 anys i de Wokingham (Berkshire), va comentar que no va triar expressament talons nude pel fet que Kate Middleton els portés, però que la moda reial clarament té influència. Com sempre, personalitats destacades van assistir a l’esdeveniment, des de Florence Brudenell Bruce (exparella del príncep Harry) fins al pilot de Fórmula 1 Jenson Button o les cares televisives Lisa Scott-Lee i Faye Tozer. També hi va haver música del grup retro femení The Tootsie Rollers. Els vigilants de la moda controlaven les entrades, oferint pashmines, corbates i fascinadors als qui no complien les normes. Els qui necessitaven un barret havien de deixar un dipòsit en metàl·lic de 50 £ per assegurar-ne el retorn. Algunes dones que promocionaven un club de striptease local van ser convidades a marxar a causa de la roba massa reveladora, mentre la resta d’assistents gaudien de la jornada, alguns fins i tot prou relaxats per fer una becaina al sol.

article_content: An oil pipeline in southern Yemen operated by the Korea National Oil Corp (KNOC), a state-owned South Korean company, was struck by an explosion on Tuesday, according to local authorities and company officials cited by Yonhap news agency. Authorities believe the explosion may have been caused by attackers, resulting in a leak from the 204-kilometer pipeline located in Shabwa province, which produces about 10,000 barrels of oil per day. Explosives were discovered near the scene, and several reports are connecting al Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula (AQAP) to the incident. KNOC has been developing four oil sites in Yemen since 2007. The Korean Embassy in Yemen stated it is cooperating with local authorities to determine the cause of the blast. The pipeline explosion took place amid operations to capture U.S.-born militant Anwar al-Awlaki in the Shabwa region. U.S. officials suspect AQAP was behind the recent attempt to ship bombs from Yemen to the United States, linking the organization to ongoing security concerns in the area. According to a senior Yemeni official, authorities are intensifying efforts to apprehend al-Awlaki, who is regarded by the United States as a key figure and propagandist in AQAP. However, he has not been linked to the recent bomb plot. U.S. officials confirmed that Anwar al-Awlaki is on a CIA and military list to be captured or killed.
translated_content: Un oleoducte al sud del Iemen operat per la Korea National Oil Corp (KNOC), una empresa estatal sud-coreana, va ser afectat per una explosió dimarts, segons han informat autoritats locals i responsables de l'empresa citats per l'agència Yonhap. Les autoritats creuen que l'explosió podria haver estat causada per atacants, provocant una fuita al llarg dels 204 quilòmetres de l'oleoducte situat a la província de Shabwa, que produeix aproximadament 10.000 barrils de petroli al dia. Es van trobar explosius prop de l'indret i diversos informes relacionen Al-Qaida a la Península Aràbiga (AQAP) amb l'incident. KNOC ha estat desenvolupant quatre jaciments de petroli al Iemen des del 2007. L'ambaixada de Corea del Sud al Iemen ha declarat que col·labora amb les autoritats locals per determinar la causa de l'explosió. L'explosió de l'oleoducte s'ha produït mentre s'efectuen operacions per capturar el militant nascut als EUA, Anwar al-Awlaki, a la regió de Shabwa. Les autoritats dels EUA sospiten que l'AQAP és darrere del recent intent d'enviar bombes des del Iemen als Estats Units, fet que relaciona l'organització amb les preocupacions de seguretat que hi ha a la zona. Segons un alt funcionari iemenita, les autoritats intensifiquen els esforços per detenir al-Awlaki, considerat pels Estats Units una figura clau i propagandista de l'AQAP. No obstant això, no s'ha vinculat al-Awlaki amb l'intent d'atemptat recent. Les autoritats nord-americanes han confirmat que Anwar al-Awlaki figura en una llista de la CIA i dels militars per ser capturat o eliminat.

article_content: Paul Gascoigne, former England international footballer, spent the Bank Holiday weekend hospitalized following reports of a prolonged period of heavy drinking. On his exit from Poole Hospital, Gascoigne appeared somewhat improved, though concerns about his ongoing health remain. At 47, Gascoigne has long struggled with alcohol dependency. In the days before admission, he appeared visibly frail and disoriented in public, drawing attention from onlookers and friends who described signs of distress at his Dorset home. Emergency services were alerted for his safety, leading to his brief hospital stay. After his discharge, photos showed him outside the hospital, and later returning to his apartment with a more put-together appearance, though he continued to wear slippers. Gascoigne is also facing the end of his tenancy on his £3 million Sandbanks penthouse, as his lease expires in September. Property management confirmed the lease is simply not being renewed, not terminated early. There has been local speculation about Gascoigne possibly joining an amateur league football team, although his health challenges cast doubt on such plans. Known for his memorable performances with clubs such as Newcastle United, Tottenham Hotspur, Lazio, and Rangers, Gascoigne retains widespread support. Notable former teammates Chris Waddle and Gary Lineker have voiced hope for his recovery and future wellbeing. Supporters and friends remain optimistic that, with proper care and encouragement, Gascoigne can overcome his difficulties.

article_content: Nkosana Mdikane, 74, a much-loved crossing guard at Aitkenbar Primary School in Dumbarton, has been instructed by West Dunbartonshire Council to stop dancing and giving high-fives to pupils. The council's directive aims to improve road safety by requiring crossing guards to stay still with one hand on their stick and the other arm outstretched, making them more visible to drivers. Mdikane, who has worked in the role since 2013 after moving from South Africa, expressed disappointment with the policy, especially because it affected the children who looked forward to his cheerful greetings. He noted that both he and the pupils were saddened by the end of these joyful interactions. Previously, Mdikane was recognized by the council for his positive contributions, and he found fulfillment in his work after retirement, bringing energy and happiness to the school run. Along with his wife Zoli, now retired, they moved to Scotland seeking a new chapter after his years as a delivery driver and chauffeur. The community's reaction has been strongly supportive of Mdikane. Parents like David Dufton have organized petitions and social media campaigns, describing the rule as unfair and unnecessary, and emphasizing Mdikane’s commitment to safety and the happiness he brings. A council spokesperson reiterated that all patrollers are required to stay stationary with one hand on their stick and the other outstretched while helping children across, citing the importance of visibility and safety.
translated_content: Nkosana Mdikane, de 74 anys i molt apreciat com a vigilant de pas de vianants a l'escola Aitkenbar de Dumbarton, ha rebut l'ordre del Consell de West Dunbartonshire de deixar de ballar i donar 'xocs de mans' als alumnes. La directriu del consell pretén millorar la seguretat viària exigint que els vigilants de pas romanguin quiets, amb una mà a la vara i l'altra braç estès, perquè els conductors els puguin veure millor. Mdikane, que fa aquesta feina des de 2013 després d'haver-se traslladat des de Sud-àfrica, s'ha mostrat decebut amb la nova política, especialment perquè afecta als infants que esperaven amb alegria les seves salutacions animades. Ha destacat que tant ell com els alumnes s'han entristit de perdre aquestes interaccions positives. Anteriorment, Mdikane havia estat reconegut pel consell per la seva contribució entusiasta, i ell valorava profundament la seva tasca després de jubilar-se, aportant energia i alegria als matins escolars. Juntament amb la seva dona Zoli, també jubilada, es van traslladar a Escòcia per començar una nova etapa després d'anys treballant de xofer i repartidor. La comunitat ha reaccionat donant molt de suport a Mdikane. Pares com David Dufton han organitzat peticions i campanyes a les xarxes socials, qualifican la normativa d'injusta i innecessària i destacant el compromís de Mdikane amb la seguretat i la felicitat dels nens. Un portaveu del consell ha reiterat que tots els vigilants han de romandre estàtics amb una mà a la vara i l’altra estesa mentre ajuden els nens a creuar, remarcant la importància de la visibilitat i la seguretat.

article_content: BEIJING: Chinese Premier Li Qiang will attend the virtual G20 Leaders’ Summit on Wednesday at India's invitation, according to the Chinese Foreign Ministry. The summit is set to advance key outcomes and action points agreed upon during the G20 annual meeting in September, held in New Delhi under India's presidency, as stated by India’s Ministry of External Affairs (MEA). The summit will address the effects of the Russia-Ukraine war and the Israel-Hamas conflict, and is expected to encourage effective implementation of decisions made at the New Delhi summit two months ago, the MEA added. Li’s participation at the meeting follows an official invitation from the Indian government, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning confirmed at a press briefing, as reported by the state-run Xinhua news agency. All G20 member leaders, the Chair of the African Union, nine guest countries, and heads of 11 international organizations have been invited to the virtual summit. India hosted the G20 Summit in New Delhi on September 9-10, 2023. India will hold the G20 presidency until November 30, 2023. During Brazil’s G20 presidency in 2024, the Troika will comprise India, Brazil, and South Africa.

La cimera té l’objectiu d’avançar en els principals resultats i punts d’acció acordats durant la reunió anual del G20 al setembre, celebrada a Nova Delhi sota la presidència índia, segons el Ministeri d’Afers Exteriors de l’Índia (MEA). La cimera abordarà els efectes de la guerra Rússia-Ucraïna i el conflicte Israel-Hamas, i s’espera que impulsi la implementació efectiva de les decisions preses a la cimera de Nova Delhi fa dos mesos, afegeix el MEA. La participació de Li a la reunió segueix una invitació oficial del govern indi, va confirmar la portaveu del Ministeri d’Afers Exteriors de la Xina, Mao Ning, en una roda de premsa, segons va informar l’agència estatal Xinhua. Durant la presidència brasilera del G20 el 2024, la Troica estarà formada per l’Índia, el Brasil i Sud-àfrica.
