article_content: Orkney, renowned for offering the world's shortest regular flight, is reaching new heights with the launch of its first aviation festival. Set to take place from September 10th to 14th, the festival will showcase the story of military and civil aviation in the islands. Throughout the years, Orkney has played a central role in aviation advances, from its involvement in both world wars to the pioneering commercial air service led by Captain E.E. (Ted) Fresson in the 1930s. Since 1967, Loganair has operated the famously brief route between Westray and Papa Westray—the world's shortest scheduled flight. In November, Rebecca Simpson became the first woman to pilot the 1.7-mile journey, drawing aviation fans from across the globe. The record flight covers the distance in just 52 seconds, and the aircraft typically seats eight or nine passengers. The aviation festival is an initiative of the local group Another Orkney Production, led by photographer and filmmaker Moya McDonald, who aims to celebrate Orkney's diverse aviation achievements. Events will include a presentation from Loganair president Scott Grier, who will share the airline's history alongside archival footage. Other highlights include a talk on the Fleet Air Arm's presence in Scapa Flow, presented by Sheena Taylor, daughter of a pilot who served there. The festival will conclude with the Aviation Trail Bus Tour and the unveiling of a new aviation information board at the Standing Stones Hotel in Stenness. Among Orkney's aviation pioneers was Agnes Shearer (better known as Scottish writer and BBC contributor Ann Scott-Moncrieff), the first local to fly over the Pentland Firth with Captain Fresson. Her early death at age 29 was viewed as a significant loss for Scottish literature and culture. "Orkney is the ideal location for an aviation festival," said McDonald. "From flying boats in Scapa Flow on U-boat patrols to today's Loganair inter-island services, Orkney has an extraordinarily rich aviation history."

Al novembre, Rebecca Simpson es va convertir en la primera dona a pilotar aquest trajecte de només 2,7 km, que atreu aficionats de l’aviació de tot el món. El vol rècord cobreix la distància en només 52 segons, i l’avió acostuma a tenir vuit o nou seients. article_content: The majority of women in the United States use birth control, and many consider it a minor inconvenience. Sometimes we forget to take our pills, and the side effects can be uncomfortable, but we accept these issues because having the ability to determine our own future is so important. I didn't truly understand how much contraceptives affected my life until I became involved in global health and realized that hundreds of millions of women and girls in sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia do not have access to birth control. For them, the lack of contraception is far more than a minor annoyance—it can be a major obstacle to a better life. After learning what women in low-income countries face, I began to wonder: what would my life have been like without access to birth control? This week, at the London Summit on Family Planning, a collaboration involving governments from developed and developing nations, foundations, the private sector, and NGOs, a significant initiative is being launched to ensure no woman has to ask herself that question. Our aim is to make modern contraceptives, as well as family planning information and services, available to 120 million more women and girls in the world's poorest countries over the next eight years. I am passionate about family planning because, everywhere I travel and connect with women in developing countries, a common theme arises: they want access to contraception. They want to control their own futures. They know that when they can decide when to have children, both they and their children are healthier, their families are more successful, and their communities thrive. Unfortunately, in many places, this positive cycle isn't happening. Nearly 13 million adolescent girls give birth each year in developing nations, often before they are prepared physically, emotionally, or financially. When girls postpone childbearing until their twenties, they're more likely to remain in school. Women with an education tend to marry later, have healthier families, and can invest in their children's education. Simply allowing women to space births by three years can reduce the death rate among children under five by 25%. Currently, several initiatives are working to expand women's access to essential contraceptives. In Senegal, we are supporting a pilot project to keep clinics consistently stocked with a full range of modern contraceptives, including implants, injectables, and IUDs, empowering women to make their own choices. Imagine traveling for hours to a clinic for birth control, only to find that supplies have run out. It is encouraging to see countries like Senegal investing in new programs so women always have options when they visit clinics. Important research is also underway to create new products that give women even more choices. I'm excited about a new injectable that women can administer themselves, eliminating the need to travel to a clinic. In the US, many of us manage our own contraception; it's difficult to imagine needing a doctor’s visit for each decision. This self-administered device could empower women in places where the pill isn’t widely used to plan their families independently. Last year, I spoke with women in Nairobi’s Korogocho slum, who discussed openly why they use birth control. After two hours, one woman, Mary Ann, summed up the conversation: 'I want to bring every good thing to one child before I have another.' This message captures why I am so dedicated to family planning and enthusiastic about the London Summit. Enabling every woman to plan her family is the first step to giving each child the best chance in life. On July 11, I invite everyone to witness the historic commitments at the summit and support the right of every woman and girl to control her own future. The views expressed are those of Melinda Gates.
translated_content: La majoria de dones als Estats Units utilitzen anticonceptius i moltes ho consideren una molèstia menor. A vegades oblidem prendre’ns la pastilla i els efectes secundaris poden ser incòmodes, però acceptem aquestes situacions perquè tenir el poder de decidir el nostre futur és molt important. No vaig valorar prou com m’havia impactat l’accés als anticonceptius fins que em vaig implicar en la salut global i vaig descobrir que centenars de milions de dones i nenes a l’Àfrica subsahariana i al sud d’Àsia no tenen accés als anticonceptius. Per a elles, la manca d’anticonceptius és molt més que una simple molèstia: pot ser un gran obstacle per a una vida millor. Quan vaig conèixer el que moltes dones viuen en països amb pocs recursos, em vaig preguntar: com hauria sigut la meva vida sense accés als anticonceptius? Aquesta setmana, a la Cimera de Londres sobre Planificació Familiar, una col·laboració entre governs de països desenvolupats i en desenvolupament, fundacions, el sector privat i ONG, es llança una iniciativa important per garantir que cap dona s’hagi de fer aquesta pregunta. El nostre objectiu és proporcionar anticonceptius moderns, informació i serveis de planificació familiar a 120 milions de dones i nenes més en els països més pobres durant els pròxims vuit anys. La planificació familiar m’apassiona perquè, arreu on viatjo i parlo amb dones de països en desenvolupament, sempre sento la mateixa idea: volen accés als anticonceptius. Volen controlar el seu propi futur. Saben que si poden decidir quan tenir fills, tant elles com els seus infants tenen millor salut, les famílies són més reeixides i les comunitats prosperen. Malauradament, en molts llocs aquest cercle positiu no es dona. Gairebé 13 milions d’adolescents donen a llum cada any en països en desenvolupament, generalment abans d’estar preparades físicament, emocionalment o econòmicament. Quan les noies retarden la maternitat fins als vint, tenen més probabilitats de continuar estudiant. Les dones amb educació es casen més tard, tenen famílies més sanes i poden invertir en l’educació dels fills. Només amb el fet que les dones puguin espaiar els naixements tres anys, la mortalitat infantil dels nens menors de cinc anys es podria reduir un 25%. Actualment, hi ha diverses iniciatives per ampliar l’accés als anticonceptius essencials. Al Senegal, donem suport a un projecte pilot per mantenir els centres mèdics sempre equipats amb la gamma completa d’anticonceptius moderns, incloent-hi implants, injectables i DIUs, donant així la capacitat de decidir a les dones. Imagineu haver de viatjar hores per buscar anticonceptius i trobar que no n’hi ha. És molt encoratjador veure països com el Senegal invertir en programes innovadors perquè les dones sempre tinguin opcions quan van al metge. També s’està investigant per crear nous productes que ampliïn les alternatives. Fa especial il·lusió un nou injectable que es poden administrar elles mateixes, eliminant la necessitat d’anar al centre mèdic. Aquí, moltes gestionem nosaltres mateixes l’anticoncepció; costa imaginar haver de visitar el metge cada vegada. Aquesta eina d’autoadministració podria donar poder a dones en llocs on la píndola no és tan habitual per planificar la família de manera independent. L’any passat, vaig parlar amb dones del barri de Korogocho a Nairobi, que van explicar obertament per què fan servir anticonceptius. Després de dues hores, una dona, la Mary Ann, ho va resumir: 'Vull donar tot el millor a un fill abans de tenir-ne un altre.' Aquesta frase resumeix per què m’importa tant la planificació familiar i per què estic entusiasmada amb la Cimera de Londres. Que cada dona pugui planificar la seva família és el primer pas per donar el millor a cada infant. L’11 de juliol, convido tothom a seguir els compromisos històrics de la cimera i donar suport al dret de totes les dones i nenes a decidir el seu futur. Les opinions expressades són de Melinda Gates.

article_content: Netflix is drawing attention for reportedly blocking some Australian users who have used VPNs to access its streaming service ahead of its official launch in Australia and New Zealand, scheduled for March 2015. VPNs let users disguise their location to view content not yet accessible in their country. Approximately 200,000 Australians are believed to have used VPNs for this purpose, and recently, some have encountered access problems.  Speculation suggests that Netflix could be moving to curb VPN usage as a preparatory measure for its regional launch. Netflix, however, claims there have been no recent changes to its VPN policies. A spokesperson told Cnet that no new restrictions have been enacted. Ben Van der Pelt of TorGuard told TorrentFreak he suspects Netflix may be temporarily testing new blocking techniques, primarily affecting IP ranges with numerous simultaneous logins.  Netflix’s Director of Corporate Communications and Technology, Cliff Edwards, recently stated in Australia that using VPNs violates the firm’s terms of service and stressed the need for content creators to be compensated.  The service, with around 53 million global subscribers, will become officially available in Australia and New Zealand for users subscribing to the network. Netflix plans to offer high-definition streaming of selected movies and TV series on smart TVs, tablets, smartphones, set-top boxes, and consoles. The availability of major originals such as House of Cards and Orange Is The New Black at launch is still uncertain. Pricing details have not yet been disclosed but are estimated to fall between AU$10 and AU$15 per month.  Netflix’s entry is expected to intensify competition among streaming providers. Foxtel, a major pay-TV service, recently lowered prices, anticipating the market shift. Additionally, streaming ventures like StreamCo, jointly launched by Nine Entertainment and Fairfax Media, are also set to debut.  Initial offerings in Australia and New Zealand will include original series such as Marco Polo, BoJack Horseman, and All Hail King Julien, with further titles like Marvel’s Daredevil and Bloodline following later. Netflix has also secured subscription video-on-demand rights to Gotham; however, existing broadcasting agreements mean the show will become available on Netflix a year after its debut on Nine Entertainment.  The anticipated official launch of Netflix in Australia and New Zealand signals a major change in the entertainment landscape, promising more competition and viewing choices for local audiences.

El Director de Comunicacions Corporatives i Tecnologia de Netflix, Cliff Edwards, va afirmar recentment a Austràlia que l'ús de VPNs viola els termes del servei i va remarcar la importància que els creadors de contingut rebin compensació.  El servei, amb uns 53 milions de subscriptors a nivell mundial, estarà oficialment disponible a Austràlia i Nova Zelanda per als usuaris que es subscriguin. Foxtel, capçalera de la televisió de pagament, ha abaixat preus recentment en previsió d'aquest canvi al mercat. A més, plataformes com StreamCo, impulsades conjuntament per Nine Entertainment i Fairfax Media, també es preparen per debutar. El llançament oficial de Netflix a Austràlia i Nova Zelanda promet canviar notablement el sector audiovisual local, oferint més elecció i competència als espectadors.

article_content: In Allegan, Michigan, eight-year-old Edward Hart, a special needs student at the Hillside Learning and Behavior Center, is facing charges for allegedly damaging police property and resisting an officer. Edward, who has known anger management issues, left his school campus on March 19, prompting staff to search for him. Authorities found him at a party store after staff contacted police. A police report states that school staff requested an officer drive Edward back to school. During the encounter, Edward reportedly cursed and physically engaged with the officer, and broke a rear-facing camera in the police car. This led the officer to file charges. Edward’s stepfather, Robert Bluhm, told Fox 43 he feels the situation was mishandled, particularly given Edward’s age and special needs. He questioned the decision to charge such a young child. The family disciplined Edward by banning TV, making him spend time in a timeout chair, and taking away his Nintendo DS. To cover the $50 police requested for camera repairs, the family plans to pawn Edward’s gaming device. Allegan Police Chief Rick Hoyer has said he does not support the prosecutor’s decision to pursue criminal charges in this case.

Carlie Ritch, known professionally as Mizz Barbie B****, has officially entered Toronto’s mayoral race. As a business owner, dominatrix, mother, and grandmother, Ritch felt compelled to challenge current mayor Rob Ford, citing his perceived arrogance and abuse of authority as primary motivators.

Running a successful dungeon in the city and planning to launch a franchise of dominatrix training academies (with potential backing from Dragon’s Den investors), Ritch aims to introduce significant reforms at City Hall. Her campaign emphasizes discipline and new leadership, including vows to replace officials who have held office for decades and to reassign underperforming city staff. She claims to have clients from City Hall but declines to disclose their identities.

Ritch emphasizes her relatable background, describing herself as a self-made, blue-collar Torontonian. She promises a transparent, change-driven administration if elected.

Rob Ford, the current mayor since 2010, has struggled with public and political pressure following his admittance to drug use and multiple public incidents, such as videos and reports of intoxicated behavior. While City Council has reduced some of his powers, Ford remains in office and plans to run for re-election.

Ritch’s unconventional background offers voters an alternative as Toronto considers the direction of its leadership following recent mayoral scandals.

article_content: Stonehenge, one of Britain's most celebrated and historic monuments, was constructed thousands of years ago by dedicated Neolithic workers who lived close to the site during its development. Without the aid of modern machinery, these builders relied on simple tools and communal effort. Now, more than 4,500 years later, archaeologists and volunteers have reconstructed huts similar to those used as temporary homes by the builders. While these replicas offer an authentic glimpse into the past, one humorous difference is that the original workers likely did not live next to a pig farm, unlike the modern reconstruction site near Old Sarum, close to Salisbury, Wiltshire. Three Neolithic house replicas, modeled on ruins found at Durrington Walls—the largest Neolithic settlement discovered in Northern Europe about two miles from Stonehenge—will form the focal point of a new £27 million visitor centre set to open at Stonehenge. This living history project involves a team of 60 volunteers test-building the huts using various materials and techniques to learn more about Neolithic lifestyles. The reconstructed houses are based on archaeological evidence gathered from the excavation of ten rare Neolithic house remains at Durrington Walls between 2006 and 2007. Radiocarbon dating indicated these buildings were in use around 2,500 BC, coinciding with the construction of Stonehenge's sarsen stones. The prototypes test different construction materials, including stone, wood, straw, and dung, since the exact appearance of the original huts above ground is uncertain. English Heritage states that these huts will provide visitors with a tangible and sensory connection to the lives and technology of the Neolithic people who built Stonehenge. Susan Greaney, a senior properties historian, notes that although much evidence informs the reconstruction, some aspects rely on informed guesswork. Building the prototypes helps test ideas about roofing, building techniques, comfort, privacy, and social organization of Neolithic communities. The visitor centre, scheduled to open later this year, is primarily funded by the Heritage Lottery Fund, English Heritage commercial income, and donations from benefactors. Outdated facilities will be removed, and the site will be landscaped to blend harmoniously with its surroundings. Overall, the project aims to deepen public appreciation for the extraordinary individuals who constructed Stonehenge and the challenges of their daily lives.

Tres rèpliques d'habitatges neolítics, modelades a partir de les ruïnes trobades a Durrington Walls—el jaciment neolític més gran descobert al nord d'Europa, a uns tres quilòmetres de Stonehenge—seran el punt central del nou centre d'interpretació de 27 milions de lliures que s'inaugurarà a Stonehenge. English Heritage afirma que aquestes cabanes oferiran als visitants una connexió tangible i sensorial amb les vides i la tecnologia de les persones neolítiques que van construir Stonehenge. Les instal·lacions antigues i obsoletes seran eliminades i l'espai es recondicionarà per integrar-se de manera harmoniosa amb l'entorn. En conjunt, el projecte pretén aprofundir l'apreciació pública per les persones extraordinàries que van construir Stonehenge i els reptes de la seva vida quotidiana.

article_content: Wales prop Aaron Jarvis is expected to be out for around six weeks after suffering a pectoral muscle injury. This is the latest setback for the Ospreys' front row, with teammates Nicky Smith, Ryan Bevington, and Duncan Jones also sidelined. Jarvis sustained his injury during Wales' 12-6 victory over South Africa at the Millennium Stadium 11 days ago. Ospreys medical performance manager Chris Towers confirmed that a scan showed Jarvis does not need surgery, but he faces a recovery period of approximately six weeks. The Ospreys will also be without lock Lloyd Peers for Saturday's European Champions Cup match against Racing Metro in Le Mans. Peers sustained ankle ligament damage during last weekend's 19-19 home draw with the French club. Towers noted that a scan confirmed the damage, and the team is consulting with an ankle specialist to determine the best treatment plan.

The Marvels faced challenges when star Iman Vellani was unable to participate in a full press tour ahead of the film’s release due to industry strikes, with her interviews mostly limited to just before opening. While this likely wouldn’t have changed the film’s outcome, Vellani’s post-release interviews have showcased her charisma and potential as a spokesperson for the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).

Vellani directly addressed the film’s struggles, including The Marvels recording the lowest box office opening weekend of any MCU film. In an interview with Yahoo, she reflected on facing negativity toward Marvel even before joining the franchise—recalling how, as a high school fan, she sometimes felt ostracized for her enthusiasm. She expressed sadness over how harsh some fans can be and encouraged audiences to allow others to enjoy what they love, saying no one should be a “wet blanket” on someone else’s excitement.

Despite the movie’s performance, Vellani is expected to continue appearing within the MCU. There is speculation about a possible second season of Ms. Marvel, which Vellani herself is advocating for with Marvel Studios and Kevin Feige. The ending of The Marvels teases her recruiting Kate Bishop and potentially leading a Young Avengers team. With future large-scale crossover films like the upcoming Avengers entries, Vellani’s character could also appear, even in smaller roles, much as Infinity War and Endgame featured nearly all Marvel heroes.

The author offers high praise for Vellani, calling her one of the MCU’s best casting choices since Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark, and looks forward to her continued presence in Marvel projects.

article_content: By Sophie Borland. A recent poll reveals that about a third of GPs believe patients should be charged for visiting A&E to discourage non-urgent attendances. Many support the idea of a basic fee, up to £10 per visit, to deter people from seeking emergency care for minor issues. The survey, conducted among 800 family doctors by doctors.net.uk, found that 32% favored the introduction of A&E fees. Some GPs commented that charging a small amount—such as £5 to £10, possibly refundable for appropriate cases—could significantly reduce unnecessary visits and encourage patients to seek advice from pharmacists for minor ailments. However, these findings may provoke frustration among members of the public, especially those who struggle to get GP appointments, particularly in the evenings and on weekends. Meanwhile, NHS officials have warned GP practices that they risk closure if they shut early without permission during the holiday season. It is suspected that hundreds of practices closed early on Christmas and New Year's Eve, even though they are paid to stay open until 6:30pm. NHS England monitored 238 surgeries in London on Christmas Eve between 3:30pm and 6:30pm and found 5% were closed. While not all 8,000 surgeries in England were contacted, if this trend is similar nationwide, up to 400 surgeries may have closed early. The same checks took place on New Year's Eve, and NHS England is now issuing breach of contract notices to practices that closed early, warning that repeated violations could lead to termination of their contracts. Some GPs, commenting on the medical news website Pulse, said keeping surgeries open late on these days is unnecessary since demand is typically low. Dr. Peter Swinyard, chairman of the Family Doctor Association, wrote, 'What a complete farce. The number of calls after 3:30pm on Christmas Eve is always vanishingly small.' Despite this, NHS England insists that GPs must fulfil their responsibility to patients, noting the risk of diverting more patients to already busy A&E and out-of-hours services if surgeries close early. A spokesperson for NHS England explained, 'We undertook this exercise to ensure patients in London could access the primary care services they are entitled to.' Last month, Dr. David Geddes, NHS England’s head of primary care commissioning, informed GPs that early closure on Christmas or New Year's Eve was 'non-negotiable,' stressing that for some patients, this may be their only opportunity to collect vital medications.

article_content: Shannon Barnes, a former cosmetics saleswoman and now a professional makeup artist in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, often faced questions from customers wondering if the dramatic eyelashes shown in mascara ads were real. She honestly admitted that mascara alone cannot achieve such results. Yet, most customers still bought the product. Barnes said even she sometimes gets swayed by the marketing, despite knowing that images are regularly airbrushed and digitally altered. She sometimes tells young girls that the images they see in advertisements do not reflect reality. Recently, two L'Oreal ads in the UK—featuring Julia Roberts and Christy Turlington—were banned for excessive retouching. The move drew little reaction in the United States, where industry experts and psychologists say most consumers are aware that ads are not fully accurate and tend not to mind. Clinical psychologist Nancy Berk from Pittsburgh noted that consumers prefer seeing 'spectacular' models in ads instead of ordinary faces, indicating that advertisements target aspirations more than realism. The cosmetics industry, valued at around $10 billion, often uses carefully crafted phrases like 'reduces appearance of' or 'skin looks younger.' These terms are difficult for the Federal Trade Commission to verify or strictly regulate. According to Mary Lou Quinlan, CEO of Just Ask a Woman marketing agency, advertising claims are creative but are supposed to remain accurate. Still, whether something is accurate or exaggerated often depends on the viewer’s perception. Paula Begoun, a Washington-based author known as the 'Cosmetics Cop,' pointed out that certain claims, especially in hair care, anti-aging, and anti-acne ads, can be misleading. She mentioned phrases like 'Skin appears more even and looks lifted,' which suggest results without guaranteeing them. Consumers who believe in advertising promises may end up disappointed if they fail to see the promised effects. Experts suggest that such people might seek self-worth through their appearance and may even pursue cosmetic procedures. Psychotherapist Brooke Miller noted that many people buy beauty products hoping to improve how they feel about themselves, indicating that ads sell a mindset as much as a product. She added that the endless potential for improvement keeps consumers coming back. Even industry executives such as Farah Ahmed, vice president at the Personal Care Products Council, acknowledge that while consumers understand products won't make them look like celebrities, ads featuring famous faces are still highly effective.

Manchester City manager Manuel Pellegrini insists the team’s FA Cup ambitions remain strong, even though they returned from Abu Dhabi just 21 hours before Saturday’s fourth-round tie against Middlesbrough at the Etihad Stadium. The squad delayed their return from a warm-weather training camp until Friday night, but Pellegrini believes there is no danger of jet lag from the seven-hour flight. After arriving in Manchester around 8pm, players such as David Silva and captain Vincent Kompany went straight to the club’s training base to prepare for the 3pm kickoff.

"We have prepared for this and will arrive at the City Football Academy for our pre-match meeting," said Pellegrini. "We analyzed the decision to travel to Abu Dhabi ahead of time. With only a four-hour time difference, which works in our favor, jet lag won't be an issue. I don’t expect any problems.

"The trip was a useful break, offering a chance to train differently. I hope we'll see the results on our return."

Pellegrini, disappointed by last season’s FA Cup defeat at home to Wigan, cautioned his players to stay alert against Championship side Middlesbrough. He praised Middlesbrough's manager, Aitor Karanka—who previously served as assistant coach at Real Madrid after Pellegrini’s departure in 2010—and highlighted Middlesbrough’s strong position in the Championship.

"I expect a very good game," Pellegrini added. "Middlesbrough are doing well and are guided by a manager I know well. If we don’t play with full intensity and focus, qualifying for the next round could be difficult."

L'equip va endarrerir el seu retorn d'una estada d'entrenament a climes càlids fins divendres a la nit, però Pellegrini creu que no hi ha risc de jet lag pel vol de set hores. "El viatge ha estat una pausa útil i ens ha donat l'oportunitat de fer un treball diferent. Espero veure'n els beneficis en el nostre retorn."

Pellegrini, encara decebut per l'eliminació de la FA Cup a casa davant del Wigan la temporada passada, va advertir els seus jugadors que no es confiïn davant un Middlesbrough molt competitiu a la Championship. Richard Parrinello, an animal control officer from Brookhaven, New York, who was on disability leave, has been found keeping around 850 snakes in his home's detached garage, authorities said Thursday. Among the snakes were two Burmese pythons, a species illegal to own in New York; those pythons have since been sent to a sanctuary in Massachusetts. Suffolk County SPCA chief Roy Gross noted that all the snakes were stored appropriately, and there was no evidence of neglect or mistreatment.

Parrinello operated a business called 'Snakeman’s Exotics' that sold reptiles domestically and internationally. His online listings included pythons, boa constrictors, and hognose snakes. The facility was reportedly clean and organized. The discovery of the snake operation followed an investigation into possible worker’s compensation fraud, leading to a search of the property by multiple agencies. Officials found turtles and turtle eggs, tarantulas, and freezers with frozen mice and alligator remains. Parrinello reportedly told undercover investigators he had about $500,000 in reptiles and eggs on hand.

While Parrinello has not been criminally charged, running this type of business from a residential area breaks local codes, and officials expect further violations soon. Brookhaven Supervisor Ed Romaine expressed concern for community safety. Parrinello received summonses for possession of wild animals and alligator parts without permits, each carrying a potential $250 fine, according to state environmental officials. Under federal rules, the import of Burmese pythons and similar exotic snakes is banned. Wildlife ecologist Frank Mazzotti noted that Burmese pythons typically grow between 6 and 9 feet and lack natural predators in the U.S., contributing to state-sponsored removal programs like those in Florida.

Entre les serps hi havia dues pitons birmanes, una espècie prohibida a Nova York; aquestes pitons ja han estat traslladades a un santuari a Massachusetts. El cap de la SPCA del Comtat de Suffolk, Roy Gross, va assenyalar que totes les serps estaven allotjades de manera adequada i que no hi havia indicis de negligència ni de maltractament.

Parrinello dirigia un negoci anomenat 'Snakeman’s Exotics' que venia rèptils tant dins com fora dels Estats Units. Les seves llistes en línia incloïen pitons, boes constrictores i serps hognose. L'operació es va descobrir arran d'una investigació per possible frau de compensació laboral, cosa que va portar diverses agències a escorcollar la propietat. Els funcionaris hi van trobar tortugues i ous de tortuga, taràntules i congeladors amb ratolins i restes d'al·ligàtor congelats. Pel que sembla, Parrinello va afirmar als investigadors infiltrats que tenia uns 500.000 dòlars en rèptils i ous a la propietat.

article_content: During a large-scale military parade in Pyongyang, Kim Jong Un addressed the nation as North Korea's young Supreme Leader, facing ranks of soldiers to commemorate his grandfather Kim Il Sung's 100th birthday. While Kim appeared somewhat nervous, his speech was confident and paid tribute to his family's leadership and the country's ongoing challenges. This speech marked a break from tradition, as it was unusual for North Koreans to hear directly from their leader. Crowd members described the occasion as an unparalleled honor and shared their pride. Kim spoke to both domestic and international audiences, highlighting the long division of Korea and voicing a willingness to work towards reunification: 'We have endured nearly 70 years of separation. Our administration is open to anyone genuinely striving for unity.' Although he touched on the prospect of peace, the parade was unmistakably a demonstration of military power, showcasing advanced weapons and sending a strong message to North Koreans and rivals like the United States. Kim asserted that North Korea's military is ready to withstand any modern warfare and emphasized that foreign powers are no longer unrivaled in military dominance. Soldiers, both male and female, affirmed their steadfast loyalty to their leaders. Citizens responded enthusiastically, often expressing pride in Kim Jong Un's leadership to outsiders. The 'military-first' doctrine is evident, despite reports from aid agencies that rural North Koreans face chronic hunger and malnutrition. Recognizing these hardships, Kim pledged that his government would prevent further suffering: 'Our firmest resolve is not to let our people go hungry again.' With the celebration over, Kim faces the immediate test of governing a nation marked by isolation, poverty, and high expectations.
translated_content: Durant una gran desfilada militar a Pyongyang, Kim Jong Un es va dirigir a la nació com a jove líder suprem de Corea del Nord, davant les files de soldats per commemorar el centenari del seu avi Kim Il Sung. Malgrat un cert nerviosisme, el seu discurs va ser segur i va fer homenatge a la seva família i als reptes que afronta el país. Aquest discurs va suposar una ruptura amb la tradició, ja que era poc usual que els nord-coreans escoltessin directament el seu líder. Els assistents van descriure l'ocasió com un gran honor i van mostrar el seu orgull. Kim es va adreçar tant a la comunitat nacional com internacional, posant l'accent en la llarga divisió de Corea i mostrant predisposició a treballar per la reunificació: 'Hem patit gairebé 70 anys de separació. La nostra administració està oberta a qui realment vulgui la unitat.' Tot i les referències a la pau, la desfilada va ser una demostració clara de força militar, amb armes sofisticades i enviant un missatge contundent tant a la població com als rivals, especialment els Estats Units. Kim va afirmar que l'exèrcit nord-coreà està preparat per afrontar qualsevol guerra moderna i va remarcar que les potències estrangeres ja no ostenten la supremacia militar. Homes i dones soldats van reafirmar la seva lleialtat als líders. Els ciutadans van respondre amb entusiasme, sovint mostrant orgull pel lideratge de Kim Jong Un davant observadors de fora del país. La doctrina del 'primer l'exèrcit' és evident, tot i que organitzacions d'ajuda alerten sobre la gana i la malnutrició cròniques en zones rurals. Reconeguent aquests problemes, Kim va prometre que el seu govern evitarà més sofriment: 'La nostra voluntat més ferma és no deixar que el nostre poble passi gana de nou.' Acabada la celebració, Kim afronta el repte immediat de governar un país caracteritzat per l'aïllament, la pobresa i unes expectatives molt altes.

The impartiality of the Speaker of the House of Representatives, Bronwyn Bishop, has come under scrutiny following allegations she hosted Liberal Party fundraisers in her parliamentary suite in Canberra. Bishop, a longtime Liberal Party member, is reported to have used the official room for these functions—a practice former Labor Speakers say they never engaged in.

A spokesman for Bishop stated the events did not breach any laws and clarified that expenses for such functions come from her private account, not taxpayer funds. On the night of the May 13 federal budget, Bishop allegedly hosted a Liberal Party fundraiser in her suite attended by 20 donors, with reports indicating the event raised $50,000 at $2,500 per plate. Prime Minister Tony Abbott was believed to be present.

Labor’s opposition manager Tony Burke asserted that if the claims are proven true, Bishop’s role as Speaker would become untenable. He stressed that the Speaker’s suite is not meant for private or party events. Former Labor Speakers Anna Burke and Harry Jenkins confirmed they never used the suite for party fundraising. 

Bishop was nominated for her position by Prime Minister Abbott and elected on November 12, 2013, becoming the third woman to serve as Speaker. Labor previously attempted, unsuccessfully, to pass a motion of no confidence against her, citing alleged partiality during question time.

Bishop, membre del Partit Liberal de tota la vida, hauria utilitzat l’espai oficial per a aquestes funcions, cosa que antics presidents laboristes asseguren que mai no van fer.

Un portaveu de Bishop va afirmar que aquests actes no vulneren cap llei i va puntualitzar que les despeses d’aquestes funcions es cobreixen amb el seu compte privat, no amb fons públics. La nit del pressupost federal del 13 de maig, Bishop hauria organitzat una recaptació de fons del Partit Liberal a la seva suite, amb l’assistència de 20 donants, i segons es diu, es van recaptar 50.000 dòlars, a raó de 2.500 dòlars per cap. Es creu que el primer ministre Tony Abbott hi va ser present.

El responsable de l’oposició laborista, Tony Burke, va afirmar que, si es confirmen les acusacions, el càrrec de Bishop com a presidenta seria insostenible. Burke va remarcar que la suite de la presidència no està destinada a esdeveniments privats o de partit. Els antics presidents laboristes Anna Burke i Harry Jenkins van confirmar que mai no van fer servir l’espai per a recaptacions de fons del partit.

Bishop va ser nominada pel primer ministre Abbott i elegida el 12 de novembre de 2013, convertint-se en la tercera dona a ocupar el càrrec. El Partit Laborista ja havia intentat, sense èxit, presentar una moció de censura contra ella al·legant parcialitat durant les sessions de preguntes al govern.

article_content: RMEISH, Lebanon — Israeli warplanes launched airstrikes along the border with Lebanon on Saturday after the militant group Hezbollah attacked several Israeli army posts, including one hit by two large rockets. The escalation comes a day after Hezbollah's leader, Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah, claimed the group is already engaged in unprecedented fighting along the Lebanon-Israel frontier and threatened further escalation as Israel’s war with Hamas — Hezbollah's ally in Gaza — nears the one-month mark. Nasrallah said Hezbollah is prepared for all options and can resort to them at any time. Hezbollah announced its fighters had attacked at least six Israeli posts along the border using 'suitable rockets and weapons,' claiming direct hits and the destruction of technical equipment. Beirut-based Al-Mayadeen TV reported that Hezbollah fired two Burkan rockets — heavy warheads previously used in Syria — at an Israeli post identified as Jal al-Allam. A Lebanese security official confirmed the rockets were used for the first time in this context. Hezbollah’s Al-Manar TV said its fighters shot down an Israeli surveillance balloon over the northern town of Misgaf Am. Near the village of Rmeish, an Israeli airstrike sent thick gray smoke into the sky, and artillery fire could be heard from afar. Lebanon’s National News Agency reported airstrikes around several other border villages, including Labbouneh and Hibarieh. Israeli military spokesman Avichay Adraee wrote on X (formerly Twitter) that Israeli warplanes, tanks, and artillery targeted the source of fire on the Lebanese side as well as Hezbollah arms depots and infrastructure. Cross-border fighting has increased since the Palestinian group Hamas attacked southern Israel on October 7, killing over 1,400 civilians and troops. In response, Israel has launched extensive aerial and ground operations in Gaza, with Palestinian health officials reporting more than 9,000 deaths, mostly civilians. Hezbollah began attacking Israeli positions on October 8 in the disputed Chebaa Farms area near the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights, and soon expanded attacks along the entire border. On Saturday, Hezbollah said one of its fighters was killed, bringing the group's death toll since the fighting began to 56. Ten civilians, including a Reuters journalist, and several Palestinian fighters have also been killed.

L'escalada arriba un dia després que el líder de Hezbollah, Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah, afirmés que el grup ja està immers en combats sense precedents a la frontera entre el Líban i Israel i amenaçés amb una escalada addicional mentre la guerra d'Israel amb Hamàs — aliat de Hezbollah a Gaza — s'acosta al primer mes. Nasrallah va dir que Hezbollah està preparat per a totes les opcions i pot recórrer-hi en qualsevol moment. Hezbollah va anunciar que els seus combatents havien atacat almenys sis posicions israelianes a la frontera utilitzant 'coets i armes adequades', i va afirmar haver aconseguit impactes directes i destruït equipament tècnic. La cadena Al-Mayadeen, amb seu a Beirut, va informar que Hezbollah va disparar dos coets Burkan — caps de guerra pesants prèviament utilitzats a Síria — contra un punt israelià conegut com a Jal al-Allam. Un oficial de seguretat libanès va confirmar que és la primera vegada que aquests coets s'utilitzen en aquest context. L'Al-Manar, la cadena de Hezbollah, va assegurar que els seus combatents van abatir un globus de vigilància israelià damunt la localitat de Misgaf Am, al nord d'Israel. Prop del poble de Rmeish, un atac aeri israelià va provocar una densa fumera grisa al cel, i des de la llunyania es podien sentir trets d'artilleria. L'Agència Nacional de Notícies del Líban va informar d'atacs aeris a diversos altres pobles fronterers, com Labbouneh i Hibarieh. El portaveu militar israelià Avichay Adraee va escriure a X (abans Twitter) que avions, tancs i artilleria d'Israel van atacar la font dels trets al costat libanès, així com dipòsits d'armes i infraestructures de Hezbollah. Els combats transfronterers han augmentat des que el grup palestí Hamàs va atacar el sud d'Israel el 7 d'octubre, matant més de 1.400 civils i soldats. Com a resposta, Israel ha llançat operacions aèries i terrestres a Gaza, on autoritats sanitàries palestines informen de més de 9.000 morts, majoritàriament civils. Hezbollah va començar a atacar posicions israelianes el 8 d'octubre a la zona disputada de les Granges de Shebaa, pròxima als Alts del Golan ocupats per Israel, i aviat va expandir els atacs a tota la frontera. Dissabte, Hezbollah va afirmar que un dels seus combatents havia mort, i la xifra total de baixes al grup des de l'inici dels combats és de 56. També han mort deu civils, incloent-hi un periodista de Reuters, i diversos combatents palestins.

article_content: Just over half of Americans view Republican control of the House of Representatives as a negative for the country, according to a new CNN/ORC International poll conducted after the recent partial government shutdown. The survey shows more than 60% of Americans believe House Speaker John Boehner should be replaced. The poll was administered shortly after the 16-day partial federal shutdown, which stemmed in part from House conservatives’ efforts to dismantle President Barack Obama’s landmark health care law. According to the results, 54% now say it’s a bad thing that the GOP controls the House—an increase of 11 points since December, soon after the 2012 elections. In contrast, just 38% see GOP control as a good thing, marking a 13-point decline from last year. This is the first time since Republicans regained the House in 2010 that a majority of Americans have described their control as detrimental for the country. CNN Chief National Correspondent John King noted that, with a year remaining until the 2014 midterms, Republicans have time to recover but face significant challenges. The majority of respondents also support replacing Boehner: 63% of all Americans, including roughly half of all Republicans, think he should be replaced. Only 30% believe he should continue as Speaker. Congressional approval suffers similarly, with only 12% approving of Congress’s performance and 86% disapproving—both figures near historic lows. President Obama’s approval stands at 44%, with 52% disapproving. His approval rating did not change during the government shutdown. Forty-four percent of Americans trust Obama more than congressional Republicans on major national issues—a slight decline—while 31% trust Republicans. The percentage expressing confidence in neither rose to 21%, about double the usual level. On health care, just over 40% favor the law, while 56% oppose it. Among opponents, 38% feel the law is too liberal and 12% not liberal enough, indicating that 53% either support the law or would prefer a more liberal approach. These numbers remain consistent with those recorded before the shutdown. The law has faced challenges, especially with the launch of its enrollment website. President Obama acknowledged these issues publicly after the shutdown ended. The poll surveyed 841 adults across the country by telephone and has a margin of error of plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.
translated_content: Segons una nova enquesta de CNN/ORC International realitzada després de l’últim tancament parcial del govern, una mica més de la meitat dels nord-americans veuen el control republicà de la Cambra de Representants com una cosa negativa per al país. L'enquesta mostra que més del 60% dels nord-americans creuen que el president de la Cambra, John Boehner, hauria de ser substituït. L’enquesta es va fer poc després de 16 dies de tancament parcial del govern federal, provocats en part pels intents dels conservadors de la Cambra de desmantellar la llei sanitària emblemàtica del president Barack Obama. Segons els resultats, ara el 54% considera que el control de la Cambra per part dels republicans és negatiu, un augment d’11 punts des del desembre, just després de les eleccions de 2012. Per contra, només el 38% ho veu com una cosa positiva, una davallada de 13 punts respecte l’any anterior. És la primera vegada des que els republicans van recuperar el control de la Cambra el 2010 que la majoria dels nord-americans valoren negativament el seu lideratge. El corresponsal en cap de CNN, John King, ha assenyalat que, tot i que queda un any per a les eleccions de mig mandat del 2014, els republicans tenen temps de recuperar-se però afronten grans reptes. La majoria dels enquestats també donen suport a substituir Boehner: el 63% de tots els nord-americans, inclosa gairebé la meitat dels republicans, creuen que hauria de ser reemplaçat. Només el 30% aposta perquè continuï en el càrrec. L’aprovació del Congrés també és molt baixa: només el 12% aproven la seva feina i el 86% la rebutgen, xifres molt properes als mínims històrics. L’aprovació del president Obama està al 44%, amb un 52% de desaprovació. El seu nivell d’aprovació no ha canviat durant el tancament de govern. El 44% dels nord-americans confien més en Obama que en els republicans del Congrés sobre els grans temes del país, una lleugera baixada, mentre que el 31% confia més en els republicans. El percentatge que declara no confiar en cap dels dos va pujar fins al 21%, el doble de l’habitual. Pel que fa a la sanitat, una mica més del 40% està a favor de la llei, mentre que el 56% hi està en contra. Dels opositors, el 38% opina que la llei és massa progressista i un 12% pensa que no ho és prou, cosa que significa que el 53% la dóna suport o voldria una reforma encara més avançada. Aquests percentatges són similars als d’abans del tancament. La llei ha tingut problemes, especialment pel que fa al llançament del web d’inscripcions. El president Obama va reconèixer aquestes dificultats públicament després del tancament. L’enquesta va recollir l’opinió de 841 adults de tot el país per telèfon i té un marge d’error de més o menys 3,5 punts percentuals.
